title: Smoked Salmon and Avocado Wholegrain Bagels with Dill Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces wholegrain bagel, plain", "120 g smoked salmon, sliced", "1 piece avocado, raw", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 g fresh dill", "20 g red onion", "50 g cucumber", "10 ml lemon juice", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g sesame seeds"]
instructions: Split the bagels and toast them lightly until the cut sides are crisp and warm. Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and black pepper until mostly smooth, then spread it evenly over the bagel halves. Stir the chopped dill into the yogurt and spoon a thin layer over the avocado. Top with the smoked salmon, thinly sliced red onion, and cucumber. Finish with sesame seeds and serve immediately while the bagels are still warm and the topping is fresh.

title: Smoked Salmon and Avocado Wholegrain Bagels with Lemon-Dill Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["2 piece Wholegrain bagel, plain", "120 g Smoked salmon, sliced", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "2 g Dill, fresh", "20 g Cucumber, raw", "20 g Red onion, raw", "10 g Capers, canned, drained", "5 ml Olive oil", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Split the bagels in half and toast them lightly until the cut sides are golden and crisp. In a small bowl, mix the yogurt with the lemon juice and chopped dill, then season with black pepper. Slice the avocado and cucumber thinly, and finely slice the red onion. Brush the warm bagel halves very lightly with olive oil, then spread each half with the lemon-dill yogurt. Top with avocado, smoked salmon, cucumber, red onion, and capers. Serve immediately while the bagels are still warm and the toppings are fresh.

title: Whole Wheat Bagels with Smoked Salmon, Avocado and Herbed Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["240 g whole wheat bagels", "120 g smoked salmon", "100 g avocado", "80 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "30 g cucumber", "20 g red onion", "10 g fresh dill", "10 ml lemon juice", "5 g capers", "2 g black pepper", "2 g chia seeds"]
instructions: Slice the bagels in half and toast them lightly until the cut sides are crisp and warm. In a small bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with the lemon juice, black pepper, and half of the chopped dill. Finely slice the cucumber and red onion. Mash the avocado with a fork until spreadable. Spread the avocado over the toasted bagel halves, then spoon on the herbed yogurt. Top with smoked salmon, cucumber, red onion, capers, and the remaining dill. Finish with chia seeds for a little extra crunch and serve immediately while the bagels are still warm.

title: Smoked Salmon and Avocado Wholegrain Bagels with Lemon Dill Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces wholegrain bagel", "120 g smoked salmon", "100 g avocado", "80 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "10 g lemon juice", "5 g fresh dill", "40 g cucumber", "20 g red onion", "20 g baby spinach", "2 g black pepper", "2 g sesame seeds"]
instructions: Split the bagels and toast them lightly until the cut sides are golden and crisp. In a small bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with the lemon juice and finely chopped dill, then season with black pepper. Slice the avocado thinly, cut the cucumber into ribbons or thin slices, and finely slice the red onion. Spread the lemon dill yogurt over each toasted bagel half, then layer on the baby spinach, cucumber, avocado, red onion, and smoked salmon. Finish with a light sprinkle of sesame seeds and serve immediately while the bagels are still warm and crisp.

title: Smoked Salmon and Avocado Wholegrain Bagels with Lemon Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["2 piece wholegrain bagel", "120 g smoked salmon", "1 piece avocado", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "10 g dill, fresh", "40 g cucumber", "20 g red onion", "1 tbsp capers, drained", "2 g black pepper", "2 g sea salt"]
instructions: Split the bagels and toast them lightly until the cut sides are crisp and warm. In a small bowl, mix the yogurt with the lemon juice and half of the chopped dill until smooth. Peel and slice the avocado, then thinly slice the cucumber and red onion. Spread the lemon yogurt over the toasted bagel halves, top with avocado, cucumber, smoked salmon, and red onion, then scatter over the capers and the remaining dill. Finish with black pepper and a small pinch of sea salt, and serve immediately while the bagels are still warm.

title: Wholegrain Banana Bread with Walnuts and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g banana, raw, ripe", "2 piece egg, whole, raw", "120 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "80 g sugar, brown", "180 g flour, wholemeal wheat", "40 g oats, rolled", "10 g baking powder", "3 g baking soda", "2 g salt, table", "5 g cinnamon, ground", "60 g walnut kernels", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and line a 23 cm loaf tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, mash the bananas until mostly smooth, then whisk in the eggs, yogurt, rapeseed oil, and vanilla extract until well combined. In a separate bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and fold gently until just combined, then stir in most of the walnuts, reserving a few for the top. Pour the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the surface. Sprinkle the remaining walnuts over the top and bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until the loaf is golden brown and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs. Let the bread cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer it to a wire rack and allow it to cool completely before slicing.

title: Wholemeal Banana Bread with Walnuts and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["3 piece Banana, raw", "250 g Wheat flour, wholemeal", "50 g Oats, rolled, dry", "2 piece Egg, raw", "150 g Yogurt, Greek, plain, low fat", "60 ml Oil, rapeseed", "80 g Sugar, brown", "8 g Baking powder", "3 g Baking soda", "2 g Salt", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "1 g Cinnamon, ground", "50 g Walnuts, plain, unsalted", "20 ml Milk, semi-skimmed"]

Leave the bread to cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer it to a wire rack and cool completely before slicing.

title: Wholegrain Buttermilk Biscuits with Chives and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g plain wheat flour", "12 g baking powder", "3 g salt", "25 g cold unsalted butter", "180 ml low-fat buttermilk", "1 piece egg, raw", "25 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "15 g fresh chives", "10 g rolled oats"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, plain flour, baking powder, salt, and rolled oats. Cut the cold butter into the flour mixture with your fingertips until it looks like coarse crumbs. Finely chop the chives and stir them through. In a separate bowl, whisk the buttermilk, egg, and Greek yogurt until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir just until a soft dough forms; do not overmix. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and gently pat it into a 2 cm thick rectangle. Fold it over once or twice for a tender texture, then pat it out again and cut into 8 biscuits. Place them close together on the tray for softer sides or spaced apart for crisper edges. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until risen and golden brown on top. Serve warm.

title: Whole Wheat Buttermilk Biscuits with Chives
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "120 g plain wheat flour", "12 g baking powder", "3 g fine salt", "30 g cold unsalted butter", "10 g olive oil", "240 ml low-fat buttermilk", "1 piece egg, raw", "15 g fresh chives"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, plain flour, baking powder, and salt. Add the cold butter and rub it into the flour with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs with a few small butter pieces left. Stir in the chopped chives. In a separate bowl, beat the egg with the buttermilk and olive oil, then pour it into the flour mixture. Mix gently just until a soft dough forms; do not overwork it. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface, pat it into a rectangle about 2 cm thick, and fold it once or twice for a flaky texture. Press or cut out 8 biscuits and place them close together on the tray for softer sides or spaced apart for crisper edges. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the tops are golden brown and the biscuits feel light and springy. Serve warm.

title: Whole Wheat Yogurt Biscuits with Chives and Honey
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "70 g plain white flour", "12 g baking powder", "3 g salt", "15 g rolled oats", "25 g unsalted butter, chilled", "180 g plain low-fat yogurt", "30 ml skim milk", "15 g fresh chives, chopped", "10 g honey"]

title: Whole Wheat Buttermilk Biscuits with Oats and Chives
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "8 g baking powder", "2 g baking soda", "3 g fine salt", "30 g unsalted butter", "20 g plain low-fat yogurt", "180 ml buttermilk, low fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "15 g chives, fresh"]

title: Whole Wheat Buttermilk Breakfast Biscuits with Oats and Chives
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "80 g plain white flour", "40 g rolled oats", "12 g baking powder", "3 g salt", "30 g cold unsalted butter", "20 ml rapeseed oil", "180 ml low-fat buttermilk", "1 piece egg, raw", "20 g fresh chives"]

title: Whole Wheat Cottage Cheese Blintzes with Warm Berry Compote
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "250 ml low fat milk", "2 piece egg, raw", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "1 g salt", "250 g low fat cottage cheese", "1 piece egg, raw", "15 g honey", "5 ml vanilla extract", "1 g lemon zest", "150 g blueberries, raw", "150 g strawberries, raw", "10 ml lemon juice", "10 g chia seeds"]
instructions: Whisk the whole wheat flour, milk, eggs, rapeseed oil, and salt into a smooth batter, then let it rest for 10 minutes so the flour hydrates. Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and lightly brush it with a little of the oil. Pour in a thin layer of batter and swirl the pan to make a delicate crepe; cook for about 1 minute until the edges lift and the surface looks set, then flip and cook for 20 to 30 seconds more. Repeat with the remaining batter. In a bowl, mix the cottage cheese, egg, honey, vanilla extract, and lemon zest until creamy and well combined. Spoon the filling into the center of each crepe, fold the sides over, and roll them into neat blintzes. Wipe the pan clean, return the blintzes seam-side down, and cook over medium-low heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until lightly golden and heated through. For the compote, warm the blueberries, strawberries, lemon juice, and chia seeds in a small saucepan over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally until the fruit softens and releases juices. Serve the blintzes warm with the berry compote spooned over the top.

title: Wholemeal Spinach and Ricotta Blintzes with Lemon Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal flour", "2 piece egg, raw", "300 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "1 g salt", "200 g ricotta cheese, low fat", "150 g spinach, raw", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp lemon zest", "15 g fresh chives", "120 g plain yogurt, low fat", "20 g honey", "5 ml lemon juice", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Whisk the wholemeal flour, eggs, milk and salt into a smooth batter, then let it rest for 10 minutes so the flour can hydrate. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and brush it lightly with the rapeseed oil. Pour in thin layers of batter and cook each crepe for about 1 to 2 minutes per side, until set and lightly golden. Set the crepes aside on a plate. Meanwhile, wilt the spinach in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until the leaves collapse and most moisture has evaporated, then chop it finely. Mix the ricotta, egg, lemon zest, chives, spinach and black pepper in a bowl until well combined. Spoon the filling onto each crepe, fold in the sides and roll them up to form neat blintzes. Return them seam-side down to the pan over low to medium heat and cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side until warmed through and lightly browned. Stir the yogurt, honey and lemon juice together and serve it spooned over the blintzes while warm.

title: Whole Wheat Blintzes with Lemon Ricotta and Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "2 pieces egg, raw", "300 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "250 g ricotta cheese, light", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "20 g honey", "1 piece lemon zest, fresh", "5 ml vanilla extract", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "10 g butter, unsalted", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, oil, and salt in a bowl until the batter is smooth and slightly thin, then let it rest for 10 minutes so the flour hydrates. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and lightly brush it with a little of the oil. Pour in a small ladle of batter, swirl it into a thin circle, and cook for about 1 minute until the edges lift and the underside is lightly golden. Flip briefly for 20 to 30 seconds, then repeat with the remaining batter. In a separate bowl, mix the ricotta, yogurt, honey, lemon zest, and vanilla until creamy. Spoon the filling onto each crepe, add a few blueberries, fold the sides in, and roll up into blintzes. Warm the butter in the skillet over low heat and briefly turn the filled blintzes in it for 1 to 2 minutes per side until lightly sealed and heated through. Serve immediately with the remaining blueberries on top.

title: Whole Wheat Cottage Cheese Blintzes with Warm Blueberry Compote
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "2 piece egg, raw", "300 ml milk, low fat, 1.5%", "15 ml canola oil", "1 g salt", "250 g cottage cheese, low fat", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "10 g honey", "5 ml vanilla extract", "1 piece lemon zest", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "15 ml water", "5 g chia seeds", "5 g butter, unsalted"]
instructions: Whisk the whole wheat flour, eggs, milk, canola oil, and salt into a smooth batter, then let it rest for 10 minutes so the flour hydrates. Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and lightly brush it with a little oil. Pour in thin layers of batter and swirl the pan to make 8 delicate crêpes, cooking each for about 1 minute on the first side and 20 to 30 seconds on the second side until just set and lightly golden. In a bowl, mix the cottage cheese, yogurt, honey, vanilla extract, and lemon zest until creamy. Spoon the filling into the center of each crêpe, fold the sides over, and roll into neat parcels. For the compote, warm the blueberries, water, chia seeds, and butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat for 4 to 5 minutes until the berries soften and the sauce thickens slightly. Serve the blintzes warm with the blueberry compote spooned over the top.

title: Whole Wheat Cottage Cheese Blintzes with Warm Blueberry Compote
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "2 pieces egg, raw", "250 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "20 ml rapeseed oil", "1 g salt", "250 g cottage cheese, low fat", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 g honey", "5 ml vanilla extract", "1 piece lemon zest, fresh", "120 g blueberries, fresh", "10 ml lemon juice", "10 g chia seeds"]
instructions: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, rapeseed oil, and salt in a bowl until the batter is smooth and thin enough to spread easily. Let it rest for 10 minutes so the flour hydrates. Heat a nonstick pan over medium heat and lightly brush it with a little of the oil. Pour in a small ladle of batter and swirl the pan to make a very thin crepe. Cook for about 1 minute until the underside is lightly golden, then turn and cook for 20 to 30 seconds more. Repeat with the remaining batter. For the filling, mix the cottage cheese, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla, and lemon zest until creamy. Spoon the filling onto the paler side of each crepe, fold in the sides, and roll into neat blintzes. Place them seam-side down in the pan over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes per side until warmed through. For the compote, warm the blueberries and lemon juice in a small saucepan over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes until the berries begin to burst and look syrupy. Serve the blintzes topped with the warm blueberry compote and sprinkle over the chia seeds.

title: Spinach and Black Bean Breakfast Burritos with Avocado Salsa
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Egg, raw", "120 g Egg white, raw", "10 ml Olive oil", "80 g Onion, raw", "120 g Red bell pepper, raw", "100 g Spinach, raw", "200 g Black beans, canned, drained", "2 g Ground cumin", "2 g Smoked paprika", "1 g Black pepper", "2 g Salt", "4 pieces Tortilla, wheat, wholemeal", "120 g Avocado, raw", "80 g Tomato, raw", "20 g Red onion, raw", "10 ml Lime juice", "20 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat"]
instructions: Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry skillet or microwave so they are pliable, then set them aside covered. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the onion and red bell pepper and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1 minute until wilted. Add the black beans, cumin, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt, then cook for 2 minutes until the beans are heated through. In a bowl, whisk the eggs and egg whites until combined. Pour them into the pan and cook over medium-low heat, stirring gently, until just set and still soft, about 3 to 4 minutes. Mix the avocado, tomato, red onion, and lime juice in a small bowl to make a fresh salsa. Divide the egg mixture among the tortillas, top with the avocado salsa and reduced-fat cheddar, then fold into burritos. For a crisper finish, return the wrapped burritos to the skillet and toast each side for 1 to 2 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Spinach, Black Bean and Egg Breakfast Burritos
ingredients_json: ["4 piece Egg, whole, raw", "2 piece Egg white, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "120 g Onion, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "120 g Spinach, raw", "200 g Black beans, canned, drained", "80 g Tomato, raw", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 g Salt, table", "0.5 g Black pepper, ground", "4 piece Tortilla, wholewheat", "60 g Cheese, cheddar, reduced fat", "40 g Avocado, raw", "20 g Salsa, tomato-based"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the onion and red bell pepper and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until softened and lightly browned at the edges. Stir in the black beans, tomato, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, then cook for 2 minutes until the mixture is hot and fragrant. Add the spinach and cook for 1 minute, just until wilted. In a bowl, beat the eggs and egg whites together, then pour them into the pan and reduce the heat to medium-low. Gently stir with a spatula for 2 to 3 minutes until the eggs are softly set and still moist. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave until pliable. Divide the egg mixture among the tortillas, then top with the reduced-fat cheddar, avocado, and salsa. Fold in the sides and roll tightly into burritos. Serve immediately while warm, or wrap in foil for a portable breakfast.

title: Spinach and Black Bean Breakfast Burritos with Salsa and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces whole wheat tortilla wraps", "6 pieces egg, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "150 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "200 g spinach, raw", "240 g black beans, cooked, drained", "120 g tomato salsa", "80 g avocado, raw", "40 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g paprika, sweet", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "20 g plain yogurt, low fat"]
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic, cumin, and paprika and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the spinach and cook until just wilted, then mix in the black beans and half of the salsa and warm through for 2 minutes. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with the salt and black pepper. Heat the remaining olive oil in another pan over medium-low heat and scramble the eggs gently for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring slowly until just set and still soft. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 to 30 seconds per side. Divide the egg mixture, bean filling, avocado slices, and grated cheese among the tortillas, then add a spoonful of yogurt and the remaining salsa. Roll each tortilla tightly into a burrito, folding in the sides as you go. Serve immediately while warm, or wrap in foil and toast briefly in a dry pan for a crisper exterior.

title: Spinach and Black Bean Breakfast Burritos with Salsa
ingredients_json: ["4 piece Egg, whole, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "100 g Spinach, raw", "120 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "80 g Tomato, diced", "40 g Onion, raw", "60 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "2 piece Tortilla, whole wheat, medium", "60 g Avocado", "30 g Salsa, tomato-based", "1 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened and lightly translucent. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1 minute until just wilted. Add the black beans and diced tomato, then cook for another 2 minutes until heated through. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the salt and black pepper. Pour the eggs into the skillet and cook over medium-low heat, stirring gently, until softly set and still moist, about 3 to 4 minutes. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave until pliable. Divide the egg mixture between the tortillas, then top with the cheese, avocado, and salsa. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly into burritos. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Spinach, Black Bean and Salsa Breakfast Burritos
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces whole wheat tortilla", "6 pieces egg, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "150 g onion", "2 cloves garlic", "120 g baby spinach", "240 g black beans, cooked, drained", "120 g tomato salsa", "80 g avocado", "40 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g paprika", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened, then add the garlic, cumin, and paprika and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the black beans and salsa and warm through for 2 minutes, then add the spinach and cook just until wilted. Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper, then heat the remaining olive oil in the pan over medium-low heat and scramble the eggs gently for 3 to 4 minutes until softly set. Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave so they are pliable. Divide the eggs, bean mixture, avocado, and cheese among the tortillas, then roll them up tightly into burritos. If desired, return the burritos seam-side down to a dry pan for 1 minute per side over medium heat to lightly toast and seal them before serving.

title: Spinach, Tomato and Feta Breakfast Casserole
ingredients_json: ["8 pieces Egg, whole, raw", "250 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "200 g Cottage cheese, low fat", "120 g Bread, wholemeal", "200 g Spinach, raw", "150 g Tomato, ripe, raw", "80 g Onion, raw", "100 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Garlic, raw", "3 g Salt, table iodised"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a medium baking dish with a little of the olive oil. Heat the remaining oil in a skillet over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until the spinach has wilted. Spread the bread cubes over the base of the baking dish, then scatter over the cooked vegetables and the chopped tomatoes. Whisk the eggs, milk, cottage cheese, salt, and black pepper together until well combined, then pour the mixture evenly over the bread and vegetables. Crumble the feta over the top. title: Smoky Paprika Breakfast Potatoes with Spinach and Eggs
ingredients_json: ["500 g potatoes, raw, with skin", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp garlic powder", "0.5 tsp ground black pepper", "0.75 tsp salt", "1 medium onion, raw", "150 g red bell pepper, raw", "100 g baby spinach, raw", "4 piece egg, raw", "20 g fresh parsley, raw"]

title: Smoky Paprika Breakfast Potatoes with Spinach and Soft Eggs
ingredients_json: ["500 g potatoes, raw, with skin", "20 ml olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "1 medium red bell pepper, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp ground cumin", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "100 g spinach, raw", "4 piece egg, raw", "15 g parsley, fresh"]

title: Smoky Herb Breakfast Potatoes with Spinach and Poached Egg

title: Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Greek Yogurt and Honey
ingredients_json: ["300 g whole wheat flour", "150 g plain white flour", "7 g dry yeast", "250 ml low-fat milk", "40 g honey", "40 g unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "3 g salt", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "60 g light brown sugar", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "30 g raisins", "20 g chopped walnuts", "15 ml milk", "10 g honey"]

title: Whole Wheat Cinnamon Rolls with Greek Yogurt Vanilla Glaze
ingredients_json: ["300 g whole wheat flour", "100 g plain white flour", "7 g dry yeast", "240 ml semi-skimmed milk", "30 g unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g honey", "3 g salt", "10 g ground cinnamon", "50 g light brown sugar", "20 g raisins", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "20 g cream cheese, light", "10 g icing sugar", "5 ml vanilla extract"]

Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until the top is golden and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. Leave the cornbread to cool for 10 minutes before slicing into squares and serving warm.

title: Lemon Ricotta and Blueberry Danish Pastries
ingredients_json: ["275 g puff pastry, all-butter, chilled", "150 g ricotta cheese, low fat", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "25 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tbsp lemon zest", "15 ml lemon juice, fresh", "120 g blueberries, fresh", "1 piece egg, raw", "10 g wholemeal flour", "15 g flaked almonds", "5 g icing sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix the ricotta, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla, lemon zest, lemon juice, and wholemeal flour until smooth and creamy. Lightly flour the work surface, then roll the puff pastry out and cut it into 6 equal squares. Fold the edges of each square in slightly to form a shallow border, then place the pastries on the tray. Spoon the ricotta filling into the centre of each one and top with a few blueberries. Beat the egg and brush it over the pastry edges for a glossy finish. Scatter the flaked almonds over the top and bake for 16 to 18 minutes, until the pastry is puffed and golden and the filling is just set. Let the danishes cool for 10 minutes, then dust lightly with icing sugar before serving.

title: Wholemeal Apple and Skyr Breakfast Danishes
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal puff pastry", "150 g skyr, plain, low fat", "80 g apple, raw, with skin", "20 g oats, rolled", "15 g honey", "1 tsp cinnamon, ground", "1 piece egg, raw", "10 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "5 g chia seeds", "1 tsp lemon juice", "5 g butter, unsalted"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Finely dice the apple and warm it in a small pan with the butter over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until just softened but still holding its shape. Stir in the oats, cinnamon, chia seeds, lemon juice, and honey, then remove from the heat and let the filling cool slightly. In a bowl, mix the skyr until smooth. Roll out the puff pastry and cut it into 4 equal squares. Score a border about 1 cm from the edge of each square without cutting all the way through, then spoon a little skyr into the center and top with the apple mixture. Beat the egg with the milk and brush the borders lightly. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until the pastry is puffed and golden and the filling looks set. Let the danishes cool for 5 minutes before serving so the skyr firms up slightly.

title: Wholegrain Berry and Skyr Breakfast Danishes
ingredients_json: ["275 g puff pastry, wholemeal", "200 g skyr, plain", "20 g oats, rolled", "15 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 g vanilla extract", "120 g blueberries, fresh", "80 g raspberries, fresh", "10 g chia seeds", "5 g lemon zest, fresh", "15 g almond flakes", "5 ml milk, semi-skimmed"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix the skyr, rolled oats, honey, vanilla extract, and lemon zest until smooth and thick. Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface and cut it into 6 equal rectangles. Score a smaller border around each rectangle without cutting all the way through, then place the pastry pieces on the tray. Spoon the skyr mixture into the centre of each piece and top with blueberries and raspberries. Brush the pastry edges with the beaten egg mixed with the milk, then scatter the almond flakes and chia seeds over the filling. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until the pastry is puffed and deep golden brown and the filling is just set. Let the danishes cool for 10 minutes before serving so the filling firms up slightly.

title: Wholegrain Berry and Skyr Danish Bites with Lemon
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal puff pastry", "200 g skyr, plain", "1 piece egg, raw", "20 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp lemon zest", "120 g blueberries, fresh", "80 g raspberries, fresh", "15 g oats, rolled", "10 g almonds, sliced", "1 tbsp milk, semi-skimmed"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix the skyr, egg, honey, vanilla extract, and lemon zest until smooth and well combined. Roll out the puff pastry and cut it into 6 equal rectangles. Score a small border around each piece, then prick the centres lightly with a fork so they puff around the edges. Spoon the skyr mixture into the middle of each rectangle and spread it evenly, leaving the border clear. Scatter the blueberries and raspberries over the filling, then sprinkle the oats and sliced almonds on top. Brush the pastry borders with the milk. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until the pastry is golden and crisp and the filling is set at the edges. Let the danishes cool for 10 minutes before serving so the filling settles slightly.

title: Whole Wheat Danish Bites with Lemon Ricotta and Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat puff pastry", "200 g low-fat ricotta cheese", "40 g plain Greek yogurt", "30 g honey", "1 piece lemon, zest only", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "100 g fresh blueberries", "1 piece egg, raw", "15 ml skim milk", "10 g sliced almonds", "5 g powdered sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, mix the ricotta, Greek yogurt, honey, lemon zest, and vanilla until smooth and creamy. Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface and cut it into 6 equal squares. Spoon the ricotta mixture into the center of each square, then top with a few blueberries. Fold the corners in slightly to form simple danish shapes and place them on the tray. Whisk the egg with the milk and brush the pastry lightly so it bakes evenly and turns golden. Sprinkle the sliced almonds over the top. Bake for 16 to 20 minutes, until the pastry is puffed and deep golden brown and the filling is just set. Let the danishes cool for 10 minutes, then dust lightly with powdered sugar before serving.

title: Baked Whole-Wheat Banana Oat Doughnuts with Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "80 g ripe banana, mashed", "2 piece egg, raw", "120 g plain yogurt, low fat", "50 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "30 g honey", "20 ml rapeseed oil", "8 g baking powder", "1 g ground cinnamon", "2 g vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt", "40 g plain yogurt, low fat", "15 g icing sugar", "5 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a doughnut tin. In a large bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk together the mashed banana, eggs, yogurt, milk, honey, rapeseed oil, and vanilla extract until smooth. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir just until combined; the batter should be thick but spoonable. Divide the batter evenly among the doughnut moulds and smooth the tops. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the doughnuts are lightly golden and spring back when touched. Let them cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. For the glaze, stir the yogurt, icing sugar, and lemon juice together and drizzle over the cooled doughnuts before serving.

title: Baked Wholemeal Banana Oat Doughnuts with Cinnamon Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g light brown sugar", "8 g baking powder", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt", "2 piece egg, raw", "120 g banana, ripe, peeled", "150 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "40 g yogurt, plain, low-fat", "30 ml rapeseed oil", "5 ml vanilla extract", "100 g yogurt, plain, low-fat", "15 g icing sugar", "1 g ground cinnamon"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a doughnut tin. In a large bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, oats, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. In a separate bowl, mash the banana until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, milk, 40 g yogurt, rapeseed oil and vanilla extract. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined; do not overmix, or the doughnuts will become heavy. Spoon or pipe the batter into the prepared tin, filling each cavity about three-quarters full. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes, until the doughnuts spring back when touched and a skewer comes out clean. Let them cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack. Stir the remaining yogurt with the icing sugar and cinnamon to make a light glaze, then drizzle it over the cooled doughnuts before serving.

title: Baked Oat and Banana Breakfast Doughnuts with Blueberry Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "2 pieces egg, raw", "120 g banana, ripe", "120 g plain yogurt, low fat", "60 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "40 g honey", "25 ml rapeseed oil", "8 g baking powder", "2 g ground cinnamon", "2 g salt", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "100 g blueberries, fresh", "60 g plain yogurt, low fat", "20 g icing sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a doughnut tin. In a bowl, mash the banana until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, yogurt, milk, honey, rapeseed oil, and vanilla extract. In a second bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir just until combined; the batter should be thick but spoonable. Divide the batter evenly among the doughnut cavities and smooth the tops. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the doughnuts are springy to the touch and a skewer comes out clean. Leave them in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool. For the glaze, blend the blueberries with the yogurt and icing sugar until smooth, then spoon or drizzle it over the cooled doughnuts before serving.

title: Baked Oat and Banana Breakfast Doughnuts with Cinnamon Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "2 pieces egg, raw", "120 g ripe banana", "120 ml plain yogurt, low fat", "80 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "40 g honey", "30 ml rapeseed oil", "8 g baking powder", "3 g ground cinnamon", "1 g salt, iodised", "5 ml vanilla extract", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "15 g honey", "2 g ground cinnamon"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a doughnut tin. In a large bowl, mash the banana until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, yogurt, milk, honey, rapeseed oil and vanilla extract until well combined. In a second bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir just until no dry flour remains; do not overmix. Spoon the batter into the doughnut tin, filling each mould about three quarters full. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the doughnuts are risen, golden and spring back when lightly pressed. Leave them in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool. For the glaze, stir the yogurt, honey and cinnamon together until smooth, then spread a thin layer over the cooled doughnuts before serving.

title: Baked Wholemeal Banana Doughnuts with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "40 g rolled oats", "80 g ripe banana, mashed", "60 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "40 g egg, beaten", "40 g honey", "120 ml semi-skimmed milk", "30 ml rapeseed oil", "8 g baking powder", "2 g ground cinnamon", "2 g vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt", "50 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "15 g icing sugar", "10 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a doughnut tin. In a large bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, mix the mashed banana, Greek yogurt, beaten egg, honey, milk, rapeseed oil, and vanilla until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir gently just until combined; do not overmix. Spoon the batter into the doughnut tin, filling each cavity about three quarters full. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the doughnuts are springy to the touch and a skewer inserted in the thickest part comes out clean. Leave them in the tin for 5 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely. For the glaze, stir the Greek yogurt, icing sugar, and lemon juice together until smooth, then drizzle over the cooled doughnuts before serving.

title: Wholegrain English Muffins with Spinach, Tomato and Poached Egg
ingredients_json: ["2 wholegrain English muffins", "2 piece egg, raw", "60 g baby spinach", "80 g tomato", "20 g red onion", "10 g olive oil", "30 g cottage cheese, low fat", "1 g black pepper", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Split the English muffins and toast them until golden and crisp. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat, then add the sliced red onion and cook for 2 minutes until softened. Add the spinach and cook for 30 to 60 seconds, just until wilted, then stir in the diced tomato and warm it through briefly. In a small saucepan, bring water to a gentle simmer and poach the eggs for about 3 minutes, until the whites are set but the yolks remain soft. Spread the cottage cheese over the toasted muffin halves, spoon on the spinach and tomato mixture, and top each portion with a poached egg. Finish with black pepper and a light sprinkle of salt before serving immediately.

title: Wholegrain English Muffins with Spinach, Poached Egg and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["2 wholemeal English muffins", "2 piece egg, raw", "60 g baby spinach, raw", "50 g avocado, raw", "20 g tomato, raw", "10 g red onion, raw", "5 g olive oil", "15 g low-fat plain yogurt", "5 ml lemon juice", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g iodized salt"]
instructions: Split the English muffins and toast them until lightly golden and crisp at the edges. Warm the olive oil in a small pan over medium heat, add the red onion and tomato, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until softened. Add the spinach and stir just until wilted, then season with the salt and black pepper. In a separate saucepan, bring water to a gentle simmer and poach the eggs for about 3 minutes until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft. Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and yogurt until creamy. Spread the avocado mixture over the toasted muffin halves, top with the spinach and tomato mixture, then finish with one poached egg on each serving. Serve immediately while the muffins are warm and the yolks are runny.

title: Whole Wheat English Muffins with Spinach, Egg and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["2 whole wheat English muffins", "2 piece egg, raw", "60 g spinach, raw", "50 g avocado, raw", "20 g low-fat cheddar cheese", "10 ml olive oil", "1 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g lemon juice"]
instructions: Split the English muffins and toast them until lightly golden and crisp. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat, add the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until just wilted. Push the spinach to one side of the pan, crack in the eggs, and cook gently over medium-low heat until the whites are set and the yolks are still slightly soft, or cook longer if you prefer them firmer. Season the eggs and spinach with the salt and black pepper. Mash the avocado with the lemon juice in a small bowl, then spread it over the toasted muffin halves. Top with the wilted spinach, a little grated or thinly sliced cheddar, and the cooked eggs. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Spinach, Egg and Avocado English Muffins with Tomato
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces English muffin, wholemeal", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "60 g Spinach, raw", "50 g Avocado, raw", "80 g Tomato, raw", "10 g Onion, raw", "10 ml Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "10 g Lemon juice, raw"]
instructions: Split the English muffins and toast them until lightly golden. Warm the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat, then add the onion and cook for 2 minutes until softened. Add the spinach and stir for 30 to 60 seconds until just wilted. Push the vegetables to one side of the pan, crack in the eggs, and cook them gently over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks are still slightly soft, or longer if preferred. Mash the avocado with the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, then spread it over the toasted muffin halves. Top with the spinach, eggs, and sliced tomato, then serve immediately while warm.

title: Wholegrain English Muffins with Spinach, Tomato and Poached Egg
ingredients_json: ["2 wholegrain English muffins", "2 pieces egg, raw", "80 g spinach, raw", "80 g tomato, raw", "20 g onion, raw", "10 g olive oil", "30 g avocado", "20 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese", "1 g black pepper", "2 g iodized salt", "5 g lemon juice"]
instructions: Split the English muffins and toast them until lightly golden and crisp. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat, then add the onion and cook for 2 minutes until softened. Add the spinach and tomato and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until the spinach wilts and the tomato just begins to soften. Season with the salt, black pepper, and lemon juice. Meanwhile, bring a small saucepan of water to a gentle simmer and poach the eggs for about 3 minutes, until the whites are set but the yolks are still soft. Mash the avocado lightly and spread it over the warm muffin halves. Top with the spinach and tomato mixture, add the poached eggs, and finish with the grated cheddar so it melts slightly from the heat.

title: Wholegrain Banana French Toast with Greek Yogurt and Berries
ingredients_json: ["4 slices wholegrain bread", "2 pieces egg, raw", "120 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 medium banana, raw", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "10 g butter, unsalted", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "100 g blueberries, raw", "50 g strawberries, raw", "10 g honey"]
instructions: Mash half of the banana in a shallow bowl, then whisk it with the eggs, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla until smooth. Dip each slice of bread into the mixture and let it soak for a few seconds on each side so it absorbs the custard without falling apart. Heat the butter in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Cook the bread for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden brown and lightly crisp at the edges, lowering the heat slightly if it browns too quickly. Slice the remaining banana and the strawberries. Serve the French toast topped with Greek yogurt, berries, banana slices, and a drizzle of honey.

title: Wholegrain Banana French Toast with Cinnamon and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["4 slices wholegrain bread", "2 pieces egg, raw", "100 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 medium banana", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "10 g butter, unsalted", "100 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "80 g blueberries, fresh", "10 g honey"]
instructions: Mash the banana in a bowl until smooth, then whisk it together with the eggs, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla extract until well combined. Place a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and melt the butter. Dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture, letting it soak for a few seconds on each side without becoming too soggy. Cook the bread in the hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until golden brown and cooked through. Serve the French toast warm with the yogurt, blueberries, and a drizzle of honey on top.

title: Wholemeal Banana French Toast with Greek Yogurt and Berries
ingredients_json: ["4 slices wholemeal bread", "2 pieces egg, raw", "120 ml semi-skimmed milk", "1 medium banana", "5 ml vanilla extract", "2 g ground cinnamon", "10 g unsalted butter", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "100 g blueberries", "50 g strawberries", "10 ml honey"]
instructions: Mash the banana in a shallow bowl until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, milk, vanilla extract and cinnamon until well combined. Dip each slice of wholemeal bread into the mixture for about 20 seconds per side so it absorbs the custard without falling apart. Heat the butter in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Cook the soaked bread for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until deeply golden, lightly crisp at the edges and cooked through. Serve the French toast warm with Greek yogurt, blueberries, sliced strawberries and a drizzle of honey.

title: Wholemeal French Toast with Greek Yogurt and Berries
ingredients_json: ["4 slices wholemeal bread", "2 pieces egg, raw", "120 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "10 g plain Greek yogurt", "5 g honey", "2 g ground cinnamon", "5 ml vanilla extract", "10 g butter, unsalted", "100 g mixed berries, fresh", "10 g chia seeds", "5 ml maple syrup"]
instructions: In a shallow bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk, Greek yogurt, honey, cinnamon, and vanilla until smooth. Dip each slice of bread into the mixture for about 20 seconds per side so it absorbs the custard without falling apart. Heat the butter in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat until it foams gently. Cook the soaked bread for 2 to 3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and lightly crisp at the edges. Reduce the heat slightly if it browns too fast. Serve the French toast warm with the mixed berries, sprinkle over the chia seeds, and finish with the maple syrup.

title: Wholemeal French Toast with Greek Yogurt, Banana and Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["4 slices wholemeal bread", "2 pieces egg, raw", "150 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "10 g butter, unsalted", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 medium banana", "80 g blueberries", "10 g honey"]
instructions: In a shallow bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla until smooth. Dip each slice of wholemeal bread into the mixture for a few seconds on each side so it absorbs the custard without falling apart. Heat the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat, then cook the bread for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden brown and lightly crisp at the edges. Serve the French toast warm with the Greek yogurt, sliced banana, blueberries, and a drizzle of honey on top.

title: Spinach, Tomato and Feta Frittata with Herbs
ingredients_json: ["8 piece Egg, whole, raw", "120 g Spinach, raw", "150 g Tomato, raw", "80 g Feta cheese", "60 g Onion, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "30 ml Milk, semi-skimmed, unspecified", "2 g Parsley, fresh", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees C. Warm 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium heat, then add the onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Add the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted, then stir in the tomatoes and cook for another minute so some of their moisture evaporates. In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, black pepper and chopped parsley until well combined. Crumble in the feta and gently stir through. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet over the vegetables and cook on low to medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until the edges begin to set. Drizzle over the remaining olive oil, then transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until puffed, set in the center and lightly golden on top. Let the frittata rest for 5 minutes before slicing into portions.

title: Spinach, Tomato and Feta Oven Frittata
ingredients_json: ["8 piece Egg, raw", "60 ml Milk, semi-skimmed, unspecified", "120 g Spinach, raw", "150 g Tomato, red, raw", "80 g Onion, raw", "60 g Feta cheese", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "10 g Chives, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Heat the olive oil in an ovenproof non-stick frying pan over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Add the spinach and cook for 1 minute, just until wilted. Stir in the chopped tomatoes and cook for another minute to remove some excess moisture. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and black pepper until evenly combined. Spread the vegetables evenly in the pan, pour over the egg mixture, and crumble the feta on top. Cook gently on the hob for 2 to 3 minutes until the edges begin to set, then transfer the pan to the oven. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the centre is just set and no longer runny. Let the frittata rest for 5 minutes before slicing, then finish with the chopped chives and serve warm.

title: Spinach, Tomato and Feta Oven Frittata
ingredients_json: ["8 piece Egg, raw", "60 ml Milk, semi-skimmed, unspecified", "120 g Spinach, raw", "150 g Tomato, red, raw", "80 g Cheese, feta", "60 g Onion, yellow, raw", "10 ml Olive oil", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and place a rack in the middle position. Heat the olive oil in a 24 cm ovenproof skillet over medium heat, then add the sliced onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened and lightly translucent. Add the spinach and cook for about 1 minute, just until wilted. Stir in the chopped tomatoes and cook for another 2 minutes so some of the excess moisture evaporates. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and black pepper until well combined. Reduce the heat to low, spread the vegetables evenly in the pan, and pour the egg mixture over them. Crumble the feta on top and cook undisturbed for 2 to 3 minutes until the edges begin to set. Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the center is just set and no longer runny. Let the frittata rest for 5 minutes before slicing into wedges.

title: Spinach, Mushroom and Feta Frittata
ingredients_json: ["6 piece Egg, raw", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed, unspecified", "150 g Mushroom, raw", "80 g Spinach, raw", "60 g Onion, raw", "50 g Feta cheese", "10 ml Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "10 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees C. Heat the olive oil in an ovenproof frying pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 3 minutes until softened. Add the mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they release their moisture and begin to brown. Add the spinach and cook for 1 minute until just wilted. In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper until well combined. Spread the vegetables evenly in the pan, then pour the egg mixture over the top. Crumble the feta over the surface and cook on low heat for 2 to 3 minutes until the edges begin to set. Transfer the pan to the oven and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the center is just set and the top is lightly golden. Rest for 5 minutes, then scatter with chopped parsley and cut into wedges to serve.

title: Spinach, Tomato and Feta Oven-Baked Frittata
ingredients_json: ["6 piece Egg, raw", "2 dl Milk, semi-skimmed, unspecified", "150 g Spinach, raw", "120 g Tomato, raw", "80 g Onion, yellow, raw", "80 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "10 ml Olive oil", "2 g Garlic, raw", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Heat the olive oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened but not browned. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the spinach and cook just until wilted. Scatter the chopped tomatoes evenly over the vegetables. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and black pepper until well combined. Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and gently shake the pan so it settles around the vegetables. Crumble the feta over the top. Cook on the stovetop for 2 to 3 minutes over medium-low heat until the edges begin to set, then transfer the skillet to the oven. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the center is just set and the top is lightly golden. Let the frittata rest for 5 minutes before slicing into wedges and serving.

title: Cinnamon Almond Granola with Pumpkin Seeds and Dried Apricots
ingredients_json: ["250 g rolled oats", "50 g almonds", "40 g pumpkin seeds", "30 g sunflower seeds", "25 g chia seeds", "40 g unsweetened shredded coconut", "30 g sesame seeds", "60 g honey", "35 g rapeseed oil", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt", "80 g dried apricots", "30 g raisins"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°C and line a large baking tray with baking paper. Roughly chop the almonds so the granola gets a mix of crunchy clusters and smaller pieces. In a large bowl, combine the oats, almonds, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, chia seeds, shredded coconut, sesame seeds, cinnamon, and salt. Warm the honey and rapeseed oil together for 20 to 30 seconds if needed so they blend easily, then pour over the dry ingredients and stir well until everything is evenly coated. Spread the mixture out in an even layer on the tray and bake for 18 to 22 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until lightly golden and fragrant. Let the granola cool completely on the tray so it crisps up, then mix through the chopped dried apricots and raisins. Store in an airtight container and serve with yogurt, milk, or fruit.

title: Honey Almond Oat Granola with Pumpkin Seeds and Dried Apricots
ingredients_json: ["200 g rolled oats", "60 g almonds", "40 g pumpkin seeds", "30 g sunflower seeds", "25 g flaxseeds", "40 g unsweetened shredded coconut", "35 g honey", "30 ml rapeseed oil", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "60 g dried apricots", "40 g raisins"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 degrees C and line a large baking tray with baking paper. Roughly chop the almonds so the granola has a mix of textures. In a large bowl, combine the oats, almonds, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, flaxseeds, shredded coconut, cinnamon, and salt. Warm the honey and rapeseed oil together for a few seconds until just runny, then stir well and pour over the dry mixture. Mix thoroughly until everything is evenly coated. Spread the granola out in a thin, even layer on the tray and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring once halfway through so it browns evenly. Remove it when it is golden and fragrant, then let it cool completely on the tray so it crisps up. Once cooled, stir in the chopped dried apricots and raisins. Store in an airtight container and serve with milk or yogurt.

title: Cinnamon Almond Granola with Pumpkin Seeds and Dried Apricots
ingredients_json: ["250 g rolled oats", "60 g raw almonds", "40 g pumpkin seeds", "30 g sunflower seeds", "25 g unsweetened shredded coconut", "25 g chia seeds", "35 g honey", "25 ml rapeseed oil", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 g salt", "80 g dried apricots", "50 g raisins", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 C and line a large baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, chopped almonds, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, shredded coconut, chia seeds, cinnamon, and salt. title: Cinnamon Almond Granola with Oats, Pumpkin Seeds and Raisins
ingredients_json: ["300 g rolled oats", "80 g almonds", "50 g pumpkin seeds", "30 g sunflower seeds", "40 g unsweetened shredded coconut", "60 g raisins", "45 g honey", "30 ml rapeseed oil", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "5 ml vanilla extract"]

title: Cinnamon Almond Oat Granola with Pumpkin Seeds and Dried Apricots
ingredients_json: ["300 g rolled oats", "80 g raw almonds", "50 g pumpkin seeds", "30 g sunflower seeds", "40 g unsweetened shredded coconut", "40 g dried apricots", "30 g honey", "30 ml rapeseed oil", "1 tbsp maple syrup", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]

title: Creamy Cheddar Grits with Spinach, Tomato and Poached Egg

title: Creamy Spinach and Egg Grits with Tomato

title: Savory Spinach and Mushroom Grits with Poached Egg

title: Creamy Spinach and Poached Egg Grits with Cherry Tomatoes

title: Whole Wheat Turkey and Spinach Breakfast Kolache
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat flour", "150 g plain white flour", "7 g dried yeast", "12 g sugar", "4 g salt", "200 ml low-fat milk", "60 ml water", "30 g butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "180 g lean turkey breast, cooked", "80 g low-fat cottage cheese", "60 g spinach, fresh", "40 g onion, diced", "20 g red bell pepper, diced", "15 ml olive oil", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g dried oregano"]

Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces, flatten each piece into a small oval, place a spoonful of filling in the center, and pinch the edges together firmly. Let them cool for a few minutes before serving warm.

title: Whole Wheat Turkey and Spinach Breakfast Kolaches

title: Whole Wheat Turkey and Spinach Breakfast Kolache

title: Whole Wheat Turkey and Spinach Breakfast Kolache
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat flour", "150 g plain white flour", "7 g instant yeast", "10 g sugar", "5 g salt", "180 ml skim milk", "60 ml water", "20 g olive oil", "1 piece egg, raw", "150 g low-fat cottage cheese", "200 g turkey breast, cooked, chopped", "80 g spinach, raw", "60 g onion, raw", "40 g red bell pepper, raw", "50 g reduced-fat cheese, grated", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g dried oregano", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "10 ml water"]

title: Whole Wheat Turkey and Spinach Breakfast Kolache

title: Wholegrain Cinnamon Apple Monkey Bread with Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["500 g wholemeal bread dough", "2 medium apples", "40 g rolled oats", "30 g walnuts", "40 g raisins", "25 g light brown sugar", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp ground cardamom", "30 g unsalted butter", "150 g plain low-fat yogurt", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 tbsp honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt"]

title: Wholemeal Cinnamon Apple Monkey Bread with Greek Yogurt Glaze

title: Wholegrain Cinnamon Banana Monkey Bread with Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholemeal wheat flour", "7 g dry yeast", "250 ml milk, low fat", "40 g rapeseed oil", "50 g honey", "2 pieces egg, raw", "1 g salt", "180 g banana, raw", "2 g ground cinnamon", "30 g brown sugar", "20 g oat bran", "200 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "15 ml lemon juice", "5 ml vanilla extract", "10 g pumpkin seeds"]

title: Warm Cinnamon Apple Wholemeal Monkey Bread
ingredients_json: ["350 g wholemeal wheat flour", "7 g dry yeast", "200 ml semi-skimmed milk", "1 piece egg, raw", "35 g rapeseed oil", "25 g honey", "3 g salt", "2 medium apple", "40 g raisins", "40 g walnuts", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "30 g light brown sugar", "20 g butter, unsalted", "10 g oats, rolled"]

title: Cinnamon Apple Greek Yogurt Monkey Bread

title: Banana Oat and Blueberry Breakfast Muffins

title: Banana Oat Blueberry Breakfast Muffins
