Remove the pan from the heat and let the oatmeal rest for 1 minute to thicken further. Divide into bowls, top with the Greek yogurt, remaining apple, walnuts, chia seeds, and honey, and serve warm.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Apple Oatmeal with Greek Yogurt and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["80 g rolled oats", "300 ml semi-skimmed milk", "200 ml water", "1 medium apple", "15 g walnuts", "100 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "10 g chia seeds", "8 g honey", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Place the oats, milk, water, cinnamon, and salt in a medium saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring often so the oats do not catch on the bottom. Reduce the heat to low and cook for about 5 minutes, until the oats are soft and the mixture is creamy but still spoonable. Meanwhile, core the apple and cut it into small dice. Stir the apple into the oatmeal during the last 2 minutes of cooking so it softens slightly but still keeps some texture. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the chia seeds and honey. Spoon the oatmeal into two bowls, top with the Greek yogurt and walnuts, and serve warm.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Oatmeal with Banana, Chia and Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["80 g rolled oats", "400 ml low-fat milk", "200 ml water", "1 piece banana", "100 g blueberries", "15 g chia seeds", "15 g almond butter", "5 g ground cinnamon", "10 g honey", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Combine the oats, milk, water, and salt in a medium saucepan and set it over medium heat. Stir frequently and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 5 to 7 minutes until the oats are soft and the porridge is creamy. Slice the banana and fold about half into the oatmeal during the last minute of cooking so it softens slightly. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the cinnamon and chia seeds. Spoon the oatmeal into bowls, top with the remaining banana, blueberries, almond butter, and drizzle with honey. Serve immediately while warm and thick.

title: Creamy Apple-Cinnamon Oatmeal with Greek Yogurt and Chia
ingredients_json: ["80 g rolled oats", "400 ml semi-skimmed milk", "200 ml water", "1 piece apple, with skin", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "15 g chia seeds", "10 g ground flaxseed", "15 g honey", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Place the oats, milk, water, and salt in a medium saucepan and bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring often, until the oats are soft and the mixture is creamy. Grate or finely dice the apple, then stir most of it into the porridge during the last 2 minutes so it softens slightly but still keeps some texture. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the cinnamon, chia seeds, and ground flaxseed. Spoon the oatmeal into bowls, top with the Greek yogurt, the remaining apple, and drizzle with honey before serving warm.

title: Spinach and Mushroom Omelet with Feta and Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["3 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Spinach, raw", "60 g Mushroom, button, raw", "40 g Tomato, raw", "25 g Cheese, feta", "15 g Onion, raw", "10 ml Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Slice the mushrooms, onion, and tomato. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 2 minutes until softened. Add the mushrooms and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until they release their moisture and start to brown. Stir in the spinach and cook for 30 seconds until just wilted. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the salt and black pepper. Pour the eggs into the skillet over medium-low heat and tilt the pan so the mixture spreads evenly. Let it cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the edges begin to set, then gently lift the edges so uncooked egg can flow underneath. When the top is mostly set but still slightly moist, scatter the tomato and feta over one half of the omelet. Fold the other half over the filling and cook for 30 seconds more, then slide onto a plate and serve warm.

title: Spinach and Mushroom Omelet with Feta and Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["4 piece Egg, raw", "60 g Spinach, raw", "80 g Mushroom, button, raw", "50 g Tomato, raw", "30 g Cheese, feta", "15 ml Olive oil", "30 ml Milk, low fat, 1.5%", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and black pepper until well combined. Heat the olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat, then add the mushrooms and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until they release their moisture and start to brown. Add the spinach and tomato and cook for 1 minute more, just until the spinach wilts. Pour the egg mixture into the pan and tilt the skillet so it spreads evenly. Cook gently over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes until the edges are set and the center is still slightly soft. Sprinkle the feta over one half of the omelet, fold the other half over it, and cook for 1 minute more until the cheese begins to soften. Slide onto a plate and serve warm.

title: Spinach and Tomato Omelet with Feta and Wholegrain Toast
ingredients_json: ["4 piece Egg, whole, raw", "50 g Spinach, raw", "80 g Tomato, red, raw", "40 g Cheese, feta", "10 g Onion, raw", "10 ml Olive oil", "20 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "40 g Bread, wholemeal"]
instructions: Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and black pepper until well combined. Heat the olive oil in a nonstick frying pan over medium heat, then add the onion and cook for 1 minute until softened. Add the spinach and tomato and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes, just until the spinach wilts and the tomato starts to release its juices. Pour the egg mixture into the pan and reduce the heat to medium-low. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, gently lifting the edges so the uncooked egg can flow underneath, until the omelet is nearly set on top. Crumble the feta over one half, fold the omelet in half, and cook for 30 to 60 seconds more until the cheese begins to soften. Serve immediately with the wholemeal bread, lightly toasted if desired.

title: Spinach and Mushroom Omelet with Feta
ingredients_json: ["3 piece Egg, raw", "50 g Spinach, raw", "70 g Mushroom, cultivated, raw", "30 g Cheese, feta", "15 g Onion, raw", "10 ml Olive oil", "20 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and black pepper in a bowl until well combined. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat, then add the onion and mushrooms and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened and lightly browned. Add the spinach and stir for about 30 seconds until it just wilts. Pour the egg mixture into the pan and tilt it so the eggs spread evenly. Cook over medium-low heat for 2 to 3 minutes, lifting the edge gently once or twice so the uncooked egg can flow underneath. When the top is mostly set but still slightly glossy, crumble the feta over one half of the omelet, fold it over, and cook for another 30 seconds before serving.

title: Spinach and Mushroom Omelet with Feta and Chives
ingredients_json: ["4 piece Egg, raw", "60 g Spinach, raw", "80 g Mushrooms, button, raw", "40 g Cheese, feta", "30 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "10 g Onion, raw", "5 ml Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Chives, fresh"]
instructions: Slice the mushrooms and finely chop the onion and chives. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 1 minute until softened. Add the mushrooms and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until they release their moisture and begin to brown. Stir in the spinach and cook for about 30 seconds until just wilted, then transfer the vegetables to a plate. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the milk, salt, and black pepper until evenly combined. Return the skillet to medium-low heat, pour in the egg mixture, and cook gently for 2 to 3 minutes, lifting the edges as they set. When the top is still slightly soft, scatter over the vegetables and crumble on the feta. Fold the omelet in half and cook for another 30 to 60 seconds until the center is just set but still tender. Slide onto plates and finish with the chopped chives.

title: Fluffy Oat and Banana Pancakes with Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "2 pieces egg, raw", "180 g banana, raw", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "80 g plain yogurt, low-fat", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g salt, table", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "100 g blueberries, raw", "10 g honey"]
instructions: Blend the oats into a coarse flour, then add the eggs, banana, milk, yogurt, baking powder, and salt. Blend until smooth and let the batter rest for 5 minutes so the oats can hydrate. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and brush it lightly with rapeseed oil. Spoon in small portions of batter and cook for about 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set. Flip carefully and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until golden and cooked through. Serve the pancakes warm topped with blueberries and a light drizzle of honey.

title: Oat and Banana Pancakes with Blueberries and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["80 g rolled oats", "100 g wholemeal wheat flour", "2 piece egg, raw", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 piece banana, raw", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "100 g blueberries, raw", "10 g honey", "8 g baking powder", "2 g ground cinnamon", "10 ml rapeseed oil"]
instructions: Blend the oats into a fine flour, then combine them in a bowl with the wholemeal flour, baking powder, and cinnamon. Mash the banana until smooth and whisk it with the eggs, milk, and half of the Greek yogurt. Stir the wet ingredients into the dry mixture until just combined; the batter should be thick but still pourable. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and brush it lightly with the rapeseed oil. Spoon small rounds of batter into the pan and cook for about 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges look set, then flip and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until golden brown. Repeat with the remaining batter, lowering the heat slightly if the pancakes brown too quickly. Serve the pancakes topped with the remaining Greek yogurt, blueberries, and honey.

title: Wholemeal Banana Oat Pancakes with Blueberries and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["80 g wholemeal wheat flour", "50 g rolled oats", "1 piece banana, raw", "2 piece egg, raw", "200 ml semi-skimmed milk", "100 g plain yogurt, low fat", "100 g blueberries, raw", "10 g honey", "8 g baking powder", "2 g ground cinnamon", "2 g salt", "10 ml rapeseed oil"]
instructions: Place the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt in a large bowl and mix well. Mash the banana in a separate bowl, then whisk it with the eggs, milk, and yogurt until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined; do not overmix. Fold in half of the blueberries. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and brush it lightly with the rapeseed oil. Spoon the batter into the pan to make small pancakes and cook for about 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set. Flip carefully and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. Serve warm with the remaining blueberries and drizzle with honey.

title: Wholegrain Banana Oat Pancakes with Blueberries and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "2 pieces egg, raw", "250 ml semi-skimmed milk", "1 piece banana, raw", "100 g plain low-fat yogurt", "100 g blueberries, raw", "10 g baking powder", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "15 ml maple syrup", "1 g salt", "2 g ground cinnamon"]
instructions: Mash the banana in a large bowl until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, milk, yogurt, rapeseed oil, and maple syrup. In a separate bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined; the batter should be thick but spoonable. Let it rest for 5 minutes so the oats soften. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly brush it with a little of the oil from the recipe. Spoon in small rounds of batter and cook for about 2 to 3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to set. Flip carefully and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. Serve warm with the blueberries scattered over the top and an extra spoonful of yogurt if desired.

title: Wholegrain Banana Pancakes with Blueberries and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "40 g rolled oats", "1 piece egg, raw", "200 ml semi-skimmed milk", "1 piece banana, raw", "100 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "80 g blueberries, raw", "10 g honey", "10 ml rapeseed oil", "4 g baking powder", "1 g ground cinnamon", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Mash the banana in a mixing bowl until smooth, then whisk in the egg, milk, and yogurt until well combined. In a separate bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture and let the batter rest for 5 minutes so the oats soften. Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and brush it lightly with the rapeseed oil. Spoon the batter into the pan to make small pancakes, cooking each one for about 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges look set. Flip carefully and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until golden and cooked through. Serve warm with the blueberries scattered over the top and drizzle with honey.

title: Wholemeal Spinach and Herb Popovers with Soft Egg
ingredients_json: ["100 g wholemeal flour", "50 g plain white flour", "2 piece egg, raw", "250 ml semi-skimmed milk", "50 ml water", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "80 g baby spinach", "20 g spring onion", "10 g fresh parsley", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "4 piece egg, raw", "20 g reduced-fat feta cheese"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees C and place a 12-hole muffin tin inside to heat for at least 10 minutes. In a bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, white flour, 2 eggs, milk, water, salt, and black pepper until smooth. Stir in the finely chopped spinach, spring onion, and parsley. Remove the hot tin from the oven and carefully divide the rapeseed oil between 6 of the holes, coating the base and sides. Pour the batter evenly into the hot tin, filling each hole about halfway. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes without opening the oven, until the popovers are deeply risen, golden, and crisp around the edges. While they bake, roast the cherry tomatoes in a hot oven for 10 to 12 minutes until softened and lightly blistered. For the eggs, poach or soft-boil the remaining 4 eggs so the yolks stay runny. Split the popovers, fill each with a little roasted tomato, top with a soft egg, and finish with crumbled reduced-fat feta.

title: Wholemeal Spinach and Herb Popovers with Soft Egg Center
ingredients_json: ["120 g Wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g Plain wheat flour", "3 pieces Egg, raw", "250 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "100 ml Water", "150 g Spinach, raw", "20 g Spring onion, raw", "10 g Chives, fresh", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "80 g Cottage cheese, low fat", "120 g Tomato, raw", "5 g Butter, unsalted"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and place a 12-cup muffin tin inside so it gets very hot. Lightly brush each cup with half of the olive oil and add a small piece of butter to each cup. Whisk the eggs, milk, water, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl until smooth. Add the wholemeal flour and plain flour and whisk just until the batter is combined and slightly airy; a few small lumps are fine. Stir in the finely chopped spinach, spring onion, and chives. Carefully remove the hot tin from the oven and divide the batter evenly between the cups, filling each one about two-thirds full. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes without opening the oven, until the popovers are tall, deeply golden, and crisp on the edges. While they bake, mix the cottage cheese with the chopped tomato and the remaining olive oil. Serve the popovers immediately, split them open if desired, and spoon the tomato and cottage cheese mixture into the centers while they are still warm and crisp.

title: Wholemeal Spinach and Feta Popovers with Herb Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g plain wheat flour", "3 piece egg, raw", "300 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "60 ml water", "20 g spinach, raw", "40 g feta cheese, reduced fat", "10 ml rapeseed oil", "1 g salt, iodised", "1 g black pepper, ground", "100 g yogurt, natural, low fat", "10 g chives, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and place a metal muffin tin inside so it gets very hot. Finely chop the spinach and chives, and crumble the feta. In a large bowl whisk the eggs, milk, water, flour, salt, and black pepper until smooth, then stir in the spinach and feta. Leave the batter to rest for 10 minutes so the flour hydrates and the popovers rise better. Carefully remove the hot tin, brush the cups with the rapeseed oil, and divide the batter evenly among 6 cups, filling each about two thirds full. Bake for 20 minutes without opening the oven, then reduce the temperature to 190 C and bake for another 8 to 10 minutes until the popovers are puffed, deep golden, and crisp on the outside. Mix the yogurt with the chopped chives and serve alongside the warm popovers immediately.

title: Wholemeal Spinach and Mushroom Popovers with Herb Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["3 piece Egg, raw", "150 g Wheat flour, wholemeal", "250 ml Milk, low fat, 1.5% fat", "80 ml Water", "10 g Butter, unsalted", "120 g Spinach, raw", "100 g Mushrooms, raw", "40 g Onion, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "120 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 g Chives, fresh", "2 g Salt, iodized", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "20 g Cheese, hard, reduced fat"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and place a 12-cup muffin tin inside so it gets very hot. Whisk the eggs, milk, water, wholemeal flour, and salt until smooth, then let the batter rest for 15 minutes. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, add the onion and mushrooms, and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until softened and lightly browned. Stir in the spinach for 1 minute until wilted, then remove from the heat and season with black pepper. Carefully remove the hot tin from the oven and add a small amount of butter to each cup so it melts and coats the base. Divide the batter evenly among 6 cups, then spoon the vegetable mixture into the centers and scatter the reduced-fat cheese on top. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes without opening the oven door until the popovers are tall, crisp, and deeply golden. Mix the yogurt with the chopped chives while the popovers bake. Serve immediately with the herb yogurt spooned alongside.

title: Wholemeal Spinach and Herb Popovers with Tomato Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "120 g plain wheat flour", "3 pieces egg, raw", "300 ml semi-skimmed milk", "100 ml water", "10 ml rapeseed oil", "80 g spinach, raw", "15 g chives, fresh", "2 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "120 g cherry tomatoes", "20 g cucumber", "5 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and place a 12-cup muffin tin inside so it becomes very hot. In a jug, whisk together the eggs, milk, water, flour, salt, and black pepper until smooth, then rest the batter for 15 minutes. Finely chop the spinach and chives and stir them into the batter. Carefully remove the hot tin, brush each cup lightly with the rapeseed oil, and pour the batter into 8 cups, filling each about halfway. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes without opening the oven door, until the popovers are deeply risen, golden, and crisp. Lower the oven to 180 C if they are browning too quickly. Meanwhile, mix the yogurt with the lemon juice, then dice the cherry tomatoes and cucumber and fold them through. Serve the popovers immediately with the tomato yogurt alongside.

title: Crispy Potato Pancakes with Spinach, Onion and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["400 g potatoes, raw", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 g wholemeal flour", "50 g onion, raw", "50 g spinach, raw", "2 tbsp rapeseed oil", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "2 g salt", "1 g ground black pepper"]
instructions: Peel the potatoes and grate them finely, then squeeze out as much liquid as possible using a clean kitchen towel. Grate the onion and finely chop the spinach. In a bowl, mix the potatoes, onion, spinach, egg, wholemeal flour, salt, and black pepper until everything is evenly combined. Heat the rapeseed oil in a nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Spoon in small mounds of the mixture and flatten them lightly with the back of the spoon. Fry for about 3 to 4 minutes on each side, until the pancakes are golden brown and crisp at the edges and the centers are cooked through. Keep the heat moderate so the pancakes cook evenly without burning. Serve hot with a dollop of Greek yogurt on top.

title: Crispy Potato Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Chives
ingredients_json: ["400 g potatoes, raw, peeled", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g wholemeal flour", "80 g onion, raw", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 g chives, fresh", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "2 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Grate the potatoes and onion on the coarse side of a box grater, then squeeze the mixture firmly in a clean kitchen towel to remove as much moisture as possible. Transfer to a bowl and mix with the egg, wholemeal flour, salt, and black pepper until evenly combined. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Spoon in small mounds of the mixture and flatten them gently with the back of the spoon. Fry for about 3 to 4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crisp at the edges, then reduce the heat slightly if they are browning too quickly. Keep the cooked pancakes warm while you finish the batch. Mix the Greek yogurt with the chopped chives and serve alongside the pancakes.

title: Crispy Oat and Herb Potato Pancakes with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["500 g potatoes, raw, peeled", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g oats, rolled", "30 g onion, raw", "15 g parsley, fresh", "15 g chives, fresh", "30 g plain yogurt, low fat", "10 ml lemon juice, fresh", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "2 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Grate the potatoes and onion finely, then squeeze the mixture firmly in a clean kitchen towel to remove as much liquid as possible. Transfer the dry potato mixture to a bowl and stir in the egg, rolled oats, chopped parsley, chopped chives, salt, and black pepper. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Spoon in the mixture and flatten each mound into a thin pancake about 1 cm thick. Fry for 3 to 4 minutes on the first side until the edges look set and the underside is golden brown, then flip carefully and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes until crisp and cooked through. While the pancakes cook, mix the low-fat yogurt with the lemon juice. Serve the pancakes hot with the yogurt on top or on the side.

title: Crispy Wholemeal Potato Pancakes with Spinach and Herby Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["400 g potatoes, raw", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g wholemeal flour", "80 g spinach, raw", "40 g onion, raw", "2 tbsp rapeseed oil", "150 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 g chives, fresh", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Peel the potatoes and grate them finely, then squeeze out as much moisture as possible using a clean kitchen towel. Grate the onion and mix it with the potatoes, egg, wholemeal flour, spinach, salt, and black pepper until evenly combined. Stir in the chopped chives. Heat half of the rapeseed oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Spoon in the mixture to form 6 small pancakes and press them lightly flat. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes on each side, keeping the heat at medium so they turn golden and crisp without burning. Add the remaining oil as needed for the second batch. Stir the yogurt with a little chopped chives and serve alongside the hot pancakes.

title: Crispy Potato Pancakes with Greek Yogurt and Chives
ingredients_json: ["500 g potatoes, raw, peeled", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 g wholemeal flour", "50 g onion, raw", "15 g chives, fresh", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Grate the potatoes and onion finely, then squeeze the mixture firmly in a clean cloth or sturdy paper towel to remove as much liquid as possible. Transfer the potatoes and onion to a bowl and mix in the egg, wholemeal flour, chopped chives, salt, and black pepper until everything is evenly combined. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Spoon the mixture into the pan in 4 to 6 small mounds and flatten them gently with the back of the spoon. Fry for 3 to 4 minutes on the first side until the edges are golden and crisp, then turn and cook for another 2 to 3 minutes until cooked through and evenly browned. Serve immediately with the Greek yogurt on top or on the side.

title: Moist Pumpkin and Oat Breakfast Bread with Walnuts and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["250 g pumpkin puree", "180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "2 pieces egg, raw", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "70 g brown sugar", "40 g walnuts", "10 g baking powder", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g ground ginger", "2 g salt", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees C and line a small loaf tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the pumpkin puree, eggs, yogurt, rapeseed oil, brown sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth. In a separate bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and fold gently until just combined, then stir in the walnuts. Spoon the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, until the loaf is risen, golden brown, and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. Let it cool in the tin for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Moist Spiced Pumpkin Bread with Oats and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["200 g pumpkin puree", "200 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "90 g brown sugar", "1 tbsp honey", "60 g walnuts", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground ginger", "0.25 tsp ground nutmeg", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a small loaf tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the pumpkin puree, eggs, yogurt, rapeseed oil, brown sugar, and honey until smooth. In a second bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir gently until just combined. Fold in the chopped walnuts without overmixing. Spoon the batter into the prepared tin and level the top. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, until the loaf is risen, golden, and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let it cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack and cool completely before slicing.

title: Moist Wholegrain Pumpkin Bread with Walnuts and Warm Spices
ingredients_json: ["250 g pumpkin puree", "250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "50 g rolled oats", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "100 g brown sugar", "30 ml honey", "10 g baking powder", "5 g baking soda", "3 g ground cinnamon", "2 g ground ginger", "1 g ground nutmeg", "2 g salt", "80 g walnuts, chopped", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175°C and line a 22 cm loaf tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the pumpkin puree, eggs, yogurt, rapeseed oil, brown sugar, honey and vanilla extract until smooth. In a second bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir gently until just combined, then fold in the chopped walnuts. Transfer the batter to the prepared tin and smooth the top. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until the loaf is well risen and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let it cool in the tin for 10 minutes before lifting it out and cooling completely on a wire rack before slicing.

title: Wholegrain Pumpkin Bread with Cinnamon and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "100 g plain wheat flour", "10 g baking powder", "3 g baking soda", "4 g ground cinnamon", "1 g ground nutmeg", "2 g salt", "200 g pumpkin purée, canned, unsweetened", "2 pieces egg, raw", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "120 g plain yogurt, low-fat", "100 g brown sugar", "30 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "50 g walnuts, chopped", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius and line a 900 g loaf tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, plain flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. In a separate bowl, beat the pumpkin purée, eggs, rapeseed oil, yogurt, brown sugar, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and fold gently until just combined. Stir in the chopped walnuts, taking care not to overmix. Spoon the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until the loaf is risen, deeply golden, and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs. Leave to cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack and cool completely before slicing.

title: Moist Wholemeal Pumpkin Bread with Cinnamon and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["250 g pumpkin puree", "220 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g plain wheat flour", "120 g brown sugar", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "120 ml low-fat plain yogurt", "8 g baking powder", "4 g bicarbonate of soda", "3 g salt", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp ground ginger", "0.5 tsp ground nutmeg", "80 g walnuts", "20 g pumpkin seeds"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175°C and line a 2 lb loaf tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the pumpkin puree, eggs, rapeseed oil and yogurt until smooth. In a second bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, plain flour, brown sugar, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, salt, cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until no dry streaks remain, then gently stir in the walnuts and pumpkin seeds. Spoon the batter into the loaf tin and smooth the top. title: Spinach, Mushroom and Feta Breakfast Quiche

title: Wholemeal Apple and Cinnamon Breakfast Scones

title: Wholemeal Apple and Oat Scones with Greek Yogurt

title: Wholegrain Blueberry and Oat Breakfast Scones

title: Whole Wheat Blueberry and Oat Scones with Greek Yogurt

title: Wholegrain Banana Yogurt Waffles with Blueberries

title: Whole Wheat Banana Oat Waffles with Greek Yogurt

title: Wholegrain Banana-Oat Waffles with Greek Yogurt and Blueberries

title: Wholegrain Banana Oat Waffles with Greek Yogurt and Blueberries

title: Smoky Tomato Baked Beans with Spinach and Wholegrain Toast

Transfer the pan to the oven and bake for 15 minutes, until the top is glossy and the beans are hot through. Serve the baked beans with toasted wholegrain bread.

title: Smoky Tomato Baked Beans with Spinach and Wholegrain Toast
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece carrot, raw", "1 stalk celery, raw", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "800 g kidney beans, canned, drained", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "200 ml water", "30 g tomato puree", "1 tbsp maple syrup", "1 tbsp apple cider vinegar", "150 g spinach, raw", "4 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "4 slices wholemeal bread"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 190 C. Warm the olive oil in a large ovenproof pan over medium heat, then add the chopped onion, garlic, diced carrot, and diced celery. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables are softened but not browned. Stir in the smoked paprika and cumin and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the kidney beans, chopped tomatoes, water, tomato puree, maple syrup, apple cider vinegar, salt, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then fold in the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Transfer the pan to the oven and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the sauce is thick and the top looks glossy and slightly reduced. Remove from the oven and rest for 5 minutes before serving with toasted wholemeal bread.

title: Hearty Beef, Lentil and Root Vegetable Stew
ingredients_json: ["600 g beef chuck, lean", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 pieces carrot, raw", "2 stalks celery, raw", "150 g parsnip, raw", "100 g brown lentils, dry", "400 g tomatoes, canned, diced", "750 ml beef stock, low salt", "2 leaves bay leaf, dried", "2 g thyme, dried", "2 g black pepper, ground", "4 g salt", "15 g tomato paste", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Cut the beef into even 3 cm cubes and pat them dry. Heat the olive oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat, then brown the beef in batches until well coloured on all sides. Remove the meat and lower the heat to medium. Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrot, celery, and parsnip, then cook for about 6 to 8 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute so it darkens slightly. Return the beef to the pot and add the lentils, diced tomatoes, beef stock, bay leaves, thyme, black pepper, and salt. Bring the stew to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover partially, and simmer for about 1 hour 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beef is tender and the lentils are cooked through. If the stew becomes too thick, add a little more water. Remove the bay leaves, stir in the chopped parsley, and let the stew rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Hearty Beef, Barley and Vegetable Stew
ingredients_json: ["600 g beef stewing steak, lean, raw", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "200 g onion, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "120 g celery, raw", "200 g swede, raw", "150 g potato, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "30 g plain flour, wheat", "20 g tomato paste", "750 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "250 ml water", "80 g pearl barley, dry", "2 g dried thyme", "2 pieces bay leaf, dried", "5 g parsley, fresh", "3 g black pepper, ground", "4 g salt, table"]
instructions: Cut the beef into even bite-sized pieces and pat them dry. Heat the rapeseed oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat, then brown the beef in batches so it sears well rather than steams. Remove the meat and lower the heat to medium. Add the onion, carrot, celery, and swede, and cook for about 6 minutes until they begin to soften. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute more. Sprinkle in the flour and stir until it coats the vegetables, then slowly pour in the beef stock and water while stirring to avoid lumps. Return the beef to the pot, add the barley, thyme, bay leaves, salt, and black pepper, and bring everything to a gentle simmer. Cover and cook on low heat for about 1 hour 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beef is tender and the barley is cooked through. Add the potato in the last 30 minutes so it holds its shape. If the stew looks too thick, add a little more water during cooking. Discard the bay leaves, stir in the chopped parsley, and let the stew rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Hearty Beef and Vegetable Stew with Tomatoes and Thyme
ingredients_json: ["800 g beef stewing steak, lean", "20 g wheat flour, plain", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "150 g onion, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "100 g celery stalk, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "30 g tomato paste", "400 g tomatoes, canned, chopped", "750 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "250 ml water", "500 g potato, raw, with skin", "150 g parsnip, raw", "150 g button mushrooms, raw", "2 g dried thyme", "2 g bay leaf", "5 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "15 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Pat the beef dry and toss it with the flour until lightly coated. Heat the rapeseed oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat, then brown the beef in batches for 3 to 4 minutes per side so the pieces develop good colour without steaming. Lower the heat to medium, add the onion, carrot, celery and garlic, and cook for 5 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to deepen the flavour. Add the chopped tomatoes, beef stock, water, potato, parsnip, mushrooms, thyme, bay leaf, salt and black pepper, then bring everything just to a gentle simmer. Cover with a lid, reduce the heat to low, and cook for about 1 1/2 to 2 hours, stirring occasionally, until the beef is tender and the vegetables are cooked through. Remove the bay leaf, stir in the parsley, and let the stew stand for 5 minutes before serving so the sauce thickens slightly.

title: Hearty Beef and Vegetable Stew with Tomatoes and Thyme
ingredients_json: ["800 g Beef stewing meat, lean, raw", "20 ml Rapeseed oil", "200 g Onion, raw", "150 g Carrot, raw", "120 g Celery, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "30 g Wheat flour, wholemeal", "400 g Tomatoes, canned, chopped", "500 ml Beef stock, reduced salt", "250 ml Water", "200 g Potato, raw", "150 g Parsnip, raw", "150 g Green beans, raw", "2 g Thyme, dried", "2 g Bay leaf, dried", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "4 g Salt, iodised"]
instructions: Cut the beef into large even cubes and pat them dry. Heat the rapeseed oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat, then brown the beef in batches until well coloured on all sides. Transfer the meat to a plate. Lower the heat to medium, add the onion, carrot, and celery, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and flour and cook for 1 minute so the flour loses its raw taste. Add the tomatoes, beef stock, water, thyme, bay leaf, black pepper, and salt, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Return the beef and any juices to the pot, bring to a gentle simmer, then cover and cook on low heat for about 1 hour and 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the potato and parsnip and simmer for another 25 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the beef is very soft. Stir in the green beans during the last 8 minutes of cooking. Remove the bay leaf, taste, and adjust the seasoning if needed before serving hot.

title: Slow-Cooked Beef and Root Vegetable Stew with Barley
ingredients_json: ["700 g Beef chuck, stewing cuts, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Carrot, raw", "150 g Celery, raw", "250 g Potato, raw", "200 g Swede, raw", "80 g Pearl barley, dry", "400 g Tomato, canned, chopped", "750 ml Beef stock, reduced salt", "15 g Tomato paste", "2 g Bay leaf, dried", "2 g Thyme, dried", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "4 g Salt, table", "15 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Pat the beef dry and cut it into large even chunks if needed. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef in batches for about 6 to 8 minutes, turning so the pieces take on a deep colour on several sides. Lower the heat to medium, add the chopped onion, garlic, carrot, and celery, and cook for 5 minutes until the onion softens and starts to look translucent. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to deepen the flavour. Add the chopped tomatoes, beef stock, bay leaf, thyme, black pepper, and salt, then return the beef and any juices to the pot. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook over low heat for 1 hour and 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the potato, swede, and pearl barley, then continue cooking for 40 to 50 minutes until the beef is very tender, the barley is soft, and the vegetables have thickened the stew. Remove the bay leaf, stir in the chopped parsley, and let the stew stand for 10 minutes before serving so the flavours settle and the sauce becomes richer.

title: Lean Beef Stroganoff with Mushrooms and Wholegrain Rice
ingredients_json: ["400 g beef sirloin, lean, raw", "250 g mushrooms, white, raw", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "15 g plain flour, wholemeal", "250 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "150 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "20 g tomato paste", "10 ml Worcestershire sauce", "5 g paprika, sweet", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt, table", "200 g rice, brown, dry", "15 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the package directions until tender, then keep it warm. While the rice cooks, slice the beef thinly against the grain and cut the mushrooms and onion into even pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, then sear the beef for 1 to 2 minutes until browned on the outside. Remove it from the pan so it stays tender. Lower the heat to medium and cook the onion and mushrooms for about 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until the mushrooms release their liquid and begin to brown. Add the garlic, paprika, and flour, and cook for 1 minute so the flour loses its raw taste. Stir in the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and beef stock, then let the sauce simmer gently for 3 to 4 minutes until it starts to thicken. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the yogurt slowly so it stays smooth and does not split. Return the beef and any juices to the pan, then warm everything through for 2 to 3 minutes without boiling. Season with the salt and black pepper, stir in the chopped parsley, and serve the stroganoff over the brown rice.

title: Lean Beef Stroganoff with Mushrooms and Wholegrain Rice
ingredients_json: ["500 g lean beef sirloin", "250 g mushrooms, button, fresh", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "1 tbsp paprika powder", "15 g plain wheat flour", "300 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "150 g sour cream, reduced fat", "20 g Dijon mustard", "10 ml lemon juice", "3 g black pepper", "5 g salt", "250 g brown rice, dry", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice in plenty of lightly salted water according to the package directions until tender, then drain and keep warm. While the rice cooks, slice the beef into thin strips and cut the mushrooms and onion into even pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then sear the beef quickly for 1 to 2 minutes until browned but still tender. Transfer it to a plate. Lower the heat to medium, add the onion and mushrooms, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the mushrooms release their moisture and begin to brown. Add the garlic and paprika and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 minute so it coats the vegetables. Gradually pour in the beef stock while stirring to make a smooth sauce, then add the mustard and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until slightly thickened. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the sour cream and lemon juice without letting the sauce boil. Return the beef and any juices to the pan, warm through for 1 to 2 minutes, then season with black pepper and salt. Serve the stroganoff over the brown rice and finish with chopped parsley.

title: Light Beef Stroganoff with Mushrooms, Dijon and Wholegrain Rice
ingredients_json: ["400 g beef sirloin, lean, raw", "250 g mushrooms, raw", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "10 g olive oil", "15 g butter, unsalted", "20 g wheat flour, wholemeal", "300 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "150 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 g mustard, Dijon", "10 ml lemon juice, fresh", "2 g paprika powder", "3 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt", "200 g rice, brown, dry", "20 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it in lightly salted water according to the packet instructions until tender, then keep it covered. Slice the beef thinly across the grain, wipe the mushrooms clean and slice them, and finely chop the onion and garlic. Heat the olive oil and butter in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened and lightly golden, then add the garlic and mushrooms and cook for another 5 to 6 minutes until the mushrooms have released their moisture and started to brown. Stir in the paprika and flour and cook for 1 minute so the flour loses its raw taste. Add the beef stock gradually while stirring, then simmer over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Lower the heat and stir in the mustard, lemon juice and yogurt, then add the beef and any juices from the plate. Cook gently for 2 to 3 minutes, just until the beef is cooked through and still tender, without boiling the sauce. Season with black pepper and the measured salt, then finish with chopped parsley and serve immediately over the cooked brown rice.

title: Creamy Beef Stroganoff with Mushrooms and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["500 g lean beef sirloin, trimmed", "250 g brown mushrooms", "1 piece yellow onion", "2 cloves garlic", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "15 g plain flour, wholemeal", "250 ml low-sodium beef stock", "150 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "15 ml Dijon mustard", "10 ml lemon juice", "5 g paprika powder", "2 g black pepper", "3 g salt", "300 g brown rice, uncooked", "20 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it in lightly salted water according to the packet instructions until tender, then keep it covered off the heat. While the rice cooks, cut the beef into thin strips and slice the mushrooms and onion. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and sear the beef for 1 to 2 minutes until browned but not fully cooked, then transfer it to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and add the onion and mushrooms to the pan. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until the mushrooms release their liquid and begin to brown. Add the garlic and paprika and cook for 30 seconds more. Sprinkle over the flour and stir well so the vegetables are lightly coated. Gradually pour in the beef stock while stirring, then add the mustard, lemon juice, pepper, and salt. Simmer gently for 4 to 5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Lower the heat and stir in the yogurt until smooth, then return the beef and any juices to the pan. Warm everything through for 2 to 3 minutes without boiling so the sauce stays creamy. Fold through the chopped parsley and serve the stroganoff over the brown rice while hot.

title: Lean Beef Stroganoff with Mushrooms and Wholewheat Pasta
ingredients_json: ["400 g lean beef sirloin", "250 g button mushrooms", "1 piece yellow onion", "2 cloves garlic", "15 ml olive oil", "15 g wholegrain flour", "300 ml low-sodium beef stock", "150 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "15 ml Dijon mustard", "10 ml tomato paste", "1 tsp sweet paprika", "2 g black pepper", "3 g salt", "200 g wholewheat pasta", "150 g spinach leaves", "10 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the wholewheat pasta until just tender, then drain and set aside. Slice the beef into thin strips, then trim and slice the mushrooms and finely chop the onion and garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef in a single layer and sear for 1 to 2 minutes per side until browned but still tender, then transfer it to a plate. Lower the heat to medium and add the onion and mushrooms to the same pan. Cook for about 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until the mushrooms have released their moisture and started to brown. Add the garlic, flour, paprika, tomato paste, and black pepper, then stir for 1 minute so the flour loses its raw taste. Pour in the beef stock gradually while stirring, and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until the sauce begins to thicken. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the Greek yogurt and Dijon mustard so the sauce stays smooth. Return the beef and any juices to the pan, then add the spinach and cook over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes until just wilted. Fold in the drained pasta, warm everything through gently, and finish with chopped parsley before serving.

title: Herb-Roasted Beef Tenderloin with Garlic Green Beans and Sweet Potato Mash
ingredients_json: ["600 g beef tenderloin, trimmed", "15 ml olive oil", "2 g black pepper, ground", "6 g salt, table", "4 g garlic, fresh", "2 g rosemary, fresh", "2 g thyme, fresh", "500 g sweet potato, raw", "30 g low-fat milk", "10 g butter, unsalted", "300 g green beans, raw", "10 g garlic, fresh", "15 ml olive oil", "15 ml lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200 C. Pat the beef tenderloin dry and rub it with olive oil, black pepper, salt, minced garlic, rosemary, and thyme. Place it in a roasting pan and sear it in a hot oven-safe pan over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until well browned. Transfer the pan to the oven and roast for about 18 to 22 minutes for medium-rare, or until the centre reaches your preferred doneness. Let the meat rest for 10 minutes before slicing so the juices stay in the meat. While the beef roasts, peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into chunks, then boil them in lightly salted water for 12 to 15 minutes until tender. Drain well and mash with the milk and butter until smooth. Trim the green beans and steam or blanch them for 4 to 5 minutes until bright green and still crisp. Warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, add the garlic for 30 seconds, then toss in the green beans and lemon juice for 1 minute. Slice the beef and serve it with the sweet potato mash and garlic green beans.

title: Garlic Rosemary Beef Tenderloin with Roasted Vegetables and Lentils
ingredients_json: ["600 g beef tenderloin", "20 ml olive oil", "3 g salt", "2 g black pepper", "4 g garlic, fresh", "2 g rosemary, fresh", "250 g carrots", "200 g zucchini", "150 g red onion", "200 g cooked lentils", "10 ml lemon juice", "5 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Pat the beef tenderloin dry and rub it with 10 ml of the olive oil, the salt, black pepper, crushed garlic, and chopped rosemary. Let it sit at room temperature for 15 minutes. Cut the carrots, zucchini, and red onion into even pieces and toss them with the remaining olive oil. Spread the vegetables on a baking tray and roast for 20 minutes, stirring once halfway through. Meanwhile, heat a heavy pan over medium-high heat and sear the beef for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until well browned. Transfer the pan to the oven, or move the beef to a roasting dish, and cook for 10 to 14 minutes until the center reaches your preferred doneness. Rest the meat for 10 minutes before slicing. Warm the cooked lentils gently with the lemon juice and chopped parsley, then serve alongside the roasted vegetables and sliced tenderloin.

title: Herb-Crusted Beef Tenderloin with Roasted Vegetables and Yogurt Mustard Sauce
ingredients_json: ["600 g beef tenderloin, trimmed", "15 ml olive oil", "5 g garlic, minced", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "2 g rosemary, dried", "2 g thyme, dried", "300 g carrot, raw", "250 g broccoli florets, raw", "200 g red bell pepper, raw", "200 g zucchini, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "2 g salt", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 g Dijon mustard", "10 ml lemon juice", "5 g chives, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Pat the beef tenderloin dry and rub it with 15 ml olive oil, garlic, black pepper, salt, rosemary, and thyme. Let it sit at room temperature for 20 minutes so it cooks more evenly. Cut the carrots, broccoli, bell pepper, and zucchini into even bite-sized pieces, then toss them with 15 ml olive oil and 2 g salt. Spread the vegetables on a baking tray and roast for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once halfway through, until tender and lightly browned. Heat a heavy skillet over medium-high heat and sear the tenderloin for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until well browned. Transfer it to the oven and roast for about 12 to 15 minutes for medium-rare, or until the internal temperature reaches about 54 to 57°C. Rest the meat on a board for 10 minutes before slicing. While it rests, mix the Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, and chives into a smooth sauce. Slice the tenderloin against the grain and serve with the roasted vegetables and yogurt mustard sauce.

title: Herb-Roasted Beef Tenderloin with Garlic Green Beans and Sweet Potato Wedges
ingredients_json: ["600 g beef tenderloin, raw", "20 ml olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, fresh", "2 g black pepper, ground", "4 g salt", "2 g dried rosemary", "2 g dried thyme", "500 g sweet potatoes, raw", "200 g green beans, raw", "150 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "1 medium onion, raw", "10 g Dijon mustard", "15 ml lemon juice", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into even wedges, then slice the onion into thick segments. Toss the sweet potatoes and onion with half of the olive oil, half of the salt, and a little black pepper, then spread them on the tray and roast for 20 minutes. While they roast, pat the beef tenderloin dry and rub it with the remaining olive oil, Dijon mustard, crushed garlic, rosemary, thyme, the remaining salt, and black pepper. After the vegetables have cooked for 20 minutes, push them to one side of the tray, add the beef tenderloin, and roast for 15 to 18 minutes for medium-rare, or until the centre reaches your preferred doneness. Remove the beef from the oven and rest it for 10 minutes before slicing. During the resting time, steam or blanch the green beans for 4 to 5 minutes until bright green and just tender, then warm the cherry tomatoes briefly in a pan or in the oven for the last few minutes. Finish the green beans with lemon juice and chopped parsley. Slice the beef across the grain and serve with the roasted sweet potatoes, onions, green beans, and tomatoes.

title: Garlic-Roasted Beef Tenderloin with Herb Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["600 g beef tenderloin, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 g black pepper, ground", "4 g salt, table", "2 g rosemary, fresh", "400 g potatoes, raw", "200 g green beans, raw", "150 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "10 g Dijon mustard", "10 ml lemon juice, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "1 small onion, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Pat the beef tenderloin dry and rub it with 15 ml olive oil, minced garlic, black pepper, 2 g salt, and chopped rosemary. Let it sit at room temperature for 20 minutes while you prepare the vegetables. Cut the potatoes into even chunks and toss them with the onion, 15 ml olive oil, and the remaining salt, then spread them on a baking tray. Roast the potatoes for 15 minutes, then add the beef tenderloin to the tray or a separate hot ovenproof pan and roast for another 18 to 22 minutes for medium-rare, depending on thickness. When the beef is in the oven, steam or blanch the green beans for 4 to 5 minutes until bright green and just tender, then toss them with the cherry tomatoes. Mix the Dijon mustard with lemon juice and spoon a little over the sliced beef before serving. Rest the beef for 10 minutes before carving so the juices stay inside, then serve with the roasted potatoes and green beans.

title: Hearty Beet and Cabbage Borscht with Lean Beef and Dill
ingredients_json: ["300 g beef chuck, lean, raw", "2 l water", "2 pieces bay leaf", "200 g beetroot, raw", "150 g white cabbage, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "100 g onion, raw", "150 g potato, raw", "30 g tomato paste", "15 ml sunflower oil", "15 ml apple cider vinegar", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "10 g fresh dill", "5 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "200 g plain yogurt, low fat"]
instructions: Place the beef in a large pot with the water and bay leaves. Bring it slowly to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce to low heat and simmer gently for about 60 minutes, skimming off any foam so the broth stays clear. While the meat cooks, peel and dice the beetroot, carrot, onion, and potato, and shred the cabbage. Heat the sunflower oil in a pan over medium heat and sauté the onion and carrot for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to deepen the flavour. Add the beetroot and vinegar, then cook for another 5 minutes so the beet keeps its colour. Transfer the vegetables to the pot with the beef, add the potato and cabbage, and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes until everything is tender. Stir in the garlic, salt, and black pepper during the last 5 minutes of cooking. Remove the bay leaves, taste the broth, and finish with chopped dill. Serve hot with a spoonful of low-fat yogurt on top.

title: Hearty Beet Borscht with Cabbage, Beans, and Dill
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp rapeseed oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "150 g carrot", "150 g celery root", "300 g beetroot", "200 g white cabbage", "200 g potato", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "1.5 l vegetable stock", "240 g cooked kidney beans", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "2 bay leaves", "2 g dried thyme", "10 g fresh dill", "150 g plain low-fat yogurt", "2 g black pepper", "4 g iodized salt"]
instructions: Heat the rapeseed oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Add the diced carrot, celery root, beetroot, cabbage, and potato, and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally so the vegetables begin to soften and pick up a little color. Stir in the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, bay leaves, and thyme, then pour in the vegetable stock. Bring the pot to a boil, reduce the heat to low, cover partly, and simmer for 25 minutes until the vegetables are tender. Add the kidney beans and continue simmering for 5 minutes. Stir in the lemon juice, black pepper, and iodized salt, then taste and adjust the acidity by simmering uncovered for 2 minutes if you want a slightly deeper flavor. Remove the bay leaves, ladle the borscht into bowls, and top each serving with dill and a spoonful of yogurt.

title: Hearty Beet and Cabbage Borscht with Lean Beef and Dill
ingredients_json: ["300 g beef, lean, stewing meat, trimmed", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "200 g beetroot, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "150 g white cabbage, raw", "150 g potato, raw", "100 g celery root, raw", "400 g tomato, canned, chopped", "1200 ml water", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "2 pieces bay leaf", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp caraway seed", "10 g dill, fresh", "150 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 ml lemon juice, raw", "3 g salt, iodized"]
instructions: Cut the beef into bite-sized pieces. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring so the surface colors evenly. Add the chopped onion and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the beetroot, carrot, celery root, potato, cabbage, tomato paste, canned tomatoes, bay leaves, caraway seeds, black pepper, water, and salt. Bring the pot to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer partially covered for 50 to 60 minutes, until the beef is tender and the vegetables are cooked through. Stir in the lemon juice and chopped dill during the last 2 minutes of cooking. Remove the bay leaves, then ladle the borscht into bowls and top each serving with a spoonful of yogurt.

title: Hearty Beet and Cabbage Borscht with Dill and Beans
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp rapeseed oil", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "2 medium carrots", "2 medium beetroots", "250 g white cabbage", "2 medium potatoes", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "1.2 l vegetable stock", "240 g canned kidney beans", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "2 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp sugar", "2 bay leaves", "1 tsp caraway seeds", "15 g fresh dill", "150 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "1 tsp black pepper", "6 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the rapeseed oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic, caraway seeds, carrots, and beetroots, then cook for another 5 minutes so the vegetables begin to release their colour and aroma. Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock, bay leaves, potatoes, and cabbage. Bring the soup to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes until the vegetables are tender. Stir in the kidney beans, lemon juice, sugar, black pepper, and salt, and simmer for 5 more minutes. Remove the bay leaves, stir through most of the dill, and ladle the borscht into bowls. Serve topped with a spoonful of Greek yogurt and the remaining dill.

title: Hearty Beet and Cabbage Borscht with Lean Beef and Dill
ingredients_json: ["500 g beetroot, raw", "300 g white cabbage, raw", "200 g potatoes, raw", "150 g carrots, raw", "100 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "300 g beef brisket, lean, raw", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1.5 l water", "2 pieces bay leaf", "10 g dill, fresh", "15 ml lemon juice", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "150 g low-fat plain yogurt"]
instructions: Trim the beef if needed and cut it into bite-sized pieces. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large pot over medium heat, add the onion and carrots, and cook for about 5 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Add the beef and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring so the meat loses its raw color. Stir in the tomato paste and garlic and cook for 1 minute more. Add the beetroot, water, bay leaves, and salt, then bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover partially, and simmer for 35 minutes. Add the potatoes and cabbage and continue simmering for 20 to 25 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the beef is cooked through. Stir in the lemon juice and black pepper, then taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. Serve hot, topped with fresh dill and a spoonful of low-fat yogurt.

title: Tomato and Ricotta Bruschetta with Basil and Balsamic Glaze
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholemeal bread", "250 g tomatoes, raw", "150 g ricotta cheese", "10 g fresh basil leaves", "10 ml olive oil", "10 ml balsamic vinegar", "1 g garlic, raw", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Slice the bread into thick pieces and arrange them on a baking tray. Lightly brush both sides with half of the olive oil and toast for 6 to 8 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden at the edges. While the bread toasts, dice the tomatoes finely and place them in a bowl with the remaining olive oil, balsamic vinegar, finely grated garlic, salt, pepper, and most of the basil torn into small pieces. Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes so the flavours blend and the tomatoes release a little juice. Spread the ricotta over the warm toasts, top generously with the tomato mixture, and finish with the remaining basil. Serve immediately while the bread is crisp and the topping is fresh and cool.

title: Tomato, Basil and White Bean Bruschetta on Wholegrain Toast
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholegrain bread", "240 g cannellini beans, canned, drained", "200 g tomatoes, ripe, raw", "40 g red onion", "10 g fresh basil leaves", "1 clove garlic", "15 ml olive oil", "15 ml lemon juice", "1 g black pepper", "2 g salt", "20 g rocket"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Slice the bread into 4 even pieces and place them on a baking tray. Toast for 6 to 8 minutes until lightly crisp and golden at the edges. While the bread toasts, finely dice the tomatoes and red onion, then chop the basil leaves. Mash about half of the cannellini beans with a fork and leave the rest whole for texture. Mix the tomatoes, onion, basil, beans, olive oil, lemon juice, grated garlic, black pepper, and salt in a bowl. Let the mixture sit for 5 minutes so the flavours blend and the tomatoes release some juice. Rub the warm toast lightly with the cut side of the garlic if you want a stronger garlic flavour, then pile the bean and tomato mixture onto the bread. Finish with a small handful of rocket on top and serve immediately while the toast is still crisp.

title: Tomato and White Bean Bruschetta with Basil and Lemon
ingredients_json: ["300 g cherry tomatoes", "240 g canned white beans, drained", "2 cloves garlic", "15 g fresh basil leaves", "15 ml lemon juice", "15 ml olive oil", "1 g fine salt", "1 g black pepper", "300 g wholemeal baguette", "10 ml olive oil", "20 g Parmesan cheese, grated"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Slice the baguette into 10 to 12 even pieces and brush each slice lightly with the 10 ml olive oil. Arrange the slices on a baking tray and toast for 6 to 8 minutes, until crisp at the edges and lightly golden. While the bread toasts, halve the cherry tomatoes and roughly mash the white beans with a fork in a bowl so they stay a little chunky. Finely chop the garlic and basil, then stir them into the tomato and bean mixture with the lemon juice, 15 ml olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Let the topping sit for 5 minutes so the flavours meld and the tomatoes release some juice. Spoon the mixture onto the warm toasts, finish with the grated Parmesan, and serve immediately while the bread is still crisp.

title: Tomato, White Bean and Basil Bruschetta with Lemon-Garlic Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["1 piece wholegrain baguette", "200 g canned white beans, drained", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "1 clove garlic", "15 ml olive oil", "15 ml lemon juice", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "10 g fresh basil leaves", "100 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "1 g lemon zest"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Slice the baguette into 8 even pieces and arrange them on a baking tray. Brush both sides lightly with half of the olive oil and toast for 6 to 8 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp at the edges. While the bread is toasting, cut the cherry tomatoes into small pieces and place them in a bowl. Rinse and drain the white beans, then lightly mash about half of them with a fork so the topping holds together while some beans stay whole. Finely grate the garlic and mix it with the tomatoes, beans, lemon juice, remaining olive oil, salt, black pepper, and torn basil. Stir in the lemon zest and let the mixture sit for 5 minutes so the flavors meld. In a small bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with a little extra black pepper if desired. Spoon the yogurt onto each toasted bread slice, top generously with the tomato and bean mixture, and serve immediately while the bread is still crisp.

title: Tomato, Basil and Cannellini Bean Bruschetta with Lemon-Ricotta
ingredients_json: ["1 piece wholegrain baguette", "2 tbsp olive oil", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "150 g canned cannellini beans, drained", "80 g ricotta cheese, low fat", "1 clove garlic", "10 g fresh basil", "15 ml lemon juice", "1 g black pepper", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Slice the baguette into 8 thick slices and brush both sides lightly with the olive oil. Toast the bread on a baking tray for 6 to 8 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp at the edges. While the bread toasts, finely chop the cherry tomatoes and basil, then mash the cannellini beans lightly with the back of a fork so they keep some texture. Mix the tomatoes, beans, half of the basil, lemon juice, black pepper, and salt in a bowl. In a separate bowl, stir the ricotta with the garlic until smooth. Spread a thin layer of ricotta on each warm toast, spoon the tomato-bean mixture on top, and finish with the remaining basil. Serve immediately while the bread is still crisp.

title: Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Yogurt Celery Dip
ingredients_json: ["1000 g Chicken wings, raw", "20 g Wheat flour, wholemeal", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Garlic powder", "15 ml Rapeseed oil", "60 ml Hot pepper sauce", "20 g Butter, unsalted", "30 g Tomato paste", "15 ml Apple cider vinegar", "10 g Honey", "150 g Yoghurt, plain, low fat", "80 g Celery, raw", "15 g Spring onion", "10 ml Lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a large baking tray with baking paper. Pat the chicken wings dry with kitchen paper, then toss them with the wholemeal flour, salt, black pepper, garlic powder and rapeseed oil until lightly coated. Spread the wings out in a single layer on the tray and bake for 25 minutes. Turn the wings over and bake for another 20 to 25 minutes, until the skin is crisp, the juices run clear and the wings are well browned. While the wings bake, warm the hot pepper sauce, butter, tomato paste, apple cider vinegar and honey in a small saucepan over low heat for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring until smooth. Transfer the cooked wings to a large bowl, pour over the buffalo sauce and toss until evenly coated. For the dip, mix the yoghurt with finely sliced celery, chopped spring onion and lemon juice. Serve the wings hot with the cooling dip on the side.

title: Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Yogurt Herb Dip
ingredients_json: ["1200 g Chicken wings, with skin, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "8 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Paprika, sweet", "80 ml Hot pepper sauce, buffalo style", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "120 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "30 g Mayonnaise, reduced fat", "10 g Lemon juice, raw", "10 g Garlic, raw", "5 g Chives, fresh", "5 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Pat the chicken wings dry, then toss them with the olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika until evenly coated. Arrange them in a single layer on the tray with a little space between each piece. Bake for 25 minutes, then turn the wings over and continue baking for 20 to 25 minutes more, until the skin is crisp, browned, and the juices run clear. While the wings bake, melt the butter gently over low heat and stir in the hot pepper sauce to make a smooth buffalo glaze. Mix the yogurt, reduced-fat mayonnaise, lemon juice, finely grated garlic, chives, and parsley to make a fresh dip. When the wings are done, transfer them to a bowl, pour over the buffalo glaze, and toss until well coated. Serve immediately with the yogurt herb dip on the side.

title: Crispy Oven-Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Yogurt Herb Dip
ingredients_json: ["1000 g Chicken wings, raw", "10 g Baking powder", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "5 g Paprika powder", "15 ml Olive oil", "60 ml Hot pepper sauce", "20 g Butter, unsalted", "15 ml Lemon juice", "2 g Garlic powder", "200 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 g Chives, fresh", "10 g Parsley, fresh", "50 g Celery stalk, raw", "80 g Carrot, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a large baking tray with baking paper. Pat the chicken wings very dry with kitchen paper, then place them in a large bowl with the baking powder, salt, black pepper, paprika, and olive oil. Toss well until the wings are lightly coated. Arrange them in a single layer on the tray with a little space between each piece. Bake for 25 minutes, then turn the wings over and bake for another 20 to 25 minutes until the skin is crisp, deeply golden, and the juices run clear. While the wings bake, warm the hot pepper sauce, butter, lemon juice, and garlic powder in a small pan over low heat until the butter melts and the sauce is smooth. Mix the yogurt with chopped chives and parsley to make the dip. Once the wings are done, toss them in the warm buffalo sauce until evenly coated. Serve immediately with the yogurt herb dip, celery sticks, and carrot sticks.

title: Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Yogurt Herb Dip
ingredients_json: ["1000 g Chicken wings, with skin, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "8 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Garlic powder", "120 ml Hot pepper sauce", "30 g Butter, unsalted", "15 ml Apple cider vinegar", "10 g Honey", "150 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 g Spring onion", "5 g Parsley, fresh", "5 ml Lemon juice", "200 g Celery", "150 g Carrot"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a large baking tray with parchment paper. Pat the chicken wings dry, then toss them with the olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder until evenly coated. Spread them out in a single layer on the tray, leaving space between each piece so they roast rather than steam. Bake for 35 minutes, turning once halfway through, until the skin is crisp and the wings are cooked through and lightly browned. While the wings bake, warm the hot pepper sauce, butter, apple cider vinegar, and honey in a small pan over low heat, stirring until the butter melts and the sauce looks smooth. Transfer the hot wings to a large bowl, pour over the buffalo sauce, and toss well so every wing is coated. Return the wings to the tray and bake for 5 more minutes to help the glaze cling. Mix the yogurt, spring onion, parsley, and lemon juice for a quick herb dip. Serve the wings immediately with celery and carrot sticks on the side.

title: Baked Buffalo Chicken Wings with Crisp Celery and Yogurt Dip
ingredients_json: ["1200 g Chicken wings, with skin, raw", "20 ml Olive oil", "5 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "1 g Garlic powder", "1 g Paprika, smoked", "80 ml Hot pepper sauce", "15 g Butter, unsalted", "150 g Yogurt, Greek style, plain, low fat", "30 g Mayonnaise, reduced fat", "10 ml Lemon juice, raw", "20 g Celery, raw", "10 g Chives, fresh", "150 g Carrot, raw"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220 C and line a large baking tray with parchment. Pat the chicken wings dry, then toss them with the olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika until evenly coated. Arrange them in a single layer on the tray with a little space between each piece. Bake for 25 minutes, then turn the wings over and continue baking for another 20 to 25 minutes until the skin is deep golden and crisp and the juices run clear. While the wings bake, warm the hot pepper sauce with the butter in a small pan over low heat until the butter melts and the mixture is smooth. Stir together the yogurt, reduced-fat mayonnaise, and lemon juice, then fold in the finely chopped chives. Thinly slice the celery and cut the carrot into sticks. When the wings are done, transfer them to a large bowl and toss with the warm buffalo sauce until well coated. Serve immediately with the celery, carrot sticks, and yogurt dip.

title: Lean Beef Bulgogi with Brown Rice and Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g beef sirloin, lean, raw", "200 g brown rice, uncooked", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced sodium", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "2 tbsp pear, grated", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 tsp ginger, fresh, grated", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 medium onion, sliced", "1 medium carrot, julienned", "150 g mushrooms, sliced", "100 g spinach, fresh", "2 tsp toasted sesame seeds", "2 stalks spring onion, sliced", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice well and cook it in lightly salted water according to the package directions until tender, then keep it covered off the heat. In a bowl, mix the soy sauce, sesame oil, grated pear, garlic, ginger, honey, and rice vinegar. Add the sliced beef and coat it well, then let it marinate for 20 to 30 minutes. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add the onion and carrot and stir-fry for 2 minutes until they start to soften. Add the mushrooms and cook for another 2 minutes until they release some moisture. Increase the heat slightly, add the beef with its marinade, and stir-fry for 3 to 5 minutes until the meat is browned and just cooked through. Add the spinach and spring onion and cook for 30 to 60 seconds until the spinach wilts. Serve the bulgogi over the brown rice and finish with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Lean Beef Bulgogi with Brown Rice and Crisp Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g beef sirloin, lean, raw", "200 g brown rice, dry", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced sodium", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 tbsp honey", "4 g garlic, fresh, minced", "10 g ginger, fresh, grated", "1 small onion, raw", "1 medium carrot, raw", "150 g mushrooms, button, raw", "1 medium zucchini, raw", "100 g spinach, fresh", "2 tbsp spring onion, chopped", "1 tbsp sesame seeds, toasted"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice in lightly salted water according to the package directions until tender, then keep it covered off the heat. While the rice cooks, slice the beef very thinly against the grain. Mix the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, honey, garlic, and ginger in a bowl, then add the beef and stir well so every piece is coated. Let it marinate for 15 to 20 minutes. Heat a large non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat until hot, then add the onion, carrot, mushrooms, and zucchini. Stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes until the vegetables are just tender but still bright. Push them to one side of the pan, add the beef with its marinade, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often, until the meat is browned and just cooked through. Add the spinach and spring onion at the end and toss for 30 to 60 seconds until the spinach wilts. Serve the bulgogi over the brown rice and finish with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Ginger-Sesame Beef Bulgogi with Brown Rice and Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g beef sirloin, lean, raw", "200 g brown rice, dry", "100 g onion, raw", "100 g carrot, raw", "150 g zucchini, raw", "80 g spinach, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "20 g fresh ginger root, raw", "60 ml soy sauce, reduced sodium", "30 g apple, raw", "15 ml sesame oil", "10 ml rice vinegar", "15 g honey", "5 g sesame seeds, toasted", "2 g black pepper, ground", "10 g spring onion, raw", "10 ml rapeseed oil"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice under cold water, then cook it in lightly salted water until tender, about 25 to 30 minutes. While the rice cooks, slice the beef very thinly against the grain so it will stay tender. Grate the apple, garlic, and ginger, then mix them with the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, honey, and black pepper to make a bulgogi marinade. Add the beef and let it sit for 15 to 20 minutes at room temperature. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the onion and carrot for 2 to 3 minutes until they begin to soften, then add the beef and marinade. Cook for about 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until the beef is browned and the sauce has thickened slightly. Add the zucchini and spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more, just until the vegetables are tender but still vibrant. Serve the bulgogi over the brown rice and finish with toasted sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.

title: Lean Beef Bulgogi Bowls with Brown Rice and Sesame Spinach
ingredients_json: ["500 g beef sirloin, lean, sliced thinly", "150 g brown rice, dry", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced sodium", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "15 g ginger, fresh, grated", "1 medium pear, peeled and grated", "1 medium onion, sliced thinly", "1 medium carrot, julienned", "150 g mushrooms, sliced", "200 g spinach, fresh", "1 tbsp sesame seeds, toasted", "2 tbsp spring onion, chopped", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it in lightly salted water until tender, about 25 to 30 minutes. While the rice cooks, mix the soy sauce, honey, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, grated pear, rice vinegar, and black pepper in a large bowl. Add the sliced beef and stir well so every piece is coated, then let it marinate for 15 to 20 minutes at room temperature. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the onion, carrot, and mushrooms and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened and lightly browned.
