Push the vegetables to the side, add the marinated beef in a single layer, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring often, until the beef is just cooked through and the sauce has reduced to a glossy coating. Add the spinach and cook for 1 minute until just wilted. Serve the bulgogi over the brown rice and finish with toasted sesame seeds and chopped spring onion.

title: Lean Beef Bulgogi with Brown Rice and Sesame Greens
ingredients_json: ["450 g beef sirloin, lean, raw", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced sodium", "1 tbsp sesame oil", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "2 tsp brown sugar", "3 cloves garlic, fresh", "20 g ginger, fresh", "1 medium onion", "1 medium carrot", "150 g mushrooms, button, raw", "2 stalks spring onion", "1 tbsp sesame seeds, toasted", "250 g brown rice, dry", "300 g spinach, raw", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "1 small pear, raw"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it according to the packet instructions until tender. While it cooks, thinly slice the beef against the grain and place it in a bowl. Grate the pear, garlic, and ginger, then mix them with the soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, and brown sugar to make a light marinade. Add the beef and turn it well so every piece is coated, then leave it to marinate for 20 minutes at room temperature or up to 2 hours in the fridge. Slice the onion, carrot, mushrooms, and spring onions into thin strips. Heat a large pan or wok over medium-high heat, add the rapeseed oil, and stir-fry the onion and carrot for 2 minutes until they begin to soften. Add the mushrooms and cook for another 2 minutes. Push the vegetables to the side, add the marinated beef in a single layer, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring often, until browned and just cooked through. Toss everything together with the spring onions and warm through for 1 minute. In a separate pan, wilt the spinach over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes until just collapsed. Serve the bulgogi over the brown rice with the spinach on the side and finish with toasted sesame seeds.

title: Turkey and Black Bean Burgers with Avocado Yogurt Slaw
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean, raw", "240 g Black beans, canned, drained", "1 piece Egg, raw", "60 g Oats, rolled", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 tbsp Parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Paprika, sweet", "1 tsp Salt", "1/2 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "4 pieces Wholemeal burger buns", "100 g Lettuce, mixed leaves", "120 g Tomato, raw", "80 g Red cabbage, raw", "1 piece Carrot, raw", "120 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp Mustard, prepared"]
instructions: Mash the black beans lightly with a fork so some texture remains. Finely chop the onion and garlic, then mix them in a large bowl with the turkey mince, egg, oats, parsley, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Fold in the mashed beans until just combined, being careful not to overwork the mixture. Shape into 4 equal patties and chill for 10 minutes if the mixture feels soft. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the burgers for about 5 to 6 minutes per side, until browned outside and cooked through with no pink in the center. While the burgers cook, shred the cabbage and carrot, then mix them with the yogurt, avocado, lemon juice, and mustard to make a creamy slaw. Split and lightly toast the burger buns. Assemble each burger with lettuce, tomato slices, a turkey patty, and a generous spoonful of avocado yogurt slaw, then serve immediately while hot.

title: Turkey and Black Bean Burgers with Avocado Yogurt Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g Turkey mince, lean", "240 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "1 piece Egg, raw", "40 g Oats, rolled", "60 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "10 g Parsley, fresh", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "4 wholemeal burger buns", "100 g Lettuce, mixed leaves", "120 g Tomato, raw", "80 g Avocado", "125 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 ml Lemon juice"]
instructions: Mash about half of the black beans with a fork and leave the rest whole for texture. Finely grate the onion and garlic, then mix them in a large bowl with the turkey mince, egg, oats, parsley, cumin, smoked paprika, mashed beans, and remaining whole beans. Season lightly with salt and black pepper if desired, then mix until just combined. Shape the mixture into 4 even patties and chill them for 10 minutes so they hold together better. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the burgers for about 5 to 6 minutes per side, until browned on the outside and cooked through with no pink in the centre. While the burgers cook, stir the avocado, yogurt, and lemon juice together into a smooth sauce. Toast the wholemeal buns briefly if you like, then fill them with lettuce, sliced tomato, the hot burgers, and the avocado yogurt sauce. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Turkey and Black Bean Burgers with Avocado Yogurt Slaw
ingredients_json: ["400 g Turkey mince, lean", "240 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "1 piece Egg, raw", "40 g Oat bran", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "5 g Ground cumin", "2 g Paprika, sweet", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "10 g Olive oil", "4 pieces Wholemeal burger bun", "120 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "80 g Cabbage, white, raw", "60 g Carrot, raw", "80 g Avocado, raw", "20 g Lettuce, iceberg, raw", "80 g Tomato, raw"]
instructions: Mash the black beans roughly in a bowl so some pieces remain for texture. Finely grate the onion and garlic, then mix them with the turkey mince, mashed beans, egg, oat bran, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper until just combined. Shape the mixture into 4 equal patties and chill them for 10 minutes so they hold together better. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the burgers for about 5 to 6 minutes per side, until browned outside and the centre is cooked through and no longer pink. While the burgers cook, mix the yogurt with the shredded cabbage and carrot, then fold in the mashed avocado to make a creamy slaw. Toast the buns lightly if desired. Assemble each burger with lettuce, tomato slices, a turkey patty, and a generous spoonful of the avocado yogurt slaw, then serve immediately while hot.

title: Turkey and Black Bean Burgers with Avocado Yogurt Slaw
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean", "240 g black beans, cooked, drained", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g rolled oats", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tbsp olive oil", "4 wholemeal burger buns", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "100 g cabbage, white, raw", "80 g carrot, raw", "1 piece avocado, raw", "30 g lettuce, iceberg, raw", "8 slices tomato, raw", "10 ml lemon juice, raw"]
instructions: Mash the black beans roughly in a bowl, leaving some texture. Finely grate the onion and garlic, then mix them with the turkey mince, egg, oats, cumin, smoked paprika, and the mashed beans. Season the mixture lightly with salt and black pepper, then shape it into 4 even patties and chill for 10 minutes so they hold together better. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the patties for about 5 to 6 minutes per side, until browned outside and cooked through with no pink in the centre. While the burgers cook, mix the yogurt with lemon juice and finely shredded cabbage and carrot to make a fresh slaw. Split and toast the buns briefly, then layer with lettuce, tomato, a burger patty, avocado slices, and the slaw. Serve immediately while the patties are hot and the buns are crisp.

title: Turkey and Black Bean Burgers with Avocado Yogurt Sauce
ingredients_json: ["400 g Turkey mince, lean, raw", "240 g Black beans, canned, drained", "60 g Oats, rolled", "1 piece Egg, raw", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "15 ml Olive oil", "4 pieces Burger bun, wholemeal", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "100 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "40 g Lettuce, romaine, raw", "80 g Tomato, raw"]
instructions: Mash half of the black beans in a bowl with a fork, leaving some whole for texture. Finely grate the onion and mince the garlic, then add them to the bowl with the turkey mince, oats, egg, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Mix gently until just combined, then fold in the remaining beans. Divide the mixture into 4 equal patties and shape them firmly so they hold together. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Cook the burgers for about 5 to 6 minutes per side, or until well browned outside and cooked through with no pink remaining in the centre. While they cook, mash the avocado with the yogurt and lemon juice until smooth and creamy. Toast the wholemeal buns lightly, then spread the avocado yogurt sauce on the bottom halves. Top with lettuce, tomato slices, and the hot burgers, then close the buns and serve immediately.

title: Spicy Black Bean and Chicken Burritos with Brown Rice and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "200 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "180 g Brown rice, cooked", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Red bell pepper, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Chili powder", "6 pieces Tortilla wrap, wholemeal", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "120 g Tomato, raw", "80 g Lettuce, raw", "60 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "30 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "15 ml Lime juice"]
instructions: Cut the chicken into small strips and season it with cumin, smoked paprika, chili powder, and a little salt from the ingredient list if included. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until browned and fully cooked through. Remove it from the pan and keep warm. In the same pan, add the onion, garlic, and red bell pepper and cook over medium heat for about 5 minutes until softened and lightly browned. Stir in the black beans and cooked brown rice, then cook for 2 to 3 minutes until everything is hot and well combined. Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan or microwave so they become pliable. Mash the avocado with lime juice, then slice the tomato and shred the lettuce. Divide the chicken, rice and bean mixture, avocado, tomato, lettuce, yogurt, and reduced-fat cheese among the tortillas. Fold in the sides and roll them up tightly into burritos. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Chicken, Black Bean and Avocado Burritos with Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Paprika powder", "0.5 tsp Garlic powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "200 g Brown rice, cooked", "240 g Black beans, canned, drained", "150 g Sweetcorn kernels, frozen", "1 piece Red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece Red onion, raw", "8 piece Tortilla wrap, wholemeal", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 piece Lime, raw", "80 g Lettuce, romaine, raw", "120 g Tomato, raw", "1 piece Avocado, raw"]
instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and season it with cumin, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally. Add the sliced red onion and diced bell pepper and cook for another 4 to 5 minutes over medium heat until softened. Stir in the black beans, sweetcorn and cooked brown rice, then cook for 2 minutes until everything is hot and well combined. In a small bowl, mix the yogurt with the grated lime zest and half of the lime juice. Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan or microwave so they become pliable. Divide the lettuce, chopped tomato, avocado slices and the chicken-rice mixture among the tortillas, then spoon over the lime yogurt. Fold the sides in, roll tightly into burritos and serve warm.

title: Smoky Chicken and Black Bean Burritos with Brown Rice and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Ground paprika", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "1 medium Onion, raw", "150 g Brown rice, dry", "300 ml Water", "240 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "150 g Sweetcorn, canned, drained", "1 medium Red bell pepper, raw", "4 large Whole wheat tortilla wrap", "80 g Avocado, raw", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "30 g Cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "60 g Tomato salsa", "20 g Baby spinach, raw", "1 tbsp Lime juice, fresh"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it in the water over low heat with a lid on for about 25 to 30 minutes, until tender and the liquid is absorbed. While the rice cooks, cut the chicken into thin strips. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, add the onion and pepper, and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until they begin to soften. Add the garlic, paprika, and cumin, then stir for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the chicken and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and fully cooked through. Stir in the black beans and sweetcorn and warm everything for 2 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and mix in the cooked rice and lime juice. Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan or microwave so they are flexible. Divide the spinach, chicken-and-rice filling, avocado, salsa, yogurt, and cheese among the tortillas, then fold the sides in and roll them up tightly. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Chicken, Black Bean and Avocado Burritos with Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces wholemeal tortilla wraps", "400 g chicken breast fillet", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp garlic powder", "0.5 tsp salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper", "240 g black beans, canned, drained", "150 g sweetcorn, canned, drained", "1 piece red bell pepper", "1 piece red onion", "80 g baby spinach", "100 g brown rice, cooked", "1 piece avocado", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "15 ml lime juice", "20 g fresh coriander"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and season it with cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until browned and cooked through with no pink remaining. Remove the chicken from the pan and keep it warm. In the same pan, add the diced red onion and sliced red bell pepper and cook over medium heat for about 4 minutes until softened. Stir in the black beans and sweetcorn and cook for 2 minutes until heated through. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave until pliable. Mix the yogurt with the lime juice and chopped coriander. To assemble, divide the rice, spinach, chicken, and vegetable mixture between the tortillas, then top with sliced avocado and a spoonful of lime yogurt. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Spiced Chicken and Black Bean Burritos with Avocado Yogurt Salsa
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "160 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "150 g Brown rice, cooked", "120 g Onion, raw", "120 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "10 g Garlic, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 tsp Ground cumin", "2 tsp Paprika, sweet", "1 tsp Ground coriander", "1 g Chilli powder", "4 g Salt", "8 g Lime juice, raw", "4 large Tortilla, wholemeal", "100 g Avocado, raw", "120 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "80 g Tomato, raw", "40 g Lettuce, iceberg, raw", "20 g Cheese, hard, reduced fat"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice if it is not already prepared and keep it warm. Cut the chicken into thin strips and season it with cumin, paprika, coriander, chilli powder, and half of the salt. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, add the chicken, and cook for 5 to 7 minutes until it is browned and cooked through. Add the onion, bell pepper, and garlic, then cook over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes until the vegetables are softened but still slightly crisp. Stir in the black beans, cooked rice, and lime juice, and cook for 2 minutes until everything is hot and well combined. In a small bowl, mash the avocado with the yogurt and finely chopped tomato to make a creamy salsa. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for about 20 seconds on each side so they become pliable. Divide the chicken and bean filling among the tortillas, top with lettuce, avocado yogurt salsa, and reduced-fat cheese, then fold tightly into burritos. Serve immediately while warm.

title: Creamy Roasted Butternut Squash Soup with Ginger and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["900 g butternut squash, peeled and diced", "150 g onion, chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "15 g fresh ginger, grated", "15 ml olive oil", "800 ml vegetable stock", "200 ml low-fat plain yogurt", "100 ml semi-skimmed milk", "2 g ground cumin", "1 g ground black pepper", "4 g salt", "20 g pumpkin seeds", "10 g fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Toss the butternut squash with the olive oil and spread it on a baking tray with the onion. Roast for about 25 minutes, turning once, until the squash is tender and lightly caramelised at the edges. Transfer the roasted vegetables to a large pot and add the garlic, ginger, cumin, vegetable stock, and salt. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes so the flavours blend. Blend the soup until smooth, then stir in the milk and half of the yogurt over low heat without boiling. Ladle into bowls and finish with the remaining yogurt, pumpkin seeds, black pepper, and chopped parsley.

title: Creamy Roasted Butternut Squash Soup with Ginger and Red Lentils
ingredients_json: ["900 g Butternut squash, raw", "150 g Carrot, raw", "120 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 g Ginger root, raw", "20 ml Olive oil", "80 g Red lentils, dry", "900 ml Vegetable stock, reduced salt", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "1 g Ground cumin", "1 g Ground coriander", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "15 ml Lemon juice, raw", "10 g Pumpkin seeds, hulled, roasted"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C. Peel the butternut squash, remove the seeds, and cut it into cubes. Cut the carrot and onion into chunks, then place them on a baking tray with the squash, garlic, ginger, and olive oil. Toss everything well and roast for 25 to 30 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned at the edges. Meanwhile, rinse the red lentils under cold water. Transfer the roasted vegetables to a large pot, add the lentils, vegetable stock, cumin, and coriander, and bring to a gentle boil over medium heat. Reduce the heat and simmer for 18 to 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are soft and the soup has thickened. Remove from the heat and blend until smooth using a stick blender, then stir in the milk, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice. Warm the soup gently over low heat for 2 to 3 minutes without boiling. Serve hot, topped with the roasted pumpkin seeds.

title: Creamy Butternut Squash, Red Lentil and Ginger Soup
ingredients_json: ["800 g butternut squash, peeled and diced", "150 g red lentils, dried", "1 piece onion, yellow, chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "15 g fresh ginger root, grated", "15 ml olive oil", "900 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp ground cumin", "0.5 tsp ground coriander", "1 g black pepper, ground", "5 g salt", "10 ml lemon juice", "20 g pumpkin seeds"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until softened but not browned. Stir in the garlic, ginger, cumin, and coriander, and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the diced butternut squash, red lentils, vegetable stock, salt, and black pepper. Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer gently for 25 minutes, or until the squash and lentils are very soft. Remove the pot from the heat and blend the soup until smooth using an immersion blender, or carefully transfer it in batches to a blender. Stir in the milk and lemon juice, then warm the soup over low heat for 2 minutes without letting it boil. Ladle into bowls and finish with pumpkin seeds sprinkled on top.

title: Creamy Butternut Squash and Red Lentil Soup with Ginger and Thyme
ingredients_json: ["900 g butternut squash, raw, peeled and diced", "150 g red lentils, dry", "150 g onion, raw, chopped", "2 cloves garlic, raw, minced", "20 g fresh ginger, raw, grated", "15 ml olive oil", "900 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "200 ml water", "150 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "2 g dried thyme", "2 g ground cumin", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt", "15 ml lemon juice, raw"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until softened and translucent. Stir in the garlic, ginger, thyme, and cumin, then cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the diced butternut squash, red lentils, vegetable stock, and water. Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes until the squash is very tender and the lentils have broken down. Remove from the heat and blend until smooth using a stick blender, or carefully blend in batches in a countertop blender. Stir in the milk, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice, then warm gently over low heat for 2 minutes without boiling. Serve hot.

title: Creamy Roasted Butternut Squash Soup with Ginger and Coconut
ingredients_json: ["900 g butternut squash, raw, peeled and diced", "200 g onion, raw, chopped", "3 cloves garlic, raw, minced", "20 g fresh ginger root, peeled and grated", "15 ml olive oil", "750 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "200 ml coconut milk, canned, light", "150 g carrot, raw, chopped", "5 g ground cumin", "2 g ground coriander", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "20 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Toss the butternut squash with the olive oil on a large baking tray and roast for about 25 minutes, turning once, until the edges are lightly browned and the flesh is tender. While the squash roasts, place the onion, carrot, garlic, and ginger in a large pot over medium heat and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until the onion is soft and fragrant but not browned. Stir in the cumin and coriander and cook for 30 seconds to release their aroma. Add the roasted squash, vegetable stock, coconut milk, black pepper, and salt, then bring to a gentle boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes so the flavours blend. Blend the soup carefully until smooth and silky, then return it to low heat and stir in the lemon juice. Warm through for 2 minutes and serve hot.

title: Lean Turkey Cabbage Rolls in Tomato Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["1 head green cabbage, raw", "500 g turkey mince, lean", "150 g brown rice, cooked", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 tbsp parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp paprika, sweet", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "2 tbsp olive oil", "400 g tomatoes, canned, chopped", "200 ml tomato passata", "150 ml water", "1 tbsp tomato puree", "1 tbsp lemon juice, raw", "1 tsp sugar"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a gentle boil over medium-high heat. Remove the core from the cabbage and blanch the whole head for 6 to 8 minutes, turning carefully until the outer leaves are soft enough to peel away. Lift the cabbage out and cool it slightly, then separate 12 to 14 large leaves and trim the thick center ribs so they roll easily. In a large bowl, combine the turkey mince, cooked brown rice, finely chopped onion, minced garlic, egg, parsley, thyme, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix until just combined so the filling stays tender. Place a generous spoonful of filling on each leaf, fold in the sides, and roll up tightly. Heat the olive oil in a large deep pan over medium heat, then arrange the rolls seam-side down and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until lightly browned. Add the chopped tomatoes, passata, water, tomato puree, lemon juice, and sugar, then spoon the sauce over the rolls. Cover the pan and simmer on low heat for 45 to 55 minutes, until the cabbage is very tender and the filling is cooked through. The sauce should be thick and rich, and the rolls should hold their shape when served.

title: Turkey and Brown Rice Cabbage Rolls in Tomato Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["1 whole green cabbage, raw", "500 g turkey mince, lean", "180 g brown rice, dry", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "200 g passata, unsweetened", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "150 ml water", "1 tsp paprika, sweet, ground", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "2 tbsp parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil, then lower the cabbage into it and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes until the outer leaves are soft and easy to peel away. Lift the cabbage out carefully, cool it slightly, and remove 12 to 14 large leaves, trimming the thick stem from each leaf so they roll easily. Cook the brown rice in lightly salted water until just tender, then drain well. In a large pan, warm the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more, then stir in the turkey mince and cook over medium-high heat until no longer pink. Mix in the cooked rice, egg, paprika, oregano, thyme, parsley, salt, and black pepper, then let the filling cool for a few minutes. Spoon a portion of filling onto each cabbage leaf, fold in the sides, and roll up tightly. Arrange the rolls seam-side down in a baking dish. Combine the chopped tomatoes, passata, tomato paste, and water, then pour the sauce over the rolls. Cover with foil and bake at 180 C for 45 minutes, then uncover and bake for another 10 minutes until the sauce is slightly thickened and the rolls are tender. Let them rest for 5 minutes before serving so they hold together well.

title: Lean Turkey Cabbage Rolls with Tomato and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["1 large head green cabbage", "500 g turkey mince, lean", "150 g brown rice, uncooked", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece carrot, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "400 g tomatoes, chopped, canned", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "250 ml water", "1 tsp paprika, sweet", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt", "2 tbsp parsley, fresh, chopped", "100 g plain yogurt, low fat"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Remove the core from the cabbage and carefully peel off 10 to 12 large leaves. Blanch the leaves for 2 to 3 minutes until pliable, then drain and cool. Cook the brown rice in lightly salted water until just tender, about 25 minutes, then drain. Finely chop the onion, garlic, and carrot. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more. In a bowl, mix the turkey mince, cooked rice, sautéed vegetables, tomato paste, paprika, thyme, black pepper, salt, and parsley until evenly combined. Divide the filling among the cabbage leaves, fold in the sides, and roll up tightly. Place the rolls seam-side down in a baking dish. Mix the chopped tomatoes with the water and pour over the rolls. Cover the dish with foil and bake at 180 C for 45 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for another 10 minutes until the sauce is slightly thickened and the rolls are cooked through. Serve hot with a spoonful of low-fat yogurt on top.

title: Turkey and Brown Rice Cabbage Rolls in Tomato Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["1 large head Savoy cabbage", "500 g Turkey mince, lean", "150 g Brown rice, uncooked", "1 piece Onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Carrot, raw, medium", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "400 g Tomatoes, canned, chopped", "200 ml Tomato passata", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "250 ml Water", "1 tsp Paprika, sweet", "1 tsp Thyme, dried", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt, table", "1 piece Egg, raw", "2 tbsp Parsley, fresh, chopped", "50 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Carefully cut out the core of the cabbage and lower the whole head into the boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes, turning once, until the outer leaves soften and peel away easily. Remove the leaves with tongs and let them cool enough to handle, then trim the thick center ribs so they roll without splitting. Cook the brown rice in lightly salted water for about 20 to 25 minutes until just tender, then drain well. While the rice cooks, heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and soften the onion and carrot for about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. In a bowl, mix the turkey mince, cooked rice, sautéed vegetables, egg, parsley, paprika, thyme, black pepper, and half the salt until evenly combined. Place a portion of filling onto each cabbage leaf, fold in the sides, and roll up firmly. Heat the remaining olive oil in a wide ovenproof pot over medium heat and arrange the rolls seam-side down. Pour over the chopped tomatoes, passata, tomato paste, and water, then season with the remaining salt. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook on low heat for 35 to 40 minutes until the cabbage is tender and the filling is fully cooked. Spoon the rolls into bowls and finish with a little Greek yogurt on top.

title: Turkey and Brown Rice Cabbage Rolls in Tomato Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["1 large head green cabbage", "500 g turkey mince, lean", "150 g brown rice, uncooked", "1 piece onion, medium, finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 piece carrot, medium, grated", "2 tbsp olive oil", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "200 ml passata", "200 ml water", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "2 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp paprika", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt", "1 piece bay leaf", "2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and carefully lower in the whole cabbage head. Simmer for 5 to 8 minutes, turning once, until the outer leaves are flexible enough to peel away. Remove the cabbage, cool slightly, and separate about 14 to 16 large leaves. Trim the thick stem from each leaf so they roll easily. Cook the brown rice in lightly salted water for about 25 minutes until just tender, then drain well. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Stir in the turkey mince and cook over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up until no pink remains. Mix in the cooked rice, half of the parsley, oregano, paprika, black pepper, and half of the salt. Spoon a portion of the filling onto each cabbage leaf, fold in the sides, and roll up tightly. Arrange the rolls seam-side down in a deep baking dish or wide pot. Combine the chopped tomatoes, passata, water, tomato paste, bay leaf, and the remaining salt, then pour the sauce over the rolls. Cover tightly with a lid or foil and bake at 180 C for 45 minutes, or simmer gently on the stovetop over low heat for about 40 minutes, until the cabbage is tender and the filling is hot throughout. Let the rolls rest for 10 minutes before serving, and finish with the remaining parsley.

title: Spinach, Mushroom and Ricotta Calzones with Tomato Herb Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholemeal bread flour", "7 g dried yeast", "1 tsp sugar", "1 tsp salt", "180 ml warm water", "1 tbsp olive oil", "200 g low-fat ricotta cheese", "80 g spinach, fresh", "150 g mushrooms, raw", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "1 clove garlic", "120 g tomato passata", "80 g mozzarella cheese, reduced-fat", "1 tbsp parmesan cheese, grated", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tbsp basil, fresh", "1 tbsp olive oil"]
instructions: Combine the flour, yeast, sugar and salt in a large bowl. Add the warm water and 1 tablespoon olive oil, then mix until a soft dough forms. Knead for about 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover and leave in a warm place for 1 hour or until doubled in size. While the dough rises, heat a pan over medium heat and cook the chopped onion and sliced mushrooms for 6 to 8 minutes until softened and most of the moisture has evaporated. Add the garlic and spinach and cook for 1 minute more until the spinach wilts. Remove from the heat and let cool slightly, then stir in the ricotta, half of the mozzarella, parmesan, oregano and basil. Heat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Divide the dough into 2 equal pieces and roll each piece into a circle about 25 cm wide. Spoon the filling onto one half of each circle, leaving a border around the edge, then fold over and press the edges firmly to seal. Place the calzones on the tray and brush the tops lightly with a little olive oil. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Warm the tomato passata in a small pan over low heat for 3 to 4 minutes and serve alongside the calzones as a simple dipping sauce.

title: Spinach, Mushroom and Ricotta Whole-Wheat Calzones
ingredients_json: ["300 g whole-wheat bread flour", "7 g dried yeast", "180 ml water", "15 ml olive oil", "5 g salt", "150 g low-fat ricotta cheese", "120 g spinach, raw", "120 g mushrooms, raw", "80 g onion", "120 g tomato passata", "100 g mozzarella cheese, reduced fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 g dried oregano", "1 g black pepper", "5 g garlic, raw"]
instructions: Warm the water until it feels lukewarm, then mix it with the yeast and let it stand for 5 minutes until slightly foamy. Combine the whole-wheat flour and salt in a large bowl, add the yeast mixture and olive oil, and knead for about 8 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 45 to 60 minutes, or until roughly doubled in size. While the dough rises, finely chop the onion and garlic, slice the mushrooms, and cook them in a dry pan over medium heat for 5 minutes until their moisture evaporates. Add the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted, then stir in the ricotta, oregano, black pepper, and half of the tomato passata. Remove from the heat and let the filling cool slightly. Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a circle about 18 cm wide. Spoon the filling onto one half of each circle, top with the reduced-fat mozzarella, brush the edges with beaten egg, and fold over to form a half-moon. Press the edges firmly to seal and make a few small slits on top so steam can escape. Place the calzones on the tray, brush the tops lightly with the remaining egg, and bake for 15 to 18 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Serve warm with the remaining tomato passata spooned over or alongside for dipping.

title: Spinach, Mushroom and Ricotta Calzones with Tomato Basil Sauce
ingredients_json: ["500 g Wheat flour, white, all-purpose", "7 g Yeast, dried, active", "300 ml Water", "10 g Salt, table", "15 ml Olive oil", "200 g Ricotta cheese, low fat", "120 g Mozzarella cheese, reduced fat", "150 g Spinach, fresh", "150 g Mushrooms, raw", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Tomato passata", "5 g Basil, fresh", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Oregano, dried", "1 piece Egg, raw"]
instructions: Start by making the dough. Mix the flour, yeast, salt, water, and olive oil in a large bowl until a rough dough forms, then knead it for about 8 to 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover the bowl and let the dough rise in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size. While the dough rises, make the filling. Heat a pan over medium heat, add the onion and mushrooms, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the mushrooms release their moisture and begin to brown. Add the garlic and spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes more, just until the spinach wilts. Remove from the heat and let the mixture cool slightly, then stir in the ricotta, mozzarella, black pepper, and oregano. Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a circle about 20 cm wide. Spoon the filling onto one half of each circle, leaving a border around the edge, then fold the dough over to make a half-moon shape and press the edges firmly to seal. Brush the tops with beaten egg and cut a small steam slit in each calzone. Bake for 16 to 20 minutes until the calzones are deeply golden and crisp on the outside. Meanwhile, warm the tomato passata with the basil in a small pan over low heat for about 5 minutes. Serve the calzones hot with the tomato basil sauce on the side.

title: Whole Wheat Chicken, Spinach and Ricotta Calzones
ingredients_json: ["300 g whole wheat pizza flour", "7 g dried yeast", "180 ml lukewarm water", "15 ml olive oil", "3 g salt", "250 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "5 ml olive oil", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g garlic powder", "150 g spinach, fresh", "120 g ricotta cheese, part skim", "80 g tomato passata", "60 g onion, raw", "120 g mushrooms, raw", "80 g mozzarella cheese, reduced fat", "5 g dried oregano", "1 piece egg, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Mix the flour, yeast and salt in a bowl, then add the lukewarm water and olive oil and bring together into a soft dough. Knead for 5 to 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover and leave in a warm place for about 45 minutes until noticeably risen. While the dough rises, heat 5 ml olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the chicken breast for about 6 to 8 minutes until no longer pink. Add the onion and mushrooms and cook for another 4 to 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the spinach and cook just until wilted, then remove from the heat and let the mixture cool slightly. Mix the ricotta, tomato passata, oregano, black pepper and garlic powder into the cooled filling, then fold in the chicken and grated mozzarella. Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a circle about 18 cm wide. Spoon the filling onto one half of each circle, leaving a border around the edge, then fold over and press the edges firmly to seal. Place the calzones on the tray, brush the tops with the beaten egg and cut a small steam slit in each one. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. Let them rest for 5 minutes before serving so the filling settles and the crust stays crisp.

title: Spinach, Mushroom and Chicken Wholewheat Calzones
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholewheat bread flour", "7 g dried yeast", "180 ml water", "10 ml olive oil", "4 g fine salt", "200 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "150 g mushrooms, raw", "80 g spinach, raw", "100 g tomato passata", "120 g part-skim mozzarella cheese", "40 g ricotta cheese, reduced fat", "60 g onion, raw", "2 g garlic, raw", "2 g dried oregano", "1 g black pepper, ground", "5 ml olive oil"]
instructions: Warm the water until it feels just lukewarm, then stir in the yeast and let it stand for 5 minutes until slightly foamy. Mix the flour and salt in a large bowl, add the yeast mixture and olive oil, then knead for about 8 to 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover the dough and leave it in a warm place for 45 to 60 minutes, or until doubled in size. While the dough rises, heat 5 ml olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 3 minutes until softened. Add the chicken and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring, until no longer pink. Stir in the garlic, mushrooms, oregano and black pepper, then cook for another 4 to 5 minutes until the mushrooms have released most of their moisture. Add the spinach and tomato passata and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until the spinach has wilted and the filling is thick. Let the mixture cool slightly, then stir in the ricotta and half of the mozzarella. Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray. Divide the dough into 2 equal pieces and roll each one into a round about 22 cm wide. Spoon the filling onto one half of each round, leaving a border around the edge, then fold over and press the edges firmly to seal. Transfer to the tray, sprinkle the remaining mozzarella over the tops, and bake for 15 to 18 minutes until the crust is golden brown and the filling is hot. Let the calzones rest for 5 minutes before serving so the cheese settles.

title: Lime-Marinated Shrimp Ceviche with Avocado, Cucumber and Coriander
ingredients_json: ["400 g shrimp, raw, peeled", "180 ml lime juice, freshly squeezed", "80 g red onion, raw", "150 g cucumber, raw", "120 g tomato, raw", "80 g avocado, raw", "15 g coriander leaves, fresh", "1 piece green chili pepper, raw", "10 ml olive oil", "3 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "120 g corn kernels, cooked"]
instructions: Cut the shrimp into bite-sized pieces and place them in a non-reactive bowl. Pour over the lime juice and mix well so every piece is coated. Cover and chill for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the shrimp turn opaque and firm at the edges but are still tender in the center. While the shrimp cures, finely dice the red onion, cucumber, tomato, avocado, and chili, and chop the coriander. When the shrimp are ready, drain off a little of the excess lime juice if needed, then fold in the vegetables, coriander, olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Taste and adjust the seasoning if necessary. Spoon the ceviche over the cooked corn kernels and serve immediately while cold and fresh.

title: Lime-Dressed Salmon Ceviche with Avocado, Cucumber and Red Onion
ingredients_json: ["300 g salmon fillet, sashimi-grade, skinless", "120 ml lime juice, freshly squeezed", "30 ml lemon juice, freshly squeezed", "80 g red onion, thinly sliced", "100 g cucumber, diced", "120 g avocado, diced", "80 g cherry tomatoes, quartered", "15 g fresh coriander leaves, chopped", "10 g fresh jalapeño pepper, finely sliced", "5 ml extra virgin olive oil", "3 g fine salt", "1 g ground black pepper", "120 g cooked sweet potato, cubed"]
instructions: Cut the salmon into 1.5 cm cubes and place them in a glass or ceramic bowl. Add the lime juice and lemon juice, then gently stir so the fish is evenly coated. Cover and chill for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the salmon turns opaque on the outside but still looks tender in the center. While the fish marinates, soak the sliced red onion in cold water for 5 minutes, then drain well. Mix the cucumber, avocado, cherry tomatoes, coriander, jalapeño, olive oil, salt and black pepper in a separate bowl. Fold the drained onion and the marinated salmon into the vegetable mixture carefully so the fish stays in good pieces. Serve immediately over the cooked sweet potato cubes for a more balanced dinner, and spoon any extra citrus dressing over the top.

title: Lime-Marinated Tuna Ceviche with Avocado, Cucumber and Sweet Potato
ingredients_json: ["400 g tuna loin, raw, sushi-grade", "180 ml lime juice, fresh", "60 ml lemon juice, fresh", "120 g red onion", "150 g cucumber, with peel", "120 g avocado, raw, flesh", "120 g sweet potato, cooked", "80 g cherry tomatoes", "15 g coriander, fresh", "1 piece red chilli pepper", "10 ml olive oil", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Cut the tuna into 1.5 cm cubes and place them in a glass bowl. Add the lime juice and lemon juice, then mix gently so the fish is fully coated. Cover and chill for 15 to 20 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the outside of the tuna turns opaque but the centre remains tender. While the tuna marinates, finely slice the red onion, dice the cucumber, halve the cherry tomatoes, chop the coriander, and thinly slice the chilli. Peel and cube the cooked sweet potato and dice the avocado just before serving. Drain off about half of the citrus juice if you want a less sharp ceviche, then fold in the onion, cucumber, tomatoes, chilli, coriander, olive oil, salt and black pepper. title: Lime-Dressed Salmon Ceviche with Avocado, Cucumber and Red Onion
ingredients_json: ["350 g salmon fillet, fresh, sushi-grade", "120 ml lime juice, fresh", "60 ml lemon juice, fresh", "120 g red onion, raw", "150 g cucumber, with peel, raw", "120 g avocado, raw", "80 g tomato, raw", "15 g fresh coriander leaves", "1 piece red chilli pepper, raw", "10 g ginger, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "120 g sweet potato, boiled"]

title: Garlic-Ginger Chicken Adobo with Brown Rice and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["800 g chicken thigh, boneless, skinless", "60 ml soy sauce, regular", "60 ml vinegar, cane", "250 ml water", "20 g garlic, raw", "15 g ginger, raw", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 pieces bay leaf", "15 ml canola oil", "200 g onion, raw", "300 g brown rice, cooked", "150 g spinach, raw"]

title: Lighter Chicken Adobo with Garlic, Bay Leaves and Brown Rice

title: Garlic-Lime Chicken Adobo with Spinach and Brown Rice

title: Ginger-Garlic Chicken Adobo with Brown Rice and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["700 g Chicken thigh, boneless, skinless", "60 ml Soy sauce, reduced sodium", "60 ml Vinegar, cane", "4 cloves Garlic, raw", "20 g Ginger, raw", "2 medium Onion, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "240 ml Water", "2 pieces Bay leaf", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "300 g Brown rice, cooked", "100 g Spinach, raw", "10 g Spring onion, raw"]

title: Light Chicken and Herb Dumplings with Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["500 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "120 g Onion, raw", "100 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Celery, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "30 g Wholemeal flour", "1000 ml Chicken stock, low sodium", "150 g Frozen peas", "5 g Fresh thyme", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt", "200 g Whole wheat flour", "8 g Baking powder", "2 g Salt", "15 g Fresh parsley", "180 ml Milk, low fat", "30 g Plain yogurt, low fat"]

title: Baked Chicken Cordon Bleu with Wholegrain Mustard Yogurt Sauce

Toss the pasta with the spinach, parsley, and olive oil so the spinach wilts gently from the heat. Serve the chicken over the pasta and spoon the piccata sauce over the top.

title: Lemon-Garlic Chicken Piccata with Capers and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken breast fillet, skinless", "30 g wholemeal flour", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g unsalted butter", "2 cloves garlic", "250 ml chicken stock, low salt", "60 ml lemon juice", "1 lemon", "20 g capers, drained", "120 g baby spinach", "2 g black pepper", "2 g salt", "10 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts horizontally into thin cutlets and lightly coat them with the wholemeal flour mixed with black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for about 3 minutes per side until golden and just cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a warm plate. Lower the heat to medium, add the butter and garlic, and stir for 30 seconds until fragrant without browning. Pour in the chicken stock, lemon juice, and capers, then simmer for 4 to 5 minutes until the sauce reduces slightly and tastes bright and savoury. Add the spinach and cook for 1 minute, just until wilted. Return the chicken to the pan, spoon the sauce over the top, and warm through for 1 minute. Finish with lemon slices and chopped parsley before serving.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken Salad with Avocado, Chickpeas and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["350 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "10 ml Olive oil", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "1 g Garlic, fresh", "120 g Chickpeas, cooked, drained", "80 g Spinach, raw", "120 g Tomato, raw", "100 g Cucumber, raw", "70 g Avocado, raw", "30 g Red onion, raw", "15 g Pumpkin seeds", "20 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 ml Water", "5 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Pat the chicken fillets dry and season them with salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat, then cook the chicken for about 5 to 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, with the juices running clear. Transfer to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing. In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, grated garlic, Greek yogurt and water until smooth. In a large salad bowl, combine the spinach, chickpeas, tomato, cucumber, avocado and red onion. Add the sliced chicken on top, drizzle over the dressing and toss gently so the avocado stays in chunks. Finish with pumpkin seeds and chopped parsley, then serve immediately while the chicken is still slightly warm.

title: Grilled Lemon Herb Chicken Salad with Avocado, Chickpeas and Yogurt Dressing
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "30 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "2 g Garlic, raw", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt, table", "120 g Chickpeas, boiled and drained", "80 g Avocado, raw, flesh only", "120 g Cherry tomatoes", "80 g Cucumber, with peel", "60 g Red onion, raw", "100 g Lettuce, mixed salad greens", "40 g Spinach, raw", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 g Dijon mustard", "5 g Honey", "5 g Fresh dill", "15 g Pumpkin seeds"]
instructions: Pat the chicken fillets dry and place them in a bowl with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, half of the lemon juice, the garlic, black pepper, and salt. Mix well and let them sit for 10 minutes. Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, with the juices running clear and the center no longer pink. Set the chicken aside to rest for 5 minutes before slicing. While the chicken cooks, whisk the yogurt, Dijon mustard, honey, the remaining lemon juice, dill, and the rest of the olive oil into a smooth dressing. In a large salad bowl, combine the lettuce, spinach, chickpeas, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and avocado. Add the sliced chicken on top, drizzle over the dressing, and finish with the pumpkin seeds. Toss lightly or serve arranged in sections so the salad stays fresh and crisp.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken Salad with Avocado, Chickpeas and Yogurt Dressing
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "200 g Chickpeas, boiled", "120 g Mixed salad leaves, raw", "150 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "100 g Cucumber, raw", "80 g Avocado, raw", "60 g Red onion, raw", "30 g Pumpkin seeds, roasted", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "20 ml Lemon juice, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "10 g Dijon mustard", "5 g Garlic, raw", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "10 g Fresh parsley, raw"]
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Season the chicken fillets with half of the salt, the black pepper, and half of the garlic, then cook for about 5 to 6 minutes per side until golden and the thickest part reaches 75°C. Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing. While the chicken cooks, whisk the yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon mustard, remaining garlic, and the rest of the salt into a smooth dressing. In a large bowl, combine the salad leaves, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, chickpeas, avocado, and parsley. Add the sliced chicken on top, drizzle with the dressing, and gently toss just before serving. Finish with the pumpkin seeds for crunch.

title: Grilled Lemon Herb Chicken Salad with Avocado, Chickpeas and Crunchy Greens
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast fillet, without skin", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 tbsp Lemon juice, raw", "1 tsp Garlic, raw, minced", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1/2 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1/2 tsp Salt", "120 g Lettuce, romaine, raw", "80 g Spinach, raw", "100 g Cucumber, raw", "120 g Cherry tomatoes, raw", "80 g Carrot, raw", "120 g Chickpeas, canned, drained", "70 g Avocado, raw", "20 g Red onion, raw", "15 g Pumpkin seeds", "1 tbsp Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard"]
instructions: Pat the chicken breast dry and mix 1 tablespoon of olive oil with the lemon juice, garlic, oregano, black pepper and salt. Coat the chicken well and let it sit for 10 minutes while you prepare the salad. Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes per side, until nicely browned and the thickest part is cooked through and the juices run clear. Transfer it to a board and rest for 5 minutes before slicing. Meanwhile, whisk the yogurt, Dijon mustard and remaining olive oil into a smooth dressing. Arrange the romaine, spinach, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, carrot, chickpeas, avocado and red onion in a large bowl or divide between plates. Top with the sliced chicken, drizzle over the dressing and finish with pumpkin seeds. Serve immediately while the chicken is warm and the greens are crisp.

title: Grilled Chicken Salad with Avocado, Chickpeas and Lemon Yogurt Dressing
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper", "10 ml Olive oil", "150 g Chickpeas, cooked, drained", "100 g Cherry tomatoes", "100 g Cucumber, with peel", "80 g Carrot, raw", "60 g Red onion", "100 g Lettuce, mixed leaves", "70 g Avocado, raw, flesh", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "20 ml Lemon juice", "5 g Dijon mustard", "5 g Fresh parsley", "1 g Garlic, raw"]
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Season the chicken breast fillets with salt and black pepper, then brush them lightly with olive oil. Cook the chicken for about 5 to 6 minutes per side until it is well browned and the thickest part reaches 75 degrees C. Transfer it to a plate and rest for 5 minutes before slicing. While the chicken cooks, rinse and drain the chickpeas, halve the cherry tomatoes, slice the cucumber, grate the carrot, thinly slice the red onion, and chop the parsley. In a bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, parsley, and garlic until smooth. Arrange the mixed leaves, chickpeas, tomatoes, cucumber, carrot, onion, and avocado on four plates. Slice the rested chicken and place it on top. Spoon the dressing over the salad and serve immediately while the chicken is still slightly warm.

title: Ginger-Garlic Chicken Teriyaki with Brown Rice and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken breast fillet, skinless", "250 g brown rice, dry", "250 g broccoli florets, fresh", "150 g carrot, raw", "2 tbsp rapeseed oil", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "2 tbsp mirin", "1 tbsp honey", "2 cloves garlic, fresh", "15 g ginger root, fresh", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "1 tbsp sesame seeds, toasted", "2 spring onions, fresh", "100 ml water"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it in lightly salted water according to the package instructions until tender, then keep it covered while you finish the dish. Slice the chicken breast into bite-sized strips and finely grate the garlic and ginger. Mix the soy sauce, mirin, honey, rice vinegar, water, garlic, and ginger in a bowl to make the teriyaki sauce. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is golden and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the pan and set it aside. Add the remaining oil to the same pan and stir-fry the broccoli and sliced carrot over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes so they stay bright and slightly crisp. Return the chicken to the pan, pour in the sauce, and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until it glazes the chicken and thickens slightly. Serve the teriyaki chicken over the brown rice, then finish with toasted sesame seeds and sliced spring onions.

title: Ginger Garlic Chicken Teriyaki with Brown Rice and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast fillet, without skin", "180 g brown rice, dry", "250 g broccoli florets, raw", "1 piece carrot, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 g ginger root, raw", "60 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "30 ml water", "20 g honey", "15 ml rice vinegar", "10 ml sesame oil", "5 g cornstarch", "15 ml water", "10 g sesame seeds, toasted", "2 stalks spring onion, raw"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it in lightly salted water according to the packet instructions until tender, then keep it covered so it stays warm. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Finely grate the garlic and ginger, then mix them with the soy sauce, water, honey, rice vinegar and sesame oil to make the teriyaki sauce. Stir the cornstarch into the extra water in a small cup until smooth. Heat a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly golden and cooked through. Add the sauce and bring it to a gentle simmer, then stir in the cornstarch mixture and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until the sauce turns glossy and coats the chicken. While the chicken cooks, steam or blanch the broccoli and sliced carrot for 3 to 4 minutes until bright and just tender. Serve the chicken teriyaki over the brown rice with the vegetables on the side, then finish with sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.

title: Ginger-Sesame Chicken Teriyaki with Brown Rice and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken breast fillet, skinless", "200 g brown rice, dry", "300 g broccoli florets", "150 g carrot, raw", "2 tbsp sesame oil", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "20 g ginger root, fresh", "60 ml soy sauce, reduced sodium", "40 ml mirin", "30 ml rice vinegar", "20 g honey", "10 g cornstarch", "80 ml water", "15 g sesame seeds, toasted", "2 pieces spring onion"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it in plenty of water until tender, about 25 to 30 minutes. While the rice cooks, cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season lightly with half of the ginger, half of the garlic, and a small splash of the soy sauce. Heat 1 tablespoon of sesame oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until golden and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the pan. Add the remaining sesame oil, the broccoli, and the carrot sliced into thin strips, then stir-fry over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes until bright and just tender. In a small bowl, mix the remaining soy sauce, mirin, rice vinegar, honey, cornstarch, water, the rest of the garlic, and the rest of the ginger until smooth. Pour the sauce into the pan and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring, until it thickens and becomes glossy. Return the chicken to the pan and coat it well in the teriyaki sauce. Serve the chicken and vegetables over the cooked brown rice and finish with sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.

title: Ginger Garlic Chicken Teriyaki with Brown Rice and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast fillet, without skin", "200 g brown rice, dry", "300 g broccoli florets, raw", "1 piece carrot, raw", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "2 tbsp mirin", "1 tbsp honey", "1 tbsp rice vinegar", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "10 g ginger, fresh", "1 tsp sesame oil", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "2 tsp cornflour", "100 ml water", "10 g spring onion, raw", "1 tbsp sesame seeds, toasted"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice under cold water, then cook it in lightly salted water until tender, about 25 to 30 minutes. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and slice the carrot into thin matchsticks. In a small bowl, mix the soy sauce, mirin, honey, rice vinegar, minced garlic, grated ginger, cornflour, and water until smooth. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat, then add the chicken and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned and cooked through. Add the carrot and broccoli, then cook for 3 to 4 minutes over medium heat so the vegetables stay bright and slightly crisp. Pour in the teriyaki sauce and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until it thickens and coats the chicken and vegetables. Finish with the sesame oil, then serve the chicken teriyaki over the brown rice and garnish with sliced spring onion and sesame seeds.

title: Ginger-Garlic Chicken Teriyaki with Brown Rice and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["600 g chicken thigh fillet, skinless", "200 g brown rice, uncooked", "300 g broccoli florets", "150 g carrots", "2 cloves garlic", "15 g fresh ginger", "60 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "40 ml mirin", "20 ml rice vinegar", "25 g honey", "10 ml sesame oil", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "10 g cornstarch", "60 ml water", "15 g spring onions", "5 g sesame seeds"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it in lightly salted water according to the packet instructions until tender. While the rice cooks, cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and slice the carrots into thin matchsticks. Finely grate the garlic and ginger. Mix the soy sauce, mirin, rice vinegar, honey, and water in a bowl, then stir in the cornstarch until smooth. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and add the chicken in a single layer. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes, turning occasionally, until the pieces are golden and cooked through. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds over medium heat until fragrant. Pour in the sauce and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring, until it thickens and coats the chicken with a glossy sheen. Heat the sesame oil in a separate pan over medium heat, then add the broccoli and carrots with a small splash of water. Stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes until the vegetables are bright and just tender but still crisp. Serve the chicken teriyaki over the brown rice, add the vegetables on the side, and finish with sliced spring onions and sesame seeds.

title: Baked Chicken and Black Bean Chilaquiles with Avocado and Lime
ingredients_json: ["300 g corn tortilla chips", "400 g canned tomatoes, chopped", "150 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 piece chili pepper, green, raw", "10 g olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp salt", "250 g chicken breast, cooked", "240 g black beans, canned, drained", "2 piece egg, whole, raw", "80 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "100 g avocado, raw", "30 g fresh coriander leaves", "30 g red onion, raw", "30 g lime juice, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat, then add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and chopped green chilies and cook for 1 minute more, then add the canned tomatoes, cumin, smoked paprika, and salt. Simmer gently for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly and tastes well cooked. Stir in the cooked chicken and black beans and warm through for 2 minutes. Add the tortilla chips and fold them into the sauce just until coated; they should soften at the edges but still keep some texture. Transfer the mixture to a baking dish, make two small wells, and crack in the eggs. Scatter the reduced-fat cheddar over the top and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the egg whites are set and the cheese has melted. Finish with sliced avocado, red onion, coriander, and lime juice, then serve immediately while the chips are still crisp-tender.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Chilaquiles with Tomatillo Salsa and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["200 g corn tortilla chips", "300 g salsa verde, tomatillo-based", "250 g chicken breast, cooked, shredded", "120 g black beans, canned, drained", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 g avocado", "40 g onion, red", "20 g coriander leaves, fresh", "30 g queso fresco", "10 ml olive oil", "1 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "15 ml lime juice"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the salsa verde and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until it looks slightly thicker and bubbles gently. Stir in the black beans and shredded chicken, then warm everything through for another 2 minutes. Add the tortilla chips and toss quickly so they are evenly coated but still keep some crunch. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 1 minute more, just until the chips begin to soften at the edges. In a separate small pan, fry the eggs over medium-low heat until the whites are set and the yolks are still slightly runny, about 3 to 4 minutes. Divide the chilaquiles between plates, top with the eggs, avocado, red onion, coriander, queso fresco, lime juice, salt, and black pepper, and serve immediately while the chips still have texture.

title: Baked Chicken and Black Bean Chilaquiles with Avocado Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["180 g corn tortilla chips, baked", "300 g tomato passata", "150 ml low sodium vegetable broth", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 pieces chili pepper, fresh", "1 tbsp olive oil", "200 g chicken breast, raw", "120 g black beans, cooked", "2 pieces eggs, raw", "60 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 piece avocado, raw", "20 g fresh coriander leaf", "30 g onion, raw, red", "40 g cheese, fresh, reduced fat", "15 ml lime juice, freshly squeezed", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g salt, iodized", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200 C. Warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, then add the chopped onion, garlic, and chili pepper and cook for 3 minutes until fragrant and softened. Stir in the tomato passata, vegetable broth, cumin, salt, and black pepper, then simmer gently for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly. Add the chicken breast and cook over medium-low heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning once, until fully cooked and tender. Stir in the black beans and baked tortilla chips, folding quickly so the chips are coated but still hold some texture. Divide the chilaquiles into two ovenproof dishes or keep them in the skillet, crack the eggs on top, and bake for 6 to 8 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks are still a little soft. Mix the Greek yogurt with lime juice, then top the chilaquiles with avocado slices, red onion, coriander, and reduced-fat cheese. Serve immediately while the chips are still lightly crisp around the edges and the sauce is hot.

title: Baked Chicken and Black Bean Chilaquiles with Salsa Verde
ingredients_json: ["200 g corn tortilla chips", "300 g chicken breast fillet, boneless, skinless", "250 g salsa verde", "150 g canned black beans, drained", "2 pieces egg, raw", "80 g onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "50 g feta cheese, reduced fat", "80 g avocado, raw", "20 g fresh coriander leaves", "10 g lime juice, raw", "1 g ground cumin", "1 g smoked paprika", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook for 4 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika, then cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the chicken breast and salt, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, turning once, until the outside is lightly golden and the chicken is just cooked through. Remove the pan from the heat and shred or slice the chicken. Warm the salsa verde in a saucepan over low heat, then fold in the black beans and chicken so everything is coated. Arrange the tortilla chips in a shallow baking dish, spoon the saucy chicken mixture over them, and bake for 5 to 7 minutes until the chips are warmed but still slightly crisp at the edges. Fry or poach the eggs in a nonstick pan over medium heat until the whites are set and the yolks are still soft. Serve the chilaquiles topped with the eggs, crumbled feta, avocado, coriander, and lime juice.

title: Baked Chicken and Black Bean Chilaquiles with Tomatillo Salsa
ingredients_json: ["200 g corn tortilla chips", "300 g chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "10 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "300 g tomatillos, raw", "2 pieces jalapeño pepper, raw", "15 g coriander leaves, fresh", "150 g black beans, cooked", "2 pieces egg, whole, raw", "80 g feta cheese", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "1 piece avocado, raw", "15 ml lime juice, raw", "5 g salt, table", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the chicken breast on a tray, rub it with half of the olive oil, 2 g of the salt, and the black pepper, then roast for about 18 to 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear. While it cooks, place the tomatillos, jalapeños, onion, and garlic in a saucepan with a small splash of water and simmer over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes until softened. Blend the cooked vegetables with the coriander, lime juice, and the remaining salt until smooth and bright green. Warm the black beans in a small pan over low heat. Fry or poach the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks are still soft. Slice the cooked chicken. Toss the tortilla chips with the tomatillo salsa in a large ovenproof dish just until coated, then fold in the black beans and chicken. Scatter the feta over the top and bake for 5 minutes so the chips soften slightly but still hold some texture. Top with the eggs, avocado slices, and yogurt, then serve immediately while the chilaquiles are warm and lightly crisp around the edges.

title: Baked Poblano Chiles Rellenos with Black Beans, Corn, and Tomato Salsa
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces Poblano peppers, raw", "200 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "120 g Sweetcorn, cooked", "80 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "150 g Tomato, raw", "30 g Coriander leaves, raw", "150 g Cheese, fresh, reduced fat", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "30 g Wholemeal breadcrumbs", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 g Ground cumin", "2 g Smoked paprika", "3 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "30 g Avocado"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray. Place the poblano peppers on the tray and roast for 12 to 15 minutes, turning once, until the skins are blistered and the peppers have softened. Transfer them to a bowl, cover, and leave for 10 minutes so they steam and become easier to peel. Meanwhile, warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes until translucent. Add the garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika, then cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the black beans and corn, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until heated through. Remove from the heat and fold in half of the coriander. Slit each pepper lengthwise and carefully remove some seeds, keeping the pepper intact. Fill each pepper with the bean mixture and sprinkle the reduced-fat cheese inside. Whisk the eggs in a shallow bowl, then dip the stuffed peppers lightly and coat them with the wholemeal breadcrumbs. Return the peppers to the tray and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the coating is golden and the cheese has melted. Chop the tomato and mix it with the remaining coriander, a little salt, and black pepper to make a fresh salsa. Serve the chiles rellenos topped with the tomato salsa and sliced avocado.

title: Baked Poblano Chiles Rellenos with Black Beans, Corn and Tomato Salsa
ingredients_json: ["4 piece poblano peppers", "200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "100 g sweet corn kernels, cooked", "120 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g tomato, raw", "30 g coriander leaves, fresh", "120 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese", "3 piece egg, raw", "30 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "15 ml olive oil", "10 ml lemon juice", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with foil or baking paper. Place the poblano peppers on the tray and roast for 15 to 18 minutes, turning once, until the skins are blistered and softened. Transfer them to a bowl and cover for 10 minutes so they steam, then carefully peel off any loose skin, make a slit along one side, and remove the seeds while keeping the peppers intact. Lower the oven to 200 C. Finely chop the onion, garlic, tomato and coriander. Warm the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes until translucent. Add the garlic, cumin and smoked paprika, then cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the black beans, corn, tomato, lemon juice, half the coriander, salt and black pepper, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the mixture is heated through and slightly thickened. Spoon the filling into each pepper and tuck in a little grated cheese, then arrange them in a baking dish. Beat the eggs in a bowl until smooth, brush the tops lightly with beaten egg, and sprinkle over the wholemeal breadcrumbs. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the cheese has melted and the tops are lightly golden. Scatter over the remaining coriander and serve hot.

title: Baked Poblano Chiles Rellenos with Black Beans, Corn and Tomato Salsa
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces poblano peppers, raw", "200 g black beans, cooked, drained", "120 g sweet corn kernels, cooked", "120 g tomato, red, raw", "80 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "60 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "60 g feta cheese", "2 pieces egg, raw", "60 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "15 ml olive oil", "15 g fresh coriander leaves", "10 ml lime juice, raw", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Place the poblano peppers on the tray and roast them for 15 to 20 minutes, turning once, until the skins are blistered and softened. Transfer the hot peppers to a bowl and cover them for 10 minutes so they steam; then peel away the loose skin, make a slit down one side, and remove the seeds carefully while keeping the peppers intact. Reduce the oven to 200 C. In a bowl, mix the black beans, corn, finely chopped onion, minced garlic, cumin, paprika, coriander, lime juice, cheddar, feta, salt, and black pepper. Spoon the filling into each pepper without overstuffing, then close them gently and place them seam-side down in a lightly oiled baking dish. Beat the eggs in a shallow bowl. Sprinkle the breadcrumbs over the stuffed peppers, then spoon or brush a little beaten egg over the tops so the crumbs stick, using the rest of the egg to lightly coat the outside. Drizzle with the olive oil and bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until the peppers are hot through, the filling is steaming, and the topping is golden. Let the chiles rest for 5 minutes before serving with a fresh tomato salsa or extra lime wedges if desired.

title: Baked Poblano Chiles Rellenos with Black Beans and Tomato Salsa
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces poblano peppers", "200 g black beans, canned, drained", "120 g sweetcorn kernels, frozen", "120 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g tomato, raw", "80 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "60 g feta cheese", "2 pieces egg, raw", "30 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g fresh coriander leaves", "15 ml lime juice", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]

Beat the eggs in a shallow bowl and place the breadcrumbs in another bowl. Dip each stuffed pepper first into the egg, then lightly coat with breadcrumbs, and return them to the baking tray. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the coating is golden and the filling is hot. Serve immediately with the remaining fresh tomato spooned over the top.

title: Baked Poblano Chiles Rellenos with Black Beans, Corn, and Tomato Salsa
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces poblano peppers", "240 g black beans, cooked, drained", "120 g sweetcorn kernels, cooked", "80 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g tomato, raw", "40 g baby spinach, raw", "120 g cheese, reduced-fat mozzarella", "2 pieces egg, raw", "60 ml milk, 1.5% fat", "15 ml olive oil", "5 g ground cumin", "3 g smoked paprika", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "10 g fresh coriander leaves", "20 ml lime juice"]
instructions:
