Transfer them to a covered bowl for 10 minutes so they steam, then peel off some of the loosened skin without tearing the peppers. Cut a slit down one side of each pepper and carefully remove the seeds while keeping the stem intact.

Warm the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until translucent, then add the garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the black beans, sweetcorn, diced tomato, and spinach, then cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the spinach wilts and the mixture looks moist but not watery. Season with salt, black pepper, and lime juice, then fold in half of the coriander.

Spoon the bean mixture evenly into the peppers and add the reduced-fat mozzarella on top, pressing it gently inside the openings. Arrange the stuffed peppers in a baking dish. Whisk the eggs with the milk until smooth, then lightly spoon or brush the mixture over the tops of the peppers so they help brown in the oven. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until the filling is hot, the cheese has melted, and the tops are just set and lightly golden. Sprinkle with the remaining coriander and serve warm.

title: Smoky Turkey and Kidney Bean Chili with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw, medium", "500 g turkey mince, lean, raw", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "250 g kidney beans, canned, drained", "150 g sweetcorn, frozen", "250 ml chicken stock, reduced salt", "2 tsp ground cumin", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp mild chili powder", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt", "150 g brown rice, dry", "2 tbsp plain yogurt, low fat", "15 g fresh coriander"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice, then cook it in plenty of water for about 25 to 30 minutes until tender but still slightly chewy. Drain and keep warm. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large heavy saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and red bell pepper and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and break it up with a spoon. Cook over medium-high heat for 5 to 7 minutes until no pink remains and the meat starts to brown. Stir in the tomato paste, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, chili powder, black pepper and salt, and cook for 1 minute to toast the spices. Add the chopped tomatoes, kidney beans, sweetcorn and chicken stock, then bring to a gentle simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chili is thick and the flavors have come together. If it looks too dry, add a small splash of water during cooking. Serve the chili over the brown rice and finish with a spoonful of low-fat yogurt and chopped fresh coriander.

title: Smoky Turkey and Black Bean Chili with Peppers and Corn
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "500 g turkey mince, lean, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece yellow bell pepper, raw", "2 tbsp chilli powder", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "400 g black beans, canned, drained", "200 g kidney beans, canned, drained", "150 g sweetcorn, frozen", "200 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "1 tbsp tomato puree", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "15 g fresh coriander, raw", "100 g plain yogurt, low fat"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, diced fairly small, and cook for about 5 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince and break it up with a spoon. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes over medium-high heat until no longer pink. Add the diced red and yellow peppers, chilli powder, cumin, smoked paprika, and oregano, then cook for 2 minutes to toast the spices. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, black beans, kidney beans, sweetcorn, vegetable stock, tomato puree, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chili has thickened and the peppers are tender. Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed, then stir through most of the coriander. Serve hot with a spoonful of yogurt on top and the remaining coriander scattered over the bowls.

title: Smoky Turkey and Bean Chili with Sweet Peppers
ingredients_json: ["15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "300 g turkey mince, lean", "1 piece red sweet pepper, raw", "1 piece green sweet pepper, raw", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "400 g kidney beans, canned, drained", "150 g black beans, canned, drained", "150 g corn kernels, frozen", "30 g tomato paste", "5 g ground cumin", "4 g smoked paprika", "2 g dried oregano", "1 g chili powder", "500 ml water", "3 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "15 g fresh coriander leaves"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and break it up with a spoon, cooking over medium-high heat for 5 to 6 minutes until no longer pink. Stir in the diced sweet peppers, tomato paste, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, chili powder, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute so the spices bloom. Add the chopped tomatoes, water, kidney beans, black beans, and corn, then bring the chili to a gentle boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened and the flavours are well developed. Stir in the coriander leaves just before serving.

title: Smoky Turkey and Black Bean Chili with Tomatoes and Peppers
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "500 g turkey mince, raw, lean", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece carrot, raw", "2 tbsp chili powder", "2 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "400 g tomatoes, canned, chopped", "400 g black beans, canned, drained", "200 g kidney beans, canned, drained", "500 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "2 tbsp tomato puree", "1 tsp salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "10 g coriander, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic, diced carrot, and diced red pepper and cook for another 3 minutes. Add the turkey mince and increase the heat to medium-high, breaking it up with a spoon and cooking for 5 to 6 minutes until no longer pink. Stir in the chili powder, cumin, and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute so the spices become fragrant. Add the chopped tomatoes, black beans, kidney beans, vegetable stock, tomato puree, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to low heat and simmer uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chili has thickened and the vegetables are tender. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed, then serve hot topped with chopped fresh coriander.

title: Smoky Turkey and Bean Chili with Tomatoes and Peppers
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "400 g turkey mince, lean, raw", "1 piece red pepper, raw", "1 piece carrot, raw", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "400 g tomatoes, canned, chopped", "250 g kidney beans, canned, drained", "250 g black beans, canned, drained", "500 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "2 tsp ground cumin", "2 tsp paprika, smoked", "1 tsp chili powder", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt", "150 g sweetcorn, frozen"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and carrot and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until the onion is soft and starting to turn translucent. Stir in the garlic, red pepper, cumin, smoked paprika, chili powder, oregano, black pepper, and salt, then cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook over medium-high heat for about 6 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon until it is no longer pink. Stir in the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, beans, and vegetable stock, then bring everything to a gentle boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer uncovered for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chili has thickened and the flavours have blended. Add the sweetcorn and cook for another 5 minutes until heated through. Serve hot while the chili is rich and spoonable.

title: Smoky Salmon and Sweetcorn Chowder with Leeks and Potatoes
ingredients_json: ["300 g salmon fillet, raw", "200 g sweetcorn kernels, frozen", "250 g potatoes, raw", "120 g leek, raw", "80 g onion, raw", "1 clove garlic, raw", "10 g butter, unsalted", "10 ml rapeseed oil", "800 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "250 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "100 g carrots, raw", "2 g smoked paprika", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt, iodised", "15 g fresh parsley, raw", "20 ml lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the rapeseed oil and butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion, sliced leek, diced carrots, and garlic, then cook for about 5 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables begin to soften but do not brown. Stir in the potatoes and smoked paprika, then pour in the vegetable stock. Bring to a gentle boil, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes until the potatoes are nearly tender. Add the sweetcorn and continue to simmer for 5 minutes. Cut the salmon into bite-sized pieces and add them to the pot with the milk, black pepper, and iodised salt. Keep the heat low and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, just until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily. Stir in the lemon juice and chopped parsley, then ladle the chowder into bowls and serve immediately while hot.

title: Smoked Salmon and Sweetcorn Chowder with Leeks and Potatoes
ingredients_json: ["20 g butter", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 medium leek, trimmed and sliced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "300 g potatoes, peeled and diced", "150 g sweetcorn kernels, frozen", "750 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "250 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "200 g salmon, smoked, sliced", "100 g carrots, diced", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 leaf bay leaf", "15 g parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Melt the butter with the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the leeks and carrots and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until softened but not browned. Stir in the garlic, thyme, and potatoes, then cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in the vegetable stock and add the bay leaf. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender. Add the sweetcorn and milk, and cook over low heat for 5 minutes without letting the chowder boil. Stir in the smoked salmon and cook for 2 to 3 minutes just until warmed through. Remove the bay leaf, then finish with lemon juice, black pepper, and chopped parsley. Ladle into bowls and serve hot.

title: Salmon, Corn and Potato Chowder with Dill
ingredients_json: ["15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "200 g potato, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "100 g celery, raw", "300 g salmon, raw", "150 g sweetcorn kernels, canned, drained", "750 ml fish stock, home-prepared", "250 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "10 g wheat flour, white", "15 g butter", "15 g fresh dill", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil and butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion, celery, and carrot, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the onion is soft and translucent but not browned. Stir in the garlic and flour and cook for 1 minute to form a light roux. Add the diced potato, fish stock, and milk, then bring the pot to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat. Cook for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potato is tender and the chowder has thickened slightly. Add the salmon cut into bite-size chunks and the drained sweetcorn, then simmer very gently for 4 to 5 minutes until the salmon is just cooked through and flakes easily. Stir in the chopped dill, black pepper, and salt, then remove from the heat and let it stand for 2 minutes before serving so the flavours settle. Serve hot in bowls while the chowder is still creamy and fragrant.

title: Salmon, Sweetcorn and Potato Chowder with Leeks and Dill
ingredients_json: ["300 g salmon fillet, raw", "300 g potatoes, raw", "150 g sweetcorn kernels, frozen", "120 g leek, raw", "80 g onion, raw", "10 g garlic, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "750 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "250 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "100 g carrots, raw", "15 g fresh dill", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sliced leek and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until softened but not browned. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Add the diced potatoes and carrots, then pour in the low-salt vegetable stock. Bring to a gentle boil, reduce the heat to low, and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes until the vegetables are just tender. Add the sweetcorn and milk, then simmer gently for 3 minutes without letting the chowder boil. Cut the salmon into bite-sized chunks and add it to the pan. Cook over low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring very gently, until the salmon is opaque and flakes easily. Stir in the dill, black pepper, and salt, then taste and adjust if needed. Serve hot while the chowder is creamy and the vegetables still hold their shape.

title: Creamy Salmon, Corn and Potato Chowder with Dill
ingredients_json: ["300 g salmon fillet, raw, without skin", "250 g potatoes, raw", "150 g sweetcorn kernels, frozen", "120 g onion, raw", "100 g celery, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "20 g butter, unsalted", "10 ml olive oil", "750 ml fish stock, reduced salt", "250 ml milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "100 ml cooking cream, 15% fat", "15 g plain flour, wheat", "10 g fresh dill", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt, iodised"]
instructions: Peel the potatoes and carrot, then cut them into small, even cubes. Dice the onion and celery finely, and cut the salmon into bite-sized chunks. Melt the butter with the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat, then add the onion, celery and carrot. Cook for about 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables soften without browning. Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 minute so it cooks out slightly and coats the vegetables. Slowly pour in the fish stock while stirring to keep the soup smooth, then add the potatoes and bring the pot up to a gentle simmer. Cook over medium-low heat for about 12 minutes, until the potatoes are nearly tender. Add the sweetcorn, milk and cooking cream, then simmer gently for another 5 minutes without letting the chowder boil hard. Stir in the salmon pieces and cook for 3 to 4 minutes more, just until the fish turns opaque and flakes easily. Finish with chopped dill, black pepper and the iodised salt, then serve hot.

title: Herbed Crab Cakes with Lemon Yogurt and Green Salad
ingredients_json: ["400 g crab meat, cooked, drained", "60 g breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g onion, spring, raw", "15 g parsley, fresh", "10 g dill, fresh", "15 g mayonnaise, reduced fat", "10 g Dijon mustard", "15 ml lemon juice, freshly squeezed", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt", "20 g olive oil", "150 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "5 g lemon zest", "120 g lettuce, mixed leaves", "100 g cucumber, raw", "100 g tomato, raw"]
instructions: Place the crab meat in a bowl and gently check for any shell fragments. Finely chop the spring onion, parsley, and dill, then add them to the crab with the breadcrumbs, egg, mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, black pepper, and salt. Mix lightly until the mixture just comes together, then shape it into 8 small patties. Stir the yogurt with the lemon zest and chill it while you cook. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium heat. Cook the crab cakes for about 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden brown and heated through, reducing the heat a little if they brown too quickly. Serve the crab cakes with the lemon yogurt and a simple salad of lettuce, cucumber, and tomato.

title: Lemon Herb Crab Cakes with Yogurt Dill Sauce
ingredients_json: ["450 g crab meat, cooked, drained", "80 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "20 g spring onion", "15 g parsley, fresh", "10 g dill, fresh", "10 g lemon juice", "1 tsp lemon zest", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "2 g garlic powder", "1 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "120 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "10 g lemon juice", "5 g dill, fresh", "1 g garlic powder"]
instructions: Place the crab meat in a large bowl and check carefully for any shell fragments. Add the breadcrumbs, egg, 60 g Greek yogurt, spring onion, parsley, dill, lemon juice, lemon zest, Dijon mustard, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt. Fold the mixture gently until just combined, then shape it into 8 even patties about 2 cm thick. Chill the patties for 15 minutes so they firm up and hold together better while cooking. Heat the olive oil and rapeseed oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Cook the crab cakes for 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden brown and heated through, adjusting the heat if they brown too quickly. In a small bowl, stir together the remaining Greek yogurt, lemon juice, dill, and garlic powder to make a fresh sauce. Serve the crab cakes warm with the yogurt dill sauce and a simple green salad or steamed vegetables.

title: Lemon Herb Crab Cakes with Yogurt Dill Sauce
ingredients_json: ["400 g crab meat, cooked, drained", "60 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g plain yogurt, low fat", "30 g spring onion", "20 g celery", "15 g parsley, fresh", "10 g dill, fresh", "1 piece lemon, zest", "15 ml lemon juice", "10 g Dijon mustard", "5 g garlic, raw", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "15 ml olive oil", "120 g plain yogurt, low fat", "5 ml lemon juice", "5 g dill, fresh"]
instructions: Place the crab meat in a large bowl and check carefully for any shell fragments. Add the breadcrumbs, egg, plain yogurt, spring onion, celery, parsley, dill, lemon zest, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, garlic, salt, and black pepper. Mix gently until just combined so the crab stays in chunky pieces. Shape the mixture into 8 even cakes and chill them for 15 minutes so they hold together better. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Cook the crab cakes for about 3 to 4 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and hot through, lowering the heat slightly if they brown too quickly. While they cook, stir together the remaining yogurt, lemon juice, and dill for a simple sauce. Serve the crab cakes warm with the yogurt dill sauce and a green salad or steamed vegetables.

title: Lemon Herb Crab Cakes with Yogurt-Dill Sauce
ingredients_json: ["400 g crab meat, cooked, picked over", "60 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 g plain yogurt, low fat", "20 g spring onion, raw", "15 g fresh parsley", "10 g fresh dill", "10 ml lemon juice", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 g black pepper", "2 g salt", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "120 g plain yogurt, low fat", "10 ml lemon juice", "5 g fresh dill", "5 g capers, drained"]
instructions: Place the crab meat in a large bowl and gently break it up, removing any bits of shell. Add the wholemeal breadcrumbs, egg, 30 g yogurt, spring onion, parsley, dill, lemon juice, mustard, black pepper, and salt. Fold everything together carefully so the crab stays in pieces and the mixture just holds together. If it feels too loose, chill it for 15 minutes before shaping. Form the mixture into 8 small cakes and place them on a tray. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Cook the crab cakes for 3 to 4 minutes per side until they are golden brown and heated through, reducing the heat slightly if they colour too quickly. While they cook, stir together the remaining yogurt, lemon juice, dill, and capers for a bright sauce. Serve the crab cakes hot with the yogurt-dill sauce and a simple green salad or steamed vegetables.

title: Lemon Herb Crab Cakes with Yogurt Dill Sauce
ingredients_json: ["450 g crab meat, cooked, drained", "60 g breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g plain yogurt, low-fat", "20 g red onion, finely chopped", "15 g fresh parsley, chopped", "10 g fresh dill, chopped", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp lemon zest", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 clove garlic, minced", "15 ml olive oil", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt", "120 g lettuce, mixed leaves", "150 g cucumber, sliced", "100 g cherry tomatoes", "30 g plain yogurt, low-fat", "5 ml lemon juice", "5 g fresh dill, chopped"]
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the crab meat, wholemeal breadcrumbs, egg, 60 g yogurt, red onion, parsley, dill, lemon juice, lemon zest, Dijon mustard, garlic, black pepper, and salt. Mix gently so the crab stays in noticeable flakes rather than becoming paste-like. Shape the mixture into 8 equal cakes, then chill them for 15 minutes so they hold together better while cooking. Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Cook the crab cakes for about 3 to 4 minutes per side, until they are golden brown and heated through with a firm, crisp exterior. While they cook, stir together the remaining yogurt, lemon juice, and dill to make a quick sauce. Serve the crab cakes hot over mixed leaves, cucumber, and cherry tomatoes, with the dill yogurt sauce spooned over or served on the side.

title: Ginger Turkey and Vegetable Dumplings with Soy-Lime Broth
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "2 piece egg, raw", "120 ml water", "300 g turkey mince, lean, raw", "150 g white cabbage, raw", "80 g carrot, raw", "40 g spring onion, raw", "10 g ginger root, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "10 ml sesame oil", "5 ml rapeseed oil", "600 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "15 ml lime juice, fresh", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Put the flour in a bowl, add the eggs and water, and mix until a rough dough forms. Knead for 6 to 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for 20 minutes. Finely chop the cabbage, carrot, spring onion, ginger, and garlic, then mix them with the turkey mince, soy sauce, sesame oil, and black pepper until evenly combined. Roll the dough thin on a lightly floured surface and cut out 12 to 16 circles. Place a spoonful of filling in the centre of each circle, fold into half-moons, and press the edges firmly to seal. Bring a large pan of water to a gentle boil over medium-high heat, add the dumplings in batches, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until they float and the filling is cooked through. Heat the vegetable stock with the lime juice in a saucepan over medium heat until steaming, then add the rapeseed oil and serve the dumplings in the broth while hot.

title: Ginger Chicken and Vegetable Dumplings with Sesame Soy Dipping Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g wheat flour, white, all-purpose", "140 ml water", "1 g salt, table", "250 g chicken mince, lean", "120 g cabbage, napa, raw", "60 g carrot, raw", "30 g spring onion, raw", "10 g ginger root, fresh", "2 cloves garlic", "15 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "5 ml sesame oil", "1 g black pepper, ground", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "60 ml water", "30 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "15 ml rice vinegar", "5 g honey", "5 g sesame seeds, toasted"]
instructions: Mix the flour and salt in a bowl, then add the water gradually and stir until a rough dough forms. Knead for 6 to 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for 20 minutes. Finely chop the cabbage and spring onion, grate the carrot, and mince the ginger and garlic. Combine the chicken mince, vegetables, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, and black pepper in a bowl and mix until evenly combined. Roll the dough into a thin sheet on a lightly floured surface and cut into 24 small rounds. Place about 1 teaspoon of filling in the centre of each round, then fold and pinch tightly to seal. Bring a large pan of water to a gentle simmer, arrange the dumplings in a lightly oiled steamer basket, and steam over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes until the filling is cooked through and the wrappers look translucent and firm. For the sauce, warm the water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey, and sesame seeds together for 1 minute over low heat. Serve the dumplings hot with the dipping sauce.

title: Steamed Chicken and Vegetable Dumplings with Ginger-Sesame Dipping Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g chicken breast, raw, minced", "150 g cabbage, white, raw, finely shredded", "80 g carrot, raw, finely grated", "2 stalks spring onion, raw, finely sliced", "2 cloves garlic, raw, minced", "10 g ginger, raw, grated", "15 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "5 ml sesame oil", "1 g black pepper, ground", "24 pieces dumpling wrappers, wheat flour", "20 ml water", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "60 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "30 ml rice vinegar", "10 g ginger, raw, finely grated", "5 g honey", "5 g sesame seeds, toasted"]
instructions: Place the minced chicken, cabbage, carrot, spring onion, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, and black pepper in a large bowl. Mix until the filling looks evenly combined and slightly sticky. Lay out the dumpling wrappers and place about 1 tablespoon of filling in the center of each one. Moisten the edges with a little water, fold into half-moons or pleat them closed, and press firmly so they are sealed. Heat a steamer over medium-high heat until the water is steaming steadily. Arrange the dumplings in a single layer on lightly oiled parchment or a cabbage leaf so they do not stick, then steam for 8 to 10 minutes until the wrappers look glossy and the chicken is fully cooked through. While they steam, whisk together the soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger, honey, and sesame seeds for the dipping sauce. Serve the dumplings hot with the sauce on the side.

title: Ginger Chicken and Vegetable Dumplings with Soy-Sesame Dip
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "150 g Cabbage, Chinese, raw", "80 g Carrot, raw", "40 g Spring onion, raw", "10 g Ginger root, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Egg, raw", "15 ml Soy sauce, regular", "10 ml Sesame oil", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "24 pieces Dumpling wrappers, wheat", "20 ml Olive oil", "120 ml Water", "30 ml Rice vinegar", "15 ml Soy sauce, regular", "10 g Coriander leaves, fresh"]
instructions: Finely chop the chicken breast with a knife or pulse it briefly in a food processor so it stays textured rather than turning into a paste. Shred the cabbage and carrot very finely, then squeeze out any excess liquid so the filling is not watery. Mix the chicken, vegetables, spring onion, grated ginger, minced garlic, egg, soy sauce, sesame oil, and black pepper in a bowl until well combined. Let the filling rest for 10 minutes so the flavours meld. Place a spoonful of filling in the centre of each wrapper, moisten the edges with water, and fold into neat dumplings, pressing out any trapped air and sealing tightly. Heat a large non-stick pan over medium heat with the olive oil, arrange the dumplings in a single layer, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the bottoms are golden. Add the water carefully, cover immediately, and steam over medium-low heat for 7 to 8 minutes until the wrappers are tender and the chicken is cooked through. Remove the lid and cook for 1 more minute over medium heat so any remaining moisture evaporates and the bottoms crisp again. Serve hot with a dip made from rice vinegar, soy sauce, and chopped coriander.

title: Steamed Chicken and Vegetable Dumplings with Ginger Soy Dip
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat dumpling wrappers", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "120 g cabbage, shredded", "80 g carrot, grated", "60 g spring onion, chopped", "10 g fresh ginger, grated", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "15 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "5 ml sesame oil", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 g black pepper", "10 ml rapeseed oil", "80 ml water", "30 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "20 ml rice vinegar", "10 g fresh ginger, finely grated", "5 g sesame seeds"]
instructions: Finely chop the chicken breast, or pulse it briefly in a food processor until minced but not pasty. Combine the chicken with cabbage, carrot, spring onion, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sesame oil, egg, and black pepper in a bowl, then mix until evenly distributed. Lay out the dumpling wrappers and place about 1 tablespoon of filling in the centre of each one. Moisten the edges with a little water, fold into half-moons, and press firmly to seal, making sure there are no air pockets. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat, arrange the dumplings in a single layer, and cook for 2 minutes until the bottoms are lightly golden. Carefully pour in the water, cover immediately, and steam over medium-low heat for 6 to 8 minutes until the wrappers are tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. Remove the lid and let any remaining water evaporate for 1 minute so the bottoms become crisp again. Mix the dipping sauce ingredients together and serve alongside the dumplings, sprinkling over the sesame seeds just before serving.

title: Baked Chicken and Vegetable Egg Rolls with Ginger-Sesame Dip
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, raw", "150 g White cabbage, raw", "80 g Carrot, raw", "60 g Onion, raw", "80 g Mushrooms, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "10 g Ginger root, raw", "15 ml Soy sauce", "10 ml Sesame oil", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "12 pieces Rice paper wrappers", "1 piece Egg, raw", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 ml Lime juice", "5 g Fresh coriander leaves", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Finely slice the chicken, cabbage, carrot, onion, mushrooms, garlic, and ginger. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until it is no longer pink. Add the onion, mushrooms, garlic, and ginger and cook for 2 minutes more. Stir in the cabbage, carrot, soy sauce, sesame oil, black pepper, and salt, and cook for another 3 to 4 minutes until the vegetables are softened but still have some bite. Remove the pan from the heat and let the filling cool slightly. Dip each rice paper wrapper briefly in warm water until pliable, place a small portion of filling in the center, fold in the sides, and roll tightly. Mix the Greek yogurt with lime juice and chopped coriander to make a fresh dip, and serve the egg rolls hot.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Enchiladas with Tomato Salsa and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["400 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "150 g spinach, fresh", "240 g black beans, canned, drained", "8 pieces tortilla, wholemeal, wheat", "300 g tomato passata", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp chili powder", "100 g plain yogurt, low fat", "80 g cheese, hard, reduced fat", "2 tbsp fresh coriander, chopped", "1 tbsp lime juice", "0.5 tsp salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat, then cook the onion for 4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and red pepper and cook for another 3 minutes. Add the chicken breast and cook over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring until the chicken is opaque and cooked through. Stir in the cumin, smoked paprika, chili powder, tomato paste, black beans, spinach, and half of the tomato passata. Cook for 2 minutes until the spinach wilts and the filling looks thick. Warm the tortillas briefly so they are flexible, then divide the filling between them and roll them up tightly. Spread the remaining tomato passata over the base of a baking dish, arrange the enchiladas seam-side down, and spoon the yogurt over the top in small streaks. Sprinkle with the reduced-fat cheese and bake for 15 to 18 minutes until the sauce is bubbling and the cheese has melted and lightly browned. Finish with coriander and lime juice before serving.

title: Lean Shrimp and Vegetable Etouffee with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g shrimp, raw, peeled", "2 tbsp olive oil", "40 g onion, raw", "60 g celery, raw", "80 g green bell pepper, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "20 g wholemeal wheat flour", "300 ml low-sodium vegetable stock", "200 g canned tomatoes, chopped", "100 g okra, raw", "1 tsp paprika", "0.5 tsp dried thyme", "0.5 tsp cayenne pepper", "1 bay leaf", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "150 g brown rice, cooked", "15 g spring onion, raw", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice according to the package directions until tender, then keep it warm. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion, celery, and green bell pepper and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until softened and fragrant. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute more. Sprinkle in the wholemeal flour and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, so it forms a light roux without browning too much. Slowly whisk in the vegetable stock until smooth, then add the tomatoes, okra, paprika, thyme, cayenne, bay leaf, salt, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer and cook over low to medium-low heat for 12 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened and the okra is tender. Add the shrimp and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes, just until they turn pink and opaque. Remove the bay leaf, then stir in the spring onion and parsley. Serve the etouffee hot over the cooked brown rice.

title: Lighter Shrimp Etouffee with Brown Rice and Bell Peppers
ingredients_json: ["300 g shrimp, raw, peeled", "200 g brown rice, dry", "30 g unsalted butter", "15 ml olive oil", "80 g onion, raw", "80 g celery, raw", "120 g red bell pepper, raw", "2 cloves garlic", "20 g whole wheat flour", "400 g tomato, canned, chopped", "500 ml vegetable broth, low sodium", "1 g bay leaf", "3 g paprika powder", "2 g dried thyme", "1 g cayenne pepper", "4 g salt", "2 g black pepper", "15 g spring onion", "10 g parsley, fresh", "30 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it in lightly salted water according to the package directions until tender, then keep it covered. While the rice cooks, heat the butter and olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion, celery, and bell pepper and cook for about 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until softened and glossy but not browned. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Sprinkle in the flour and stir constantly for 2 minutes to form a light roux. Add the paprika, thyme, cayenne, bay leaf, black pepper, and salt, then slowly pour in the vegetable broth while whisking so the sauce stays smooth. Stir in the chopped tomato and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the vegetables are tender. Add the shrimp and simmer gently for 3 to 4 minutes, just until the shrimp turn pink and opaque. Remove the bay leaf, stir in the lemon juice, then finish with the spring onion and parsley. Serve the etouffee hot over the brown rice.

title: Light Shrimp and Okra Etouffee with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g raw shrimp, peeled", "250 g okra, sliced", "150 g onion, diced", "100 g celery, diced", "100 g green bell pepper, diced", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "20 g olive oil", "15 g whole wheat flour", "400 g canned diced tomatoes", "500 ml low sodium vegetable broth", "2 g smoked paprika", "2 g dried thyme", "1 g cayenne pepper", "2 g bay leaf", "10 ml lemon juice", "4 g salt", "2 g black pepper", "300 g cooked brown rice", "15 g fresh parsley, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat. Add the onion, celery, and green bell pepper and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic, flour, smoked paprika, thyme, cayenne, bay leaf, salt, and black pepper and cook for 1 minute to make a light roux and bloom the spices. Add the diced tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes, scraping the pan well. Pour in the vegetable broth and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer. Add the okra and cook over medium-low heat for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the okra is tender. Add the shrimp and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until pink and just cooked through. Stir in the lemon juice and parsley, then remove the bay leaf. Serve the etouffee hot over the cooked brown rice.

title: Shrimp and Okra Etouffee with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g shrimp, peeled", "2 tbsp olive oil", "30 g whole wheat flour", "1 piece onion, diced", "1 piece green bell pepper, diced", "2 stalk celery, diced", "3 cloves garlic, minced", "200 g okra, sliced", "400 g canned diced tomatoes, no salt added", "500 ml low sodium vegetable broth", "2 tsp paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp cayenne pepper", "2 g bay leaf", "5 g fresh parsley, chopped", "10 ml lemon juice", "300 g cooked brown rice", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the flour and stir constantly for 3 to 4 minutes until it turns light golden brown, making a quick roux without letting it burn. Add the onion, bell pepper, and celery, then cook for 6 to 8 minutes over medium heat until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the okra and cook for 4 minutes, stirring often, so it begins to lose its raw texture. Pour in the tomatoes and vegetable broth, then add the paprika, thyme, black pepper, cayenne, bay leaf, and salt. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, lower the heat, and cook for 12 to 15 minutes until slightly thickened. Add the shrimp and simmer for 3 to 5 minutes until they turn pink and opaque. Stir in the parsley and lemon juice, then taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. Serve the etouffee hot over the cooked brown rice.

title: Lighter Shrimp and Okra Etouffee with Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g shrimp, raw, peeled", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion", "1 medium green bell pepper", "2 stalks celery", "3 cloves garlic", "200 g okra, fresh", "2 tbsp wholemeal flour", "400 g diced tomatoes, canned", "500 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 bay leaf", "1 tsp cayenne pepper", "150 g brown rice, dry", "2 tbsp parsley, fresh", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it in lightly salted water according to the packet instructions until tender, then keep it covered. Finely dice the onion, bell pepper, and celery, and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat and cook the onion, bell pepper, and celery for 6 to 8 minutes until softened but not browned. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then stir in the wholemeal flour and cook for 1 minute to form a light roux. Add the tomato paste, smoked paprika, thyme, bay leaf, cayenne, and black pepper, then slowly pour in the vegetable stock while stirring until smooth. Add the diced tomatoes and okra, bring to a gentle simmer, and cook for 12 to 15 minutes until the sauce thickens and the okra is tender. Stir in the shrimp and cook for 3 to 4 minutes over low to medium heat until they turn pink and opaque. Remove the bay leaf, stir in the lemon juice and chopped parsley, then serve the etouffee hot over the brown rice.

title: Chicken and Bell Pepper Fajitas with Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, raw, skinless", "2 pieces Bell pepper, mixed colours", "1 piece Onion, yellow", "2 cloves Garlic", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 tsp Ground cumin", "2 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "0.5 tsp Ground black pepper", "0.5 tsp Salt", "1 piece Lime", "150 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "8 pieces Tortilla, wholemeal", "80 g Avocado", "30 g Lettuce, shredded"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Cut the peppers and onion into even strips and mince the garlic. In a bowl, mix the chicken with half the olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, black pepper, salt, and garlic. Let it sit for 10 minutes while you prepare the vegetables. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the remaining olive oil. Cook the chicken for about 5 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is browned and cooked through. Remove it from the pan and keep warm. Add the onion and peppers to the same pan and cook for 6 to 8 minutes over medium-high heat until softened and lightly charred at the edges but still slightly crisp. Return the chicken to the pan, squeeze over the lime juice, and toss everything together for 1 minute so the flavours combine. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave until pliable. Serve the fajita filling in the tortillas with yogurt, sliced avocado, and shredded lettuce.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Fajitas with Peppers and Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["500 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground coriander", "1 tsp garlic powder", "0.5 tsp salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper", "1 piece red bell pepper", "1 piece yellow bell pepper", "1 piece red onion", "200 g canned black beans, drained", "8 pieces wholemeal tortilla, small", "200 g plain low-fat yogurt", "1 piece lime", "15 g fresh coriander leaves", "1 piece avocado", "120 g tomato salsa"]
instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and place it in a bowl with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, ground coriander, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and leave it for 10 minutes while you prepare the vegetables. Cut the peppers and red onion into thin strips. Heat the remaining olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat, then add the chicken in a single layer. Cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring once or twice, until browned and cooked through with no pink remaining. Remove the chicken to a plate. Add the sliced peppers and onion to the same pan and cook over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes until softened and lightly charred at the edges. Stir in the black beans and cook for 2 minutes more until heated through. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan over low heat for about 30 seconds on each side, or until flexible. Mix the yogurt with the juice of the lime and most of the coriander leaves. Fill each tortilla with the chicken, vegetables, and beans, then top with avocado slices, tomato salsa, and the lime yogurt. Serve immediately while everything is hot.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Fajitas with Peppers and Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["450 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow", "2 pieces bell pepper, mixed colors", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp chili powder", "0.5 tsp salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper, ground", "240 g black beans, canned, drained", "8 pieces tortilla wrap, wholegrain", "150 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 piece lime", "20 g fresh coriander", "1 piece avocado", "100 g tomato, fresh"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Cut the onion and bell peppers into even slices, and mince the garlic. Heat 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken, cumin, smoked paprika, chili powder, salt, and black pepper, then cook for about 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is browned and cooked through. Transfer the chicken to a plate. Add the remaining olive oil to the same skillet, then add the onion and peppers. Cook over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes until softened and lightly charred at the edges. Stir in the garlic and black beans and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant and warmed through. Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together. Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet or wrapped in foil in the oven until pliable. Mix the yogurt with the juice and finely grated zest of the lime. Slice the avocado and dice the tomato. Serve the chicken and vegetable filling in the tortillas, topped with lime yogurt, avocado, tomato, and chopped coriander.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Fajitas with Roasted Peppers and Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["500 g Chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 tsp Ground cumin", "2 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Garlic powder", "0.5 tsp Ground black pepper", "1 tsp Salt", "2 pieces Red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece Yellow bell pepper, raw", "1 piece Red onion, raw", "240 g Black beans, canned, drained", "8 pieces Tortilla wrap, wholemeal", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 piece Lime, raw", "15 g Fresh coriander, raw", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "1 piece Tomato, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Slice the chicken into thin strips and place it in a bowl with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt. Mix well and let it sit while you prepare the vegetables. Cut the peppers and onion into thin strips and spread them on a baking tray with the remaining olive oil. Roast for 12 minutes, then add the chicken and black beans to the tray and cook for another 12 to 15 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are softened with some browned edges. Meanwhile, stir the yogurt with the juice of half the lime and half of the chopped coriander. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan over medium heat for about 30 seconds per side, or until soft and flexible. Fill each tortilla with the chicken, vegetables, black beans, sliced avocado, and diced tomato, then finish with the lime yogurt and the remaining coriander. Serve immediately while everything is hot and fresh.

title: Chicken and Pepper Fajitas with Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["500 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless", "2 pieces Red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece Yellow bell pepper, raw", "1 piece Brown onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 tsp Ground cumin", "2 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Chilli powder", "0.5 tsp Salt", "0.25 tsp Black pepper, ground", "30 ml Lime juice, raw", "120 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "8 pieces Tortilla wrap, wholemeal", "60 g Avocado, raw", "20 g Coriander, fresh", "1 piece Lime, raw"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Cut the peppers and onion into even strips, and finely chop the garlic. In a bowl, mix the chicken with half the olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, chilli powder, salt, black pepper, and half the lime juice. Let it sit while you prepare the vegetables. Whisk the yogurt with the remaining lime juice and a little grated lime zest if you like a brighter flavour. Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat, add the remaining olive oil, and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through. Transfer it to a plate. Add the onion and peppers to the same pan and cook over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened with a little char on the edges. Add the garlic for the last 30 seconds. Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together for 1 minute so the flavours combine and the juices coat the vegetables. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or microwave until soft and pliable. Fill each tortilla with the chicken and pepper mixture, then top with avocado slices, coriander, and a spoonful of the lime yogurt before serving immediately.

title: Baked Herb Falafel with Lemon Yogurt and Cucumber Tomato Salad
ingredients_json: ["250 g chickpeas, dried", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "15 g parsley, fresh", "10 g coriander leaf, fresh", "1 tsp cumin, ground", "1 tsp coriander, ground", "0.5 tsp baking powder", "30 g wholemeal wheat flour", "20 ml olive oil", "2 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "150 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 ml lemon juice, raw", "1 piece cucumber, raw", "200 g tomato, raw", "1 piece lettuce, cos or romaine", "4 pieces wholemeal pita bread", "10 g sesame seeds, whole"]
instructions: Soak the dried chickpeas in plenty of water for at least 12 hours, then drain them well and pat them dry. Preheat the oven to 220 degrees C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Add the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, coriander, cumin, ground coriander, baking powder, flour, salt, and black pepper to a food processor and pulse until the mixture is finely chopped but still slightly coarse. Shape the mixture into 16 small balls or patties and place them on the tray. Brush or drizzle with the olive oil, then bake for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once halfway through, until the falafel are deep golden and firm on the outside. While they bake, mix the yogurt and lemon juice in a bowl and chill it until serving. Chop the cucumber and tomatoes, shred the lettuce, and lightly toast the pita bread. Serve the falafel in the pitas with the salad, yogurt sauce, and sesame seeds sprinkled over the top.

title: Baked Herbed Falafel with Lemon Tahini and Crisp Salad
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chickpeas, dried", "1 l Water, tap", "1 piece Onion, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "30 g Parsley, fresh", "15 g Coriander leaf, fresh", "2 tsp Cumin seed, ground", "1 tsp Coriander seed, ground", "1 tsp Baking powder", "40 g Oat flour", "15 ml Lemon juice, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "120 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "20 g Tahini", "30 ml Lemon juice, raw", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "200 g Lettuce, mixed salad greens", "150 g Tomato, raw", "100 g Cucumber, raw", "120 g Wholemeal pita bread"]
instructions: Rinse the dried chickpeas and soak them in the water for at least 12 hours at room temperature. Drain them well, then pat them dry so the falafel mixture is not too wet. Add the soaked chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, coriander leaf, cumin, ground coriander, baking powder, oat flour, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to a food processor. Pulse until the mixture is finely chopped and holds together when pressed, but still has a little texture. Chill the mixture for 20 minutes. Heat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Shape the mixture into small balls or patties and place them on the tray. Bake for 10 minutes, then turn them carefully and bake for another 10 to 12 minutes until they are deep golden and crisp at the edges. While they bake, whisk the yogurt, tahini, lemon juice, and finely grated garlic with a small splash of water until smooth and creamy. Toss the salad greens, tomato, and cucumber together. Serve the falafel in warm wholemeal pita bread with the salad and lemon tahini sauce.

title: Baked Herb Falafel with Lemon Tahini Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["250 g chickpeas, dry", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "30 g parsley, fresh", "15 g coriander leaves, fresh", "1 tbsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground coriander", "0.5 tsp baking powder", "30 g wholemeal flour", "15 ml olive oil", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "200 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "30 g tahini", "20 ml lemon juice", "1 clove garlic, raw", "200 g cucumber, raw", "150 g tomatoes, raw", "80 g lettuce, raw", "4 piece wholemeal pita bread"]
instructions: Soak the chickpeas in plenty of water for 12 hours, then drain them well and pat them dry. Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Finely chop the onion, garlic, parsley, and coriander, then pulse the soaked chickpeas in a food processor until the mixture is coarse but holds together. Add the chopped herbs, onion, garlic, cumin, ground coriander, baking powder, flour, salt, and black pepper, then mix until evenly combined. Shape the mixture into small balls or flattened patties and place them on the tray. Brush or drizzle with olive oil and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, turning halfway through, until the falafel are deep golden brown and crisp on the outside. While they bake, stir together the yogurt, tahini, lemon juice, and crushed garlic until smooth. Slice the cucumber and tomatoes and prepare the lettuce. Warm the pita bread briefly, then fill each pita with lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, and the baked falafel. Serve with the lemon tahini yogurt spooned over the top.

title: Baked Herb Falafel with Lemon Tahini and Crisp Salad
ingredients_json: ["250 g chickpeas, dried", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "30 g parsley, fresh", "10 g coriander leaves, fresh", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground coriander", "0.5 tsp baking powder", "30 g wholemeal flour", "20 ml lemon juice, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "5 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "150 g tahini paste", "40 ml water", "1 clove garlic, raw", "200 g tomatoes, raw", "150 g cucumber, raw", "80 g lettuce, raw", "4 piece wholemeal pita bread"]
instructions: Soak the dried chickpeas in plenty of cold water for at least 12 hours, then drain them well and pat them dry. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Add the chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, coriander leaves, cumin, ground coriander, baking powder, wholemeal flour, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to a food processor and pulse until the mixture is coarse but holds together when pressed. If it looks too wet, pulse in a little more flour; if it seems too dry, add a small splash of water. Shape the mixture into 20 small balls or patties and place them on the tray. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, turning halfway through, until the falafel are firm and deep golden brown on the outside. For the sauce, whisk the tahini with water and the remaining garlic until smooth and creamy. Serve the falafel in warm wholemeal pita bread with chopped tomatoes, cucumber, and lettuce, then drizzle over the lemon tahini sauce.

title: Baked Herb Falafel with Lemon Tahini and Crunchy Salad
ingredients_json: ["250 g chickpeas, dry", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "20 g parsley, fresh", "10 g coriander leaf, fresh", "2 tbsp lemon juice, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "30 g wholemeal flour", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp ground coriander", "0.5 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp salt", "0.25 tsp black pepper", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "20 g tahini", "1 piece lemon peel, raw", "100 g cucumber, raw", "150 g tomato, raw", "80 g lettuce, raw", "4 pieces wholemeal pita bread"]
instructions: Soak the chickpeas in plenty of water for at least 12 hours, then drain them well and pat them dry. Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Roughly chop the onion, garlic, parsley, and coriander, then pulse them with the soaked chickpeas, lemon juice, olive oil, flour, cumin, ground coriander, baking powder, salt, and black pepper in a food processor until the mixture is coarse and holds together when pressed. Shape the mixture into 16 small falafel balls and place them on the tray. Brush lightly with a little extra olive oil if needed, then bake for 20 to 25 minutes, turning halfway through, until deeply golden and crisp on the outside. While the falafel bakes, mix the yogurt, tahini, and lemon zest into a smooth sauce. Chop the cucumber and tomato, and tear the lettuce. Warm the pita breads briefly in the oven or a dry pan until soft. Serve the falafel in the pita breads with the salad and lemon tahini sauce.

title: Creamy Chicken and Spinach Fettuccini with Lemon and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["300 g fettuccini pasta, dry", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "10 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "200 g mushrooms, raw", "150 g spinach, raw", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "100 ml cooking cream, low fat", "40 g cheese, parmesan", "1 piece lemon, raw", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "5 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccini until al dente, usually 9 to 11 minutes. Reserve a small cup of the pasta water, then drain the pasta. While the pasta cooks, cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until lightly golden and cooked through. Lower the heat to medium, add the chopped onion, garlic, and mushrooms, and cook for another 4 to 5 minutes until the mushrooms soften and the onion turns translucent. Stir in the spinach and let it wilt for about 1 minute. Pour in the milk and low-fat cream, then add the parmesan and lemon zest. Simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes until the sauce looks smooth and slightly thickened. Add the drained fettuccini and a splash of the reserved pasta water, tossing well so the sauce coats the pasta evenly. Season with salt and black pepper, finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley, and serve immediately while hot.

title: Wholewheat Fettuccini with Chicken, Spinach and Tomato Cream Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholewheat fettuccini", "250 g chicken breast fillet", "10 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g cherry tomatoes", "150 g baby spinach", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "40 g Parmesan cheese", "5 g dried basil", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "500 ml water"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat and cook the wholewheat fettuccini until just tender, about 9 to 11 minutes. While the pasta cooks, cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the chicken, and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until lightly golden and cooked through. Add the finely chopped onion and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes until softened, then stir in the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the cherry tomatoes and dried basil, lower the heat to medium, and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the tomatoes start to break down and release their juices. Stir in the baby spinach and let it wilt for 1 to 2 minutes. Remove the pan from the heat and mix in the Greek yogurt and half of the Parmesan so the sauce stays smooth and creamy. Drain the pasta, reserving a little of the cooking water, then toss the fettuccini through the sauce. If needed, add a small splash of the reserved pasta water to loosen the sauce. Finish with the remaining Parmesan and black pepper, then serve immediately while hot.

title: Wholewheat Fettuccine with Chicken, Spinach and Tomato-Parmesan Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholewheat fettuccine, dry", "250 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "200 g spinach, raw", "200 g crushed tomatoes, canned", "100 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "30 g parmesan cheese, grated", "5 g basil, fresh", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt, table"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the wholewheat fettuccine until just tender, about 9 to 11 minutes. While the pasta cooks, cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat, add the onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and chicken and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until the chicken is lightly browned and cooked through. Stir in the cherry tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes until they begin to soften, then add the crushed tomatoes and milk. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly. Add the spinach in handfuls and stir until wilted, then mix in the parmesan, basil, black pepper and salt. Drain the pasta, reserving a small splash of cooking water, and toss the fettuccine through the sauce until evenly coated. If the sauce seems too thick, loosen it with a little of the reserved pasta water. Serve hot.

title: Wholewheat Chicken Fettuccini with Spinach, Tomatoes and Lemon
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholewheat fettuccini, dry", "300 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, fresh", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "200 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "150 g spinach, fresh", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "50 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 piece lemon, raw", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt, table", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the wholewheat fettuccini for about 9 to 11 minutes until al dente. While the pasta cooks, cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, add the chicken, and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until lightly golden and cooked through. Reduce the heat to medium, add the chopped onion and garlic, and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant and softened. Stir in the cherry tomatoes and cook for another 3 minutes until they begin to soften and release their juices. Add the spinach and cook just until wilted. Lower the heat and stir in the Greek yogurt, Parmesan, lemon zest, and lemon juice, then season with black pepper and salt. Drain the pasta, reserving a small splash of cooking water, and toss it into the skillet with the sauce. Add a little of the reserved water if needed to loosen the sauce so it coats the noodles evenly. Finish with chopped parsley and serve immediately while hot.

title: Chicken and Spinach Fettuccini with Tomato-Garlic Parmesan Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g fettuccine, dry", "300 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "200 g spinach, raw", "150 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "30 g parmesan cheese, grated", "250 ml water", "2 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g dried oregano", "5 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine until just al dente, about 9 to 11 minutes. While the pasta cooks, cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through. Add the chopped onion and cook over medium heat for 3 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and oregano for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the cherry tomatoes and water, reduce the heat to medium, and simmer for 5 minutes until the tomatoes begin to break down and make a light sauce. Stir in the spinach and let it wilt for 1 to 2 minutes. Lower the heat and mix in the yogurt and parmesan, stirring gently so the sauce stays smooth and creamy. Season with salt and black pepper, then add the drained fettuccine and toss well until everything is evenly coated. Serve hot with chopped parsley on top.

title: Pepper-Crusted Filet Mignon with Garlic Herb Mushrooms and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces beef filet mignon, raw, 170 g each", "2 g black pepper, ground", "4 g salt, table", "10 ml olive oil", "15 g butter, unsalted", "2 cloves garlic, fresh, 6 g", "150 g mushrooms, button, raw", "200 g green beans, raw", "30 g shallot, raw", "10 ml lemon juice, freshly squeezed", "5 g parsley, fresh", "50 ml water"]
instructions: Pat the filet mignon dry and season both sides with the ground black pepper and half of the salt. Let the steaks sit at room temperature for 20 minutes while you prepare the vegetables. Trim the green beans and thinly slice the shallot and mushrooms. Heat the olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering, then sear the steaks for 2 to 3 minutes per side until a deep brown crust forms. Reduce the heat to medium and add the butter and half of the garlic, then baste the steaks for 1 to 2 minutes more until they reach your preferred doneness, about 54 to 57 C for medium-rare. Transfer the steaks to a plate and rest them for 5 to 8 minutes. In the same pan, add the shallot, mushrooms, remaining garlic, and water, then cook over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes until the mushrooms soften and most of the liquid evaporates. Add the green beans, remaining salt, and lemon juice, and cook for 4 to 6 minutes until the beans are bright green and tender-crisp. Stir in the parsley, then serve the vegetables alongside the rested filet mignon and spoon the mushroom pan juices over the top.

title: Garlic Herb Filet Mignon with Roasted Asparagus and Cauliflower Purée
ingredients_json: ["320 g Beef tenderloin filet mignon, raw", "10 ml Olive oil", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "6 g Garlic, fresh", "2 g Rosemary, fresh", "2 g Thyme, fresh", "120 g Asparagus, raw", "200 g Cauliflower, raw", "15 g Onion, raw", "20 ml Milk, low fat", "5 g Butter, unsalted", "10 ml Lemon juice", "2 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Trim the asparagus and cut the cauliflower into small florets. Put the cauliflower and onion in a small saucepan, cover with water, and simmer over medium heat for 12 to 15 minutes until very soft. Drain well, then blend with the milk, butter, and lemon juice until smooth and creamy. Season lightly and keep warm. Rub the filet mignon with olive oil, salt, black pepper, minced garlic, rosemary, and thyme. Heat a heavy skillet over medium-high heat until hot, then sear the steaks for about 2 minutes per side until well browned. Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast for 4 to 6 minutes for medium-rare, or a little longer if preferred. At the same time, spread the asparagus on a tray, season lightly, and roast for 8 to 10 minutes until tender and bright green. Let the steaks rest for 5 minutes before serving. Spoon the cauliflower purée onto plates, top with the filet mignon, add the asparagus, and finish with chopped parsley.

title: Garlic Herb Filet Mignon with Roasted Asparagus and Cauliflower Mash
ingredients_json: ["360 g beef fillet steak, raw", "10 ml olive oil", "4 g salt", "2 g black pepper, ground", "4 g garlic, fresh", "6 g fresh rosemary", "6 g fresh thyme", "20 g unsalted butter", "300 g asparagus, raw", "10 ml olive oil", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "500 g cauliflower, raw", "60 ml low fat milk", "10 g grated Parmesan cheese", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "5 g lemon juice"]
instructions: Remove the filet mignon from the refrigerator 20 minutes before cooking so it comes closer to room temperature. Preheat the oven to 220°C. Cut the cauliflower into florets and steam or boil it until very tender, about 12 to 15 minutes. Drain well, then mash it with the milk, Parmesan, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper until smooth and creamy. Trim the asparagus and toss it with olive oil, salt, and black pepper, then spread it on a baking tray and roast for 10 to 12 minutes until bright green and lightly browned at the edges. Pat the steaks dry and season them with salt and black pepper. Heat a heavy skillet over medium-high heat, add the olive oil, and sear the filet mignon for about 2 to 3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Add the butter, garlic, rosemary, and thyme to the pan, then baste the steaks with the melted butter for 1 minute. Finish the steaks in the oven for 4 to 6 minutes for medium-rare, or until the internal temperature reaches your preferred doneness. Rest the steaks on a board for 5 minutes before serving. Spoon the cauliflower mash onto plates, add the asparagus, and top with the filet mignon and the pan juices.

title: Garlic-Herb Filet Mignon with Roasted Asparagus and Cauliflower Mash
ingredients_json: ["360 g beef filet mignon steaks", "10 ml olive oil", "4 g salt", "2 g black pepper", "6 g garlic cloves", "4 g fresh rosemary", "4 g fresh thyme", "300 g cauliflower florets", "120 ml low-fat milk", "15 g unsalted butter", "250 g asparagus", "10 ml lemon juice", "5 g parsley leaves"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C. Place the cauliflower florets on a baking tray and roast for about 18 minutes until very tender and lightly browned at the edges. At the same time, trim the asparagus and toss it with half of the olive oil, a little salt, and the lemon juice, then set aside. Pat the filet mignon steaks dry and season them with the remaining salt and the black pepper. Heat a heavy skillet over medium-high heat, add the remaining olive oil, and sear the steaks for 2 to 3 minutes per side until a deep brown crust forms. Add the garlic, rosemary, and thyme to the pan, then reduce the heat to medium and spoon the aromatic oil over the meat for 1 minute. Transfer the skillet to the oven for 4 to 6 minutes for medium-rare, or until the steaks reach your preferred doneness, then rest them for 5 minutes. While the meat rests, steam or microwave the asparagus until crisp-tender, about 4 minutes. Mash the roasted cauliflower with the milk and butter until smooth and creamy, then fold in the parsley. Serve each steak with the cauliflower mash and asparagus, and spoon any pan juices over the top.

title: Herb-Crusted Filet Mignon with Garlic Green Beans and Roasted Baby Potatoes
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces beef tenderloin fillets, raw, 170 g each", "10 ml olive oil", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g rosemary, fresh", "2 g thyme, fresh", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "300 g baby potatoes", "150 g green beans, fresh", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "15 g butter, unsalted", "1 shallot, raw, 30 g", "50 ml beef stock, reduced salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Cut the baby potatoes in half and toss them with 1 tbsp olive oil, half the salt, and a little black pepper, then spread them on a baking tray and roast for 25 to 30 minutes until golden and tender. Pat the filet mignon dry, rub with 10 ml olive oil, the remaining salt, black pepper, finely chopped rosemary, and thyme. Heat a heavy pan over medium-high heat and sear the steaks for 2 to 3 minutes per side until deeply browned. Add the crushed garlic to the pan for the last 30 seconds, then transfer the pan to the oven and cook the steaks for about 4 to 6 minutes for medium-rare, or until they reach your preferred doneness. Remove the steaks and let them rest for 5 to 8 minutes. Meanwhile, sauté the shallot in the same pan over medium heat, add the green beans and beef stock, and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until bright green and just tender. Stir in the lemon juice and butter to make a light glossy finish. Serve the filet mignon with the roasted potatoes and garlic green beans, spooning any pan juices over the meat.

title: Garlic-Lime Flank Steak with Roasted Peppers and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["600 g flank steak", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp lime juice", "3 cloves garlic", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "250 g brown rice", "600 ml water", "2 medium red bell pepper", "1 medium yellow onion", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "100 g baby spinach", "1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley"]
instructions: Place the flank steak in a shallow dish and mix 1 tablespoon of the olive oil with the lime juice, minced garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Coat the steak well and let it marinate for 20 to 30 minutes while you prepare the other ingredients. Rinse the brown rice, then combine it with the water in a saucepan, bring it to a boil, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 30 to 35 minutes until tender and the water is absorbed. Heat the oven to 220 C and line a tray with baking paper. Slice the peppers and onion into strips, toss them with the remaining olive oil, and spread them on the tray with the cherry tomatoes. Roast for 15 to 20 minutes until softened and lightly browned at the edges. Heat a heavy pan or grill pan over medium-high heat. Sear the flank steak for about 3 to 5 minutes per side for medium-rare, depending on thickness, until nicely browned outside and still juicy inside. Rest the steak for 8 to 10 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain. Toss the spinach through the hot rice so it wilts slightly, then serve the rice with the roasted vegetables and sliced steak on top. Finish with chopped parsley and any resting juices from the steak.

title: Garlic-Lime Flank Steak with Quinoa, Black Beans and Roasted Peppers
ingredients_json: ["700 g flank steak", "30 ml olive oil", "20 ml lime juice", "10 g garlic, fresh", "5 g ground cumin", "3 g smoked paprika", "2 g black pepper, ground", "4 g salt", "150 g quinoa, uncooked", "240 g black beans, cooked and drained", "200 g red bell pepper", "150 g zucchini", "80 g red onion", "15 g fresh coriander leaves", "1 piece avocado", "10 ml lime juice"]
instructions: Mix 20 ml olive oil, 20 ml lime juice, minced garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, black pepper and salt in a bowl. Coat the flank steak evenly and let it marinate for 20 minutes while you prepare the vegetables. Rinse the quinoa, then cook it in 300 ml water over medium heat until the water is absorbed, about 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and let it stand covered for 5 minutes, then fluff it with a fork. Heat the oven to 220 C. Slice the bell pepper, zucchini and red onion into even pieces, toss them with the remaining olive oil, and roast on a tray for 18 to 20 minutes until tender and lightly browned. Warm the black beans in a small pan over low heat. Heat a grill pan or heavy skillet over high heat until very hot, then sear the steak for about 3 to 5 minutes per side for medium-rare, depending on thickness. Let it rest for 8 minutes before slicing thinly across the grain. Serve the sliced steak over quinoa with black beans, roasted vegetables, avocado slices, coriander and a final squeeze of lime.

title: Garlic-Lime Flank Steak with Quinoa and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["600 g flank steak", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp lime juice", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "200 g quinoa, uncooked", "600 ml water", "200 g red bell pepper", "200 g zucchini", "150 g red onion", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 g fresh parsley"]

Meanwhile, rinse the quinoa well and cook it in the water over medium heat until the liquid is absorbed, about 15 minutes. Remove from the heat and let it stand covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the bell pepper, zucchini, and red onion into bite-sized pieces and toss them with the cherry tomatoes and 1 tablespoon olive oil. Spread the vegetables on a baking tray and roast for 18 to 22 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until tender and lightly browned. Heat a grill pan or heavy skillet over high heat until very hot. Sear the flank steak for about 3 to 5 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until well browned outside and cooked to medium-rare or medium. Let the steak rest for 8 to 10 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain. Serve the sliced steak over quinoa with the roasted vegetables and sprinkle with chopped parsley.

title: Garlic-Lime Flank Steak with Roasted Peppers and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["600 g flank steak", "30 ml olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "30 ml lime juice", "5 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "150 g quinoa, dry", "300 ml water", "200 g red bell pepper", "200 g zucchini", "150 g red onion", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g fresh parsley", "1 piece lime"]
