Coat the flank steak evenly and let it marinate for 20 to 30 minutes while the oven heats to 220 C. Rinse the quinoa well, then simmer it in 300 ml water over medium heat for about 15 minutes until the water is absorbed and the grains are tender. Remove from the heat and let it stand covered for 5 minutes. Cut the peppers, zucchini, and red onion into even pieces, toss them with 15 ml olive oil, and roast them on a baking tray for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once, until lightly browned and tender. Heat a heavy pan or grill pan over high heat. Sear the flank steak for about 3 to 5 minutes per side for medium-rare, or a little longer if you prefer it more done, until nicely browned on the outside. Rest the steak on a board for 10 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain. Fluff the quinoa with a fork, fold through the roasted vegetables and parsley, and serve with the sliced steak and lime wedges.

title: Miso-Garlic Flank Steak with Roasted Broccoli and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["600 g flank steak", "30 g low sodium soy sauce", "20 g white miso paste", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g fresh ginger", "2 cloves garlic", "15 ml lime juice", "5 g honey", "300 g broccoli florets", "200 g carrots", "200 g cooked brown rice", "2 g sesame seeds", "5 g spring onion"]
instructions: Mix the soy sauce, miso paste, olive oil, grated ginger, minced garlic, lime juice, and honey in a shallow dish. Coat the flank steak well and let it marinate for 20 to 30 minutes at room temperature. Meanwhile, heat the oven to 220 C. Toss the broccoli florets and carrots with a small spoonful of the marinade, then spread them on a baking tray and roast for 18 to 22 minutes until tender and lightly browned at the edges. Heat a heavy pan over medium-high heat until very hot. Sear the flank steak for about 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium-rare, or a little longer if you prefer it more done. Rest the steak for 8 to 10 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain. Serve the sliced steak with the roasted vegetables and warm brown rice, then finish with sesame seeds and chopped spring onion.

title: Garlic-Lime Flat Iron Steak with Quinoa, Black Beans and Roasted Peppers
ingredients_json: ["600 g flat iron steak", "15 ml olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "15 ml lime juice", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "150 g quinoa, dry", "300 ml water", "240 g black beans, cooked, drained", "200 g red bell pepper", "150 g red onion", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "10 ml olive oil", "5 g fresh coriander leaves", "10 ml plain yogurt, low fat", "10 ml water"]
instructions: Rinse the quinoa well, then combine it with the water in a saucepan. Bring it to a boil over medium-high heat, reduce to low, cover, and simmer for about 15 minutes until the water is absorbed and the grains are tender. Remove from the heat and let it stand covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Heat the oven to 220 C. Cut the red pepper and red onion into bite-size pieces and place them on a baking tray with the cherry tomatoes. Toss with 10 ml olive oil and roast for 18 to 20 minutes, until the vegetables are softened and lightly browned at the edges. Mix the garlic, lime juice, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and 15 ml olive oil, then rub it over the flat iron steak and let it sit for 10 minutes while the vegetables roast. Heat a heavy pan or grill pan over medium-high heat until very hot. Cook the steak for about 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium-rare, or a little longer if you prefer it more done. Rest the steak on a board for 8 minutes before slicing thinly across the grain. Warm the black beans in a small pan over medium heat with a splash of water until heated through. Stir the quinoa with the black beans, roasted vegetables, and chopped coriander. Serve the sliced steak over the grain and vegetable mixture, and spoon over the yogurt mixed with 10 ml water as a light sauce.

title: Grilled Flat Iron Steak with Lemon Herb Quinoa and Roasted Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["600 g flat iron steak, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "2 g black pepper, ground", "4 g salt, table", "2 cloves garlic, fresh", "10 g fresh rosemary", "15 ml lemon juice, fresh", "180 g quinoa, dry", "400 ml water", "300 g broccoli florets, raw", "150 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "10 ml olive oil", "1 medium shallot, raw", "5 g parsley, fresh", "1 g lemon zest, fresh"]
instructions: Pat the steak dry and let it sit at room temperature for 20 minutes. Finely chop the garlic and rosemary, then mix them with the olive oil, black pepper, half the salt, and lemon juice. Rub this mixture over the steak and leave it to marinate while you prepare the rest. Rinse the quinoa under cold water, then cook it with the water in a covered saucepan over medium heat for about 15 minutes, until the liquid is absorbed and the grains are fluffy. Remove from the heat and let it stand for 5 minutes before fluffing with a fork. Preheat the oven to 220 C. Toss the broccoli, cherry tomatoes, and sliced shallot with the remaining olive oil and salt, then spread them on a baking tray and roast for 15 to 18 minutes until the broccoli is tender and lightly browned. Heat a heavy skillet or grill pan over high heat until very hot. Cook the steak for 3 to 5 minutes per side for medium-rare, depending on thickness, until well browned on the outside and still juicy inside. Transfer it to a board and rest for 8 minutes before slicing against the grain. Stir the parsley and lemon zest through the quinoa, then serve with the roasted vegetables and sliced steak on top.

title: Garlic Herb Flat Iron Steak with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["500 g flat iron steak", "300 g sweet potatoes", "200 g green beans", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g garlic, minced", "2 g dried rosemary", "2 g dried thyme", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "15 ml lemon juice", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C. Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into 2 cm cubes, then toss them with half of the olive oil, half of the garlic, the rosemary, thyme, salt and black pepper. Spread them on a baking tray and roast for 20 minutes. While they roast, bring the steak to room temperature and pat it dry. Rub the steak with the remaining olive oil, garlic, salt and black pepper. After the sweet potatoes have cooked for 20 minutes, add the green beans and cherry tomatoes to the tray, drizzle with the lemon juice, and return everything to the oven for 10 to 12 minutes until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned. Heat a heavy pan over medium-high heat until very hot. Sear the steak for 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium-rare, or a little longer if preferred, until a browned crust forms and the internal temperature reaches your desired doneness. Rest the steak on a board for 5 to 10 minutes so the juices redistribute. Slice thinly against the grain, sprinkle with parsley, and serve with the roasted vegetables.

title: Garlic Herb Flat Iron Steak with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["500 g flat iron steak", "300 g sweet potatoes", "200 g green beans", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g garlic", "5 g fresh rosemary", "5 g fresh thyme", "15 ml lemon juice", "3 g black pepper", "4 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray with parchment. Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into 2 cm cubes, then toss them with half the olive oil, half the garlic, half the rosemary, half the thyme, the salt, and a little black pepper. Spread them on the tray and roast for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, pat the steak dry and rub it with the remaining olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, and black pepper. Trim the green beans and halve the cherry tomatoes. After the sweet potatoes have roasted for 20 minutes, add the green beans and tomatoes to the tray and return it to the oven for 10 to 12 minutes. While the vegetables finish, heat a heavy pan over medium-high heat and sear the steak for about 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium-rare, or a little longer if you prefer it more done. Rest the steak on a board for 5 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain. Toss the roasted vegetables with lemon juice, then serve alongside the sliced steak.

title: Garlic-Herb Flat Iron Steak with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["600 g flat iron steak", "400 g sweet potatoes", "250 g green beans", "20 ml olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "2 g dried rosemary", "2 g dried thyme", "4 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "15 ml lemon juice"]

When the sweet potatoes have had 20 minutes, add the green beans to the tray and return it to the oven for 10 to 12 minutes, until the beans are tender and the potatoes are golden at the edges. Meanwhile, heat a heavy pan over medium-high heat until very hot. Sear the steak for 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium-rare, or a little longer if you prefer it more cooked. Transfer the steak to a board and rest it for 5 minutes so the juices settle. Slice thinly against the grain and finish with lemon juice. Serve the steak with the roasted sweet potatoes and green beans.

title: Spiced Chicken and Hummus Flatbreads with Roasted Peppers and Rocket
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "4 pieces wholemeal flatbread", "120 g hummus, plain", "2 pieces red bell pepper", "1 piece red onion", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 clove garlic, fresh", "80 g baby rocket leaves", "120 g cherry tomatoes", "30 g natural yoghurt, plain", "15 ml lemon juice", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and toss it with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, grated garlic, salt, and black pepper. Slice the peppers and red onion into thin strips, then spread them on the tray with the chicken and the remaining oil. Roast for 18 to 20 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender and lightly browned. Warm the flatbreads in a dry pan over medium heat for about 30 seconds on each side, or until soft and flexible. Mix the yoghurt with lemon juice to make a quick sauce. Spread hummus over each flatbread, top with roasted chicken and vegetables, add rocket and halved cherry tomatoes, then drizzle with the yoghurt sauce. Serve immediately while the flatbreads are warm and the vegetables are still juicy.

title: Spiced Chicken and Hummus Flatbreads with Roasted Peppers and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "5 g Instant dry yeast", "3 g Salt", "10 ml Olive oil", "140 ml Water", "300 g Chicken breast, without skin", "2 g Ground cumin", "2 g Smoked paprika", "1 g Ground black pepper", "2 g Garlic powder", "5 ml Olive oil", "150 g Hummus, plain", "120 g Red bell pepper", "80 g Red onion", "100 g Baby spinach", "100 g Cherry tomatoes", "20 g Feta cheese, reduced fat", "10 ml Lemon juice"]
instructions: Mix the whole wheat flour, yeast and salt in a bowl, then stir in the olive oil and warm water until a soft dough forms. Knead for 5 to 7 minutes until smooth and elastic, cover, and leave in a warm place for about 45 minutes until lightly risen. While the dough is rising, cut the chicken breast into strips and toss it with cumin, smoked paprika, black pepper, garlic powder and 5 ml olive oil. Heat a large non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes, turning once or twice, until browned and cooked through. In the same pan, add the sliced red pepper and onion and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes until softened but still slightly crisp. Split the dough into 4 pieces and roll each piece into a thin oval. Cook the flatbreads in a hot dry skillet over medium-high heat for 1 to 2 minutes per side until puffed and lightly charred in spots. Warm the hummus, then spread it over each flatbread. Top with spinach, tomatoes, peppers, onion and chicken, then crumble over the feta and finish with lemon juice. Serve immediately while the flatbreads are warm and the vegetables are fresh.

title: Herbed Chicken and Roasted Vegetable Flatbreads with Lemon Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["240 g whole wheat flour", "5 g dried yeast", "3 g salt", "150 ml water", "10 ml olive oil", "300 g chicken breast fillet, without skin", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g paprika, sweet", "5 ml olive oil", "150 g zucchini", "120 g red bell pepper", "80 g red onion", "5 ml olive oil", "2 g dried oregano", "200 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "10 ml lemon juice", "1 g garlic, fresh", "40 g spinach leaves, fresh", "60 g cherry tomatoes", "20 g feta cheese"]
instructions: Mix the whole wheat flour, yeast, salt, water, and olive oil in a bowl until a soft dough forms. Knead for 5 to 7 minutes until smooth, then cover and leave in a warm place for about 45 minutes until slightly risen. While the dough rests, cut the chicken into thin strips and season with black pepper and paprika. Heat 5 ml olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until browned and cooked through, then set aside. Slice the zucchini, red pepper, and red onion, toss them with 5 ml olive oil and oregano, and roast at 220 C for 15 to 18 minutes until tender and lightly charred. Combine the yogurt, lemon juice, and finely grated garlic to make the sauce. Divide the dough into 4 pieces, roll each piece thinly, and cook in a dry hot pan over medium-high heat for 1 to 2 minutes per side until puffed and spotted with brown. Top each flatbread with spinach, roasted vegetables, chicken, cherry tomatoes, yogurt sauce, and crumbled feta. Serve immediately while the flatbreads are warm and soft.

title: Whole Wheat Chicken, Spinach and Feta Flatbreads with Roasted Peppers
ingredients_json: ["200 g whole wheat flour", "7 g dried yeast", "150 ml warm water", "10 ml olive oil", "3 g salt", "250 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "5 ml olive oil", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "1 g black pepper, ground", "150 g red bell pepper", "80 g red onion", "100 g spinach, fresh", "60 g feta cheese", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "10 ml lemon juice", "1 clove garlic", "5 g parsley, fresh"]

Fill the flatbreads with spinach, roasted vegetables and chicken, then scatter over the feta and finish with the yogurt sauce before serving warm.

title: Chicken, Hummus and Roasted Vegetable Flatbreads with Yogurt Herb Drizzle
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal flour", "5 g dry yeast", "5 g salt", "150 ml warm water", "15 ml olive oil", "250 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "200 g courgette", "150 g red pepper", "150 g red onion", "10 ml olive oil", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "1 g black pepper", "100 g hummus", "150 g Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "10 g fresh parsley", "10 g fresh mint", "10 ml lemon juice", "50 g baby spinach"]

Cover and leave in a warm place for about 45 minutes, or until slightly risen. Meanwhile, heat the oven to 220°C. Slice the courgette, red pepper and red onion into thin strips and toss them with the olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika and black pepper. Spread them on a baking tray and roast for 18 to 20 minutes, stirring once, until tender and lightly caramelised. At the same time, season the chicken breast and cook it in a hot non-stick pan over medium-high heat for about 6 to 8 minutes, turning once, until cooked through and lightly browned. Rest for 3 minutes, then slice. Divide the dough into 4 pieces and roll each one into a thin flatbread. Cook each flatbread in a hot dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until puffed and browned in spots. Mix the Greek yogurt with the chopped parsley, mint and lemon juice. Spread hummus over each flatbread, top with spinach, roasted vegetables and sliced chicken, then finish with the herb yogurt drizzle and serve warm.

title: Light French Onion Soup with Wholegrain Toast and Gruyère
ingredients_json: ["600 g yellow onions", "15 ml olive oil", "15 g unsalted butter", "2 cloves garlic", "1.2 l low-sodium beef stock", "250 ml water", "150 ml dry white wine", "2 g dried thyme", "1 leaf bay leaf", "2 g black pepper", "4 g salt", "10 ml balsamic vinegar", "120 g wholegrain baguette", "80 g Gruyère cheese", "10 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Peel the onions and slice them thinly. Heat the olive oil and butter in a large heavy pot over medium heat, then add the onions and cook for 25 to 30 minutes, stirring often, until they are soft, deep golden brown, and sweet-smelling. Lower the heat if they start to catch, because slow caramelisation gives the soup its flavour. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more, then pour in the white wine and let it bubble for 2 to 3 minutes until the sharp alcohol smell has cooked off. Stir in the stock, water, thyme, bay leaf, black pepper, salt, and balsamic vinegar. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered for 20 minutes so the flavours meld and the soup tastes rich but still light. While the soup simmers, toast the wholegrain baguette slices under a hot grill or in a toaster until crisp and lightly browned. Remove the bay leaf from the soup, then divide the hot soup between 4 ovenproof bowls, place the toast on top, and sprinkle evenly with Gruyère. Put the bowls under a hot grill for 3 to 5 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbling, and browned in spots. Finish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.

title: Light French Onion Soup with Wholegrain Toast and Gruyère
ingredients_json: ["4 medium yellow onions", "2 tbsp olive oil", "20 g unsalted butter", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tbsp plain wheat flour", "150 ml dry white wine", "1.5 l beef stock, reduced salt", "2 sprigs fresh thyme", "1 piece bay leaf", "2 g black pepper", "4 slices wholegrain baguette", "80 g Gruyère cheese"]
instructions: Peel the onions and slice them thinly. Heat the olive oil and butter in a large pot over medium heat, then add the onions with a small pinch of salt from the stock allowance and cook for about 25 to 30 minutes, stirring often, until they are deeply golden and sweet but not burnt. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more. Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 minute so it coats the onions. Pour in the white wine and let it bubble for 2 to 3 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Add the beef stock, thyme, bay leaf, and black pepper, then bring the soup to a gentle simmer. Cook uncovered for 20 minutes so the flavours meld and the broth becomes slightly richer. While the soup simmers, toast the baguette slices until crisp. Remove the thyme sprigs and bay leaf, then ladle the soup into ovenproof bowls, top each with toast and Gruyère, and place under a hot grill for 2 to 4 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbling, and lightly browned. Serve immediately while hot.

title: Light French Onion Soup with Wholegrain Toast and Gruyère
ingredients_json: ["800 g brown onion", "20 g unsalted butter", "15 ml olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "10 g plain wheat flour", "1500 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "250 ml water", "10 ml Worcestershire sauce", "2 g dried thyme", "1 leaf bay leaf", "3 g black pepper", "4 g salt", "120 g wholemeal bread", "80 g Gruyère cheese", "10 g parsley, fresh"]

Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the flour and cook for another minute so the soup stays slightly thickened. Pour in the beef stock and water, then add the Worcestershire sauce, thyme, bay leaf, black pepper, and salt. Bring the soup to a gentle simmer and cook for 20 minutes, skimming if needed. Meanwhile, toast the wholemeal bread until crisp and lightly golden. Remove the bay leaf, ladle the hot soup into bowls, place the toast on top, and divide the Gruyère over the bread. Put the bowls under a hot grill for 2 to 4 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbling, and browned in spots. Finish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.

title: Light French Onion Soup with Wholegrain Toast and Gruyère
ingredients_json: ["800 g yellow onions", "20 g unsalted butter", "15 ml olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "10 g plain wheat flour", "150 ml dry white wine", "1200 ml low-sodium beef stock", "2 pieces bay leaf", "2 sprigs fresh thyme", "2 ml black pepper", "3 g salt", "4 slices wholegrain bread", "80 g Gruyère cheese"]
instructions: Peel the onions and slice them thinly. Lower the heat if they begin to catch. Add the garlic and flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring well so the flour coats the onions. Pour in the white wine and scrape the bottom of the pot to release any browned bits, then let it simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until slightly reduced. Add the stock, bay leaves, thyme, black pepper, and salt. Bring the soup to a gentle simmer and cook for 20 minutes so the flavours meld. Meanwhile, toast the bread slices until crisp. Preheat the grill to high, ladle the soup into heatproof bowls, place the toast on top, and cover each portion with Gruyère. Grill for 2 to 4 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbling, and lightly browned. Serve immediately while hot.

title: Light French Onion Soup with Wholegrain Toast and Melted Gruyère
ingredients_json: ["800 g yellow onions", "20 g unsalted butter", "15 ml olive oil", "5 g garlic", "10 g plain flour", "150 ml dry white wine", "1200 ml low-salt beef stock", "200 ml water", "2 g dried thyme", "2 pieces bay leaf", "2 g black pepper", "4 g salt", "8 slices wholegrain baguette", "120 g Gruyère cheese"]
instructions: Thinly slice the onions. Heat the butter and olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat, then add the onions and cook for about 25 to 30 minutes, stirring often, until they are deeply golden and sweet. Lower the heat if they start to catch. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the flour and cook for another minute so the soup stays smooth. Pour in the white wine and let it bubble for 2 to 3 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom. Add the beef stock, water, thyme, bay leaves, black pepper, and salt, then bring to a gentle simmer. Cook uncovered for 20 minutes so the flavours meld and the broth becomes slightly richer. Serve immediately while hot.

title: Crispy Oven-Finished Paprika Fried Chicken with Lemon-Yogurt Slaw
ingredients_json: ["800 g Chicken thigh, skinless, boneless", "250 ml Buttermilk, plain", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tsp Paprika powder", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1.5 tsp Salt, table", "120 g Wheat flour, wholemeal", "40 g Oat bran", "1 tsp Baking powder", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "2 tbsp Rapeseed oil", "300 g White cabbage, raw", "150 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "15 ml Lemon juice, raw", "10 g Parsley, fresh", "1 tbsp Mustard, prepared", "1 tbsp Honey"]
instructions: Cut the chicken thighs into even pieces and place them in a bowl with the buttermilk, crushed garlic, paprika, black pepper, and 1 teaspoon of the salt. Mix well, cover, and marinate in the fridge for at least 30 minutes, or up to 4 hours for better flavour. In a second bowl, combine the wholemeal flour, oat bran, baking powder, thyme, and the remaining salt. Beat the eggs in a third bowl. Heat the oven to 220 C and line a tray with baking paper. Remove the chicken from the marinade, let excess liquid drip off, then dip each piece in the flour mixture, then the egg, and then back into the flour so the coating is well covered. Place the coated chicken on the tray, drizzle or brush lightly with the rapeseed oil, and bake for 18 to 22 minutes, turning once halfway through, until the coating is deep golden and the chicken is cooked through with no pink in the centre. While the chicken bakes, mix the cabbage, grated carrot, yogurt, lemon juice, parsley, mustard, and honey into a crisp slaw. Serve the chicken hot with the slaw on the side.

title: Crispy Oven-Fried Chicken Thighs with Smoky Yogurt Slaw
ingredients_json: ["800 g Chicken thigh, meat only, raw", "120 g Wheat flour, wholemeal", "2 piece Egg, raw", "80 g Breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "30 g Oat bran", "30 g Olive oil", "200 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "10 g Garlic, raw", "5 g Paprika, smoked", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "6 g Salt, iodized", "300 g Cabbage, white, raw", "120 g Carrot, raw", "80 g Apple, raw", "20 g Mustard, prepared", "10 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Place a wire rack on top if you have one, and lightly brush or spray it with a little of the olive oil so the coating crisps evenly. In one shallow bowl mix the wholemeal flour with half the salt, the smoked paprika and black pepper. In a second bowl beat the eggs. In a third bowl combine the breadcrumbs and oat bran. Pat the chicken thighs dry, then coat each piece first in the seasoned flour, then the egg, and finally the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently so the crust sticks well. Arrange the chicken on the rack or tray, drizzle or brush the remaining olive oil over the top, and bake for about 30 to 35 minutes, turning once halfway through, until the coating is deep golden and the chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear. While the chicken bakes, shred the cabbage, grate the carrot, and thinly slice the apple. Stir together the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, mustard, chopped parsley, and the remaining salt to make a creamy slaw dressing, then toss it with the vegetables. Serve the hot fried-style chicken with the crunchy slaw on the side.

title: Crispy Oven-Fried Chicken with Smoky Paprika and Herb Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["600 g Chicken thigh fillets, without skin", "120 g Wholemeal breadcrumbs", "60 g Oat bran", "2 pieces Egg, raw", "100 g Plain yogurt, low fat", "30 g Dijon mustard", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "10 g Paprika, sweet", "5 g Garlic powder", "3 g Black pepper, ground", "6 g Salt", "20 ml Rapeseed oil", "10 g Fresh parsley", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "300 g Broccoli, raw", "250 g Carrots, raw", "200 g Sweet potato, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C and line a large baking tray with baking paper. Cut the sweet potato and carrots into even wedges or sticks, then toss them with half the oil and spread them on one side of the tray. Roast for 10 minutes to get them started. Meanwhile, mix the breadcrumbs, oat bran, paprika, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt in a shallow bowl. Whisk the eggs in a second bowl, and stir the mustard and lemon juice into the yogurt in a small serving bowl. Dip each chicken thigh fillet into the egg, then coat it well in the breadcrumb mixture, pressing gently so the crust adheres. Warm the remaining oil in a frying pan over medium heat and cook the coated chicken for 2 to 3 minutes per side until the outside is golden. Transfer the chicken to the tray with the vegetables and roast for 15 to 18 minutes more, until the chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear. Add the broccoli to the tray for the last 8 minutes so it stays bright and tender-crisp. Finely chop the parsley and garlic, then stir them into the yogurt sauce. Serve the chicken hot with the roasted vegetables and a spoonful of the herb yogurt on the side.

title: Crispy Oven-Fried Chicken Thighs with Lemon Yogurt Slaw
ingredients_json: ["800 g Chicken thighs, without skin, raw", "120 g Plain yogurt, low fat", "30 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "2 g Garlic powder", "2 g Paprika, sweet", "4 g Salt", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "60 g Wholemeal breadcrumbs", "30 g Wheat flour, wholemeal", "1 piece Egg, raw", "15 ml Rapeseed oil", "300 g Cabbage, white, raw", "120 g Carrot, raw", "80 g Onion, red, raw", "20 g Mustard, prepared", "10 ml Honey", "10 ml Apple cider vinegar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Add the chicken thighs and coat them well, then let them sit for 15 minutes while you prepare the coating. Combine the wholemeal breadcrumbs and wholemeal flour in a shallow dish. Beat the egg in a second dish. Lift each piece of chicken from the yogurt, let the excess drip off, dip it in the egg, and then press it into the breadcrumb mixture until evenly coated. Arrange the chicken on the tray and drizzle lightly with rapeseed oil. Bake for 25 minutes, turning once halfway through, until the coating is crisp and the chicken is cooked through with no pink juices and an internal temperature of 75 C. While the chicken bakes, finely shred the cabbage and carrot and slice the red onion thinly. Mix the vegetables with mustard, honey, and apple cider vinegar to make a fresh slaw. Serve the crispy chicken hot with the lemon yogurt slaw on the side.

title: Crispy Oven-Fried Chicken Thighs with Paprika Yogurt Coating
ingredients_json: ["700 g chicken thigh fillets, skinless", "150 g plain yogurt, low-fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "120 g whole wheat breadcrumbs", "40 g wholemeal flour", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tsp paprika, sweet", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1 tsp onion powder", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "1 tsp salt", "300 g broccoli, raw", "200 g carrots, raw", "200 g potatoes, boiled", "1 tbsp lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Cut the potatoes into bite-sized pieces if needed and toss the broccoli and carrots with half of the olive oil and the lemon juice. Spread them on the tray and roast for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, mix the yogurt and egg in one bowl. In a second bowl combine the breadcrumbs, flour, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and salt. Dip each chicken thigh fillet into the yogurt mixture, then coat it well in the seasoned crumb mixture and press the coating on firmly. Place the coated chicken on a lightly oiled rack set over a baking tray or beside the vegetables if there is space, then drizzle the remaining olive oil over the chicken. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes, turning once halfway through, until the coating is crisp and the chicken is cooked through with no pink in the centre. Serve the chicken hot with the roasted vegetables and potatoes.

title: Ginger Chicken and Vegetable Brown Rice Fried Rice
ingredients_json: ["250 g Brown rice, cooked", "200 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "2 piece Egg, raw", "100 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Broccoli, raw", "80 g Frozen peas", "80 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 g Ginger, fresh", "20 ml Soy sauce, reduced sodium", "15 ml Rapeseed oil", "5 g Sesame oil", "10 g Spring onion, raw", "10 ml Lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice ahead of time if possible and chill it so the grains stay separate. Cut the chicken into small bite-sized pieces. Heat a large non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat with the rapeseed oil, then add the chicken and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned and just cooked through. Add the onion, carrot, broccoli, garlic, and ginger, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables begin to soften but still keep some bite. Push everything to one side of the pan, add the eggs, and scramble them for about 1 minute until just set. Stir in the cold rice and peas, then pour over the soy sauce and lemon juice. Toss well over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until the rice is hot, glossy, and evenly seasoned. Finish with the sesame oil and spring onion, then serve immediately while steaming hot.

title: Ginger Chicken and Vegetable Fried Rice with Edamame
ingredients_json: ["250 g brown rice, cooked", "200 g chicken breast, raw", "2 pieces egg, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "100 g frozen peas", "80 g shelled edamame, cooked", "80 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "10 g ginger, raw", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "15 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "10 ml sesame oil", "20 g spring onion, raw", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cook the brown rice ahead of time and let it cool so it fries well and stays separate. Cut the chicken into small bite-sized pieces, finely chop the onion, garlic, and ginger, and dice the carrot. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat, then add the chicken and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly golden and just cooked through. Add the onion, carrot, garlic, and ginger, and stir-fry for 2 minutes until fragrant and slightly softened. Push the mixture to one side of the pan, crack in the eggs, and scramble them for about 1 minute until just set. Add the cooked rice, peas, and edamame, then stir everything together over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes until the rice is hot and lightly toasted. Pour in the soy sauce and sesame oil, then toss well so the grains are evenly coated. Finish with the spring onion and black pepper, and cook for another 30 seconds before serving while hot.

title: Ginger Chicken and Vegetable Fried Rice
ingredients_json: ["300 g brown rice, cooked", "200 g chicken breast, skinless", "2 pieces egg, raw", "100 g carrot, raw", "100 g frozen peas", "100 g broccoli florets", "80 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "10 g ginger, raw", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "20 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "10 ml water", "5 g sesame seeds, whole", "20 g spring onion, raw", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into small bite-sized pieces. Finely chop the onion, garlic, and ginger, dice the carrot, and cut the broccoli into small florets. Beat the eggs in a bowl. Heat half of the oil in a large non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly golden and cooked through. Remove it from the pan and set aside. Add the remaining oil, then cook the onion, carrot, broccoli, garlic, and ginger over medium heat for about 4 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables are beginning to soften but still have some bite. Push the vegetables to one side of the pan, pour in the beaten eggs, and scramble them gently for 1 to 2 minutes until just set. Add the cooked rice, peas, chicken, soy sauce, water, and black pepper. Stir-fry over high heat for 3 to 4 minutes, breaking up any clumps and making sure everything is evenly mixed and hot throughout. Finish by stirring through the spring onion and sesame seeds, then serve immediately while steaming hot.

title: Ginger Chicken and Vegetable Fried Rice with Edamame
ingredients_json: ["300 g cooked brown rice", "220 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "2 piece egg, raw", "120 g shelled edamame, cooked", "150 g carrot, raw", "120 g broccoli florets, raw", "80 g onion, raw", "2 piece garlic clove, raw", "15 g ginger root, raw", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "20 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "10 ml sesame oil", "25 g spring onion, raw", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into small bite-sized pieces. Heat a large non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat and add the rapeseed oil. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until lightly browned and cooked through. Add the onion, carrot, broccoli, garlic, and ginger, then cook for 3 to 4 minutes until the vegetables start to soften but still keep some bite. Push everything to one side of the pan, pour in the beaten eggs, and scramble them gently for about 1 minute until just set. Add the cooked brown rice and edamame, then stir-fry over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until the rice is hot and evenly mixed. Stir in the reduced-salt soy sauce, sesame oil, and black pepper, then cook for another 30 seconds. Finish with the sliced spring onion and serve immediately while hot.

title: Ginger Chicken and Vegetable Brown Rice Fried Rice
ingredients_json: ["250 g brown rice, cooked", "250 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "2 pieces egg, raw", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 g ginger, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "150 g broccoli, raw", "100 g frozen peas", "80 g red bell pepper, raw", "30 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "10 ml sesame oil", "2 stalks spring onion, raw", "10 ml lemon juice, raw"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into small bite-sized pieces and season lightly. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat, then add the chicken and stir-fry for about 5 to 6 minutes until it is cooked through and lightly browned. Remove the chicken to a plate. Add the onion, garlic, ginger, carrot, broccoli, and red bell pepper to the pan and cook over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables are bright and just tender. Stir in the peas and cook for 1 minute more. Push the vegetables to one side, crack in the eggs, and scramble them gently until just set. Add the cooked brown rice and chicken back to the pan, then pour over the soy sauce and sesame oil. Stir-fry over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until everything is hot, evenly coated, and the rice begins to take on a slightly toasted aroma. Finish with the spring onion and lemon juice, then serve immediately while steaming hot.

title: Creamy Spinach and Mushroom Gnocchi with Lemon and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["800 g Potato gnocchi, fresh", "15 ml Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "250 g Mushrooms, button, raw", "200 g Spinach, raw", "150 g Cherry tomatoes", "200 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "100 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "40 g Cheese, Parmesan", "1 piece Lemon, raw", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt, table", "10 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the gnocchi for 2 to 3 minutes, until they float to the surface. Drain them well. While the gnocchi cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until softened and translucent. Add the minced garlic and sliced mushrooms, then cook for another 6 to 7 minutes over medium-high heat until the mushrooms are browned and their liquid has mostly evaporated. Stir in the cherry tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes until they begin to soften. Lower the heat to medium-low, add the milk and yogurt, and stir until the sauce looks smooth and gently steaming but not boiling. Add the spinach in handfuls and let it wilt into the sauce. Tip in the drained gnocchi, parmesan, lemon zest, lemon juice, black pepper, and salt, then toss everything together for 1 to 2 minutes until the gnocchi are well coated and the sauce has thickened slightly. Finish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

title: Spinach and Mushroom Gnocchi with Tomato, Basil and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["800 g potato gnocchi, fresh", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g mushroom, button, raw", "200 g spinach, raw", "400 g tomato passata", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "30 g parmesan cheese, grated", "15 g basil, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until soft and translucent, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more without letting it brown. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes until they release their moisture and start to turn golden. Stir in the tomato passata, oregano, black pepper and salt, then simmer gently for 8 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly. Meanwhile, cook the gnocchi in a large pot of boiling water until they float to the surface, then let them cook for 30 seconds longer and drain well. Add the gnocchi to the sauce with the spinach and toss over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes until the spinach wilts and everything is coated. Remove from the heat, scatter over the parmesan and basil, and serve immediately while hot.

title: Creamy Spinach and Mushroom Gnocchi with Lemon Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["500 g Potato gnocchi, cooked", "200 g Mushroom, button, raw", "120 g Spinach, raw", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "150 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "40 g Cheese, Parmesan, grated", "1 piece Lemon, raw", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 4 minutes, stirring often, until softened and lightly translucent. Stir in the sliced mushrooms and cook for 6 to 8 minutes over medium-high heat until they release their moisture and begin to brown. Add the minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Meanwhile, cook the gnocchi in a large pan of boiling salted water according to the package instructions, then drain well. Reduce the skillet heat to medium-low and pour in the milk, stirring to lift any browned bits from the pan. Add the spinach and let it wilt for 1 minute, then stir in the drained gnocchi, Parmesan, lemon zest, and black pepper. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes, gently tossing, until the sauce lightly coats the gnocchi and looks creamy. Serve immediately with a little extra lemon juice stirred through for brightness.

title: Creamy Spinach and Mushroom Gnocchi with Lemon and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["800 g Potato gnocchi, fresh", "15 ml Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw, medium", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "250 g Mushrooms, button, raw", "200 g Spinach, fresh", "200 g Tomato, canned, chopped", "150 ml Cream, cooking, light", "40 g Cheese, Parmesan", "15 ml Lemon juice, raw", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Pepper, black", "10 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes, allowing the mushrooms to release their moisture and begin to brown. Add the chopped tomatoes, light cream, salt, and black pepper, then simmer gently for 3 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the gnocchi in a large pot of boiling water until they float to the surface, then let them cook for 1 more minute before draining. Add the gnocchi to the sauce with the spinach and toss over low heat until the spinach has wilted and the gnocchi are well coated. Stir in the lemon juice and most of the Parmesan, then taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. Serve immediately with the remaining Parmesan and chopped parsley scattered over the top.

title: Whole Wheat Gnocchi with Spinach, Cherry Tomatoes and Lemon Ricotta
ingredients_json: ["500 g gnocchi, fresh, potato-based", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "150 g spinach, raw", "250 g ricotta cheese, part-skim", "40 g parmesan cheese, grated", "1 piece lemon, zest and juice", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "3 g salt, table"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat, then add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant but not browned. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften and release their juices. Add the gnocchi to the boiling water and cook according to the package instructions, usually 2 to 3 minutes, until they float to the surface. Add the spinach to the skillet and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted. In a bowl, mix the ricotta with the lemon zest, lemon juice, black pepper, and salt. Drain the gnocchi well and add it to the skillet, tossing gently to coat in the tomato and spinach mixture. Remove the pan from the heat and fold in the ricotta mixture and half of the parmesan. Serve immediately with the remaining parmesan scattered over the top.

title: Lean Beef and Vegetable Goulash with Paprika and Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["500 g Beef, lean, stewing meat", "15 ml Rapeseed oil", "2 pieces Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 pieces Red bell pepper, raw", "2 pieces Carrot, raw", "400 g Tomato, canned, chopped", "2 tbsp Paprika, sweet", "1 tbsp Tomato puree", "750 ml Water", "300 g Potato, raw", "150 g White cabbage, raw", "2 leaves Bay leaf, dried", "1 tsp Caraway seed", "5 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "10 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Cut the beef into bite-sized cubes and pat it dry. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large heavy pot over medium-high heat, then brown the beef in batches for about 5 minutes per batch so the meat develops color without steaming. Lower the heat to medium, add the chopped onions and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic, paprika, tomato puree, and caraway seed and cook for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Add the carrots, red peppers, canned tomatoes, bay leaves, water, salt, and black pepper, then bring everything to a gentle simmer. Cover the pot and cook over low heat for about 60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beef is becoming tender. Add the potatoes and cabbage and continue simmering for 25 to 30 minutes more, until the vegetables are soft and the goulash has thickened slightly. Remove the bay leaves, stir in the chopped parsley, and let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Lean Beef and Paprika Goulash with Potatoes and Peppers

title: Chicken Gyros with Wholemeal Pita, Tzatziki and Crisp Salad

title: Spinach and Ricotta Whole-Wheat Manicotti with Tomato Basil Sauce

title: Creamy Garlic and Chive Mashed Potatoes with Greek Yogurt

title: Creamy Chestnut Mushroom Soup with Spinach and White Beans

title: Creamy Mushroom and Spinach Soup with Barley

title: Creamy Mushroom and Spinach Soup with Barley
ingredients_json: ["300 g button mushrooms", "200 g chestnut mushrooms", "1 piece onion", "2 cloves garlic", "15 ml olive oil", "40 g pearl barley", "750 ml vegetable stock", "250 ml semi-skimmed milk", "100 g baby spinach", "80 g carrot", "10 g fresh parsley", "2 g black pepper", "2 g dried thyme", "3 g salt", "15 ml lemon juice"]

title: Creamy Garlic Mushroom and Barley Soup
ingredients_json: ["15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "400 g mushrooms, white, raw", "150 g mushrooms, brown, raw", "100 g celery, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "80 g pearl barley, dry", "1000 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "500 ml water", "2 g dried thyme", "1 piece bay leaf", "150 ml milk, semi-skimmed, pasteurised", "100 g plain yoghurt, low fat", "10 g parsley, fresh", "3 g salt"]

title: Creamy Garlic Mushroom and Barley Soup with Spinach

title: Lean Turkey and Black Bean Nachos with Tomato Salsa and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g tortilla chips, corn, plain", "300 g turkey mince, lean", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 medium red bell pepper, raw", "200 g black beans, cooked, drained", "150 g tomato puree", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 g salt", "0.5 g black pepper, ground", "120 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "150 g tomato, raw", "80 g red onion, raw", "15 g fresh coriander leaves", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 medium avocado, raw", "20 ml lime juice, raw"]

title: Chicken and Black Bean Loaded Nachos with Avocado Yogurt Salsa
ingredients_json: ["180 g tortilla chips, corn, unsalted", "250 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp paprika, sweet", "1 tsp cumin, ground", "0.5 tsp garlic powder", "0.5 tsp salt", "150 g black beans, canned, drained", "100 g sweetcorn, canned, drained", "120 g cherry tomatoes", "1 piece red onion", "1 piece avocado, raw, flesh only", "150 g yogurt, Greek style, plain, low fat", "1 tbsp lime juice", "120 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "10 g fresh coriander", "1 piece jalapeño pepper, fresh"]

title: Wholewheat Chicken and Spinach Noodle Casserole

title: Turkey and Spinach Wholewheat Noodle Casserole with Tomato and Yogurt

title: Turkey, Spinach and Tomato Wholewheat Noodle Casserole
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat noodles", "300 g turkey mince, lean", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, medium, chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "1 piece carrot, medium, diced", "1 piece red bell pepper, chopped", "200 g mushrooms, sliced", "400 g tomatoes, chopped, canned", "2 tbsp tomato puree", "150 ml low-fat milk", "100 g plain yogurt, low-fat", "80 g spinach, fresh", "60 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat, grated", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground"]

title: Chicken, Spinach and Tomato Wholewheat Noodle Casserole
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat egg noodles", "400 g chicken breast fillet, skinless", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "200 g mushrooms, raw", "150 g carrot", "200 g spinach, raw", "400 g tomatoes, canned, chopped", "200 g tomato passata", "2 dl milk, semi-skimmed", "150 g cottage cheese, low fat", "30 g hard cheese, reduced fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "1 tsp salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]

Slice the chicken breast into thin strips, shred the carrot into fine matchsticks, and slice the spring onions. Whisk the eggs in a bowl. Add the remaining oil, then fry the garlic, ginger, and chilli for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Push the aromatics to one side, pour in the eggs, and stir gently until softly set. Add the noodles, tamarind paste, fish sauce, soy sauce, lime juice, and honey, then toss well over medium heat so the noodles are evenly coated. Return the chicken to the pan, add the carrot, bean sprouts, and most of the spring onions, and stir-fry for 1 to 2 minutes until everything is hot but the vegetables still have some crunch. Fold in half of the peanuts and most of the coriander, then serve immediately topped with the remaining peanuts, spring onions, coriander, and fresh lime wedges.

title: Lean Chicken Pad Thai with Lime, Bean Sprouts and Peanuts
ingredients_json: ["150 g rice noodles, dry", "250 g chicken breast, skinless", "2 tbsp rapeseed oil", "2 piece egg, raw", "2 cloves garlic", "1 piece shallot", "150 g bean sprouts", "100 g carrot", "2 stalk spring onion", "30 g unsalted roasted peanuts", "2 tbsp lime juice", "2 tbsp tamarind paste", "1 tbsp low-sodium soy sauce", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tsp brown sugar", "1 tsp chilli flakes", "10 g fresh coriander"]
instructions:
Soak the rice noodles in hot water until flexible but still slightly firm, then drain well. Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Finely chop the garlic and shallot, julienne the carrot, and cut the spring onions into short lengths. Whisk the eggs in a small bowl.

Heat 1 tablespoon of the rapeseed oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly golden and cooked through. Transfer it to a plate. Add the remaining oil, then cook the shallot and garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Push them to the side, pour in the eggs, and scramble gently for 30 to 60 seconds until just set.

Add the noodles, tamarind paste, soy sauce, fish sauce, brown sugar, chilli flakes, and lime juice. Toss constantly over medium-high heat for 1 to 2 minutes so the noodles absorb the sauce. Return the chicken to the pan, then add the carrot, bean sprouts, and spring onions. Cook for another 1 to 2 minutes, just until the vegetables are warmed but still crisp. Remove from the heat and fold through most of the coriander.

Serve immediately topped with the peanuts and the remaining coriander. The noodles should be glossy and lightly sauced, with the vegetables still fresh and the chicken tender.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Pad Thai with Lime and Peanuts
ingredients_json: ["180 g rice noodles, dry", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "2 piece egg, raw", "150 g bean sprouts, raw", "80 g carrot, raw", "80 g red bell pepper, raw", "60 g spring onion, raw", "30 g unsalted peanuts, roasted", "2 tbsp lime juice", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "1 tbsp fish sauce", "1 tbsp tamarind paste", "2 tsp brown sugar", "2 tbsp rapeseed oil", "2 g garlic, raw", "10 g fresh coriander leaves", "1 piece lime wedge"]
instructions: Soak or cook the rice noodles according to the package directions until just tender, then drain them well and set them aside.
