Mix the lime juice, reduced-salt soy sauce, fish sauce, tamarind paste, and brown sugar in a small bowl. Heat 1 tablespoon of rapeseed oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned and cooked through, then transfer it to a plate. Add the remaining oil to the pan and cook the garlic for about 20 seconds until fragrant. Add the egg and stir quickly so it forms soft curds. Add the carrot and red bell pepper and stir-fry for 2 minutes so they stay crisp. Return the chicken and noodles to the pan, pour over the sauce, and toss everything together over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes until the noodles are evenly coated and glossy. Fold in the bean sprouts and half of the spring onion at the end so they stay fresh and crunchy. Serve immediately topped with peanuts, coriander, and the remaining spring onion, with a lime wedge on the side.

title: Lemon-Ginger Chicken Pad Thai with Wholegrain Rice Noodles
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholegrain rice noodles", "300 g chicken breast, raw, without skin", "2 piece egg, chicken, whole, raw", "150 g bean sprouts, raw", "80 g carrot, raw", "80 g spring onion, raw", "50 g unsalted peanuts, roasted", "15 g garlic, raw", "10 g ginger, raw", "30 ml lime juice, raw", "30 ml tamarind paste", "20 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "15 ml fish sauce", "10 ml honey", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "5 g coriander leaf, fresh"]
instructions: Soak or cook the rice noodles according to the package directions until just tender, then drain them well and set them aside. Cut the chicken into thin strips. Whisk together the lime juice, tamarind paste, soy sauce, fish sauce, and honey in a small bowl. Heat the rapeseed oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes until it is lightly browned and cooked through. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Push the chicken to one side, add the eggs to the pan, and scramble them gently until just set. Add the drained noodles and pour in the sauce, then toss everything together over high heat for 1 to 2 minutes until the noodles are coated and glossy. Stir in the bean sprouts, carrot, and spring onion, and cook for another minute so the vegetables stay crisp but warmed through. Remove from the heat, top with the peanuts and coriander, and serve immediately with a squeeze of extra lime if desired.

title: Chicken and Seafood Paella with Peppers and Peas
ingredients_json: ["2 tbsp olive oil", "300 g chicken breast, skinless", "150 g raw prawns, peeled", "100 g squid rings, raw", "1 medium onion", "2 cloves garlic", "1 red bell pepper", "1 yellow bell pepper", "200 g paella rice", "800 ml low-salt chicken stock", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes", "100 g green peas, frozen", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp saffron threads", "1 tsp sea salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "1 lemon", "2 tbsp fresh parsley"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wide paella pan over medium heat. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until lightly browned on the outside. Add the finely chopped onion and garlic, then cook for 3 minutes more until softened. Stir in the sliced red and yellow peppers and cook for another 4 minutes. Add the paella rice, smoked paprika, saffron, salt, and black pepper, and stir for 1 minute so the grains are well coated. Pour in the chicken stock and chopped tomatoes, then bring everything to a gentle boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer without stirring for 12 minutes. Scatter in the peas, prawns, and squid rings, then continue cooking for 6 to 8 minutes until the rice is tender, the liquid has mostly absorbed, and the seafood is just cooked through. Remove the pan from the heat and cover it loosely for 5 minutes. Finish with lemon wedges and chopped parsley before serving.

title: Chicken, Prawn and Vegetable Paella with Smoked Paprika
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, raw", "200 g Prawns, raw, peeled", "250 g Paella rice, dry", "1 l Chicken stock, reduced salt", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece Green bell pepper, raw", "150 g Tomatoes, chopped, canned", "100 g Frozen peas", "1 tbsp Tomato paste", "2 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Saffron", "1 piece Lemon, raw", "15 g Parsley, fresh", "1 tsp Salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wide paella pan or large shallow frying pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sliced peppers and cook for about 6 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, smoked paprika and saffron, then cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Add the diced chicken and cook over medium-high heat for 4 to 5 minutes, turning until the outside is opaque. Stir in the rice so every grain is coated, then add the chopped tomatoes and hot stock. Bring the pan to a steady simmer and spread the rice out in an even layer. Cook uncovered for 15 minutes without stirring, shaking the pan gently now and then so the rice cooks evenly. Scatter over the peas and prawns, pressing them gently into the rice, and cook for another 6 to 8 minutes until the prawns are pink, the rice is tender, and most of the liquid has been absorbed. If the top looks dry before the rice is cooked, add a small splash of hot water. Remove the pan from the heat, cover loosely, and rest for 5 minutes. Finish with chopped parsley and lemon wedges, then serve warm.

title: Chicken and Prawn Paella with Peppers and Peas
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "200 g Prawn, raw", "300 g Paella rice, dry", "1 l Chicken stock, reduced salt", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Red pepper, raw", "1 piece Yellow pepper, raw", "200 g Tomato, chopped, canned", "150 g Frozen peas", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Saffron, dried", "1 tsp Salt", "1 piece Lemon, raw", "15 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-size pieces and season lightly with half the salt. Heat the olive oil in a wide paella pan or large frying pan over medium-high heat, then brown the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly golden. Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 minutes over medium heat until softened, then stir in the garlic, paprika, and saffron for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the diced red and yellow peppers and cook for another 3 minutes. Stir in the paella rice so it is coated in the oil and spices, then add the chopped tomatoes and hot chicken stock. Bring everything to a steady simmer, reduce the heat to medium-low, and cook without stirring for about 15 minutes. Scatter the peas and prawns over the top, then continue cooking for 6 to 8 minutes until the rice is tender, the prawns are pink, and most of the liquid has been absorbed. If the pan looks dry before the rice is cooked, add a small splash of stock. Remove from the heat, cover loosely, and rest for 5 minutes. Finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley before serving.

title: Chicken and Prawn Wholegrain Paella with Peppers and Peas
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, skinless", "200 g Raw prawns, peeled", "250 g Brown rice, dry", "1.2 l Vegetable stock, reduced salt", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece Yellow bell pepper, raw", "150 g Frozen peas", "200 g Tomatoes, chopped, canned", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Saffron, dried", "1 tsp Lemon juice", "10 g Parsley, fresh", "1 pinch Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or wide frying pan over medium heat. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces, add it to the pan, and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until lightly browned on the outside. Add the chopped onion and sliced peppers, then cook for another 5 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, and saffron and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the brown rice and stir well so every grain is coated. Pour in the tomatoes and hot stock, then bring the pan to a gentle simmer. Reduce the heat to low and cook uncovered for about 25 minutes, stirring only occasionally, until the rice is nearly tender. Add the peas and prawns on top and cook for 5 to 7 minutes more until the prawns are pink and the rice has absorbed most of the liquid. The paella is ready when the rice is tender, the mixture looks moist but not soupy, and a few grains at the bottom are just beginning to catch. Finish with lemon juice, parsley, and black pepper, then rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken and Seafood Paella with Peppers and Peas
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken thigh fillet, without skin", "200 g Raw prawns, peeled", "200 g Mussels, flesh only", "250 g Paella rice", "1.2 l Chicken stock, reduced salt", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece Yellow bell pepper, raw", "200 g Tomato, canned, chopped", "100 g Frozen peas", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Saffron, dried", "1 piece Lemon, raw", "10 g Fresh parsley", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wide paella pan or large shallow skillet over medium heat. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned on the outside. Add the chopped onion and sliced peppers, then cook for another 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, and saffron and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the paella rice and stir for 1 minute so the grains are coated in the oil and spices. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and hot stock, then spread the rice evenly across the pan and bring it to a steady simmer. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook uncovered for about 15 minutes without stirring, until the rice has absorbed most of the liquid. Scatter over the peas, prawns, and mussels, pressing them gently into the rice, and continue cooking for 5 to 7 minutes until the seafood is cooked through and the rice is tender but still slightly firm in the centre. If the pan looks dry before the rice is done, add a small splash of hot stock. Remove from the heat, cover loosely, and leave to rest for 5 minutes. Finish with black pepper, chopped parsley, and lemon wedges before serving.

title: Lemongrass Chicken Pancit Bihon with Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["180 g rice vermicelli noodles, dry", "250 g chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "15 ml canola oil", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "80 g onion, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "120 g cabbage, raw", "100 g green beans, raw", "80 g red bell pepper, raw", "60 g bean sprouts, raw", "30 g scallions, raw", "500 ml chicken broth, reduced sodium", "30 ml soy sauce, reduced sodium", "15 ml calamansi juice", "2 g ground black pepper", "2 g salt, iodized", "5 g garlic, raw", "10 g ginger, raw"]
instructions: Soak the rice vermicelli in warm water for about 8 minutes until softened but not fully cooked, then drain well. Slice the chicken breast into thin strips. Heat the canola oil in a large wok or deep skillet over medium-high heat, then add the garlic, ginger, and onion and stir for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant and lightly softened. Add the chicken and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until the pieces turn opaque and are nearly cooked through. Add the carrot, green beans, and bell pepper, then stir-fry for 2 minutes over medium-high heat so the vegetables stay crisp-tender. Pour in the chicken broth, soy sauce, calamansi juice, salt, and black pepper, then bring the mixture to a gentle simmer. Add the drained noodles and toss continuously for 2 to 3 minutes until the noodles absorb the liquid and are evenly coated. Add the cabbage, bean sprouts, and scallions, then cook for another 1 minute just until the cabbage begins to wilt. Remove from the heat and serve immediately while the noodles are glossy and the vegetables are still bright.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Pancit Canton with Ginger and Lime
ingredients_json: ["200 g wheat noodles, dry", "250 g chicken breast, skinless", "15 ml canola oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "10 g ginger, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "150 g green cabbage, raw", "100 g green beans, raw", "100 g red bell pepper, raw", "80 g bean sprouts, raw", "30 ml soy sauce, reduced sodium", "20 ml lemon juice, fresh", "500 ml water", "2 g black pepper, ground", "10 g spring onion, raw"]
instructions: Soak or briefly rinse the wheat noodles according to the package directions if they are very dry, then drain well. Cut the chicken breast into thin strips, slice the onion, mince the garlic and ginger, and cut the vegetables into thin, even pieces so they cook quickly. Heat the oil in a large wok or deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the outside is lightly browned and the pieces are just cooked through. Add the onion, garlic, and ginger, then stir-fry for about 1 minute until fragrant. Add the carrot, green beans, and bell pepper, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring often, so the vegetables stay crisp. Pour in the water and soy sauce, then bring to a gentle simmer. Add the noodles and toss continuously for 2 to 4 minutes until the liquid is mostly absorbed and the noodles are tender but still springy. Stir in the cabbage and bean sprouts during the last minute so they wilt slightly without losing crunch. Finish with lemon juice and black pepper, then remove from the heat. Serve hot and garnish with sliced spring onion.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Pancit Bihon with Calamansi
ingredients_json: ["180 g rice vermicelli noodles, dry", "220 g chicken breast, skinless, raw", "15 ml canola oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "120 g cabbage, raw", "80 g green beans, raw", "80 g shiitake mushrooms, raw", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced sodium", "1 tbsp oyster sauce", "500 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "60 g spring onion, raw", "30 ml calamansi juice, fresh", "1 g ground black pepper"]
instructions: Soak the rice vermicelli in warm water for 8 minutes until just pliable, then drain well. Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and slice the onion, garlic, carrot, cabbage, green beans, mushrooms, and spring onion. Heat the canola oil in a large wok or deep skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is no longer pink and lightly browned. Add the onion and garlic and cook for 1 minute over medium heat until fragrant. Stir in the carrot, green beans, and mushrooms, then cook for 3 minutes so the vegetables begin to soften but still stay crisp. Add the chicken stock, soy sauce, and oyster sauce, then bring the mixture to a gentle simmer. Add the drained noodles and toss carefully for 2 to 3 minutes until they absorb most of the liquid. Add the cabbage and spring onion and cook for another 1 to 2 minutes until the cabbage just wilts. Finish with calamansi juice and black pepper, then toss well and serve hot while the noodles are glossy and the vegetables are tender-crisp.

title: Chicken and Whole Wheat Pancit Bihon with Crisp Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["180 g rice vermicelli noodles, dried", "250 g chicken breast, skinless", "15 ml canola oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "120 g carrot", "150 g cabbage, white", "100 g green beans", "80 g shiitake mushrooms, fresh", "200 ml chicken broth, reduced sodium", "30 ml soy sauce, light", "15 ml calamansi juice", "2 g black pepper, ground", "20 g spring onion, raw", "10 g red bell pepper"]
instructions: Soak the rice vermicelli in warm water for about 8 minutes until just pliable, then drain well. Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and slice the vegetables into even bite-size pieces so they cook quickly. Heat the canola oil in a large wok or wide skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until lightly browned and cooked through. Add the onion and garlic and cook for 1 minute over medium heat until fragrant. Stir in the carrot, green beans, mushrooms, and red bell pepper, then cook for 3 minutes so the vegetables begin to soften but still stay crisp. Pour in the chicken broth, soy sauce, calamansi juice, and black pepper, then bring the pan to a gentle simmer. Add the cabbage and the drained noodles, tossing carefully with tongs for 2 to 3 minutes until the noodles have absorbed most of the liquid and are evenly coated. If the pan looks dry before the noodles are tender, add a small splash of water and keep tossing. Finish with the spring onion, turn off the heat, and serve immediately while the noodles are glossy and the vegetables are bright.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Pancit Bihon with Lemon and Soy
ingredients_json: ["180 g rice vermicelli noodles, dry", "300 g chicken breast, skinless", "2 tbsp canola oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "2 pieces carrot, raw", "150 g cabbage, raw", "100 g green beans, raw", "80 g snow peas, raw", "100 g shiitake mushrooms, raw", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced sodium", "1 tbsp oyster sauce", "500 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "1 piece lemon, raw", "2 stalks spring onion, raw", "1 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Soak the rice vermicelli in warm water for 8 to 10 minutes until just pliable, then drain well. Cut the chicken into thin strips and slice the vegetables into even pieces so they cook quickly. Heat the oil in a large wok or wide pan over medium-high heat, then add the onion and cook for 2 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and chicken and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes until the chicken is no longer pink on the outside. Add the carrots, green beans, mushrooms, and snow peas, then stir-fry for another 3 minutes. Pour in the stock, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and black pepper, then bring everything to a gentle boil over medium heat. Add the cabbage and the drained noodles, tossing carefully with tongs so the noodles absorb the sauce evenly. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, turning the noodles often, until the liquid is mostly absorbed and the noodles are tender but not mushy. Finish with lemon juice and spring onion, then serve immediately while hot.

title: Grilled Chicken, Spinach and Roasted Pepper Panini
ingredients_json: ["200 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "4 slices wholemeal bread", "60 g roasted red peppers, drained", "40 g baby spinach leaves, fresh", "30 g mozzarella cheese, reduced fat", "20 g hummus", "10 ml olive oil", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g garlic powder", "5 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or sandwich press over medium heat. Slice the chicken breast lengthwise into thin fillets and season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and lemon juice. Brush the chicken lightly with half of the olive oil and cook for 5 to 6 minutes per side until fully cooked and lightly browned, then rest for 2 minutes before slicing. Spread hummus on two slices of bread and layer with spinach, roasted red peppers, sliced chicken, and mozzarella. Close with the remaining bread slices and brush the outsides with the rest of the olive oil. Toast the panini on the grill pan or press for 3 to 4 minutes, pressing gently, until the bread is crisp and golden and the cheese has melted. Cut in half and serve immediately while hot.

title: Grilled Chicken, Spinach and Tomato Panini with Light Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["240 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "8 g Olive oil", "2 g Fine sea salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "4 slices Wholemeal bread, sliced", "60 g Mozzarella, light", "40 g Spinach, fresh", "80 g Tomato, raw", "20 g Red onion, raw", "15 g Basil pesto, reduced fat"]
instructions: Season the chicken breast with olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Heat a grill pan or frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 5 to 6 minutes per side, until it is golden outside and cooked through with no pink in the centre. Transfer to a board and let it rest for 3 minutes, then slice thinly. Warm a panini press or heavy skillet over medium heat. Spread the pesto lightly over two slices of bread, then layer on spinach, sliced tomato, red onion, chicken, and mozzarella. Close with the remaining bread slices. Press the sandwiches in the panini press for 4 to 5 minutes, or cook in a skillet with a second heavy pan on top, turning once, until the bread is crisp and deeply golden and the cheese has melted. Cut each panini in half and serve immediately while hot.

title: Grilled Chicken, Spinach and Tomato Panini with Basil Pesto
ingredients_json: ["320 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "8 g olive oil", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "8 slices wholemeal bread", "40 g basil pesto", "80 g mozzarella cheese, reduced fat", "60 g tomato, raw", "40 g baby spinach, raw", "20 g red onion"]
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or panini press to medium-high heat. Brush the chicken breast lightly with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper. Cook the chicken for about 5 to 6 minutes per side, until nicely browned and fully cooked through, then rest it for 3 minutes before slicing thinly. Spread basil pesto over four slices of bread, then top each with spinach, tomato slices, red onion, sliced chicken, and mozzarella. Close with the remaining bread slices. Grill the sandwiches in the panini press or in a hot grill pan with a heavy pan on top for 3 to 5 minutes, until the bread is crisp and golden and the cheese has melted. Slice each panini in half and serve immediately while warm.

title: Grilled Chicken, Spinach and Tomato Panini with Basil Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["180 g chicken breast fillet, skinless", "8 g olive oil", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "4 slices whole grain bread", "80 g mozzarella cheese, reduced fat", "40 g spinach leaves, fresh", "80 g tomato, fresh", "30 g red onion", "40 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "5 g basil, fresh", "5 ml lemon juice", "10 g pesto, basil", "5 g butter, unsalted"]
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt, black pepper, and half of the olive oil. Grill or pan-sear it over medium-high heat for about 5 to 6 minutes per side, until cooked through and lightly golden, then let it rest for 3 minutes before slicing thinly. Mix the yogurt, chopped basil, and lemon juice in a small bowl to make a quick basil yogurt spread. Brush the outside of the bread slices with the remaining olive oil and spread the pesto on the inside of two slices, then add the yogurt mixture to the other two slices. Layer the spinach, tomato slices, red onion, chicken, and mozzarella evenly between the bread to build two sandwiches. Heat a panini press to medium-high or use a skillet and place a heavy pan on top of the sandwiches. Cook for 4 to 6 minutes, pressing gently, until the bread is crisp and deeply marked and the cheese has melted. If using a skillet, flip once halfway through for even browning. Cut the panini in half and serve immediately while hot and crisp.

title: Grilled Chicken, Spinach and Tomato Panini with Pesto
ingredients_json: ["240 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "8 g Olive oil", "2 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "8 slices Wholegrain bread", "40 g Basil pesto", "80 g Mozzarella cheese, low moisture, part-skim", "60 g Fresh spinach", "120 g Tomato, raw", "20 g Red onion", "10 g Butter"]
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper, then brush it lightly with the olive oil. Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 5 to 6 minutes per side, until well browned and the thickest part reaches 75 C. Let it rest for 5 minutes, then slice it thinly. Spread the pesto evenly over four slices of bread. Top each with spinach, tomato, red onion, sliced chicken, and mozzarella, then close with the remaining bread slices. Butter the outside of each sandwich lightly. Preheat a panini press or heavy skillet over medium heat and cook the sandwiches for 3 to 5 minutes, pressing gently, until the bread is crisp and deep golden and the cheese has melted. Slice each panini in half and serve warm.

title: Wholewheat Pasta Carbonara with Peas, Spinach and Turkey Bacon
ingredients_json: ["240 g wholewheat spaghetti", "120 g turkey bacon, smoked, sliced", "3 pieces egg, raw", "40 g cheese, parmesan, grated", "100 g peas, frozen, boiled", "60 g spinach, fresh", "1 piece onion, raw, small", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "10 ml olive oil", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt, iodized"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat and cook the wholewheat spaghetti until al dente, usually 8 to 10 minutes. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the diced onion and garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant and softened. Add the turkey bacon and cook for another 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned. Stir in the peas and spinach and cook just until the spinach wilts. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the grated parmesan, black pepper, and salt. Drain the pasta, reserving a small cup of the cooking water, then return the pasta to the warm skillet off the heat. Pour in the egg mixture and toss quickly and continuously so the eggs form a silky sauce without scrambling. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if needed to loosen the sauce and coat everything evenly. Serve immediately while creamy and hot.

title: Wholewheat Carbonara with Peas, Turkey Bacon and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat spaghetti", "120 g turkey bacon", "2 pieces egg, raw", "40 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "100 g peas, frozen", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt", "20 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente, about 9 to 10 minutes. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and fry the turkey bacon for 3 to 4 minutes until lightly crisp. Add the finely chopped onion and garlic and cook for another 2 minutes, stirring often so they soften without browning. Stir in the peas and cook for 2 minutes more. In a bowl, whisk the eggs with the grated Parmesan and black pepper. Reserve about 150 ml of the pasta water, then drain the spaghetti and add it to the pan with the bacon and vegetables over low heat. Remove the pan from the heat, pour in the egg mixture, and toss quickly so the eggs coat the pasta and turn silky without scrambling. Add a little reserved pasta water if needed to loosen the sauce and make it creamy. Finish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.

title: Wholewheat Turkey Carbonara with Peas and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholewheat spaghetti", "150 g turkey bacon", "2 piece egg, whole, raw", "2 piece egg yolk, raw", "40 g parmesan cheese, hard", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g peas, frozen", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "20 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the wholewheat spaghetti until just al dente, about 8 to 10 minutes. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the turkey bacon with the chopped onion for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned. Add the garlic and peas and cook for 2 minutes more until the peas are hot and bright green. In a bowl, whisk together the whole eggs, egg yolks, finely grated parmesan, black pepper, and a small splash of hot pasta water. Drain the pasta, reserving about 200 ml of the cooking water, then add the pasta to the pan off the heat. Pour in the egg mixture and toss quickly and continuously so the sauce turns silky and coats the pasta without scrambling. Add a little reserved pasta water at a time until the sauce is creamy and glossy. Stir in the chopped parsley, taste for seasoning, and serve immediately.

title: Wholewheat Turkey Carbonara with Peas and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat spaghetti", "120 g turkey bacon", "2 piece egg", "2 piece egg yolk", "40 g Parmesan cheese", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 clove garlic", "150 g frozen peas", "60 g spinach, raw", "1 g black pepper", "2 g salt", "20 ml water"]

title: Wholewheat Turkey Carbonara with Peas and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["240 g wholewheat spaghetti", "150 g turkey bacon, cured, cooked", "2 piece egg, raw", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "40 g parmesan cheese, grated", "150 g peas, frozen, cooked", "60 g spinach, fresh", "2 clove garlic, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 g black pepper, ground", "4 g salt, table"]

title: Wholewheat Pasta Primavera with Lemon, Parmesan and Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["240 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "200 g broccoli florets, raw", "150 g zucchini, raw", "120 g red bell pepper, raw", "120 g carrots, raw", "100 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "80 g frozen peas", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece lemon, raw", "40 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "15 g fresh basil leaves", "2 g black pepper, ground", "4 g salt", "250 ml vegetable broth"]

Add the cherry tomatoes, peas, and vegetable broth, then simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until the tomatoes begin to soften. Stir in the roasted vegetables, drained pasta, lemon zest, and lemon juice, tossing gently so everything is evenly coated. Add a little reserved pasta water if the sauce needs loosening. Remove from the heat, fold through the basil, and finish with the Parmesan before serving warm.

title: Wholewheat Pasta Primavera with Lemon, Parmesan and Spring Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["240 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "150 g zucchini, raw", "150 g broccoli, raw", "120 g red bell pepper, raw", "100 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "80 g peas, frozen", "120 g spinach, raw", "120 g ricotta cheese, part-skim", "30 g parmesan cheese, grated", "1 piece lemon, raw", "200 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt, table"]

Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. title: Lemon Garlic Chicken Pasta Primavera with Tender Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat pasta, dry", "300 g chicken breast, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece onion, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece yellow bell pepper, raw", "150 g zucchini, raw", "100 g broccoli florets, raw", "100 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "100 g green peas, frozen", "150 ml milk, low fat", "50 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "15 ml lemon juice, fresh", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt, table", "5 g basil, fresh"]

title: Wholewheat Pasta Primavera with Lemon, Parmesan and Spring Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece zucchini, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "150 g broccoli florets, raw", "100 g carrots, raw", "120 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "100 g spinach, raw", "150 ml low-fat cooking cream", "40 g parmesan cheese, grated", "1 piece lemon, raw", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt, table", "15 g fresh basil leaves, raw"]

title: Whole Wheat Pasta Primavera with Lemon, Parmesan and Spring Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["300 g whole wheat pasta", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g broccoli, raw", "150 g zucchini, raw", "150 g red bell pepper, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "100 g green peas, frozen", "150 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "80 g baby spinach, raw", "100 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "30 ml lemon juice, freshly squeezed", "40 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt, table", "5 g basil, fresh"]

Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. title: Mediterranean Tuna Pasta Salad with Lemon, Spinach and Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["240 g wholemeal pasta", "160 g tuna in water, drained", "120 g cherry tomatoes", "80 g cucumber", "60 g baby spinach", "60 g canned sweetcorn, drained", "40 g red onion", "40 g black olives, pitted", "50 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "15 ml olive oil", "20 ml lemon juice", "5 g Dijon mustard", "2 g garlic, fresh", "2 g dried oregano", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Cook the wholemeal pasta in a large pan of lightly salted boiling water until just tender, about 9 to 11 minutes. title: Lemon Tuna and Chickpea Pasta Salad with Spinach and Cherry Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["240 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "185 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "240 g chickpeas, canned, drained", "120 g cherry tomatoes", "100 g cucumber", "80 g baby spinach", "60 g red onion", "30 g black olives, pitted", "30 g feta cheese", "30 ml olive oil", "25 ml lemon juice", "1 g garlic, raw", "2 g dried oregano", "1 g black pepper, ground", "3 g iodised salt"]
instructions: Cook the wholewheat pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until just tender, then drain it and rinse briefly under cold water to stop the cooking. Drain the tuna and chickpeas well. Halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber, thinly slice the red onion, and tear the spinach if the leaves are large. In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, finely grated garlic, oregano, black pepper, and iodised salt. title: Mediterranean Tuna and Chickpea Pasta Salad with Lemon Herb Dressing
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal pasta, dry", "160 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "240 g chickpeas, cooked, drained", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "100 g cucumber", "80 g red bell pepper", "50 g red onion", "40 g spinach, fresh", "30 g black olives, pitted", "30 g feta cheese", "20 ml olive oil", "20 ml lemon juice", "10 g parsley, fresh", "5 g dill, fresh", "2 g garlic, raw", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Cook the wholemeal pasta in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water over medium-high heat until just tender, then drain and rinse briefly under cold water to stop the cooking. Let it drain well so the salad stays fresh rather than watery. While the pasta cooks, halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber and red pepper, thinly slice the red onion, and roughly chop the spinach, parsley, and dill. In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, grated garlic, and salt until the dressing looks glossy and slightly emulsified. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooled pasta, tuna, chickpeas, tomatoes, cucumber, red pepper, red onion, spinach, olives, and herbs. title: Lemon Chicken and Mediterranean Vegetable Pasta Salad
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat fusilli pasta", "300 g chicken breast fillet, skinless", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp garlic powder", "1 piece red bell pepper", "1 piece yellow bell pepper", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "1 piece cucumber", "80 g red onion", "120 g baby spinach", "80 g feta cheese", "40 g black olives, pitted", "60 g plain Greek yogurt", "2 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 clove garlic", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the wholewheat fusilli until just tender, following the packet time. Drain it well and rinse briefly under cold water so the pasta stops cooking and stays firm. While the pasta cooks, heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Rub the chicken breast with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil, the oregano, garlic powder, and a little of the salt, then cook for 5 to 6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, with no pink in the centre. Let it rest for a few minutes before slicing thinly. Chop the red and yellow peppers, cucumber, and red onion into bite-sized pieces, and halve the cherry tomatoes. Whisk together the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, finely grated garlic, the remaining olive oil, and the rest of the salt to make a light dressing. In a large bowl, combine the pasta, spinach, vegetables, olives, and sliced chicken, then pour over the dressing and toss gently until evenly coated. Crumble the feta over the top and serve at room temperature or chilled.

title: Mediterranean Tuna and Chickpea Pasta Salad with Lemon Herb Dressing
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "160 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "240 g chickpeas, canned, drained", "120 g cherry tomatoes", "100 g cucumber", "80 g red bell pepper", "60 g red onion", "50 g spinach, raw", "30 g black olives, pitted", "25 g feta cheese", "15 ml olive oil", "20 ml lemon juice", "1 g garlic, fresh", "2 g dried oregano", "2 g fresh parsley", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the wholewheat pasta until just tender, usually 9 to 11 minutes. Drain it well and rinse briefly under cold water so it stops cooking and cools quickly. While the pasta cooks, chop the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, and red onion into small bite-sized pieces. In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano, and black pepper until combined. Add the cooled pasta, chickpeas, tuna, vegetables, spinach, olives, and parsley to the bowl. Toss gently until everything is evenly coated, then fold in the feta last so it stays in small pieces. Let the salad rest for 10 minutes before serving so the flavours can blend.

title: Vegetable and Lentil Wholemeal Pasties with Thyme
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal flour", "75 g plain flour", "125 g low-fat butter", "120 ml water", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, medium", "2 pieces carrot, medium", "150 g swede", "120 g potato", "150 g cooked green lentils, drained", "80 g frozen peas", "2 cloves garlic", "2 tsp fresh thyme leaves", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp salt", "1 tbsp tomato puree", "1 tsp dried rosemary", "20 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. First make the pastry by rubbing the butter into the flours until the mixture looks like fine breadcrumbs. Stir in half of the egg and add the water gradually until a soft dough forms, then chill it for 20 minutes. While the dough chills, heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until softened. Add the carrot, swede and potato, then cook for another 8 minutes, stirring often. Mix in the garlic, lentils, peas, thyme, rosemary, tomato puree, salt and black pepper, and cook for 2 minutes until the filling is well combined and lightly thickened. Roll out the pastry and cut it into 4 equal circles. Spoon the filling onto one half of each circle, sprinkle over the reduced-fat cheddar, then fold over and crimp the edges firmly. Place the pasties on the tray, brush with the remaining egg, and bake for 30 to 35 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Let them rest for 5 minutes before serving so the filling settles.

title: Wholemeal Chicken, Sweet Potato and Spinach Pasties
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "125 g plain wheat flour", "150 g unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "120 ml cold water", "300 g chicken breast, skinless", "250 g sweet potato, raw", "120 g carrot", "80 g onion", "100 g spinach, fresh", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp garlic, minced", "1 tsp thyme, dried", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "1 tsp salt, table", "1 piece egg, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Make the pastry by rubbing the butter into both flours until the mixture looks like fine crumbs, then stir in the egg and cold water until a firm dough forms. Wrap and chill the dough while you prepare the filling. Dice the chicken into small pieces and cut the sweet potato and carrot into very small cubes so they cook through evenly. Warm the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, then add the onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic, chicken, sweet potato and carrot, then cook for about 8 minutes, stirring often, until the chicken is no longer pink and the vegetables start to soften. Stir in the spinach, thyme, pepper and salt, and cook for 1 more minute until the spinach has wilted and any excess moisture has evaporated. Remove the pan from the heat and let the filling cool slightly. Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface and cut into 6 equal rounds. Divide the filling between the rounds, fold each one over and seal the edges firmly with your fingers or a fork. Place the pasties on the tray, brush the tops with the second egg beaten with a little water, and cut a small steam slit in each one. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown and crisp all over. Rest for 5 minutes before serving so the filling settles.

title: Wholemeal Chicken, Sweet Potato and Spinach Pasties
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal plain flour", "125 g cold unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 ml cold water", "300 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "250 g sweet potato, raw", "100 g onion, raw", "80 g carrot, raw", "100 g spinach, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 g black pepper", "4 g salt", "1 piece egg, raw", "15 ml milk, semi-skimmed"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Wrap it and chill for 20 minutes. Dice the chicken into small pieces, then heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes until starting to soften, then add the chicken, sweet potato, cumin, paprika, thyme, pepper and salt. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until the chicken is just cooked through and the sweet potato is beginning to soften. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1 minute until wilted, then remove from the heat and let the filling cool slightly. Divide the pastry into 4 pieces and roll each piece into a circle. Spoon the filling onto one half of each circle, fold over to make pasties, and seal the edges firmly. Place them on the tray, brush with the egg beaten with milk, and cut a small steam hole on top of each one. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown and crisp, then rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Herbed Chicken, Sweet Potato and Spinach Pasties
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholemeal wheat flour", "150 g plain white flour", "150 g low-fat butter", "120 ml cold water", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "1 g salt", "250 g chicken breast, raw", "200 g sweet potato, raw", "80 g onion, raw", "100 g spinach, raw", "80 g carrot, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "2 g garlic, raw", "2 g dried thyme", "1 g black pepper", "30 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "15 ml milk, semi-skimmed"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Cut the chicken breast into very small dice and cook it in a pan over medium-high heat with the olive oil for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring until it is just opaque. Add the onion, carrot, sweet potato and garlic, then reduce the heat to medium and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the spinach, thyme, black pepper and a small amount of salt, then cook for 1 minute until the spinach wilts. Remove from the heat and mix in the reduced-fat cheddar, then leave the filling to cool slightly. To make the pastry, rub the butter into the flours and salt until the mixture looks like fine breadcrumbs. Beat the egg with the cold water, add it gradually, and mix just until a dough forms. Wrap and chill the dough for 10 minutes if it feels sticky. Roll the pastry out on a lightly floured surface and cut into 4 equal circles. Divide the filling between them, brush the edges with a little beaten egg, fold into pasties, and crimp the edges firmly to seal. Place the pasties on the tray, brush the tops with the egg yolk mixed with milk, and bake for 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Let them rest for 5 minutes before serving so the filling settles.

title: Wholemeal Chicken, Lentil and Vegetable Pasties with Thyme
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "75 g plain white flour", "125 g unsalted butter", "120 ml cold water", "1 piece egg, raw", "250 g chicken breast, without skin", "120 g cooked green lentils", "100 g onion, raw", "80 g carrot, raw", "80 g swede, raw", "80 g leek, raw", "60 g frozen peas", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "2 g dried thyme", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g iodised salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Place the wholemeal flour, white flour and a small pinch of the salt in a bowl, then rub in the cold butter until the mixture looks like fine breadcrumbs. Mix in about 90 ml of the cold water to form a firm dough, adding the rest only if needed, then wrap and chill for 20 minutes. Dice the chicken into small pieces. Heat the rapeseed oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly coloured. Add the onion, carrot, swede and leek, then cook over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the lentils, peas, thyme, black pepper and remaining salt, then cook for 2 minutes more. Remove from the heat and let the filling cool slightly. Divide the dough into 4 pieces and roll each piece into a round about 3 mm thick. Spoon the filling onto one half of each round, leaving a border around the edge, then brush the edge with beaten egg and fold over to seal. Crimp the edges firmly and place the pasties on the tray. Brush the tops with the remaining beaten egg and cut a small steam slit in each one. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is piping hot. Leave to rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Buckwheat Pierogies with Potato, Spinach and Cottage Cheese
ingredients_json: ["250 g buckwheat flour", "150 g plain wheat flour", "1 piece egg, raw", "180 ml water", "10 g rapeseed oil", "3 g salt", "400 g potatoes, boiled", "200 g cottage cheese, low fat", "100 g spinach, fresh", "80 g onion, raw", "10 g garlic, raw", "15 g butter", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "30 g dill, fresh", "1 g black pepper, ground", "20 g rapeseed oil"]
instructions: Combine the buckwheat flour, wheat flour, egg, water, rapeseed oil and salt in a large bowl and knead for 5 to 7 minutes until you have a smooth, elastic dough. Cover it and let it rest for 20 minutes so it becomes easier to roll. Meanwhile, mash the boiled potatoes and mix them with the cottage cheese. Finely chop the onion, garlic and spinach. Warm the butter in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 to 5 minutes until soft and lightly golden, then add the garlic and spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until the spinach wilts. Stir the vegetables into the potato mixture and season with black pepper and half of the dill. Roll the dough thin on a lightly floured surface, cut out circles, place a spoonful of filling in the centre of each, fold and seal the edges firmly. Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle boil and cook the pierogies in batches for 3 to 4 minutes, until they float and the dough is tender. For a lighter finish, toss the drained pierogies with the remaining rapeseed oil and serve with Greek yogurt and the rest of the dill.

title: Whole Wheat Potato Pierogies with Spinach, Cottage Cheese and Caramelized Onion
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat flour", "1 piece egg, raw", "120 ml water", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "3 g salt", "300 g potatoes, boiled, without skin", "150 g cottage cheese, low fat", "80 g spinach, raw", "120 g onion, raw", "10 g butter", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g nutmeg, ground", "120 g plain yogurt, low fat"]
instructions: Mash the boiled potatoes until smooth and let them cool slightly. Finely chop the spinach and onion. Heat the butter in a skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for about 8 to 10 minutes until soft and lightly golden, then stir in the spinach and cook for 1 minute until wilted. Mix the potato, cottage cheese, half of the onion mixture, black pepper and nutmeg into a filling and set aside. In a bowl, combine the flour, egg, water, rapeseed oil and salt, then knead for about 5 minutes until you have a smooth dough. Cover and rest it for 20 minutes. Roll the dough thin on a lightly floured surface and cut out circles about 8 cm wide. Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each circle, fold over into a half-moon shape and pinch the edges firmly to seal. Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle boil and cook the pierogies in batches for 3 to 4 minutes, until they float and the dough feels tender. Serve warm topped with the remaining onion mixture and a spoonful of yogurt.

title: Whole Wheat Pierogies with Potato, Cottage Cheese and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["250 g Whole wheat flour", "80 g Plain yogurt, low fat", "1 piece Egg, raw", "60 ml Water", "2 g Salt", "300 g Potatoes, boiled", "100 g Cottage cheese, low fat", "120 g Spinach, raw", "60 g Onion, raw", "10 ml Olive oil", "2 g Garlic, raw", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "1 g Nutmeg, ground", "30 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat"]
instructions: To make the dough, mix the whole wheat flour and salt in a bowl, then add the egg, yogurt, and water. Stir until a rough dough forms, then knead for about 5 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and let it rest for 20 minutes so it rolls out more easily. Meanwhile, cook the filling by warming the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft and lightly golden, then add the garlic and spinach and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the spinach has wilted and most of the moisture has evaporated. Mash the boiled potatoes with the cottage cheese, spinach mixture, black pepper, and nutmeg until well combined. Roll the dough thin on a lightly floured surface and cut into circles. Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each circle, fold over, and seal the edges firmly. Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle boil and cook the pierogies in batches for 3 to 4 minutes, until they float and the dough is tender. For extra flavour, briefly pan-fry the cooked pierogies in a nonstick pan over medium heat until lightly golden on both sides. Serve warm with the Greek yogurt on top.

title: Whole-Wheat Potato and Spinach Pierogies with Yogurt-Dill Sauce
ingredients_json: ["300 g whole wheat flour", "150 g all-purpose flour", "2 piece egg, raw", "180 ml water", "5 g salt", "20 ml rapeseed oil", "500 g potato, boiled", "150 g onion, raw", "200 g spinach, cooked, drained", "120 g cottage cheese, low fat", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g nutmeg, ground", "30 g butter, unsalted", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 g dill, fresh", "10 ml lemon juice"]
