Knead for about 5 minutes until smooth, then cover and rest for 20 minutes. While the dough rests, mash the boiled potatoes with the cottage cheese, cooked spinach, black pepper, and nutmeg. Finely dice the onion and cook it in the butter over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes until soft and lightly golden, then stir it into the filling and let it cool slightly. Roll the dough out thinly on a lightly floured surface, cut into circles, and place a spoonful of filling in the center of each circle. Fold the dough over the filling, press the edges firmly to seal, and crimp them well. Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle boil and cook the pierogies in batches for 3 to 4 minutes, until they float and the dough looks tender. For extra flavor, warm them briefly in a dry nonstick pan over medium heat until lightly browned on the bottom. Stir the yogurt with chopped dill and lemon juice, then serve the pierogies hot with the yogurt-dill sauce spooned over the top.

title: Whole Wheat Pierogies with Potato, Cottage Cheese and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat flour", "1 piece egg, raw", "120 ml water", "10 ml olive oil", "3 g salt", "400 g potato, boiled", "150 g cottage cheese, low fat", "120 g spinach, raw", "80 g onion, raw", "15 g butter", "2 g black pepper, ground", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "20 g chives, fresh"]
instructions: Mash the boiled potatoes until smooth and let them cool slightly. Finely chop the onion and sauté it in the butter over medium heat for about 5 minutes until soft and lightly golden, then stir in the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted. Mix the potatoes with the cottage cheese, onion, spinach, black pepper, chopped chives, and half of the salt. For the dough, combine the whole wheat flour, remaining salt, egg, water, and olive oil, then knead for 5 to 7 minutes until elastic. Cover the dough and rest it for 20 minutes. Roll the dough thinly on a lightly floured surface and cut out circles about 8 cm wide. Place about 1 tablespoon of filling in the center of each circle, fold into half-moons, and press the edges firmly to seal. Bring a large pot of salted water to a gentle boil and cook the pierogies in batches for 3 to 4 minutes, until they float and the dough is tender. Serve warm with the Greek yogurt and extra chives.

title: Wholewheat Veggie Pizza with Mozzarella, Spinach and Roasted Peppers
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat flour", "7 g dry yeast", "160 ml warm water", "10 ml olive oil", "3 g salt", "120 g tomato passata", "1 clove garlic", "1 tsp dried oregano", "150 g part-skim mozzarella cheese", "80 g cherry tomatoes", "80 g red bell pepper", "60 g red onion", "50 g baby spinach", "40 g mushrooms", "20 g black olives", "5 ml olive oil", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Mix the wholewheat flour, yeast and salt in a bowl. Add the warm water and olive oil, then stir until a rough dough forms. Knead for 8 to 10 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover and leave in a warm place for about 45 minutes, or until doubled in size. Preheat the oven to 230 C and place a baking tray inside to heat up. Mash the garlic into the tomato passata and stir in the oregano. Roll the dough out on a lightly floured surface into a thin round and transfer it to baking paper. Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the base, leaving a small border. Scatter over the mozzarella, cherry tomatoes, bell pepper, red onion, spinach, mushrooms and olives, then drizzle with the remaining olive oil and season with black pepper. Slide the pizza onto the hot tray and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling and lightly browned at the edges. Let it rest for 2 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Whole Wheat Veggie Pizza with Tomato, Spinach and Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat flour", "7 g dry yeast", "5 g salt", "5 g sugar", "180 ml warm water", "15 ml olive oil", "120 g tomato passata", "1 g dried oregano", "1 g garlic powder", "100 g mozzarella cheese, reduced fat", "80 g mushrooms", "60 g red bell pepper", "50 g red onion", "40 g baby spinach", "30 g black olives", "10 g grated Parmesan cheese", "5 ml olive oil"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 240°C and place a baking tray or pizza stone inside to heat up. Mix the whole wheat flour, dry yeast, salt and sugar in a bowl, then add the warm water and olive oil. Stir until a rough dough forms, then knead for about 8 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 45 minutes, or until it has roughly doubled in size. Roll the dough out on a lightly floured surface into a thin round base and place it on baking paper. Spread the tomato passata over the base, leaving a small border around the edge, then sprinkle with oregano and garlic powder. Top with mozzarella, mushrooms, red bell pepper, red onion, spinach and black olives, then finish with Parmesan and a small drizzle of olive oil. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the crust is golden and crisp and the cheese is bubbling. Let the pizza rest for 2 minutes before slicing into four portions.

title: Whole Wheat Chicken and Vegetable Pizza with Tomato and Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat flour", "7 g dry yeast", "1 tsp salt", "1 tsp sugar", "150 ml lukewarm water", "1 tbsp olive oil", "150 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tsp olive oil", "1 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "80 g tomato passata", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 clove garlic", "125 g mozzarella cheese, low fat", "80 g red bell pepper", "60 g red onion", "80 g zucchini", "50 g cherry tomatoes", "20 g fresh spinach", "10 g basil leaves"]
instructions: Mix the whole wheat flour, yeast, salt, and sugar in a large bowl. Add the lukewarm water and olive oil, then knead for about 8 minutes until the dough is smooth and elastic. Cover it and leave it in a warm place for 45 minutes, or until doubled in size. While the dough rises, heat the oven to 220 C. Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and season it with the salt and black pepper. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until just cooked through and lightly browned. Slice the pepper, onion, and zucchini thinly. Mix the tomato passata with the grated garlic and dried oregano. Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface and place it on a baking tray or pizza stone. Spread the tomato sauce over the base, then scatter the spinach, vegetables, chicken, cherry tomatoes, and torn mozzarella evenly on top. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling and starting to brown at the edges. Finish with fresh basil and let the pizza rest for 2 minutes before slicing.

title: Whole Wheat Vegetable Pizza with Tomato, Spinach and Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat flour", "7 g dry yeast", "160 ml warm water", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp salt", "1 tsp honey", "120 g tomato passata", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 clove garlic", "100 g low-fat mozzarella", "80 g cherry tomatoes", "60 g red bell pepper", "50 g red onion", "50 g fresh spinach", "40 g mushrooms", "10 g fresh basil"]
instructions: Mix the warm water, yeast, and honey in a bowl and let it stand for 5 minutes until foamy. Add the whole wheat flour, salt, and olive oil, then knead for 8 to 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover the dough and leave it in a warm place for about 45 minutes, until doubled in size. Heat the oven to 240 C and place a baking tray inside to preheat. Stir the tomato passata with the oregano and finely grated garlic. Roll the dough out on a lightly floured surface into a thin round and transfer it to baking paper. Spread the tomato sauce over the base, then top with sliced mozzarella, cherry tomatoes, bell pepper, red onion, spinach, and mushrooms. Bake on the hot tray for 12 to 15 minutes, until the crust is crisp and browned at the edges and the cheese has melted. Finish with fresh basil, let it rest for 2 minutes, then slice and serve.

title: Whole Wheat Chicken and Vegetable Pizza with Tomato and Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat pizza flour", "7 g dry yeast", "150 ml water", "10 g olive oil", "3 g salt", "200 g chicken breast, raw", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tbsp olive oil", "120 g tomato passata", "2 g dried oregano", "1 g garlic powder", "80 g mozzarella cheese, reduced fat", "60 g red onion", "80 g bell pepper, red", "100 g zucchini", "40 g baby spinach", "20 g black olives"]
instructions: Mix the whole wheat flour, dry yeast, salt, water, and 10 g olive oil in a bowl until a soft dough forms. Knead for about 8 minutes until smooth and elastic, then cover and let it rise in a warm place for 45 minutes, or until it has visibly puffed up. While the dough rises, cut the chicken breast into thin strips and season it with smoked paprika. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and cooked through. Set it aside. Preheat the oven to 230 C and place a baking tray or pizza stone inside to heat up. Roll the dough out on a lightly floured surface into a thin round base and transfer it to baking paper. Spread the tomato passata over the surface, leaving a small border clear at the edges, then sprinkle with oregano and garlic powder. Top with the cooked chicken, mozzarella, sliced red onion, bell pepper strips, thin zucchini slices, baby spinach, and black olives. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the crust is crisp and the cheese is melted and lightly browned. Let the pizza rest for 2 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Creamy Polenta with Garlic Mushrooms, Spinach and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["180 g Polenta, dry", "900 ml Water", "250 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp Salt, table", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "300 g Mushrooms, button, raw", "150 g Spinach, raw", "80 g Onion, raw", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "15 g Butter, unsalted", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, raw"]
instructions: Bring the water, milk, and salt to a gentle boil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in the polenta in a steady stream, then reduce the heat to low and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick, creamy, and smooth. If it becomes too stiff, add a splash of hot water or milk and keep stirring. While the polenta cooks, warm the olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and mushrooms and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the mushrooms have released their moisture and started to brown. Add the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until just wilted, then stir in the lemon juice and black pepper. Remove the polenta from the heat and mix in the Parmesan. Spoon the creamy polenta into warm bowls and top with the mushroom and spinach mixture. Serve immediately while hot and silky.

title: Creamy Polenta with Mushroom, Spinach and Tomato Ragout
ingredients_json: ["180 g polenta, dry", "900 ml water", "250 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "10 g salt, table", "20 g olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g mushrooms, cultivated, raw", "200 g courgette, raw", "400 g tomatoes, chopped, canned", "100 g spinach, raw", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "5 g dried oregano", "2 g black pepper, ground", "40 g parmesan cheese", "15 g butter"]
instructions: Bring the water, milk and salt to a gentle boil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Whisk in the polenta in a thin stream, then reduce the heat to low and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick, smooth and creamy. If it becomes too stiff, loosen it with a splash of hot water. Meanwhile, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until soft and lightly golden, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Stir in the mushrooms and courgette and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until they start to brown and release their moisture. Add the tomato paste, canned tomatoes, oregano and black pepper, then simmer for 8 to 10 minutes until the sauce is slightly reduced and glossy. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until just wilted. Remove the polenta from the heat and stir in the butter and parmesan until creamy. Spoon the polenta into warm bowls and top with the vegetable ragout. Serve immediately while hot.

title: Creamy Parmesan Polenta with Mushroom and Spinach Ragout
ingredients_json: ["180 g polenta, dry", "900 ml water", "300 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp salt", "20 g butter", "40 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g mushrooms, button, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "200 g spinach, raw", "400 g tomatoes, canned, chopped", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp dried thyme", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the water, milk, and salt in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat until just below a boil. Reduce the heat to low and slowly whisk in the polenta in a steady stream. Cook for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring often, until thick, creamy, and the grains are tender. Stir in the butter and Parmesan, then cover and keep warm on the lowest heat. While the polenta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the mushrooms and red bell pepper and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until the mushrooms release their liquid and begin to brown. Stir in the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, thyme, and black pepper, then simmer for 8 to 10 minutes until slightly reduced. Add the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted and bright green. Spoon the creamy polenta into bowls and top with the vegetable ragout. Serve immediately while hot.

title: Creamy Polenta with Mushroom, Spinach and White Bean Ragout
ingredients_json: ["180 g polenta, dry", "900 ml water", "250 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "8 g salt", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g mushrooms, button, raw", "200 g spinach, raw", "240 g beans, cannellini, cooked, drained", "200 g tomatoes, canned, chopped", "10 g tomato paste", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 g black pepper, ground", "20 g parmesan cheese", "10 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Bring the water, milk and salt to a gentle boil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Whisk in the polenta in a thin stream, then reduce the heat to low and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick, smooth and creamy. If it becomes too stiff, add a splash of hot water. While the polenta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Add the mushrooms and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until browned and their liquid has evaporated. Stir in the tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, thyme and black pepper, then simmer for 5 minutes. Add the cannellini beans and spinach and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the spinach has wilted and the beans are hot through. Stir in the lemon juice. Spoon the polenta into warm bowls, top with the mushroom and bean ragout, and finish with the parmesan cheese.

title: Creamy Polenta with Mushroom, Spinach and White Bean Ragout
ingredients_json: ["180 g polenta, dry", "900 ml water", "300 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "12 g olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g mushrooms, brown, raw", "1 piece carrot, raw", "200 g spinach, raw", "240 g cannellini beans, canned, drained", "400 g tomatoes, chopped, canned", "20 g parmesan cheese", "5 g salt", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g dried thyme"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and carrot and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic, mushrooms and thyme, then cook for another 6 to 8 minutes until the mushrooms release their moisture and begin to brown. Add the canned tomatoes and drained cannellini beans, then simmer gently for 10 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly. Meanwhile, bring the water and milk to a boil in a separate pot, whisk in the polenta slowly, and reduce the heat to low. Cook for about 10 to 15 minutes, stirring often, until the polenta is smooth and creamy. Stir the spinach into the bean and mushroom ragout and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Season with salt and black pepper. Spoon the polenta into warm bowls, top with the ragout, and finish with the parmesan cheese.

title: Garlic Herb Pork Chops with Roasted Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["600 g pork loin chops, boneless", "500 g potatoes, raw", "250 g green beans, fresh", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g garlic, fresh", "2 g dried rosemary", "2 g dried thyme", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "30 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C. Cut the potatoes into bite-sized wedges and toss them with half of the olive oil, half of the salt, half of the pepper, and half of the dried rosemary. Spread them on a baking tray and roast for 15 minutes. While the potatoes start cooking, pat the pork chops dry and rub them with the remaining olive oil, garlic, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper. After the potatoes have had their first roast, add the pork chops to the tray and return everything to the oven. Roast for 12 to 15 minutes more, turning the chops once halfway through, until the pork is cooked through and the juices run clear. Steam or boil the green beans for 4 to 5 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp. Finish the pork and beans with lemon juice, then serve the chops with the roasted potatoes and green beans immediately.

title: Garlic Herb Pork Chops with Roasted Sweet Potato and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["600 g Pork chop, lean, raw", "400 g Sweet potato, raw", "300 g Green beans, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "10 g Garlic, raw", "2 g Rosemary, fresh", "2 g Thyme, fresh", "3 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into even wedges, then trim the green beans. Place the sweet potato on a baking tray with 10 ml of the olive oil, half the salt, and half the pepper, and roast for 15 minutes. While that cooks, pat the pork chops dry and rub them with the remaining olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the pork chops for 2 to 3 minutes per side until nicely browned. Add the lemon juice to the pan, then transfer the chops to the oven tray and roast for 8 to 12 minutes, until the pork is cooked through and the juices run clear. Add the green beans to the tray for the last 8 minutes of cooking so they stay bright and tender-crisp. Rest the pork for 5 minutes before serving with the roasted vegetables and pan juices.

title: Garlic Herb Pork Chops with Roasted Sweet Potato and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["600 g Pork chop, lean, boneless, raw", "300 g Sweet potato, raw", "250 g Green beans, raw", "150 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "10 ml Lemon juice, raw", "2 g Dried thyme", "2 g Dried rosemary", "3 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "15 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Peel the sweet potato and cut it into bite-sized cubes, then slice the onion into wedges. Toss the sweet potato and onion with half of the olive oil, half of the salt, the thyme, and half of the pepper, then spread them on a baking tray. Roast for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, pat the pork chops dry and rub them with the remaining olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper. After the vegetables have started roasting, place the pork chops on a second tray or in a hot ovenproof pan and cook for about 12 to 15 minutes, depending on thickness, until the centre is just cooked through and the juices run clear. Add the green beans to the vegetable tray for the last 8 minutes so they stay bright and tender. Stir the lemon juice through the vegetables and sprinkle with chopped parsley before serving. Let the pork rest for 3 minutes before plating so it stays juicy.

title: Garlic Herb Pork Chops with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["4 piece Pork chop, lean, boneless", "500 g Sweet potato, raw", "250 g Green beans, raw", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, raw", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Dried rosemary", "1/2 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt, table", "10 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into 2 cm cubes. Slice the onion into wedges and trim the green beans. Toss the sweet potatoes and onion with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, half of the garlic, the thyme, rosemary, half of the salt, and a little black pepper. Spread them on a baking tray and roast for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, pat the pork chops dry and rub them with the remaining olive oil, Dijon mustard, lemon juice, remaining garlic, salt, and black pepper. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the pork chops for 2 to 3 minutes per side until nicely browned. Transfer the chops to the tray with the vegetables and roast for 8 to 10 minutes more, until the pork is cooked through and the juices run clear. Add the green beans to the tray for the last 6 to 8 minutes so they stay bright and tender. Let the pork rest for 5 minutes before serving, then finish with chopped parsley and serve everything together.

title: Garlic Herb Pork Chops with Roasted Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["600 g pork loin chops, boneless", "500 g potatoes, raw", "250 g green beans, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g garlic, raw", "5 g fresh rosemary", "5 g fresh thyme", "2 g black pepper", "4 g salt", "15 ml lemon juice", "100 ml low-sodium vegetable stock"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Cut the potatoes into bite-sized wedges and toss them with half of the olive oil, half of the salt, half of the pepper, and the chopped rosemary and thyme. Spread them on a baking tray and roast for 15 minutes. Pat the pork chops dry and season them with the remaining salt and pepper. Heat the remaining olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chops for 2 to 3 minutes per side until well browned. Add the garlic to the pan and cook for 30 seconds, then pour in the vegetable stock and lemon juice. Transfer the pork chops to the tray with the potatoes and roast for 8 to 10 minutes, until the pork reaches 63 C in the center and the potatoes are tender. During the last 5 minutes, add the green beans to the tray so they become bright green and just tender. Let the pork rest for 3 minutes before serving with the pan juices spooned over the top.

title: Sticky Ginger Pork Ribs with Roasted Broccoli and Brown Rice
ingredients_json: ["900 g Pork ribs, lean meat only", "200 g Brown rice, dry", "300 g Broccoli, raw", "150 g Carrot, raw", "1 piece Onion, raw, medium", "20 g Ginger root, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, reduced salt", "1 tbsp Honey", "1 tbsp Rice vinegar", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "300 ml Water", "1 tbsp Lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Put the pork ribs in a roasting dish. Finely grate the ginger and garlic, then mix them with the reduced-salt soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, smoked paprika, black pepper, lemon juice, and half of the olive oil. Coat the ribs well with this mixture and let them sit for 15 minutes while you prepare the vegetables. Rinse the brown rice and cook it in the water according to the package directions until tender. Cut the broccoli into florets, slice the carrot, and cut the onion into wedges. Toss the vegetables with the remaining olive oil and spread them on a baking tray. Roast the ribs and vegetables in the oven for about 40 to 45 minutes, turning the ribs once halfway through and stirring the vegetables so they brown evenly. The ribs are ready when the meat is cooked through and lightly caramelised at the edges, and the vegetables are tender with some golden spots. Serve the ribs over the brown rice with the roasted broccoli, carrot, and onion.

title: Honey-Garlic Oven-Baked Pork Ribs with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["900 g Pork ribs, lean, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "20 g Honey", "15 ml Soy sauce, reduced salt", "10 g Garlic, raw", "10 g Ginger, raw", "15 ml Apple cider vinegar", "10 g Dijon mustard", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Paprika, sweet", "4 g Salt, table", "300 g Carrot, raw", "250 g Broccoli, raw", "200 g Red onion, raw", "300 g Sweet potato, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Mix the olive oil, honey, reduced-salt soy sauce, finely grated garlic, finely grated ginger, apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, black pepper, paprika, and salt in a bowl to make a sticky glaze. Pat the pork ribs dry, rub them well with the glaze, and place them on the tray. Cover loosely with foil and bake for 70 minutes, turning once halfway through so the ribs cook evenly. Meanwhile, cut the carrots, broccoli, red onion, and sweet potato into bite-sized pieces and toss them lightly in a little of the remaining glaze or the tray juices. Remove the foil after 70 minutes, add the vegetables around the ribs, and bake uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes more at 190 C until the ribs are browned, the vegetables are tender, and the meat is pulling away from the bone. Let the ribs rest for 10 minutes before serving so the juices settle.

title: Honey-Garlic Pork Ribs with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["1200 g pork ribs, lean, raw", "20 ml olive oil", "30 ml honey", "25 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "15 ml apple cider vinegar", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "2 g ginger, fresh", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g smoked paprika", "6 g salt", "400 g carrots, raw", "300 g broccoli, raw", "300 g red onion, raw", "200 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "10 ml lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Mix the olive oil, honey, reduced-salt soy sauce, apple cider vinegar, finely grated garlic, grated ginger, black pepper, smoked paprika and salt in a bowl. Rub about two thirds of the glaze over the pork ribs and place them in a roasting dish. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 70 minutes. While the ribs cook, cut the carrots into thick batons, break the broccoli into florets, slice the red onion into wedges and halve the cherry tomatoes. Toss the vegetables with the remaining glaze and spread them in a second baking tray. After the first 70 minutes, remove the foil from the ribs, increase the oven to 200°C and add the vegetables to the oven. Roast everything for 25 to 30 minutes more, turning the vegetables once, until the ribs are browned at the edges, the meat is tender and the vegetables are caramelised but still bright. Finish with lemon juice before serving.

title: Ginger-Soy Pork Ribs with Roasted Sweet Potato and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["900 g Pork ribs, lean, raw", "300 g Sweet potato, raw", "250 g Broccoli, raw", "150 g Carrot, raw", "2 tbsp Rapeseed oil", "3 tbsp Soy sauce, reduced salt", "2 tbsp Tomato puree", "2 tbsp Honey", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 g Ginger, raw", "2 tbsp Lemon juice, raw", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Paprika powder", "1 tsp Onion powder", "1 tbsp Sesame seeds, dry"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Mix the reduced-salt soy sauce, tomato puree, honey, grated ginger, crushed garlic, lemon juice, black pepper, paprika, and onion powder in a large bowl. Coat the pork ribs well in the marinade and leave them to rest for 20 minutes while you prepare the vegetables. Cut the sweet potato and carrot into even chunks and toss them with 1 tablespoon of rapeseed oil. Spread them on a baking tray and roast for 20 minutes. Place the ribs on a second tray, or add them beside the vegetables if there is enough space, and roast for 35 to 45 minutes, turning once halfway through, until the meat is browned, tender, and cooked through. Steam or blanch the broccoli for 4 to 5 minutes so it stays bright green and just tender. Toss the broccoli with the remaining rapeseed oil and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Serve the ribs with the roasted sweet potato, carrot, and broccoli, spooning over any pan juices from the ribs.

title: Ginger-Soy Baked Pork Ribs with Roasted Sweet Potato and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["900 g pork ribs, lean, raw", "300 g sweet potato, raw", "300 g broccoli, raw", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tbsp honey", "2 tbsp apple cider vinegar", "2 tbsp olive oil", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "10 g fresh ginger root, raw", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground black pepper", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Line a large baking tray with parchment paper. Mix the soy sauce, tomato paste, honey, apple cider vinegar, olive oil, finely grated garlic, grated ginger, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt in a bowl to make a glossy marinade. Cut the pork ribs into manageable portions, coat them well with the marinade, and arrange them on the tray. Cover loosely with foil and bake for 45 minutes. Meanwhile, peel the sweet potato and cut it into bite-sized chunks, then cut the broccoli into florets. After 45 minutes, remove the foil, add the sweet potato to the tray with a small drizzle of oil, and continue baking for 20 minutes. Add the broccoli for the final 10 to 12 minutes so it stays bright green and just tender. The ribs are ready when they are browned, sticky, and cooked through, and the sweet potato is soft at the edges. Rest everything for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Slow-Braised Pork Shoulder with Apples, Carrots and Thyme
ingredients_json: ["900 g Pork shoulder, lean and trimmed", "15 ml Olive oil", "150 g Onion, raw", "200 g Carrot, raw", "150 g Celery, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Apple, raw, with skin", "200 ml Vegetable stock, reduced salt", "150 ml Water", "15 ml Dijon mustard", "5 g Thyme, fresh", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt, table", "250 g Potato, raw", "200 g Kale, raw", "10 ml Lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 C. Cut the pork shoulder into large chunks and pat it dry. Heat the olive oil in a heavy casserole over medium-high heat and brown the pork well on all sides, then transfer it to a plate. Lower the heat to medium and add the onion, carrot and celery, cooking for about 5 minutes until they begin to soften. Stir in the garlic and cook for 1 minute more. Add the apples, stock, water, Dijon mustard, thyme, black pepper and salt, then return the pork to the pot. Bring everything to a gentle simmer, cover with a lid and place in the oven for about 2 hours, until the pork is very tender. Add the potatoes for the last 35 minutes of cooking so they become soft without breaking apart. Stir in the kale for the final 10 minutes until wilted and bright green. Finish with lemon juice, taste the sauce, and serve hot with plenty of the braising vegetables and juices.

title: Braised Pork Shoulder with Apples, Carrots and Cabbage
ingredients_json: ["800 g pork shoulder, boneless", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "2 pieces onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic", "300 g carrot, raw", "250 g white cabbage, raw", "2 pieces apple, raw", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes", "250 ml vegetable stock", "2 tbsp wholegrain mustard", "5 g dried thyme", "2 g black pepper", "3 g salt", "10 ml apple cider vinegar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 C. Cut the pork shoulder into large chunks and season it with the salt and black pepper. Heat the rapeseed oil in a heavy ovenproof pot over medium-high heat, then brown the pork well on all sides, working in batches if needed. Lower the heat to medium, add the chopped onions and sliced garlic, and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened. Stir in the carrots, cabbage and thyme, then add the mustard, chopped tomatoes, stock and apple cider vinegar. Return the pork to the pot and bring everything to a gentle simmer. Cover with a lid and transfer to the oven for about 2 hours, until the pork is very tender and can be pulled apart easily. During the last 20 minutes, stir in the apple chunks so they soften without breaking down completely. Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving so the sauce settles.

title: Slow-Braised Pork Shoulder with Apples, Cabbage and Barley
ingredients_json: ["900 g Pork shoulder, lean and boneless", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 piece Onion, yellow, raw", "3 clove Garlic, raw", "250 g Carrot, raw", "300 g Cabbage, white, raw", "300 g Apple, raw, with skin", "150 g Pearl barley, dry", "500 ml Vegetable stock, low salt", "200 ml Water", "15 ml Apple cider vinegar", "10 g Dijon mustard", "2 g Thyme, fresh", "2 g Bay leaf, dried", "5 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "10 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°C. Cut the pork shoulder into large chunks and season it with half of the salt and the black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a heavy ovenproof pot over medium-high heat, then brown the pork well on all sides for 6 to 8 minutes. Remove the meat and lower the heat to medium. Add the onions and carrots and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they begin to soften. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Add the barley, cabbage, apples, stock, water, cider vinegar, mustard, thyme, bay leaf, and the remaining salt, then return the pork and any juices to the pot. Bring it to a gentle simmer, cover with a lid, and transfer to the oven. Braise for about 2 hours, stirring once halfway through, until the pork is tender and the barley is plump. If the mixture looks too dry near the end, add a small splash of water. Remove the bay leaf, taste, and finish with chopped parsley before serving.

title: Braised Pork Shoulder with Apple, Cabbage and Carrots
ingredients_json: ["800 g Pork shoulder, lean and fat, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "150 g Onion, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Apple, raw, with skin", "250 g Carrot, raw", "300 g White cabbage, raw", "200 g Canned chopped tomatoes", "250 ml Chicken stock, reduced salt", "15 ml Apple cider vinegar", "10 g Dijon mustard", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Paprika, sweet", "2 g Thyme, dried", "4 g Salt, table", "200 g Potatoes, boiled", "10 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 170°C. Cut the pork shoulder into large chunks and season it with the black pepper, paprika, thyme, and salt. Warm the olive oil in a heavy ovenproof pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork well on all sides for about 6 to 8 minutes, working in batches if needed. Lower the heat to medium, add the onion and cook for 4 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Stir in the tomatoes, stock, cider vinegar, and mustard, scraping up any browned bits from the base of the pot. Add the carrots, apple, and cabbage, then return the pork to the pot and bring everything to a gentle simmer. Cover with a lid and transfer to the oven for about 2 hours and 15 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the pork is very tender and the vegetables are soft. Serve the braise hot with the boiled potatoes and finish with chopped parsley.

title: Slow-Braised Pork Shoulder with Rosemary, Apples and Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["900 g Pork shoulder, boneless, lean and fat", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 pieces Onion, raw", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "300 g Carrot, raw", "250 g Parsnip, raw", "2 pieces Apple, with skin", "200 g Celery, stalk", "250 g Tomato, canned, chopped", "250 ml Vegetable stock, reduced salt", "2 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "2 tsp Rosemary, dried", "1 tsp Thyme, dried", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt, table", "200 g Brown rice, cooked"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 160 C. Cut the pork shoulder into large chunks and season it with the salt, black pepper, rosemary and thyme. Warm the olive oil in a heavy casserole over medium-high heat and brown the pork well on all sides for about 6 to 8 minutes. Transfer the pork to a plate. Lower the heat to medium and add the onion, garlic, carrot, parsnip and celery. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables start to soften and the onion looks translucent. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock, lemon juice and apples, then return the pork to the pan. Cover with a lid and braise in the oven for about 2 hours and 15 minutes, until the pork is very tender and pulls apart easily with a fork. If the sauce looks too thin, uncover for the last 15 minutes to let it reduce slightly. Serve the braised pork and vegetables over the cooked brown rice with plenty of the pan juices spooned over the top.

title: Garlic Herb Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["600 g pork tenderloin, raw", "400 g sweet potatoes, raw", "250 g green beans, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "3 cloves garlic, fresh", "2 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 tsp dried rosemary", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp paprika, sweet", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tbsp lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into even 2 cm cubes, then trim the green beans. Pat the pork tenderloin dry and rub it with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, the Dijon mustard, minced garlic, rosemary, thyme, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Place the sweet potatoes on a baking tray with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and toss well. Roast for 15 minutes. Add the pork tenderloin to the tray or place it on a second tray and roast for another 18 to 22 minutes, until the pork is lightly browned and reaches an internal temperature of 63 C. Add the green beans for the last 10 minutes so they stay bright and tender-crisp. Remove the pork from the oven, cover loosely with foil, and rest for 5 to 8 minutes before slicing. Finish with lemon juice and serve the sliced pork with the roasted sweet potatoes and green beans.

title: Garlic Rosemary Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Vegetables and Apple Cider Pan Sauce
ingredients_json: ["600 g Pork tenderloin, raw", "500 g Potatoes, raw", "250 g Carrots, raw", "200 g Broccoli, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 tsp Rosemary, fresh", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt, table", "150 ml Apple juice, unsweetened", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 piece Onion, raw, medium"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Pat the pork tenderloin dry and rub it with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, the garlic, rosemary, black pepper, and half of the salt. Cut the potatoes, carrots, and onion into even chunks, then toss them with the remaining olive oil and salt on a large roasting tray. Roast the vegetables for 15 minutes. Add the pork tenderloin to the tray, nestling it among the vegetables, and roast for another 18 to 22 minutes until the pork reaches 63 C in the centre and the vegetables are tender and lightly browned. Add the broccoli for the last 8 minutes of cooking so it stays bright and just tender. Transfer the pork to a board and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes. Meanwhile, place the tray on the hob over medium heat, pour in the apple juice, Dijon mustard, and lemon juice, and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes, scraping up the browned bits until the sauce slightly thickens. Slice the pork and serve it with the roasted vegetables and the pan sauce spooned over the top.

title: Herb-Roasted Pork Tenderloin with Lemon Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["500 g Pork tenderloin, raw", "300 g Potatoes, with skin, raw", "200 g Green beans, raw", "150 g Carrot, raw", "1 piece Onion, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "10 g Fresh rosemary", "5 g Fresh thyme", "30 ml Lemon juice, raw", "5 g Salt, table", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Pat the pork tenderloin dry and rub it with half of the olive oil, the minced garlic, chopped rosemary, thyme, black pepper, and a little salt. Cut the potatoes and carrots into even pieces and toss them with the remaining oil and salt. Spread the vegetables in a roasting tin and place the pork on top or alongside them. Roast for about 25 to 30 minutes, turning the pork once halfway through, until the meat is lightly browned and the internal temperature reaches 63 C in the thickest part. Add the green beans for the last 10 minutes so they stay bright and tender-crisp. Rest the pork for 5 to 10 minutes before slicing, then finish with lemon juice over the meat and vegetables. Serve the tenderloin with the roasted potatoes, carrots, and green beans while warm.

title: Honey-Garlic Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["600 g Pork tenderloin, lean, raw", "400 g Sweet potato, raw", "250 g Green beans, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 tbsp Honey", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tbsp Soy sauce, reduced salt", "1 tbsp Dijon mustard", "1 tsp Paprika, sweet", "1 tsp Dried thyme", "1 tsp Salt, table", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 piece Lemon, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Line a baking tray with baking paper. Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into bite-size cubes, then toss them with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, half the salt, and half the black pepper. Spread them on the tray and roast for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, trim the pork tenderloin and pat it dry. Mix the honey, garlic, soy sauce, Dijon mustard, paprika, thyme, remaining olive oil, remaining salt, and remaining black pepper in a bowl, then coat the pork evenly. After the sweet potatoes have roasted for 15 minutes, push them to one side of the tray and add the pork to the other side. Roast for 18 to 22 minutes, turning the pork once halfway through, until the meat is lightly browned and the centre reaches 63 C. Add the green beans to the tray for the last 8 minutes so they stay bright and tender. Rest the pork for 5 minutes before slicing. Serve the sliced pork with the roasted sweet potatoes and green beans, and finish with a squeeze of lemon juice over the vegetables.

title: Lemon Garlic Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["600 g Pork tenderloin, raw", "500 g Sweet potato, raw", "300 g Green beans, raw", "150 g Red onion, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "30 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "2 g Lemon zest", "5 g Dijon mustard", "2 g Dried thyme", "3 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into 2 cm cubes. Slice the red onion into wedges and trim the green beans. Place the sweet potatoes and onion on a baking tray with 10 ml of the olive oil, half the salt, half the black pepper, and the dried thyme, then toss well and spread into an even layer. Roast for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, pat the pork tenderloin dry and mix the remaining olive oil with the garlic, lemon juice, lemon zest, Dijon mustard, and the remaining salt and pepper. Rub this mixture all over the pork. After the vegetables have roasted for 15 minutes, push them to one side of the tray and add the pork tenderloin. Roast for 18 to 22 minutes, turning the pork once halfway through, until the thickest part reaches 63 C and the juices run clear. Add the green beans to the tray for the last 8 minutes so they stay bright and tender-crisp. Remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes before slicing. Serve the sliced pork with the roasted vegetables and spoon over any pan juices.

title: Chicken, Leek and Vegetable Pot Pies with Wholegrain Topping
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, skinless, raw", "150 g Leek, raw", "120 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Celery, raw", "120 g Frozen peas", "200 g Button mushrooms, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "20 g Wholemeal flour", "300 ml Chicken stock, reduced salt", "100 ml Semi-skimmed milk", "5 g Dijon mustard", "2 g Thyme, fresh", "3 g Salt", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "250 g Wholemeal puff pastry, raw", "1 piece Egg, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and place four medium ramekins or a small baking dish on a tray. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season lightly with the salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly golden on the outside but not fully cooked through. Add the sliced leek, diced carrot, chopped celery, and sliced mushrooms, and cook over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften. Sprinkle in the wholemeal flour and stir for 1 minute so it coats the mixture. Gradually pour in the chicken stock and milk, stirring constantly until the sauce thickens and becomes smooth. Stir in the peas, Dijon mustard, and thyme, then simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Divide the filling between the ramekins. Roll out the wholemeal puff pastry and cut lids large enough to cover the pies, then place on top and press the edges to seal. Brush the pastry with beaten egg and cut a small steam slit in each top. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the pastry is risen and deep golden and the filling is bubbling at the edges. Let the pies rest for 5 minutes before serving so the sauce settles.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Pot Pies with Wholegrain Herb Crust
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, raw, skinless", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 pieces Carrot, raw", "2 sticks Celery, raw", "150 g Mushrooms, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 tbsp Wholemeal flour", "250 ml Chicken stock, reduced salt", "150 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "100 g Frozen peas", "1 tsp Thyme, dried", "1 tsp Parsley, dried", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt", "200 g Wholemeal shortcrust pastry", "1 piece Egg, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and place a baking tray inside to heat. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and chop the onion, carrots, celery, mushrooms, and garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, then cook the onion, carrot, and celery for 6 to 8 minutes until they begin to soften. Add the garlic and mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes more, stirring often. Add the chicken and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until it loses its pink colour on the outside. Stir in the wholemeal flour and cook for 1 minute so it no longer looks dry. Gradually pour in the chicken stock and milk, stirring continuously until the sauce thickens and becomes glossy. Add the peas, thyme, parsley, black pepper, and salt, then simmer gently for 3 minutes. Divide the filling between 4 individual ovenproof pie dishes or ramekins. Roll out the pastry and cut lids large enough to cover the dishes, then place them on top and press the edges to seal. Brush the tops with beaten egg and cut a small slit in the centre of each lid to let steam escape. Bake on the hot tray for 22 to 25 minutes until the pastry is deep golden and the filling is bubbling at the edges. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Wholegrain Pot Pies
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "10 ml olive oil", "80 g onion, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "100 g celery stalk, raw", "150 g mushrooms, raw", "150 g frozen peas", "15 g plain flour, wholemeal", "350 ml chicken stock, reduced salt", "60 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "5 g Dijon mustard", "2 g dried thyme", "2 g black pepper", "4 g salt", "200 g wholemeal puff pastry", "1 piece egg, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and place a baking tray inside to heat. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned. Add the onion, carrot, celery, and mushrooms, then cook over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes until the vegetables start to soften. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then gradually pour in the chicken stock and milk while stirring until the sauce is smooth. Add the mustard, thyme, black pepper, salt, and peas, then simmer for 5 minutes until the filling thickens and the chicken is cooked through. Divide the filling between 4 small ovenproof pie dishes or ramekins. Roll out the pastry and cut lids large enough to cover the tops, then place them over the filling and press the edges to seal. Brush the pastry with beaten egg and cut a small slit in each lid for steam to escape. Set the pies on the hot baking tray and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until the pastry is golden brown and crisp and the filling is bubbling. Let the pies rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken, Leek and Vegetable Pot Pies with Wholemeal Pastry
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, without skin", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 medium Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 medium Carrot, raw", "2 stalks Celery, raw", "1 medium Leek, raw", "150 g Mushrooms, button, raw", "200 g Frozen peas", "30 g Wholemeal flour, wheat", "300 ml Chicken stock, reduced salt", "150 ml Milk, semi-skimmed, 1.5% fat", "1 tbsp Parsley, fresh", "1 tsp Thyme, dried", "1 tsp Dijon mustard", "1 sheet Puff pastry, wholemeal", "1 piece Egg, raw", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, then brown the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly golden. Remove the chicken and set it aside. Add the onion, garlic, carrot, celery, leek, and mushrooms to the pan and cook over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables soften and the mushrooms release their moisture. Sprinkle over the wholemeal flour and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the chicken stock and milk gradually so the sauce stays smooth. Add the thyme, Dijon mustard, black pepper, and parsley, then return the chicken to the pan along with the peas. Simmer gently for 5 to 7 minutes until the sauce thickens and the chicken is cooked through. Divide the filling among 4 ovenproof dishes. Cut the pastry into 4 pieces, place one piece over each dish, and press the edges lightly to seal. Brush the pastry with beaten egg and cut a small steam slit in the top of each pie. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes until the pastry is crisp and deep golden brown and the filling is bubbling at the edges. Leave to stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken, Leek and Mushroom Wholemeal Pot Pie
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, raw, skinless", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 medium Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Leek, raw", "150 g Mushrooms, raw", "120 g Carrots, raw", "100 g Celery, raw", "30 g Wholemeal flour", "300 ml Chicken stock, reduced salt", "150 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "10 g Dijon mustard", "5 g Fresh thyme", "2 g Black pepper", "3 g Salt", "250 g Wholemeal puff pastry, chilled", "1 piece Egg, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and place a baking tray inside to heat. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned. Add the onion, garlic, leek, mushrooms, carrots, and celery, then cook over medium heat for 8 minutes until the vegetables soften. Stir in the wholemeal flour and cook for 1 minute so it loses its raw taste. Slowly pour in the chicken stock and milk while stirring, then add the mustard, thyme, black pepper, and salt. Simmer gently for 5 to 7 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the chicken and vegetables. Spoon the filling into a medium pie dish. Roll out the pastry and lay it over the top, trimming the edges and pressing them down to seal. Cut a small slit in the centre and brush the top with beaten egg. Bake on the hot tray for 25 to 30 minutes until the pastry is risen and deep golden brown and the filling is bubbling. Let the pie rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Slow-Braised Lean Beef Pot Roast with Root Vegetables and Herbs
ingredients_json: ["800 g beef chuck roast, trimmed", "15 ml olive oil", "150 g onion, yellow, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "120 g celery, raw", "400 g potato, with skin, raw", "200 g parsnip, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "30 g tomato paste", "500 ml beef broth, reduced sodium", "250 ml water", "2 g thyme, dried", "2 g rosemary, dried", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt, table", "2 g bay leaf, dried", "15 g flour, wheat, all-purpose"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 C. Pat the beef dry and season it with half of the salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a heavy oven-safe pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef well on all sides, about 8 minutes total. Remove the beef and lower the heat to medium. Add the onion, carrot, and celery and cook for 5 minutes until they begin to soften. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Sprinkle in the flour and stir for another minute so it coats the vegetables. Pour in the beef broth and water, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Add the thyme, rosemary, bay leaf, and the remaining salt and pepper. Return the beef to the pot, cover with a lid, and braise in the oven for 2 hours. Add the potato and parsnip around the beef, cover again, and cook for another 45 to 60 minutes, until the meat is very tender and the vegetables are cooked through. Let the pot roast rest for 10 minutes before slicing the beef and serving it with the vegetables and braising juices.

title: Herb-Braised Beef Pot Roast with Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["1200 g beef chuck roast", "15 ml olive oil", "150 g onion", "120 g carrot", "120 g celery", "20 g garlic", "30 g tomato paste", "500 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "250 ml water", "200 ml dry red wine", "500 g potato, raw, with skin", "250 g parsnip", "2 g bay leaf, dried", "2 g thyme, dried", "2 g rosemary, dried", "4 g black pepper, ground", "6 g salt", "15 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160°C. Pat the beef chuck roast dry and season it with the salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and brown the beef well on all sides, about 3 to 4 minutes per side. Remove the beef and lower the heat to medium. Add the onion, carrot, and celery, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until they start to soften and pick up color. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in the red wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot, then add the beef stock, water, bay leaf, thyme, and rosemary. Return the beef to the pot, cover with a lid, and bring it to a gentle simmer. Transfer to the oven and braise for about 2 hours. Add the potatoes and parsnips around the roast, cover again, and cook for another 45 to 60 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the beef pulls apart easily with a fork. Remove the bay leaf, shred or slice the beef, and stir in the chopped parsley before serving.

title: Slow-Cooked Beef Pot Roast with Carrots, Potatoes and Herbs
ingredients_json: ["900 g beef chuck roast", "15 ml olive oil", "2 pieces yellow onion", "3 cloves garlic", "300 g carrots", "500 g potatoes", "200 g celery", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "500 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "30 ml tomato paste", "2 g dried thyme", "2 g dried rosemary", "2 pieces bay leaf", "10 g plain wheat flour", "5 g black pepper", "4 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 C. Pat the beef dry and season it lightly with the salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a heavy casserole over medium-high heat and brown the beef well on all sides, about 3 to 4 minutes per side. Remove the meat and lower the heat to medium. Add the onions, garlic, celery and tomato paste, then cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened and fragrant. Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 minute to coat the vegetables. Pour in a little of the stock and scrape up any browned bits from the base of the pot. Add the remaining stock, chopped tomatoes, thyme, rosemary and bay leaves, then return the beef to the pot. Bring just to a simmer, cover with a lid and transfer to the oven for 2 hours. Add the carrots and potatoes around the meat, cover again and cook for another 1 to 1.5 hours, until the beef is tender enough to pull apart with a fork and the vegetables are soft. Remove the bay leaves, rest the roast for 10 minutes, then slice or shred the beef and serve it with the vegetables and a spoonful of the cooking juices.

title: Slow-Cooked Beef Pot Roast with Root Vegetables and Herbs
ingredients_json: ["900 g beef chuck roast, lean", "15 ml olive oil", "150 g onion, yellow, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "120 g celery, raw", "500 g potato, raw, with skin", "200 g parsnip, raw", "300 ml beef stock, low sodium", "200 ml water", "30 g tomato paste", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 g thyme, dried", "2 g rosemary, dried", "2 g black pepper, ground", "5 g salt, iodised", "15 g wholemeal flour"]
instructions: Pat the beef chuck dry and season it with the salt and black pepper. Add the onion, carrot, celery, and garlic to the pot and cook over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes until they start to soften and pick up color. Stir in the tomato paste and flour, then cook for 1 minute so the flour loses its raw taste. Pour in the beef stock and water, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Add the thyme and rosemary, return the beef to the pot, and bring everything to a gentle simmer. Add the potatoes and parsnips, then continue cooking for 45 to 60 minutes more until the beef is fork-tender and the vegetables are soft but not falling apart. Let the pot roast rest for 10 minutes before slicing the beef and serving it with the vegetables and cooking juices.

title: Slow-Cooked Lean Beef Pot Roast with Carrots, Potatoes and Herbs
ingredients_json: ["900 g beef chuck roast, lean", "15 ml olive oil", "2 pieces onion, yellow", "4 cloves garlic, fresh", "300 g carrots, raw", "500 g potatoes, raw", "250 g celery, raw", "400 g tomatoes, canned, chopped", "500 ml beef broth, reduced salt", "15 ml tomato paste", "2 g dried thyme", "2 g dried rosemary", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt, iodized", "2 leaves bay leaf"]
instructions: Pat the beef dry and season it with the salt and black pepper. Add the onions and celery and cook for 5 minutes until they begin to soften, then add the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute more. Add the carrots and potatoes, then continue cooking for 1 to 1.5 hours until the beef is fork-tender and the vegetables are soft but still hold their shape. title: Creamy Leek and Potato Soup with Spinach and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["600 g potatoes, raw, peeled", "200 g leek, raw", "120 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "800 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "250 ml water", "150 g spinach, raw", "200 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "5 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g dried thyme", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Wash and peel the potatoes, then cut them into small even cubes. Slice the leek thinly and rinse it well to remove any grit. Finely chop the onion and garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat, then add the onion and leek and cook for about 6 to 8 minutes until softened but not browned. Stir in the garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant. Add the potato cubes, vegetable stock, water, salt, and black pepper. Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer gently for 20 to 25 minutes, or until the potatoes are very tender. Add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted. Remove the pot from the heat and blend the soup until smooth using a hand blender. Stir in the yogurt off the heat so it stays creamy and does not split. Check the seasoning, then ladle into bowls and finish with chopped parsley.

title: Creamy Potato and Leek Soup with White Beans and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["600 g potatoes, raw, peeled", "200 g leek, raw", "120 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "750 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "250 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "200 g white beans, canned, drained", "100 g spinach, raw", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g dried thyme", "4 g salt", "15 ml lemon juice, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and leek and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until they are soft but not browned. Stir in the garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant. Add the potatoes, vegetable stock, and salt, then bring the soup to a gentle boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 18 to 20 minutes, or until the potatoes are very tender. Add the white beans and milk, then blend the soup partially with an immersion blender so it is creamy but still has some texture. Stir in the spinach and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until wilted. Finish with black pepper and lemon juice, then taste and adjust the seasoning if needed. Serve hot.

title: Creamy Leek and Parsley Potato Soup with White Beans
ingredients_json: ["600 g Potatoes, raw, peeled", "150 g Leek, raw", "120 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "15 g Olive oil", "750 ml Vegetable stock, reduced salt", "300 ml Water", "200 g Beans, cannellini, canned, drained", "100 ml Milk, semi-skimmed, pasteurised", "10 g Parsley, fresh", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt, table", "10 ml Lemon juice"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the potatoes, vegetable stock, water, salt, and black pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for about 18 to 20 minutes, until the potatoes are very tender when pierced with a fork. Stir in the drained cannellini beans and simmer for 3 minutes more. Remove the pot from the heat and blend the soup partly or fully with a stick blender, leaving some texture if desired. Stir in the milk, chopped parsley, and lemon juice, then warm gently over low heat for 1 to 2 minutes without boiling. Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed, then serve hot.

title: Creamy Leek and Potato Soup with Spinach and White Beans
ingredients_json: ["600 g potatoes, raw, peeled", "180 g leek, raw", "120 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "800 ml vegetable broth, reduced salt", "200 g cannellini beans, canned, drained", "150 g spinach, fresh", "120 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "2 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g dried thyme", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and sliced leek and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until soft but not browned. title: Creamy Leek and Potato Soup with White Beans and Parsley
ingredients_json: ["600 g potatoes, raw, peeled", "200 g leek, raw", "150 g celery, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g white beans, cooked, drained", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 l vegetable stock, reduced salt", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "10 g parsley, fresh", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt, table"]

Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for about 20 minutes until the potatoes are very tender. Blend most of the soup with an immersion blender, leaving some texture for a rustic finish. title: Rosemary Garlic Prime Rib with Roasted Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["1200 g beef rib roast, lean and trimmed", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g garlic, fresh", "2 g rosemary, fresh", "2 g black pepper, ground", "6 g salt", "300 g carrots", "250 g parsnips", "200 g red onions", "15 ml olive oil", "200 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "15 g Dijon mustard"]
instructions: Remove the beef rib roast from the refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking so it starts to warm slightly. Preheat the oven to 220 C. Mix the olive oil, crushed garlic, chopped rosemary, black pepper, and salt, then rub this evenly over the beef. Place the beef in a roasting pan and roast for 20 minutes to build a browned crust. Reduce the oven temperature to 160 C and continue roasting for about 55 to 70 minutes, until the centre reaches your preferred doneness, aiming for about 55 C for medium-rare. While the beef roasts, cut the carrots, parsnips, and red onions into large even pieces and toss them with the remaining olive oil. Add the vegetables to a tray and roast them in the lower part of the oven for about 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until tender and lightly caramelised. Transfer the beef to a board, cover loosely with foil, and rest for 15 to 20 minutes so the juices redistribute. Pour the beef stock into the roasting pan, scrape up the browned bits, and simmer briefly on the hob until slightly reduced, then whisk in the Dijon mustard to make a light pan sauce. Slice the prime rib against the grain and serve it with the roasted vegetables and a little sauce spooned over the top.

title: Herb-Roasted Prime Rib with Garlic Cauliflower Mash and Green Beans
ingredients_json: ["1200 g beef rib roast, lean", "20 g olive oil", "15 g garlic, fresh", "10 g rosemary, fresh", "5 g thyme, fresh", "6 g salt, iodized", "2 g black pepper, ground", "900 g cauliflower florets", "250 g potatoes, boiled", "30 g butter, unsalted", "100 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "400 g green beans, raw", "10 ml lemon juice", "15 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 C. Pat the beef rib roast dry and rub it with olive oil, minced garlic, chopped rosemary, chopped thyme, salt, and black pepper. Reduce the oven to 160 C and continue roasting for about 70 to 90 minutes, until the centre reaches 54 C for medium-rare or 60 C for medium. Transfer the meat to a board, cover loosely with foil, and rest for 20 minutes so the juices redistribute. Cook the green beans in boiling water for 4 to 5 minutes until bright green and just tender, then drain and toss with lemon juice and chopped parsley. Slice the prime rib against the grain and serve it with the cauliflower mash and green beans.

title: Rosemary-Garlic Prime Rib with Roasted Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["900 g beef rib roast, lean, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g garlic, raw", "2 g rosemary, fresh", "2 g black pepper, ground", "4 g salt, table", "300 g carrots, raw", "250 g parsnips, raw", "200 g red onions, raw", "10 ml olive oil", "150 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "10 g Dijon mustard", "10 g lemon juice, raw", "5 g parsley, fresh"]

Slice the beef against the grain, serve with the roasted vegetables, spoon over the sauce, and finish with chopped parsley.

title: Rosemary Garlic Prime Rib with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["1200 g beef rib roast, lean, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g garlic, fresh", "2 g rosemary, fresh", "2 g black pepper, ground", "6 g salt", "400 g carrots, raw", "300 g parsnips, raw", "250 g red onions, raw", "15 ml lemon juice", "200 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "10 g Dijon mustard"]

title: Rosemary Garlic Prime Rib with Roasted Root Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["1200 g beef prime rib roast, lean", "15 ml olive oil", "10 g garlic, fresh", "5 g rosemary, fresh", "5 g thyme, fresh", "6 g salt", "2 g black pepper, ground", "300 g carrots", "250 g parsnips", "200 g red onion", "15 ml olive oil", "200 ml beef stock, reduced salt"]

title: Slow-Cooked Pulled Pork with Smoky Apple Slaw
ingredients_json: ["800 g pork shoulder, lean", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "2 pieces onion, yellow, raw", "4 cloves garlic, raw", "200 ml apple juice, unsweetened", "100 ml tomato passata", "15 ml apple cider vinegar", "20 g tomato paste", "2 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "5 g salt, iodised", "300 g cabbage, white, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "100 g apple, with skin, raw", "75 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 g mustard, prepared", "6 pieces wholemeal burger bun"]
instructions: Heat the rapeseed oil in a heavy pot over medium heat and brown the pork shoulder well on all sides, about 6 to 8 minutes. Remove the meat and soften the chopped onions in the same pot for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, tomato paste, smoked paprika, cumin, oregano, black pepper, and salt and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in the apple juice, passata, and apple cider vinegar, stirring to lift any browned bits from the bottom. Return the pork to the pot, cover with a lid, and cook on very low heat for about 2.5 to 3 hours, or until the meat is very tender and pulls apart easily with a fork. Shred the pork into strands and mix it back into the sauce so it stays moist. For the slaw, shred the cabbage, grate the carrot, and slice the apple finely, then mix with the yogurt and mustard. Serve the pulled pork in wholemeal buns with a generous spoonful of slaw on top.

title: Slow-Cooked Pulled Pork with Smoky Apple Slaw and Wholegrain Buns
ingredients_json: ["900 g pork shoulder, lean", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "2 pieces onion, yellow, raw", "4 cloves garlic, raw", "200 g tomato passata", "150 ml apple juice, unsweetened", "15 ml apple cider vinegar", "20 g mustard, prepared", "15 g smoked paprika", "5 g ground cumin", "3 g black pepper, ground", "6 g salt, table", "250 g white cabbage, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "120 g apple, with skin, raw", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "8 g lemon juice", "4 wholemeal bread rolls, medium"]
instructions: Pat the pork shoulder dry and rub it with the smoked paprika, cumin, black pepper, and salt. title: Slow-Cooked Pulled Pork with Smoky Apple Slaw
ingredients_json: ["900 g pork shoulder, lean, raw", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "2 pieces onion, raw", "4 cloves garlic, raw", "2 pieces apple, with skin, raw", "200 g tomato passata", "15 ml apple cider vinegar", "20 g honey", "10 g smoked paprika", "5 g ground cumin", "3 g ground black pepper", "6 g salt", "150 ml water", "300 g white cabbage, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "100 g plain yogurt, low fat", "8 pieces wholemeal burger bun", "30 g mustard, prepared"]
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the pork shoulder and cut it into large pieces. Lower the heat to medium and add the sliced onions and crushed garlic, cooking for 2 minutes until fragrant. Stir in the tomato passata, apple cider vinegar, honey, smoked paprika, cumin, black pepper, salt, water, and one grated apple. title: Smoky Apple Cider Pulled Pork with Cabbage Slaw
ingredients_json: ["900 g pork shoulder, lean", "250 ml apple cider, unsweetened", "150 ml chicken stock, low salt", "20 g tomato paste", "15 g Dijon mustard", "15 ml apple cider vinegar", "10 g smoked paprika", "5 g ground cumin", "4 g garlic powder", "2 g onion powder", "2 g black pepper, ground", "6 g salt", "10 g olive oil", "300 g white cabbage", "150 g carrot", "80 g red onion", "120 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "10 ml lemon juice", "4 g honey", "8 small corn tortilla"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 160 C. Pat the pork shoulder dry and rub it with smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and salt. Stir together the apple cider, chicken stock, tomato paste, Dijon mustard, and apple cider vinegar, then pour the mixture around the pork. Cover tightly and cook in the oven for 3 to 3.5 hours, until the meat is very tender and pulls apart easily with a fork. Remove the pork to a board, shred it, and skim any excess fat from the cooking liquid. Return the shredded pork to the pot and mix it with enough of the juices to keep it moist. For the slaw, finely shred the cabbage, grate the carrot, and slice the red onion thinly. Mix the vegetables with Greek yogurt, lemon juice, and honey, then chill briefly so the cabbage stays crisp. Warm the corn tortillas, fill them with the pulled pork, and top with the slaw before serving.

title: Slow-Cooked Pulled Pork with Smoky Paprika and Apple Slaw
ingredients_json: ["900 g Pork shoulder, lean only, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 pieces Onion, raw", "4 cloves Garlic, raw", "2 tbsp Tomato purée", "2 tbsp Apple cider vinegar", "200 ml Apple juice, unsweetened", "200 g Tomatoes, crushed, canned", "2 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Dried oregano", "1 tsp Salt", "0.5 tsp Black pepper, ground", "8 pieces Wholemeal burger bun", "300 g White cabbage, raw", "2 pieces Carrot, raw", "150 g Plain yoghurt, low fat", "1 tbsp Lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150°C. Trim any large pieces of visible fat from the pork shoulder and cut it into 3 to 4 large chunks so it cooks evenly. Add the vinegar, apple juice and crushed tomatoes, then return the pork to the pot. Add the salt and black pepper, cover with a lid and cook in the oven for about 3 hours, turning the pork once halfway through, until it is very tender and pulls apart easily with a fork. Remove the pork from the pot and shred it with two forks, then stir it back into the sauce and let it sit for 10 minutes so it absorbs the flavour. Mix the cabbage, grated carrot, yoghurt and lemon juice to make a fresh slaw. Serve the pulled pork in wholemeal buns with the slaw on top, spooning over a little of the cooking sauce for extra moisture.

title: Chicken, Black Bean and Spinach Quesadillas with Salsa Fresca
ingredients_json: ["220 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp Garlic powder", "0.25 tsp Salt", "120 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "60 g Baby spinach, fresh", "80 g Sweetcorn, cooked", "60 g Onion, red, raw", "120 g Tomato, raw", "15 g Fresh coriander leaves", "10 ml Lime juice", "4 pieces Tortilla wrap, wholemeal", "120 g Cheese, semi-hard, reduced fat", "30 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat"]

Stir the chicken back into the pan and remove from the heat. Mix the tomato, red onion, coriander, and lime juice in a small bowl to make a fresh salsa. Lay out the tortillas and divide the chicken mixture evenly over two of them, then top with the cheese and close with the remaining tortillas. Return each quesadilla to the pan over medium heat and cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side, pressing lightly, until the tortillas are golden and crisp and the cheese has melted. Cut into wedges and serve hot with the salsa and a spoonful of yogurt.

title: Chicken, Black Bean and Spinach Quesadillas with Avocado Salsa

Fold each tortilla in half and cook in a dry skillet over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and crisp and the cheese has melted. Slice the quesadillas and serve hot with the avocado salsa on the side.

title: Chicken, Black Bean and Spinach Quesadillas with Tomato Salsa

title: Chicken, Black Bean and Spinach Quesadillas with Mild Salsa
ingredients_json: ["240 g Chicken breast, raw, skinless", "8 pieces Tortilla wrap, wholemeal", "160 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "120 g Sweetcorn, frozen, boiled", "80 g Spinach, raw", "120 g Cheese, reduced fat, grated", "80 g Onion, raw", "10 g Olive oil", "120 g Tomato salsa, reduced sugar", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "2 g Salt"]

title: Chicken, Black Bean and Spinach Quesadillas with Tomato Salsa

title: Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli with Tomato, Garlic and Basil
ingredients_json: ["300 g fresh ravioli, spinach and ricotta", "300 g tomato passata", "2 clove garlic, raw", "1 medium onion", "15 ml olive oil", "150 g baby spinach, raw", "80 g ricotta cheese, semi-skimmed", "20 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "6 g basil, fresh", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt, table", "500 ml water"]

title: Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli with Tomato, Garlic and Basil
ingredients_json: ["300 g fresh ravioli with ricotta and spinach filling", "250 g passata", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "2 cloves garlic", "15 ml olive oil", "80 g baby spinach", "30 g parmesan cheese", "10 g fresh basil leaves", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "2 g dried oregano"]

Add the cherry tomatoes and oregano, then cook for 4 to 5 minutes until the tomatoes start to soften and release juices. title: Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli with Tomato, Basil and Parmesan

title: Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli with Tomato, Garlic and Basil
ingredients_json: ["250 g durum wheat flour", "2 piece egg, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "120 g ricotta cheese", "80 g spinach, raw", "40 g parmesan cheese", "1 clove garlic", "1 g nutmeg, ground", "300 g tomatoes, canned, chopped", "1 piece onion, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "5 g basil, fresh", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "30 g pine nuts"]
instructions: Make the pasta dough by mixing the flour, eggs and 1 tablespoon of olive oil until a smooth dough forms. Knead it for about 8 minutes, then cover and rest for 20 minutes.
