Meanwhile, make the sauce by warming 15 ml of olive oil in a pan over medium heat, cooking the chopped onion for 5 minutes until soft, then adding the garlic for 30 seconds. Stir in the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until slightly thickened. Toss the cooked ravioli gently with the sauce, add the basil, and serve topped with the remaining parmesan and toasted pine nuts.

title: Spinach and Ricotta Ravioli with Tomato Basil Sauce
ingredients_json: ["250 g fresh ravioli with spinach and ricotta filling", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "80 g spinach, raw", "60 g carrot, raw", "15 g tomato paste", "5 g basil, fresh", "10 g Parmesan cheese", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "500 ml water"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion, garlic, and carrot. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat, then add the onion and carrot and cook for 5 minutes until softened but not browned. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant. Add the chopped tomatoes and water, then season with the salt and black pepper. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer and cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened. Add the spinach and basil and cook for 2 minutes until the spinach has wilted. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the ravioli according to the packet instructions until they float and are tender. Drain the ravioli well, then gently toss them with the tomato sauce. Serve hot topped with the Parmesan cheese.

title: Creamy Smoky Refried Beans with Tomato, Onion and Lime
ingredients_json: ["400 g cooked pinto beans, drained", "15 ml olive oil", "80 g onion, diced", "10 g garlic, minced", "80 g tomato, chopped", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "1 g dried oregano", "120 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "15 ml lime juice", "2 g salt", "10 g fresh coriander leaves"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and oregano, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the chopped tomato and cook for 2 minutes until it starts to break down. Stir in the pinto beans and vegetable stock, then lower the heat and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the beans are very tender and the liquid has reduced slightly. Mash the beans with a potato masher or the back of a spoon until creamy but still a little textured. Stir in the lime juice, salt and chopped coriander, then cook for 1 minute more. Serve warm as a side dish or filling.

title: Smoky Refried Beans with Garlic, Onion and Lime
ingredients_json: ["400 g cooked pinto beans", "30 ml olive oil", "80 g onion", "10 g garlic", "100 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "1 g ground black pepper", "4 g salt", "15 ml lime juice", "10 g fresh coriander"]
instructions: Warm the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring often, until softened and lightly golden. Add the minced garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and black pepper, then cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the pinto beans and vegetable stock, reduce the heat to low, and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes so the beans soften further and take on the spice. Mash the beans with a potato masher or the back of a spoon until they are mostly smooth but still a little textured, then cook for 2 to 3 minutes more, stirring constantly, until thick and creamy. Remove from the heat and stir in the salt, lime juice and chopped coriander. Serve warm as a side dish or filling.

title: Smoky Refried Beans with Garlic, Onion and Lime
ingredients_json: ["500 g cooked pinto beans", "30 ml olive oil", "120 g onion", "12 g garlic", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "1 g ground black pepper", "4 g salt", "60 ml vegetable broth", "20 ml lime juice", "10 g fresh coriander"]
instructions: Finely chop the onion and garlic. Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat, then add the onion and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and black pepper, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the cooked pinto beans and salt, then pour in the vegetable broth. Lower the heat and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring often, until the beans are heated through. Mash the beans with a potato masher or the back of a spoon, leaving some texture. Continue cooking for 3 to 5 minutes more, stirring, until thick and creamy. Stir in the lime juice and chopped coriander just before serving, and serve warm.

title: Smoky Tomato Refried Beans with Lime and Cilantro
ingredients_json: ["400 g canned pinto beans, drained and rinsed", "15 ml olive oil", "80 g yellow onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "5 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "200 g canned chopped tomatoes", "60 ml water", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "15 ml lime juice", "10 g fresh coriander leaves, chopped"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for about 5 minutes, stirring often, until it becomes soft and translucent. Add the garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the pinto beans, chopped tomatoes, water, salt, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 8 to 10 minutes so the flavours blend and the liquid slightly reduces. Mash the beans with a potato masher or fork until mostly smooth but still a little chunky, adding a splash more water if the mixture becomes too thick. Stir in the lime juice and chopped coriander, then cook for 1 minute more. Serve warm.

title: Smoky Lime Refried Black Beans with Onion and Cumin
ingredients_json: ["400 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "15 ml olive oil", "80 g onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "1 g dried oregano", "50 ml water", "10 ml lime juice", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "10 g fresh coriander leaves"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, and oregano, then cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the black beans and water, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes so the beans heat through and absorb the spices. Mash the beans with a potato masher or the back of a spoon until mostly smooth but still a little chunky, adding a little more water if needed for a creamy texture. Stir in the lime juice, salt, and black pepper, then cook for another minute until thick and glossy. Finish with the chopped coriander leaves and serve warm.

title: Oven-Baked Pork Ribs with Smoky Tomato Glaze and Roasted Sweet Potato
ingredients_json: ["900 g Pork ribs, lean, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "150 g Tomato puree, canned", "30 g Honey", "15 ml Apple cider vinegar", "2 tsp Smoked paprika", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 tsp Onion powder", "1 tsp Black pepper", "1 tsp Salt", "600 g Sweet potato, raw", "200 g Red onion, raw", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "20 g Parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Line a large baking tray with baking paper. Pat the ribs dry and place them on the tray. In a bowl, mix the olive oil, tomato paste, tomato puree, honey, apple cider vinegar, smoked paprika, crushed garlic, onion powder, black pepper, and salt until smooth. Brush about two thirds of the glaze over the ribs, coating them evenly. Cover the tray tightly with foil and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes until the meat is tender and starting to pull back from the bones. Meanwhile, cut the sweet potato into chunks and slice the red onion into wedges. Toss them with the remaining glaze and spread them on a second tray. Remove the foil from the ribs, raise the oven temperature to 220°C, and bake the ribs for 15 to 20 minutes more until browned and sticky. Roast the vegetables on the lower shelf for the last 25 to 30 minutes, turning once, until caramelised and soft. Finish the ribs with lemon juice and chopped parsley, then serve with the roasted sweet potato and onion.

title: Sticky Honey-Garlic Pork Ribs with Roasted Vegetables
ingredients_json: ["900 g Pork ribs, lean", "20 ml Olive oil", "30 ml Honey", "25 ml Soy sauce, reduced salt", "15 ml Tomato paste", "3 cloves Garlic, raw", "10 g Ginger, raw", "15 ml Apple cider vinegar", "1 tsp Paprika, sweet", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt", "400 g Carrots, raw", "300 g Broccoli, raw", "300 g Sweet potato, raw", "200 g Onion, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. Line a large roasting tray with baking paper. Mix the olive oil, honey, reduced-salt soy sauce, tomato paste, finely grated garlic, grated ginger, apple cider vinegar, paprika, black pepper, and salt in a bowl to make a glaze. Cut the sweet potato, carrots, and onion into even pieces and divide them around the tray with the broccoli. Brush the ribs generously with the glaze, then place them on top of the vegetables in a single layer. Roast for 45 minutes, turning and basting the ribs halfway through so they stay moist and glossy. Increase the oven to 210°C and roast for another 15 to 20 minutes until the ribs are well browned, sticky, and cooked through, and the vegetables are tender with caramelised edges. Rest the ribs for 5 minutes before serving with the roasted vegetables and any juices from the tray.

title: Sticky Ginger-Garlic Pork Ribs with Roasted Sweet Potato and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["1200 g Pork ribs, lean, raw", "500 g Sweet potato, raw", "300 g Broccoli, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "4 cloves Garlic, raw", "20 g Ginger root, raw", "2 tbsp Soy sauce, reduced salt", "2 tbsp Tomato paste", "1 tbsp Honey", "1 tbsp Apple cider vinegar", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground", "1 tsp Salt", "1 piece Lemon, raw"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius. Trim any large pieces of fat from the ribs and place them in a roasting dish. Finely grate the garlic and ginger, then mix them with the soy sauce, tomato paste, honey, apple cider vinegar, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt to make a sticky glaze. Coat the ribs well with the glaze, cover the dish tightly with foil, and roast for 1 hour and 15 minutes so the meat starts to become tender. While the ribs cook, cut the sweet potato into chunks and toss them with half of the olive oil. After the first roasting time, add the sweet potato to the dish and continue roasting uncovered for 35 minutes, turning the ribs once and basting with the juices halfway through. Put the broccoli on a baking tray, drizzle with the remaining olive oil, and roast it for the final 15 minutes until bright green and lightly browned. The ribs are ready when the meat is tender and pulls back from the bone, with a glossy caramelised surface. Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice and serve the ribs with the roasted sweet potato and broccoli.

title: Honey-Soy Baked Pork Ribs with Roasted Broccoli and Sweet Potatoes
ingredients_json: ["900 g Pork ribs, lean, raw", "30 ml Honey", "30 ml Soy sauce, reduced salt", "15 ml Olive oil", "20 g Tomato puree", "10 g Garlic, raw", "10 g Ginger, raw", "15 ml Apple cider vinegar", "5 g Paprika, sweet", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "600 g Sweet potato, raw", "400 g Broccoli, raw", "10 ml Olive oil", "3 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C. Mix the honey, reduced-salt soy sauce, olive oil, tomato puree, finely grated garlic, grated ginger, apple cider vinegar, paprika, and black pepper in a large bowl. Add the ribs and turn them until they are evenly coated. Arrange them in a roasting tray, cover tightly with foil, and bake for 45 minutes. Meanwhile, peel the sweet potatoes and cut them into chunks. Cut the broccoli into florets. Toss both vegetables with olive oil and salt, then set aside. Remove the foil from the ribs, baste them with the pan juices, and return them to the oven for 20 minutes so they start to caramelise. Add the sweet potatoes and broccoli to a second tray and roast for 25 to 30 minutes until the sweet potatoes are tender and the broccoli is lightly browned at the edges. Increase the oven to 220 C for the last 5 to 8 minutes on the ribs, until the surface is sticky and well browned and the meat is cooked through and tender. Let the ribs rest for 5 minutes before serving with the roasted vegetables and any reduced juices from the tray.

title: Honey-Garlic Oven-Baked Pork Ribs with Roasted Sweet Potatoes and Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["900 g pork ribs, lean, raw", "500 g sweet potato", "300 g broccoli florets", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 tbsp honey", "2 tbsp soy sauce, reduced salt", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "2 tbsp apple cider vinegar", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt", "1 medium onion", "1 lemon, juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C. Line a large roasting tray with baking paper. Mix the honey, reduced-salt soy sauce, minced garlic, apple cider vinegar, smoked paprika, black pepper, salt, and lemon juice in a bowl to make a glaze. Pat the ribs dry and coat them well with about two thirds of the glaze. Arrange them on the tray, cover tightly with foil, and bake for 60 minutes. While the ribs cook, peel the sweet potato and cut it into wedges, then toss it with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and the sliced onion. After the first hour, add the sweet potato and onion to the tray around the ribs and return to the oven uncovered for 25 minutes. Add the broccoli tossed with the remaining olive oil for the final 12 to 15 minutes so it stays bright green and tender. Brush the ribs with the remaining glaze during the last 10 minutes, then cook until the meat is caramelised and pulls away from the bone easily. Let everything rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Mediterranean Chicken, Spinach and Brown Rice Casserole
ingredients_json: ["250 g brown rice, dry", "400 g chicken breast, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece zucchini, raw", "200 g spinach, raw", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "250 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "100 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "50 g feta cheese, reduced fat", "5 g paprika powder", "2 g dried oregano", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Rinse the brown rice under cold water, then cook it in lightly simmering water for about 25 minutes until just tender, and drain well. While the rice cooks, cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large ovenproof pan over medium heat, then cook the onion for 4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic, chicken, paprika, oregano, and black pepper, and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until the chicken is lightly browned on the outside. Stir in the red pepper and zucchini, then cook for another 4 minutes. Add the chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock, and salt, and simmer gently for 5 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly. Fold in the spinach until it wilts, then stir in the cooked rice and yogurt. Transfer everything to a casserole dish, scatter the feta over the top, and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until bubbling and hot through. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving so the casserole firms up slightly.

title: Herbed Chicken and Brown Rice Vegetable Casserole
ingredients_json: ["250 g brown rice, uncooked", "400 g chicken breast, skinless, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "150 g zucchini, raw", "100 g red bell pepper, raw", "200 g spinach, raw", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "500 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp paprika powder", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Rinse the brown rice under cold water, then cook it in the vegetable stock for about 20 minutes until it is just tender and most of the liquid is absorbed. While the rice cooks, cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned on the outside. Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrot, zucchini, and red pepper, then cook for another 5 minutes over medium heat until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, thyme, oregano, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and simmer for 3 minutes. Add the spinach and cook just until wilted. Mix the cooked rice with the chicken and vegetable mixture, then fold in the yogurt. Transfer everything to a lightly oiled casserole dish and scatter the Parmesan over the top. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden on top. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving so it sets neatly.

title: Mediterranean Chicken and Brown Rice Casserole with Spinach and Tomatoes
ingredients_json: ["250 g brown rice, dry", "400 g chicken breast, raw", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "200 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "150 g spinach, raw", "2 tbsp olive oil", "600 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "200 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "150 g plain yogurt, low-fat", "30 g parmesan cheese, grated", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp paprika, ground", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Rinse the brown rice under cold water and set it aside. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces, finely chop the onion and garlic, and dice the red pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large ovenproof pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 3 to 4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and chicken and cook for another 4 to 5 minutes, stirring until the chicken is lightly sealed on the outside. Stir in the red pepper, oregano, paprika, black pepper, salt, chopped tomatoes, brown rice, and chicken stock. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then cover tightly and bake for 35 minutes. Remove from the oven, stir in the spinach and cherry tomatoes, then spoon over the yogurt and sprinkle with parmesan. Return uncovered to the oven for 10 to 15 minutes until the rice is tender, the liquid has been absorbed, and the top is lightly golden. Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before serving so it sets up nicely.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken and Vegetable Brown Rice Casserole
ingredients_json: ["250 g brown rice, dry", "500 ml water", "400 g chicken breast, skinless, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "150 g courgette, raw", "150 g red bell pepper, raw", "200 g broccoli florets, raw", "200 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "150 ml low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "100 g plain yogurt, low-fat", "30 g Parmesan cheese", "2 pieces egg, raw", "2 g dried thyme", "2 g dried oregano", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "5 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Rinse the brown rice and cook it in the water for about 25 to 30 minutes until it is just tender and the liquid is absorbed. While the rice cooks, cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned. Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrot, courgette, red pepper and broccoli, then cook over medium heat for about 6 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, thyme, oregano, salt, black pepper and lemon juice, and simmer for 2 minutes. In a bowl, whisk together the milk, yogurt and eggs, then mix in the Parmesan. Combine the cooked rice with the chicken and vegetable mixture in a large casserole dish, pour over the egg mixture, and stir gently so everything is evenly coated. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the top is set and lightly golden and the casserole is hot throughout. Let it stand for 5 minutes before serving so it slices cleanly.

title: Lemon Chicken and Spinach Brown Rice Casserole
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, raw", "250 g Brown rice, dry", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "150 g Carrot, raw", "150 g Bell pepper, red, raw", "200 g Spinach, raw", "400 g Tomato, canned, chopped", "500 ml Chicken broth, reduced salt", "150 g Yogurt, Greek style, plain, low fat", "30 g Cheese, hard, reduced fat", "15 ml Olive oil", "1 piece Lemon, raw", "2 g Paprika, sweet", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Thyme, dried", "2 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Rinse the brown rice under cold water and set it aside. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces, finely chop the onion and garlic, and dice the carrot and red pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe casserole dish over medium heat, then cook the onion for 3 minutes until softened. Add the garlic, chicken, paprika, black pepper, thyme, and salt, and cook for 4 minutes, stirring often, until the chicken is lightly sealed. Stir in the carrot, red pepper, chopped tomatoes, brown rice, and chicken broth. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, then cover tightly and transfer to the oven. Bake for 40 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the rice is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed. Remove the dish from the oven and fold in the spinach, yogurt, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Sprinkle the grated reduced-fat cheese over the top and return to the oven uncovered for 8 minutes until hot and lightly browned. Let the casserole stand for 5 minutes before serving so it settles and slices more cleanly.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken Rice Pilaf with Spinach and Peas
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken fillet, without skin", "250 g Rice, long grain, brown, dry", "15 ml Olive oil", "1 medium Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "150 g Carrot, raw", "100 g Celery, raw", "120 g Peas, green, frozen", "100 g Spinach, raw", "700 ml Broth, chicken, reduced salt", "15 ml Lemon juice, raw", "1 tsp Lemon zest, raw", "2 g Thyme, dried", "2 g Parsley, fresh", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then drain well. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season lightly with the salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy saucepan over medium heat, then cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes until it turns lightly golden on the outside. Remove it to a plate. Add the onion, carrot, and celery to the pan and cook over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until the onion is soft and fragrant. Add the garlic and thyme and cook for 30 seconds more. Stir in the rice and toast it for 1 minute so the grains look glossy. Pour in the broth and lemon juice, then bring everything to a gentle boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 35 minutes without stirring until most of the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender. Add the peas, spinach, cooked chicken, and lemon zest, then cover again and cook for 5 minutes until the spinach wilts and the chicken is hot through. Fluff the pilaf with a fork, stir in the parsley, and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Herbed Chicken and Vegetable Rice Pilaf
ingredients_json: ["250 g basmati rice, uncooked", "300 g chicken breast, raw, skinless", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece carrot, raw, medium", "1 piece celery stalk, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "150 g frozen peas", "750 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp ground cumin", "2 pieces bay leaf", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "10 g parsley, fresh", "5 g salt"]
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then drain well. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, chop the onion, carrot, celery, and red bell pepper into small even pieces, and mince the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy saucepan over medium heat, add the chicken, and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until lightly browned on the outside. Add the onion, carrot, celery, and bell pepper, then cook for another 5 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the garlic, thyme, cumin, and bay leaves and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the rice and stir for 1 minute so the grains are coated in oil and toasted slightly. Pour in the vegetable stock and add the salt, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in the peas, replace the lid, and cook for 5 more minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. Remove from the heat and let the pilaf stand covered for 5 minutes. Discard the bay leaves, fluff the rice with a fork, and finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley before serving.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken Rice Pilaf with Spinach and Carrots
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast, skinless, raw", "200 g long grain brown rice, uncooked", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "100 g celery, raw", "600 ml low-salt chicken stock", "100 g spinach, raw", "1 medium lemon, raw", "2 tbsp parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 tsp dried thyme", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice under cold water until the water runs clearer. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season lightly with half the black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat, then add the onion, carrot, and celery and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until they begin to soften. Add the garlic and thyme and cook for 30 seconds more, stirring so the garlic does not brown. Add the chicken and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the outside is no longer pink. Stir in the rice, then pour in the chicken stock and add the salt. Bring to a gentle boil, reduce the heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for about 35 minutes until the rice is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed. Remove from the heat and let it stand covered for 5 minutes. Fluff the pilaf with a fork, then fold in the spinach, parsley, lemon zest, lemon juice, and the remaining black pepper. Stir gently until the spinach wilts and the pilaf looks light and evenly mixed. Serve warm.

title: Lemon Herb Chicken and Vegetable Rice Pilaf
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast fillet, raw, skinless", "200 g long grain brown rice, dry", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece carrot, raw", "1 piece celery stalk, raw", "100 g courgette, raw", "75 g frozen peas", "700 ml low-salt chicken stock", "1 tbsp lemon juice, freshly squeezed", "1 tsp lemon zest", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 leaf bay leaf", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "15 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season lightly with half of the salt and the black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat, then brown the chicken for 3 to 4 minutes until lightly golden but not cooked through. Remove it to a plate. Lower the heat to medium and add the onion, garlic, carrot, celery, and courgette. Cook for 5 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the rice, thyme, lemon zest, and bay leaf, and cook for 1 minute so the grains are well coated. Pour in the stock and lemon juice, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes without stirring until the rice is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed. Add the peas and the browned chicken during the last 5 minutes of cooking so everything heats through. Remove from the heat, keep covered for 5 minutes, then discard the bay leaf and fluff the pilaf with a fork. Stir through the parsley and serve warm.

title: Herbed Chicken and Vegetable Rice Pilaf
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast fillet, skinless, raw", "250 g Long grain brown rice, dry", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "1 piece Carrot, raw, medium", "1 piece Celery stalk, raw", "1 piece Red bell pepper, raw", "150 g Frozen peas", "700 ml Chicken stock, reduced salt", "2 g Dried thyme", "2 g Dried parsley", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt, table", "10 g Fresh parsley, raw"]
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear, then drain well. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces. Dice the onion, carrot, celery, and red pepper, and finely chop the garlic. Heat the olive oil in a large heavy saucepan over medium heat. Add the chicken and cook for about 4 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until lightly browned on the outside. Add the onion, carrot, celery, and red pepper, then cook for another 5 minutes over medium heat until the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the garlic, thyme, dried parsley, black pepper, and salt, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the rice and stir for 1 minute so the grains are coated in the oil and lightly toasted. Pour in the chicken stock, bring it to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover tightly, and simmer for 25 minutes without stirring. Add the peas on top, re-cover, and cook for 5 more minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed. Remove from the heat and let it stand covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork and stir through the fresh parsley before serving.

title: Mushroom, Spinach and Lemon Parmesan Risotto
ingredients_json: ["250 g Arborio rice, dry", "1 liter Vegetable stock, low salt", "1 piece Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Mushrooms, button, raw", "150 g Spinach, raw", "30 ml Olive oil", "30 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 piece Lemon, raw", "20 g Butter, unsalted", "30 g White wine, dry", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Warm the vegetable stock in a saucepan and keep it at a gentle simmer over low heat. Finely chop the onion and garlic, then slice the mushrooms. Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat, add the onion and cook for about 5 minutes until soft and translucent. Stir in the garlic and mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes until the mushrooms have released their moisture and started to brown. Add the rice and stir for 1 to 2 minutes so every grain is coated and slightly toasted. Pour in the white wine and cook until it has mostly evaporated. Add a ladle of hot stock and stir frequently over medium-low heat until the liquid is nearly absorbed. Continue adding stock one ladle at a time, stirring often and allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding the next. After about 18 to 20 minutes, the rice should be creamy but still have a slight bite. Stir in the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted. Remove from the heat, then mix in the butter, Parmesan, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Season with black pepper and salt, cover the pan, and let the risotto rest for 2 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Spinach, Pea and Lemon Risotto with Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "300 g arborio rice, dry", "100 ml white wine", "900 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "150 g frozen peas", "200 g spinach, raw", "60 g parmesan cheese, grated", "20 g butter", "1 piece lemon, raw", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large heavy saucepan over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until soft and translucent, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds without letting it brown. Add the arborio rice and stir for 1 to 2 minutes until the grains look glossy. Pour in the white wine and let it simmer until almost fully absorbed. Add the warm vegetable stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and waiting until each addition is nearly absorbed before adding the next. Continue for about 18 to 20 minutes, until the rice is creamy but still slightly firm in the centre. Stir in the peas for the last 4 minutes of cooking, then add the spinach and let it wilt into the risotto. Remove the pan from the heat and mix in the butter, parmesan, lemon zest, and lemon juice. Season with black pepper, cover for 2 minutes, then stir again and serve immediately while creamy and hot.

title: Mushroom, Spinach and Pea Risotto with Lemon and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, medium, chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "250 g mushrooms, brown, sliced", "300 g risotto rice, dry", "120 ml dry white wine", "900 ml vegetable stock, reduced salt", "150 g frozen peas", "100 g spinach, fresh", "40 g parmesan cheese, grated", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp lemon zest, grated", "2 tbsp parsley, fresh, chopped", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft and translucent, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until they have released their moisture and started to brown. Stir in the risotto rice and cook for 1 minute so the grains are well coated. Pour in the white wine and stir until it has almost completely evaporated. Add the hot vegetable stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding the next. Keep the heat at a gentle simmer and continue for about 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy and just tender. Stir in the peas for the last 3 minutes, then fold in the spinach until wilted. Remove the pan from the heat and mix through the parmesan, lemon juice, lemon zest, parsley, and black pepper. Let the risotto stand for 2 minutes before serving so it settles into a glossy, creamy texture.

title: Mushroom, Pea and Spinach Risotto with Lemon and Parmesan
ingredients_json: ["250 g Arborio rice, dry", "150 g Onion, raw", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "250 g Mushrooms, white, raw", "100 g Peas, green, frozen", "100 g Spinach, raw", "20 g Olive oil", "20 g Butter, unsalted", "1200 ml Vegetable stock, low salt", "80 ml White wine, dry", "40 g Cheese, Parmesan, grated", "1 piece Lemon, raw", "10 g Parsley, fresh", "2 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Warm the vegetable stock in a saucepan and keep it at a gentle simmer. Finely chop the onion and garlic, and slice the mushrooms. Heat the olive oil and butter in a wide pan over medium heat, then cook the onion for about 5 minutes until soft and translucent. Add the garlic and mushrooms and cook for another 5 to 6 minutes until the mushrooms have released their liquid and started to brown. Stir in the rice and cook for 1 minute so the grains are coated and slightly glossy. Pour in the white wine and stir until it has nearly evaporated. Add the warm stock a ladleful at a time, stirring often and waiting until each addition is mostly absorbed before adding the next. Continue for about 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy but still lightly firm in the centre. Stir in the peas for the last 3 minutes of cooking, then add the spinach and cook just until wilted. Remove the pan from the heat and mix in the Parmesan, lemon zest, a little lemon juice, and black pepper. Let the risotto rest for 2 minutes, then finish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.

title: Lemon Asparagus and Pea Risotto with Parmesan and Herbs
ingredients_json: ["300 g Risotto rice, dry", "1.2 l Vegetable stock, reduced salt", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "1 piece Onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves Garlic, raw", "200 g Asparagus, raw", "150 g Green peas, frozen", "80 g Spinach, raw", "100 ml White wine, dry", "40 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "1 piece Lemon, raw, zest and juice", "15 g Parsley, fresh", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Warm the vegetable stock in a saucepan and keep it at a gentle simmer. Finely chop the onion and garlic, then trim the asparagus and cut it into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, add the onion and cook for about 5 minutes until soft and translucent. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the risotto rice and toast it for 1 to 2 minutes until the grains look glossy. Pour in the white wine and stir until it has mostly evaporated. Add the warm stock a ladle at a time, stirring often and allowing each addition to be absorbed before adding more. Continue for about 18 to 20 minutes until the rice is creamy and tender but still has a slight bite. About 8 minutes before the end of cooking, stir in the asparagus and peas. In the last 2 minutes, add the spinach so it wilts into the risotto. Remove from the heat and mix in the Parmesan, lemon zest, lemon juice, chopped parsley, and black pepper. Let it stand for 2 minutes before serving so the texture becomes silky and cohesive.

title: Lean Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Onion Gravy
ingredients_json: ["500 g lean minced beef", "50 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml low-fat milk", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "10 g parsley, fresh", "5 g Dijon mustard", "5 ml Worcestershire sauce", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "10 ml rapeseed oil", "200 g mushrooms, brown, raw", "15 g wholemeal flour", "300 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "15 g tomato purée", "5 ml soy sauce, reduced salt", "150 g carrots, raw", "200 g green beans, raw", "200 g potatoes, boiled"]
instructions: Finely chop half of the onion and the garlic, then mix them with the minced beef, breadcrumbs, egg, milk, parsley, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, salt and black pepper until just combined. Shape the mixture into 4 oval patties and press them slightly flat so they cook evenly. Heat half of the oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat and brown the patties for about 3 minutes per side until well coloured. Transfer them to a plate. Add the remaining oil to the pan, then cook the rest of the onion and the mushrooms over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the flour and tomato purée and cook for 1 minute, then slowly add the beef stock while stirring to make a smooth gravy. Add the soy sauce, return the patties to the pan, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 to 12 minutes until the steaks are cooked through and the gravy has thickened. Meanwhile, steam the carrots and green beans for 6 to 8 minutes until tender but still bright, and warm the boiled potatoes. Serve the Salisbury steaks with the mushroom gravy, vegetables and potatoes spooned alongside.

title: Lean Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Onion Gravy
ingredients_json: ["500 g beef mince, lean", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g oats, rolled", "30 g onion, raw", "10 g Worcestershire sauce", "2 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "15 ml olive oil", "150 g onion, raw", "200 g mushrooms, white, raw", "10 g garlic, raw", "15 g wholemeal flour", "300 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "10 g tomato paste", "5 g Dijon mustard", "15 g plain yogurt, low fat", "5 g parsley, fresh", "400 g potatoes, boiled", "200 g green beans, raw"]
instructions: Finely grate the first onion and mix it with the lean beef mince, egg, rolled oats, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and black pepper. Combine gently until just mixed, then shape the mixture into 4 oval patties about 2 cm thick. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the patties for 3 to 4 minutes per side until well browned. Transfer them to a plate. Add the remaining oil to the pan, then cook the sliced onion and mushrooms over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir in the garlic and flour and cook for 1 minute, then whisk in the beef stock, tomato paste, and Dijon mustard. Simmer for 3 to 5 minutes until the gravy thickens. Return the patties to the pan, reduce the heat to low, cover, and cook for another 6 to 8 minutes until the steaks are cooked through and the gravy is rich. Stir in the yogurt off the heat for a smoother sauce, then finish with chopped parsley. Serve the Salisbury steaks with boiled potatoes and steamed green beans.

title: Lean Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Onion Gravy
ingredients_json: ["500 g lean minced beef, raw", "60 g rolled oats", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 g onion, finely grated", "2 g garlic powder", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "10 ml vegetable oil", "200 g brown onion, sliced", "200 g mushrooms, fresh, sliced", "15 g wholemeal flour", "300 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "10 ml tomato purée", "5 ml Worcestershire sauce", "5 g Dijon mustard", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Combine the minced beef, rolled oats, egg, grated onion, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt in a large bowl. Mix gently until just combined, then shape the mixture into 4 oval patties about 2 cm thick. Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the patties for 3 to 4 minutes per side until well browned, then transfer them to a plate. Lower the heat to medium and add the sliced onion and mushrooms to the same pan. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the onions are soft and the mushrooms have released their moisture and started to brown. Sprinkle in the flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring so it coats the vegetables. Pour in the beef stock gradually while stirring, then add the tomato purée, Worcestershire sauce, and Dijon mustard. Simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until the gravy thickens. Return the patties to the pan, spoon the gravy over them, cover, and cook on low heat for 8 to 10 minutes until the steaks are cooked through and the sauce is rich and glossy. Finish with chopped parsley and serve hot with steamed vegetables or mashed potatoes.

title: Lean Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Onion Gravy
ingredients_json: ["500 g lean beef mince", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g rolled oats", "60 g onion", "2 cloves garlic", "10 g Dijon mustard", "15 ml Worcestershire sauce", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "15 ml olive oil", "250 g brown mushrooms", "80 g onion", "15 g wholemeal flour", "300 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "10 g tomato paste", "5 g fresh thyme", "200 g carrots", "300 g potatoes", "15 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "10 g butter"]
instructions: Peel the potatoes and carrots, cut them into even chunks, and steam or boil them until tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain well, then mash the potatoes with the milk and butter until smooth, and keep warm. Finely grate or chop the onion and garlic for the steaks. In a large bowl, combine the beef mince, egg, oats, 60 g onion, garlic, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, black pepper, and salt. Mix gently until just combined, then shape the mixture into 4 oval patties. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the patties for about 3 minutes per side until a crust forms. Reduce the heat to medium, remove the patties, and set them aside. Add the remaining onion and the mushrooms to the same pan and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until softened and lightly browned. Stir in the flour and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute. Gradually pour in the beef stock while stirring, then add the thyme and simmer for 3 to 4 minutes until the gravy thickens. Return the patties to the pan and simmer gently for 6 to 8 minutes until cooked through and the sauce is rich and glossy. Serve the Salisbury steaks with the mushroom onion gravy and the mashed potatoes and carrots on the side.

title: Lean Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Onion Gravy
ingredients_json: ["500 g lean beef mince", "50 g rolled oats", "1 piece egg, raw, whole", "80 g onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "10 g parsley, fresh", "5 g Dijon mustard", "5 ml Worcestershire sauce", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "10 ml olive oil", "200 g onion, sliced", "200 g mushrooms, button, sliced", "15 g plain flour, wholemeal", "400 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "10 ml tomato paste", "5 ml Worcestershire sauce", "150 g carrots, sliced", "600 g potatoes, peeled", "15 g butter"]
instructions: Put the potatoes and carrots in a saucepan, cover with water, and simmer over medium heat for about 20 minutes until tender. While they cook, mix the beef mince, rolled oats, egg, finely chopped onion, garlic, parsley, Dijon mustard, Worcestershire sauce, black pepper, and salt in a bowl until just combined. Shape the mixture into 4 oval patties and let them rest for 5 minutes so they hold together better. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and brown the patties for 3 to 4 minutes per side until nicely coloured. Remove them to a plate. Add the sliced onion and mushrooms to the same pan and cook over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes until softened and lightly browned. Sprinkle in the flour and stir for 1 minute, then add the beef stock, tomato paste, and Worcestershire sauce, stirring until smooth. Return the patties to the pan, lower the heat, and simmer gently for 10 to 12 minutes until the sauce thickens and the patties are cooked through. Drain the potatoes and carrots, mash the potatoes with the butter, and serve the Salisbury steaks topped with mushroom onion gravy alongside the vegetables.

title: Lemon Herb Baked Salmon with Quinoa and Roasted Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["600 g salmon fillet, raw, skinless", "180 g quinoa, dry", "500 g broccoli florets, raw", "200 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "20 g red onion, raw", "20 ml olive oil", "30 ml lemon juice, freshly squeezed", "2 g garlic, fresh, minced", "2 g dill, fresh", "2 g parsley, fresh", "3 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Rinse the quinoa well, then cook it in 360 ml water over medium heat for about 15 minutes until the grains are tender and the liquid is absorbed. Fluff it with a fork and keep it covered. Toss the broccoli, cherry tomatoes, and sliced red onion with half of the olive oil, 1 g of the salt, and half of the pepper, then spread them on the tray. Roast for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, mix the lemon juice, garlic, chopped dill, chopped parsley, the remaining olive oil, the remaining salt, and the remaining pepper. Place the salmon on the tray after the vegetables have started roasting, brush it with the lemon herb mixture, and return everything to the oven for 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily and the broccoli is lightly browned at the edges. Serve the salmon over the quinoa with the roasted vegetables spooned alongside.

title: Lemon Herb Salmon with Roasted Broccoli and Quinoa
ingredients_json: ["320 g salmon fillet, raw", "120 g quinoa, dry", "300 g broccoli, raw", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "15 ml olive oil", "20 ml lemon juice", "2 g lemon zest", "2 g garlic, fresh", "2 g dried dill", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Rinse the quinoa well, then cook it in 240 ml water over a medium heat for about 15 minutes until the grains are tender and the water is absorbed. Set it aside with the lid on for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, place the broccoli and cherry tomatoes on a baking tray, toss with half of the olive oil, half of the salt, and a little black pepper, then roast for 15 minutes. Mix the lemon juice, lemon zest, grated garlic, dill, remaining olive oil, remaining salt, and black pepper, then brush or spoon it over the salmon fillets. Add the salmon to the tray and roast for 10 to 12 minutes more, until the fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork. Fluff the quinoa, stir in the chopped parsley, and serve it with the roasted vegetables and salmon.

title: Lemon Herb Salmon with Quinoa and Roasted Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["300 g salmon fillet, raw, without skin", "140 g quinoa, dry", "400 g broccoli, raw", "200 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "1 piece lemon", "15 ml olive oil", "2 g garlic powder", "2 g dried dill", "2 g black pepper", "3 g salt", "10 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Rinse the quinoa well, then cook it in 280 ml water over medium heat for about 15 minutes until the grains are tender and the liquid is absorbed. While the quinoa cooks, cut the broccoli into small florets and halve the cherry tomatoes. Place them on the baking tray, drizzle with half of the olive oil, and season with 2 g of the salt, half of the black pepper, and the garlic powder. Roast for 15 minutes, stirring once halfway through. Pat the salmon dry and place it on the tray with the vegetables for the last 10 to 12 minutes of roasting. Brush the salmon with the remaining olive oil, sprinkle with dill, the rest of the salt, and the remaining black pepper, then top with lemon slices. Cook until the salmon flakes easily with a fork and is just opaque in the center. Fluff the quinoa, chop the parsley, and serve the salmon over the quinoa with the roasted vegetables and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.

title: Lemon-Dill Baked Salmon with Quinoa and Roasted Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["320 g salmon fillet, raw, with skin", "120 g quinoa, dry", "300 g broccoli florets, raw", "200 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "20 ml olive oil", "15 ml lemon juice, freshly squeezed", "2 g lemon zest", "2 g garlic, fresh, minced", "2 g dill, fresh", "3 g parsley, fresh", "2 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "300 ml water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Rinse the quinoa under cold water, then combine it with the water in a saucepan. Bring it to a boil over medium heat, reduce to low, cover, and simmer for about 15 minutes until the water is absorbed and the grains are tender. Remove from the heat and let it stand covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Meanwhile, place the broccoli and cherry tomatoes on a baking tray, toss with half of the olive oil, half of the salt, and a little black pepper, and roast for 15 minutes. Mix the remaining olive oil with lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, dill, parsley, the remaining salt, and the rest of the black pepper. Place the salmon on a lined baking tray, spoon the lemon-herb mixture over the top, and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the fish flakes easily and is just opaque in the center. Serve the salmon with the quinoa and roasted vegetables while hot, spooning any juices from the tray over the fish.

title: Baked Salmon with Lemon-Dill Quinoa and Roasted Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["320 g salmon fillet, raw, without skin", "120 g quinoa, dry", "300 g broccoli florets, raw", "150 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece lemon, raw", "10 g fresh dill", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Rinse the quinoa under cold water, then cook it in 300 ml water over medium heat for about 15 minutes until the grains are tender and the water is absorbed. Fluff it with a fork and stir in half of the lemon zest, half of the chopped dill, and half of the lemon juice. Place the broccoli and cherry tomatoes on a baking tray, toss them with 10 ml of the olive oil, the crushed garlic, black pepper, and half of the salt, then roast for 15 minutes. Pat the salmon fillets dry, place them on a second tray or add them to the vegetables for the last 12 to 14 minutes of cooking, and drizzle with the remaining olive oil, lemon juice, and salt. Cook until the salmon flakes easily with a fork and the centre is just opaque. Serve the salmon over the quinoa with the roasted vegetables and the remaining dill on top.

title: Grilled Chicken and Avocado Hummus Sandwiches with Tomato and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "4 slices Wholemeal bread", "80 g Hummus, plain", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "80 g Tomato, raw", "40 g Baby spinach, raw", "20 g Red onion, raw", "10 ml Lemon juice", "5 ml Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Pat the chicken breast dry and season it with salt and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the chicken for about 5 to 6 minutes per side, until golden on the outside and cooked through with no pink in the centre. Transfer it to a plate and let it rest for 5 minutes, then slice it thinly. Toast the wholemeal bread lightly so it is warm and crisp. Mash the avocado with the lemon juice, then spread the hummus over two slices of bread and the avocado mixture over the other two. Divide the spinach, tomato slices, red onion, and sliced chicken between the sandwiches, then close them and press gently. Cut each sandwich in half and serve while the bread is still warm.

title: Grilled Chicken and Avocado Hummus Sandwiches with Tomato and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "8 slices Wholemeal bread", "120 g Hummus, plain", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "2 medium Tomato, raw", "40 g Baby spinach, raw", "1 medium Red onion, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 tbsp Lemon juice, raw", "1 tsp Salt, table", "1 tsp Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Rub the chicken breasts with olive oil, half of the lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, then cook them for about 5 to 6 minutes per side until nicely browned and cooked through, with the juices running clear. Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly. Toast the bread slices lightly so they are warm and sturdy. Spread hummus on 4 slices of bread, then layer on the spinach, sliced tomato, thinly sliced red onion, avocado, and the sliced chicken. Drizzle over the remaining lemon juice, close the sandwiches with the remaining bread slices, and cut each sandwich in half before serving.

title: Grilled Chicken and Avocado Wholegrain Sandwiches with Lemon Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["320 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "8 slices Wholemeal bread", "1 piece Avocado, raw, flesh only", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 g Lemon juice", "20 g Baby spinach leaves, raw", "80 g Tomato, raw", "40 g Red onion, raw", "10 g Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground", "2 g Garlic powder"]
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Rub the chicken breast fillets with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder, then cook for about 5 to 6 minutes per side until the surface is well browned and the centre is no longer pink. Transfer the chicken to a board and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly. In a small bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with lemon juice until smooth. Toast the wholemeal bread lightly so it is warm and firm enough to hold the filling. Slice the avocado, tomato, and red onion. Spread the lemon yogurt on the bread, then layer with spinach, tomato, onion, avocado, and sliced chicken. Close the sandwiches, cut each one in half, and serve immediately while the bread is still crisp and the chicken is warm.

title: Grilled Chicken Hummus Sandwiches with Avocado and Crunchy Salad
ingredients_json: ["320 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "8 slices Wholemeal bread", "120 g Hummus, plain", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "120 g Tomato, raw", "80 g Cucumber, raw", "40 g Red onion, raw", "40 g Lettuce, romaine, raw", "15 ml Olive oil", "10 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "2 g Black pepper, ground", "3 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Season the chicken breast fillets with salt, black pepper, and half of the lemon juice. Heat the olive oil in a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for about 5 to 6 minutes per side until nicely browned and cooked through, with the juices running clear. Transfer the chicken to a board and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly. Toast the wholemeal bread lightly until just golden. Mash the avocado with the remaining lemon juice. Slice the tomato, cucumber, and red onion thinly, and shred the lettuce. Spread hummus on four slices of bread, then top with lettuce, sliced chicken, tomato, cucumber, red onion, and avocado. Close with the remaining bread slices, press gently, and cut each sandwich in half before serving.

title: Grilled Chicken and Avocado Wholegrain Sandwiches with Lemon Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast fillet, raw", "8 slices Wholemeal bread", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "20 g Mayonnaise, reduced fat", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, raw", "2 tsp Dijon mustard", "60 g Tomato, raw", "40 g Cucumber, raw", "40 g Lettuce, raw", "10 g Red onion, raw", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or frying pan over medium-high heat. Cut the chicken breast fillets in half lengthwise so they cook evenly, then rub them with olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Cook the chicken for about 5 to 6 minutes per side until well browned, cooked through, and the juices run clear. Transfer to a board and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly. In a small bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, reduced-fat mayonnaise, lemon juice, and Dijon mustard until smooth. Toast the wholemeal bread lightly so it stays sturdy. Mash the avocado and spread it over four slices of bread, then add lettuce, tomato, cucumber, red onion, and sliced chicken. Spoon over some of the yogurt dressing, top with the remaining bread slices, and press gently. Cut each sandwich in half and serve while the chicken is still slightly warm.

title: Tray-Baked Chicken Sausage with Roasted Vegetables and Lentils
ingredients_json: ["400 g chicken sausage, cooked", "250 g red lentils, cooked", "300 g courgette, raw", "200 g red bell pepper, raw", "200 g red onion, raw", "250 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "2 g garlic, raw", "2 g dried thyme", "3 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "15 ml lemon juice, raw", "20 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C. Cut the courgette, red bell pepper, and red onion into bite-sized pieces and spread them over a large baking tray with the cherry tomatoes. Drizzle with the olive oil, add the garlic, thyme, salt, and black pepper, then toss well so everything is lightly coated. Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the vegetables are tender and starting to caramelise at the edges. Slice the chicken sausage and warm it through in the oven for the last 5 minutes of cooking. Tip the cooked lentils into a pan with a splash of water and heat gently for 3 to 4 minutes until hot. Combine the lentils and roasted vegetables on serving plates, top with the warmed sausage, then finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley.

title: Herbed Chicken Sausages with Roasted Peppers, Lentils and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["320 g chicken sausage, raw", "240 g cooked lentils, drained", "200 g red bell pepper", "150 g zucchini", "120 g red onion", "80 g baby spinach", "15 ml olive oil", "2 g garlic, fresh", "2 g smoked paprika", "1 g ground black pepper", "3 g dried thyme", "2 g salt", "20 g whole grain mustard", "30 ml water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Slice the red bell pepper, zucchini and red onion into even pieces, then place them in a roasting dish with the olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, thyme, black pepper and salt. Toss well so the vegetables are lightly coated, then roast for 15 minutes until they start to soften and take on colour. Add the chicken sausages to the dish and roast for another 15 to 18 minutes, turning them once halfway through, until they are browned and cooked through with an internal temperature of 75°C. While the sausages finish cooking, warm the lentils in a saucepan with the water over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes. Stir the spinach into the hot lentils just until wilted, then mix in the mustard. Serve the lentils and vegetables topped with the sausages and any pan juices.

title: Italian Sausage and Bean Tray Bake with Roasted Peppers and Spinach
ingredients_json: ["400 g pork sausage, reduced fat", "240 g cannellini beans, canned, drained", "200 g red bell pepper, raw", "150 g zucchini, raw", "150 g red onion, raw", "150 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "100 g baby spinach, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 g dried oregano", "1 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "30 g wholemeal breadcrumbs", "15 g Parmesan cheese, grated"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Cut the sausages into thick pieces and place them in a large roasting dish with the peppers, zucchini, red onion and cherry tomatoes. Drizzle with the olive oil, add the garlic, oregano, black pepper and salt, then toss everything so the vegetables are lightly coated. Roast for 20 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the sausages are browned and the vegetables are starting to soften. Add the cannellini beans and spinach, then stir gently so the spinach begins to wilt and the beans warm through. Sprinkle over the wholemeal breadcrumbs and Parmesan, then return the dish to the oven for 8 to 10 minutes more until the top is lightly crisp and the sausages are cooked through. Let the tray bake rest for 5 minutes before serving so the juices settle.

title: Chicken Sausages with Warm Lentil and Roasted Vegetable Traybake
ingredients_json: ["6 pieces chicken sausage", "250 g cooked lentils, drained", "200 g courgette", "200 g red bell pepper", "150 g red onion", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "2 tbsp olive oil", "2 cloves garlic", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "20 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Slice the courgette, red pepper, and red onion into bite-sized pieces and spread them on a large baking tray with the cherry tomatoes. Add the olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, thyme, salt, and black pepper, then toss well so everything is evenly coated. Roast for 20 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until the vegetables are starting to soften and caramelise. Add the chicken sausages to the tray and roast for another 15 minutes, turning them once, until they are browned and cooked through. Warm the lentils in a small pan with a splash of water over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, then stir in the lemon juice. Spoon the lentils onto plates, top with the roasted vegetables and sausages, and finish with chopped parsley.

title: Herby Chicken Sausage Traybake with Sweet Potatoes, Peppers and Lentils

title: Ginger Soy Seitan Stir-Fry with Brown Rice and Broccoli

title: Lean Lamb Shepherd's Pie with Lentils and Sweet Potato Mash

title: Turkey and Black Bean Sliders with Avocado Yogurt Slaw

title: Turkey and Bean Sloppy Joes with Smoky Tomato Sauce

title: Braised Swiss Steak with Tomatoes, Onions and Mushrooms
ingredients_json: ["700 g beef round steak, lean, raw", "30 g wholemeal wheat flour", "15 ml rapeseed oil", "200 g onion, raw", "120 g carrot, raw", "150 g celery, raw", "200 g mushroom, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "400 g tomato, canned, diced, no added salt", "200 ml beef stock, reduced salt", "15 g tomato paste", "10 ml Worcestershire sauce", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g paprika, sweet", "2 g dried thyme", "150 g potato, raw", "200 g green beans, raw", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C. Pat the beef dry and lightly coat it with the wholemeal flour, pressing so the surface is evenly covered. Heat the rapeseed oil in a heavy ovenproof pot over medium-high heat, then brown the beef for 2 to 3 minutes on each side until deep golden. Remove the meat and lower the heat to medium. Add the onion, carrot, celery and mushrooms, then cook for about 6 minutes until softened and lightly coloured. Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, paprika and thyme and cook for 1 minute more until fragrant. Pour in the tomatoes, beef stock and Worcestershire sauce, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Return the beef to the pot, nestling it into the sauce. Cover and braise in the oven for 1 hour 15 minutes to 1 hour 30 minutes, until the beef is very tender. Add the potato during the last 35 minutes of cooking so it becomes tender without falling apart, and add the green beans for the final 10 minutes. Finish with black pepper and chopped parsley, then serve hot with the vegetables and sauce spooned over the steak.

title: Braised Swiss Steak with Tomato, Onion and Peppers
ingredients_json: ["700 g beef round steak", "20 g wholemeal wheat flour", "12 g rapeseed oil", "150 g onion", "120 g carrot", "150 g red bell pepper", "200 g celery", "2 cloves garlic", "400 g canned chopped tomatoes", "150 ml low-sodium beef stock", "15 ml tomato paste", "2 g dried thyme", "1 g bay leaf", "3 g black pepper", "5 g salt", "20 g fresh parsley"]
instructions: Trim any visible fat from the beef and cut it into 4 even portions. Coat the meat lightly with the wholemeal flour and black pepper, pressing it on so it sticks. Heat the rapeseed oil in a heavy casserole over medium-high heat, then brown the beef for about 2 minutes on each side until a good crust forms. Remove the beef and lower the heat to medium. Add the onion, carrot, celery and red bell pepper and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables begin to soften and the onion looks translucent. Stir in the garlic and tomato paste and cook for 1 minute until fragrant. Pour in the chopped tomatoes and beef stock, then add the thyme, bay leaf and salt. Return the beef to the pan, nestling it into the sauce. Bring the liquid to a gentle simmer, cover with a lid, and cook on low heat for 1.5 to 2 hours until the beef is fork-tender and the sauce is rich. Stir once or twice during cooking and add a small splash of water if the sauce reduces too much. Remove the bay leaf, stir through the chopped parsley, and serve hot with the vegetables spooned over the meat.

title: Lean Turkey Taco Salad with Black Beans, Avocado and Lime Yogurt Dressing
ingredients_json: ["400 g turkey mince, lean", "1 tbsp rapeseed oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 tsp ground cumin", "2 tsp paprika powder", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp chili powder", "400 g black beans, canned, drained", "200 g sweetcorn, canned, drained", "300 g lettuce, romaine, raw", "200 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "1 piece avocado, raw", "100 g cucumber, raw", "60 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "30 ml lime juice, raw", "20 g salsa, tomato-based", "30 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat, grated", "40 g tortilla chips, baked", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the rapeseed oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic, cumin, paprika, oregano, chili powder, and salt, then add the turkey mince. Cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is browned all the way through and no longer pink. Add the black beans and sweetcorn and warm through for 2 to 3 minutes, then remove the pan from the heat. In a small bowl, mix the Greek yogurt, lime juice, and salsa to make a quick dressing. Arrange the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, and sliced avocado in bowls, spoon over the warm turkey mixture, and drizzle with the dressing. Finish with the grated cheddar and baked tortilla chips just before serving so they stay crisp.

title: Lean Turkey Taco Salad with Black Beans, Avocado and Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["400 g turkey mince, lean", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "2 tsp ground cumin", "2 tsp sweet paprika", "1 tsp ground coriander", "1 tsp chili powder", "200 g black beans, canned, drained", "150 g sweetcorn, canned, drained", "100 g tomato, raw", "100 g cucumber, raw", "120 g romaine lettuce", "80 g cherry tomatoes", "1 medium avocado, raw", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "15 ml lime juice", "10 g fresh coriander leaves", "30 g whole grain tortilla chips", "5 g salt"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic, cumin, paprika, coriander, and chili powder and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is browned and cooked through with no pink remaining. Stir in the black beans and sweetcorn and warm everything together for 2 minutes. Meanwhile, mix the yogurt with the lime juice and half of the coriander to make a quick dressing. Divide the lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and cherry tomatoes between four bowls. Spoon the hot turkey mixture over the vegetables, top with avocado slices and tortilla chips, then drizzle with the lime yogurt. Finish with the remaining coriander and serve immediately.

title: Turkey Taco Salad with Black Beans, Avocado and Lime Yogurt Dressing

title: Turkey and Black Bean Tacos with Lime Yogurt and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["8 pieces corn tortillas", "400 g turkey mince, lean", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 tsp dried oregano", "0.5 tsp chili powder", "200 g black beans, cooked, drained", "200 g tomatoes, chopped, canned", "1 g salt, table", "1 g black pepper, ground", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "15 ml lime juice", "80 g avocado", "100 g red cabbage, raw", "80 g lettuce, iceberg, raw", "40 g coriander, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until soft and translucent, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince, break it up with a spoon, and cook over medium-high heat for about 6 to 8 minutes until no pink remains. Stir in the cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, chili powder, salt, and black pepper, then add the black beans and chopped tomatoes. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the filling is thick and well combined. title: Chicken and Black Bean Tacos with Lime Yogurt and Avocado Salsa
ingredients_json: ["400 g Chicken breast, raw, skinless", "8 pieces Corn tortilla", "200 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "150 g Onion, raw", "150 g Red bell pepper, raw", "2 tbsp Olive oil", "2 tsp Ground cumin", "2 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 tsp Garlic powder", "1 tsp Salt", "1 piece Lime, raw", "200 g Plain yogurt, low fat", "120 g Avocado, raw", "80 g Tomato, raw", "40 g Lettuce, raw", "20 g Fresh coriander", "1 piece Jalapeño pepper, raw"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and season it with half of the cumin, paprika, garlic powder, and salt. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is browned and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the pan and keep it warm. Add the remaining oil to the same skillet, then cook the sliced onion and red bell pepper over medium heat for about 6 minutes until softened and lightly browned. Stir in the black beans, the remaining spices, and a splash of water, then cook for 2 minutes until the beans are heated through. Warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan over medium heat for about 30 seconds per side until pliable. Mash the avocado with diced tomato, chopped coriander, and finely chopped jalapeño, then stir in half of the lime juice. Mix the yogurt with the remaining lime juice to make a quick sauce. Fill each tortilla with chicken, bean and pepper mixture, lettuce, avocado salsa, and a spoonful of lime yogurt. Serve immediately while the tortillas are warm and the filling is juicy.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Tacos with Avocado Lime Slaw
ingredients_json: ["300 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "8 pieces corn tortillas, small", "200 g black beans, canned, drained", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 clove garlic, raw", "1 piece onion, red, raw", "150 g cabbage, white, raw", "1 piece carrot, raw", "1 piece avocado, raw flesh", "2 tbsp plain yogurt, low fat", "1 piece lime, raw", "80 g tomato, raw", "20 g coriander leaf, raw", "2 g salt, table"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and mix it with cumin, smoked paprika, grated garlic, and half of the salt. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes until browned and cooked through. Add the sliced red onion and black beans for the last 2 minutes so the onion softens and the beans heat through. Meanwhile, shred the cabbage and carrot finely, then mix them with diced avocado, yogurt, lime juice, chopped coriander, and the remaining salt to make a fresh slaw. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan over medium heat for about 20 seconds per side until pliable. Fill each tortilla with the chicken and bean mixture, top with the avocado lime slaw and diced tomato, and serve immediately while everything is warm and crisp.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Tacos with Lime Yogurt and Avocado
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, raw", "8 pieces Tortilla, corn", "240 g Black beans, canned, drained", "150 g Tomato, raw", "80 g Onion, red, raw", "1 piece Avocado, raw", "150 g Cabbage, red, raw", "100 g Yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 ml Lime juice, raw", "10 g Coriander leaves, fresh", "15 ml Olive oil", "2 g Cumin, ground", "2 g Paprika, sweet", "2 g Garlic powder", "3 g Salt, table", "1 g Black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into thin strips and place it in a bowl with the olive oil, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and let it sit for 10 minutes while you prepare the vegetables. Finely shred the red cabbage, dice the tomato, thinly slice the red onion, and chop the coriander. Mash the avocado with the lime juice and stir in the yogurt to make a creamy topping. Heat a large frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is browned and cooked through with no pink remaining. Warm the black beans in a small saucepan over low heat for 3 to 4 minutes until hot. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan over medium heat for about 20 seconds per side until soft and flexible. Fill each tortilla with chicken, black beans, cabbage, tomato, and onion, then spoon over the avocado yogurt and finish with coriander. Serve immediately while the tortillas are warm and the filling is juicy.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Tacos with Avocado Lime Slaw
ingredients_json: ["300 g Chicken breast, raw, skinless", "8 pieces Corn tortilla", "150 g Black beans, cooked, drained", "1 tbsp Olive oil", "1 tsp Ground cumin", "1 tsp Smoked paprika", "1 clove Garlic, raw", "1 piece Onion, yellow, raw", "150 g Cabbage, white, raw", "1 piece Carrot, raw", "1 piece Avocado, raw, edible portion", "1 piece Lime, raw", "100 g Tomato, raw", "30 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "10 g Coriander, fresh", "2 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into thin strips and season it with cumin, smoked paprika, minced garlic, and half of the salt. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned and cooked through. Add the sliced onion and black beans and cook for another 2 minutes until the onion softens and the beans are hot.
