Warm the corn tortillas in a dry pan over medium heat for about 20 seconds per side until soft and flexible. Spoon the chicken and bean mixture into the tortillas, top with the slaw, and serve immediately while everything is warm and crisp.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Tamales with Roasted Corn and Tomato Salsa
ingredients_json: ["250 g corn masa harina", "300 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "60 g olive oil", "200 g cooked chicken breast, shredded", "150 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "120 g sweetcorn kernels", "80 g onion, finely diced", "2 cloves garlic, minced", "150 g tomato, diced", "30 g fresh coriander leaves", "1 medium avocado", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "4 g salt", "2 g black pepper", "12 dried corn husks", "15 ml lime juice"]
instructions: Soak the corn husks in hot water for at least 30 minutes, then drain them and pat them dry. In a pan over medium heat, warm a little of the olive oil and cook the onion for 4 to 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, black pepper, and a small amount of salt, then cook for 1 minute more. Stir in the shredded chicken, black beans, sweetcorn, and lime juice, and cook just until heated through. In a bowl, mix the masa harina with the remaining olive oil and chicken stock until you get a soft, spreadable dough; it should hold together but not be runny. Lay a corn husk flat, spread about 2 tablespoons of masa over the center, add a spoonful of the filling, and fold the sides and bottom up to enclose it. Repeat with the remaining husks and filling. Arrange the tamales upright in a steamer, cover them with a lid and steam over medium heat for about 45 to 55 minutes, adding more water if needed. They are ready when the masa peels cleanly away from the husk and feels firm. Serve warm with diced tomato, chopped coriander, and sliced avocado on top.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Tamales with Corn Masa and Mild Salsa Verde
ingredients_json: ["500 g masa harina", "250 g chicken breast, boneless, skinless", "150 g black beans, canned, drained", "150 g corn kernels, frozen", "80 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "30 g tomato paste", "15 g olive oil", "500 ml chicken stock, low sodium", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "120 g salsa verde", "8 g baking powder", "6 g salt", "2 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "1 g black pepper", "20 g fresh coriander leaves", "12 dried corn husks"]
instructions: Soak the corn husks in hot water for at least 30 minutes until flexible, then drain and pat them dry. Heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika and black pepper, then cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Stir in the chicken breast and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until just cooked through. Shred the chicken finely, then mix it with the black beans, corn kernels, tomato paste and half of the coriander. In a large bowl, beat the masa harina with the baking powder and salt, then gradually add the warm chicken stock until you have a soft, spreadable dough. Whisk in the Greek yogurt for a lighter, moist masa. Lay a husk on the work surface and spread about 3 tablespoons of masa down the centre, leaving space at the sides. Add 2 tablespoons of filling in the middle, then fold the sides of the husk over the filling and fold up the bottom to enclose it. Repeat with the remaining husks. Arrange the tamales upright in a steamer basket, cover with extra husks or a clean cloth, and steam over gently bubbling water for 55 to 65 minutes over medium-low heat. The tamales are ready when the masa feels firm and pulls away cleanly from the husk. Serve warm with salsa verde and the remaining coriander spooned over the top.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Tamales with Roasted Tomato Salsa
ingredients_json: ["300 g corn masa harina", "450 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "60 g olive oil", "12 g baking powder", "5 g salt", "8 dried corn husks", "250 g chicken breast, skinless", "120 g black beans, cooked, drained", "100 g onion, finely chopped", "2 cloves garlic", "80 g roasted red peppers, drained", "10 g ground cumin", "5 g smoked paprika", "15 ml lime juice", "20 g fresh coriander", "200 g tomatoes, chopped", "30 g plain yogurt, low-fat"]
instructions: Place the dried corn husks in a bowl, cover them with hot water, and let them soak for 30 minutes until flexible. Meanwhile, season the chicken breast with half of the cumin, half of the paprika, and a little salt, then cook it in a hot pan over medium heat for about 6 to 8 minutes per side until fully cooked and lightly golden. Rest the chicken for 5 minutes, then shred it finely. In the same pan, soften the onion over medium heat for 4 minutes, add the garlic for 1 minute, then stir in the black beans, roasted red peppers, lime juice, remaining spices, and half of the coriander. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes until fragrant, then mix in the shredded chicken and remove from the heat. In a large bowl, whisk the masa harina, baking powder, salt, chicken stock, and olive oil into a soft dough that holds together but is not sticky; add a little more stock if needed. Drain the corn husks and pat them dry. Spread a thin layer of masa onto the wide side of each husk, leaving space at the edges, then spoon the filling down the center and fold the sides over before folding the bottom up. Arrange the tamales upright in a steamer basket, cover them with extra husks or a clean cloth, and steam over medium heat for about 60 minutes. They are ready when the husks peel away easily from the masa. While they steam, stir the tomatoes with the yogurt and remaining coriander to make a fresh salsa. Let the tamales rest for 10 minutes before serving with the salsa.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Tamales with Green Chile and Corn
ingredients_json: ["300 g corn masa harina", "600 ml hot vegetable broth", "60 g lard", "10 g baking powder", "6 g salt", "250 g cooked chicken breast, shredded", "150 g canned black beans, drained", "120 g roasted green chiles, chopped", "80 g onion, finely diced", "15 g garlic, minced", "10 ml olive oil", "100 g sweetcorn kernels", "20 g fresh coriander leaves", "8 g ground cumin", "6 g smoked paprika", "12 dried corn husks", "60 ml salsa verde"]
instructions: Soak the corn husks in hot water for at least 30 minutes until flexible, then drain them well. Warm the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 to 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, green chiles, black beans, sweetcorn, and shredded chicken, then cook for 3 minutes more until fragrant and heated through. Stir in the coriander and remove the filling from the heat. In a large bowl, beat the lard until soft, then mix in the masa harina, baking powder, salt, and hot vegetable broth little by little until you have a smooth, spreadable dough that holds together but is not wet. Spread about 2 tablespoons of masa onto the centre of each husk, add a spoonful of filling down the middle, and fold the sides and bottom over the filling to form neat parcels. Arrange the tamales upright in a steamer basket with the open ends facing up. Steam over medium heat for about 60 to 75 minutes, topping up the water if needed, until the masa pulls away from the husk easily and feels firm. Let the tamales rest for 10 minutes before serving with salsa verde.

title: Chicken and Black Bean Tamales with Roasted Corn and Mild Chile Salsa
ingredients_json: ["400 g masa harina", "8 g baking powder", "6 g fine salt", "60 g lard", "500 ml warm vegetable stock", "200 g cooked chicken breast, shredded", "150 g canned black beans, drained", "120 g roasted sweet corn kernels", "80 g onion, finely diced", "10 g garlic, minced", "5 g ground cumin", "2 g smoked paprika", "15 ml olive oil", "120 g green salsa verde", "30 g fresh cilantro", "16 dried corn husks", "1000 ml water"]
instructions: Soak the corn husks in the water for at least 30 minutes until they are flexible, then drain them well. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes until soft, then add the garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute more. Stir in the shredded chicken, black beans, corn, and salsa verde, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the filling is hot and lightly thickened. In a large bowl, mix the masa harina, baking powder, and salt, then rub in the lard until the mixture looks sandy. Add the warm vegetable stock gradually and beat for 2 to 3 minutes until the dough is soft, smooth, and spreadable; it should hold together without feeling wet. Pat dry a corn husk and spread about 2 tablespoons of masa over the center, leaving space around the edges. Spoon 1 to 2 tablespoons of filling down the middle, add a little cilantro, and fold the husk to enclose the filling, then fold the narrow end up. Arrange the tamales upright in a steamer basket, cover with extra husks or a clean cloth, and steam over medium heat for 60 to 75 minutes, topping up the water if needed. The tamales are ready when the masa pulls away cleanly from the husk and feels firm, not sticky. Let them rest for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Turkey and Vegetable Tater Tot Casserole with Light Cheddar
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "150 g frozen peas", "200 g mushrooms, raw", "400 g crushed tomatoes, canned", "2 tbsp tomato paste", "150 ml low-sodium chicken stock", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "1 tsp dried thyme", "1 tsp paprika, sweet", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "600 g potato nuggets, frozen", "80 g cheddar cheese, reduced-fat, grated", "2 tbsp parsley, fresh, chopped"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and lightly grease a medium baking dish. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, then add the onion and carrot and cook for about 5 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and mushrooms and cook for another 3 minutes until the mushrooms release their moisture. Add the turkey mince and cook over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink. Stir in the tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, chicken stock, thyme, paprika, black pepper, and salt, then simmer for 8 to 10 minutes until the mixture thickens slightly. Remove the pan from the heat and stir through the peas and Greek yogurt so the filling becomes creamy. Spoon the mixture into the baking dish and spread it into an even layer. Arrange the frozen potato nuggets over the top in a single layer, then sprinkle with the grated cheddar. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until the topping is golden and crisp and the filling is bubbling around the edges. Let the casserole rest for 5 minutes before serving, then finish with chopped parsley.

title: Turkey and Vegetable Tater Tot Casserole with Light Cheddar
ingredients_json: ["450 g lean ground turkey", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece yellow onion", "2 cloves garlic", "150 g carrots", "150 g frozen peas", "200 g chopped spinach, frozen", "300 g canned diced tomatoes", "30 g tomato paste", "150 ml low-sodium vegetable broth", "5 g dried thyme", "2 g black pepper", "3 g salt", "15 g whole wheat flour", "300 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "120 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese", "600 g frozen tater tots"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and lightly grease a medium baking dish. Add the garlic and ground turkey, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until no pink remains. Stir in the flour and tomato paste, then add the diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, thyme, black pepper, salt, peas, and spinach. Simmer for 4 to 5 minutes until the mixture thickens and the vegetables are heated through. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the Greek yogurt for a creamy, slightly tangy sauce. Spread the turkey mixture evenly into the baking dish and top with the tater tots in a single layer. Sprinkle the cheddar over the top and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the tots are crisp and the casserole is bubbling around the edges. Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving so it sets up neatly.

title: Turkey and Vegetable Tater Tot Casserole with Light Cheddar
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "150 g frozen peas", "200 g mushrooms, raw", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "120 g tomato puree", "100 ml low sodium chicken stock", "5 g dried thyme", "2 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt", "800 g potato croquettes, frozen", "120 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and lightly grease a medium baking dish. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, then add the onion and carrot and cook for 5 minutes until the onion softens. Add the garlic and mushrooms and cook for another 3 minutes until the mushrooms release their moisture. ingredients_json: ["400 g fresh cheese tortellini", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g mushrooms, raw", "150 g spinach, raw", "200 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "50 g grated parmesan cheese", "30 ml lemon juice", "50 ml water", "2 g black pepper", "2 g salt", "10 g fresh basil"]
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil over high heat and cook the tortellini according to the package directions until just tender. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they release their moisture and start to brown. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes, then add the spinach and let it wilt down. Lower the heat to low and stir in the yogurt, lemon juice, water, parmesan, black pepper, and salt, keeping the sauce gentle so it does not curdle. Drain the tortellini, reserve a small splash of cooking water, and add the pasta to the skillet. Toss everything together for 1 to 2 minutes until well coated and glossy, adding a little reserved water if needed for a smoother sauce. Finish with torn basil and serve immediately.

title: Crispy Black Bean and Avocado Chicken Tostadas with Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["4 piece corn tostada shells", "300 g chicken breast, skinless, raw", "2 tsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp paprika, smoked", "1/2 tsp garlic powder", "1/2 tsp salt", "200 g black beans, cooked, drained", "80 g sweetcorn kernels, cooked", "100 g cherry tomatoes", "80 g red onion", "1 piece avocado", "100 g lettuce, romaine, raw", "100 g plain yogurt, low fat", "15 ml lime juice", "10 g fresh coriander leaves", "1 piece jalapeño pepper, fresh", "20 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Place the chicken breast on a tray, rub it with olive oil, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, and salt, then roast for 18 to 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear. Let it rest for 5 minutes, then slice it thinly. Warm the black beans and sweetcorn in a small pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until hot. In a bowl, mix the yogurt with lime juice and chopped coriander to make a quick sauce. Dice the tomatoes, red onion, avocado, and jalapeño, and shred the lettuce. Warm the tostada shells in the oven for 2 minutes so they stay crisp. Assemble each tostada with lettuce, black beans and sweetcorn, sliced chicken, tomato, red onion, avocado, and a little cheese, then finish with the lime yogurt sauce and jalapeño. Serve immediately while the shells are crisp.

title: Crispy Black Bean and Avocado Tostadas with Lime Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["8 pieces corn tostada shells", "400 g black beans, canned, drained", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 g salt", "150 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "1 piece avocado, raw, medium", "1 piece lime, raw", "120 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "80 g lettuce, romaine, raw", "30 g red onion, raw", "20 g coriander, fresh", "40 g cheese, feta, reduced fat"]
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, and salt and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the black beans and 2 tablespoons of water, then cook for 3 to 4 minutes, mashing some of the beans with a spoon so the mixture becomes thick and spreadable. Warm the tostada shells in a 180 C oven for 3 to 4 minutes until crisp. In a small bowl, mix the yogurt with the juice of half the lime and a little grated zest. Slice the tomatoes, avocado, and red onion, and shred the lettuce. Spread the bean mixture over each tostada shell, top with lettuce, tomatoes, avocado, and red onion, then drizzle with the lime yogurt. Finish with crumbled feta, chopped coriander, and the remaining lime cut into wedges for serving.

title: Grilled Chicken and Black Bean Tostadas with Avocado Salsa
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces corn tostada shells", "300 g chicken breast, skinless, boneless", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp salt", "0.25 tsp ground black pepper", "200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "100 g cherry tomatoes, halved", "80 g romaine lettuce, shredded", "1 piece avocado, flesh", "50 g red onion, finely sliced", "30 g fresh coriander leaves", "1 piece lime, juice", "40 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "20 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese, grated"]
instructions: Preheat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Rub the chicken breast with olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, then cook for about 5 to 6 minutes per side until browned and fully cooked through with no pink in the centre. Transfer the chicken to a board and rest for 5 minutes before slicing thinly. Warm the black beans in a small pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes until hot. In a bowl, gently mash the avocado with lime juice and stir in the red onion and coriander to make a quick salsa. To assemble, place the tostada shells on plates, spread a spoonful of Greek yogurt over each one, then top with lettuce, black beans, sliced chicken, cherry tomatoes, avocado salsa, and a little grated cheddar. title: Chicken, Black Bean and Avocado Tostadas with Fresh Tomato Salsa
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces corn tostada shells", "250 g chicken breast, skinless, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "1 g garlic powder", "1 g fine salt", "200 g black beans, cooked, drained", "80 g red onion", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "10 g fresh coriander leaves", "15 ml lime juice", "1 piece avocado, edible portion 140 g", "80 g plain Greek yogurt, 2% fat", "60 g romaine lettuce", "20 g pickled jalapeños"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200°C and place the tostada shells on a tray for 3 to 4 minutes, just until crisp and warmed through. Mix the chicken with olive oil, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt, then cook it in a hot non-stick pan over medium-high heat for 5 to 7 minutes, turning once, until browned and fully cooked with no pink in the centre. Rest the chicken for 2 minutes, then slice it thinly. Meanwhile, combine the black beans with a splash of water in a small pan over medium heat and warm them for 3 to 4 minutes until steaming. Finely chop the red onion, cherry tomatoes, and coriander, then stir them together with the lime juice to make a fresh salsa. Slice the avocado and shred the lettuce. Spread a spoonful of Greek yogurt over each tostada shell, top with lettuce, warm black beans, chicken, salsa, avocado, and jalapeños, then serve immediately while the shells are still crisp.

title: Black Bean and Chicken Tostadas with Avocado Lime Salsa
ingredients_json: ["4 pieces corn tostada shells", "300 g chicken breast fillet, raw", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp smoked paprika", "0.5 tsp garlic powder", "0.5 tsp salt", "200 g canned black beans, drained and rinsed", "100 g cherry tomatoes", "80 g red onion", "1 piece avocado, raw, edible portion", "30 g lettuce, shredded", "50 g plain yogurt, low fat", "15 ml lime juice", "10 g fresh coriander leaves", "1 piece jalapeño pepper, fresh", "20 g feta cheese"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and place the tostada shells on a baking tray. Lightly warm them for 3 to 4 minutes so they stay crisp. Season the chicken breast with cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and salt, then heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for about 6 to 7 minutes per side until browned and cooked through, then rest it for 5 minutes before slicing. In a bowl, mix the black beans with the diced cherry tomatoes, finely chopped red onion, chopped coriander, jalapeño, and lime juice. Mash the avocado with the yogurt until creamy but still slightly chunky. Spread a thin layer of the avocado mixture over each tostada shell, add shredded lettuce, sliced chicken, and the bean salsa, then finish with crumbled feta. Serve immediately while the shells are crisp.

title: Creamy Wholewheat Tuna and Spinach Casserole with Sweetcorn
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "2 tbsp olive oil", "1 medium onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "250 g mushrooms, raw", "200 g spinach, raw", "2 cans tuna in water, drained", "300 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "20 g wholemeal flour", "100 g sweetcorn, canned, drained", "30 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and lightly grease a medium casserole dish. Cook the wholewheat pasta in a large pan of salted boiling water for about 8 minutes, until just tender, then drain well. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 4 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes until the mushrooms release their moisture and start to brown. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk until the sauce looks smooth and begins to thicken. Lower the heat and stir in the yogurt, oregano, black pepper, spinach, tuna, and sweetcorn. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes, just until the spinach wilts and everything is hot. Fold in the drained pasta and spoon the mixture into the casserole dish. Scatter the reduced-fat cheddar over the top and bake for 18 to 20 minutes, until bubbling around the edges and lightly golden on top. Let it stand for 5 minutes before serving so the sauce settles.

title: Creamy Tuna, Spinach and Wholewheat Pasta Casserole
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholewheat penne pasta, dry", "240 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "200 g mushrooms, raw", "150 g spinach, raw", "300 ml milk, low fat, 1.5%", "150 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "25 g flour, wholemeal", "15 g parmesan cheese, grated", "30 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat, grated", "5 g Dijon mustard", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt, iodised", "1 tsp dried parsley"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Cook the wholewheat pasta in a large pot of lightly salted water until just al dente, then drain well. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and soften the chopped onion for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and sliced mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes until the mushrooms release their moisture and start to brown. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk until smooth. Lower the heat and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes until the sauce thickens. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the yogurt, Dijon mustard, parmesan, black pepper, salt, and dried parsley. Fold in the tuna, spinach, and drained pasta, mixing until the spinach starts to wilt. Spoon everything into a medium casserole dish, scatter the cheddar over the top, and bake for 15 to 18 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving so the sauce settles.

title: Wholewheat Tuna and Vegetable Casserole with Light Cheddar Crust
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "320 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "200 g frozen peas, boiled", "150 g carrot, raw", "150 g courgette, raw", "120 g onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "25 g olive oil", "25 g plain wheat flour", "500 ml semi-skimmed milk", "100 g plain yogurt, low fat", "120 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "15 g Dijon mustard", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "10 g parsley, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and lightly oil a large casserole dish. Cook the wholewheat pasta in boiling salted water for about 2 minutes less than the packet time, then drain well. While the pasta cooks, dice the onion, carrot, and courgette, and finely chop the garlic. Warm the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat, then cook the onion and carrot for 5 minutes until they begin to soften. Add the courgette and garlic and cook for another 3 minutes. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until slightly thickened. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the yogurt, Dijon mustard, black pepper, and salt. Fold in the tuna, peas, cooked pasta, and chopped parsley, then transfer everything to the casserole dish. Scatter the reduced-fat cheddar evenly over the top and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until bubbling around the edges and golden on top. Let the casserole stand for 5 minutes before serving so it sets slightly.

title: Creamy Wholegrain Tuna, Spinach and Pea Bake
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholegrain pasta, dry", "240 g tuna, canned in spring water, drained", "200 g frozen peas", "150 g spinach, fresh", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "30 g wholemeal flour", "400 ml milk, semi-skimmed, pasteurised", "100 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "120 g cheddar cheese, reduced fat", "15 g wholegrain mustard", "5 ml lemon juice", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt", "20 g breadcrumbs, wholemeal"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and lightly grease a medium baking dish. Cook the wholegrain pasta in a large pot of salted water until just al dente, then drain well. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and soften the chopped onion for about 5 minutes until it becomes translucent. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Stir in the wholemeal flour and cook for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in the milk until smooth. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until it thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Remove from the heat and mix in the yogurt, mustard, lemon juice, black pepper, and salt. Fold in the tuna, peas, spinach, and half of the cheddar, then add the drained pasta and stir until everything is evenly coated. Transfer the mixture to the baking dish, sprinkle over the remaining cheddar and the wholemeal breadcrumbs, and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling and golden on top. Let it stand for 5 minutes before serving so it sets slightly.

title: Creamy Tuna, Spinach and Wholewheat Pasta Bake
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholewheat pasta, dry", "250 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "200 g spinach, raw", "150 g frozen peas", "200 g low-fat plain yogurt", "250 ml semi-skimmed milk", "25 g plain flour, wholemeal", "20 g olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "100 g reduced-fat cheddar cheese", "15 g breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "2 g ground black pepper", "2 g dried parsley", "1 g nutmeg, ground", "3 g salt, table"]

While the pasta cooks, heat the remaining olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and soften the chopped onion for about 5 minutes until it looks translucent. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep the heat at medium and simmer gently for 3 to 4 minutes until the sauce thickens. Remove from the heat and stir in the yogurt, black pepper, parsley, nutmeg, half of the cheese, the tuna, spinach, and peas. Fold in the pasta and mix until everything is evenly coated. Spoon the mixture into the casserole dish, sprinkle over the remaining cheese and the breadcrumbs, then bake for 20 to 25 minutes until hot throughout, bubbling at the edges, and golden on top. Let it stand for 5 minutes before serving so the sauce settles.

title: Mediterranean Tuna Salad with Chickpeas, Cucumber and Lemon Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["240 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "240 g chickpeas, canned, drained", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "120 g cucumber", "80 g red bell pepper", "60 g red onion", "80 g baby spinach", "30 g pitted black olives", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "15 ml lemon juice", "10 ml olive oil", "5 g Dijon mustard", "2 g garlic, raw", "2 g dried oregano", "1 g black pepper", "2 g iodized salt"]
instructions: Drain the tuna and chickpeas well. Cut the cherry tomatoes in half, dice the cucumber and red bell pepper, and thinly slice the red onion. In a large bowl, combine the tuna, chickpeas, tomatoes, cucumber, pepper, onion, spinach, and olives. In a separate small bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon mustard, garlic, oregano, black pepper, and iodized salt until smooth. Pour the dressing over the salad and gently toss until everything is evenly coated without breaking up the tuna too much. Let the salad sit for 5 minutes so the flavours blend, then serve immediately while the spinach is still crisp.

title: Mediterranean Tuna Salad with Chickpeas, Cucumber and Lemon Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["240 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "240 g chickpeas, canned, drained", "150 g cherry tomatoes", "120 g cucumber", "80 g red bell pepper", "60 g red onion", "80 g mixed salad leaves", "30 g black olives, pitted", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "15 ml lemon juice", "10 ml olive oil", "5 g fresh parsley", "1 g black pepper", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Place the drained chickpeas in a large bowl and lightly mash about one quarter of them with a fork so the salad becomes more cohesive. Add the tuna and break it into large flakes. Halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber and red bell pepper, and thinly slice the red onion, then add everything to the bowl with the salad leaves and olives. In a small bowl, whisk the yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, chopped parsley, black pepper and salt until smooth. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently so the leaves stay crisp and the tuna remains in chunks. Let the salad sit for 5 minutes so the flavours meld, then serve chilled or at cool room temperature.

title: Mediterranean Tuna Salad with Chickpeas, Lemon and Herbs
ingredients_json: ["250 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "240 g chickpeas, cooked, drained", "120 g cherry tomatoes", "100 g cucumber", "80 g red bell pepper", "40 g red onion", "60 g baby spinach", "30 g black olives", "15 g parsley, fresh", "10 g dill, fresh", "30 ml lemon juice", "15 ml olive oil", "5 g Dijon mustard", "2 g garlic, raw", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper"]
instructions: Drain the tuna well and flake it into a large bowl. Rinse and drain the chickpeas, then add them to the bowl. Halve the cherry tomatoes, dice the cucumber and red bell pepper, and thinly slice the red onion. Add the vegetables, spinach, olives, parsley, and dill to the bowl. In a small cup, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon mustard, garlic, salt, and black pepper until emulsified. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss gently so the tuna stays in nice flakes and the spinach is lightly coated. Let the salad stand for 5 minutes before serving so the flavours blend. Serve chilled or at cool room temperature.

title: Mediterranean Tuna Salad with Chickpeas, Lemon and Herbs
ingredients_json: ["240 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "240 g chickpeas, cooked, drained", "120 g cherry tomatoes", "120 g cucumber", "80 g red bell pepper", "60 g red onion", "80 g baby spinach", "30 g black olives, pitted", "15 g parsley, fresh", "15 ml lemon juice", "15 ml olive oil", "2 g garlic, raw", "1 g black pepper", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Drain the tuna and chickpeas well. Cut the cherry tomatoes in halves, dice the cucumber and red bell pepper, thinly slice the red onion, and chop the parsley. In a large bowl, combine the spinach, chickpeas, tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, onion, olives, and parsley. Add the tuna on top and break it into large flakes with a fork. Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, black pepper, and salt together, then pour the dressing over the salad. Toss gently until everything is lightly coated. Serve immediately, or chill for 10 minutes if you want the flavours to meld more.

title: Mediterranean Tuna Salad with Chickpeas, Cucumber and Lemon Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["240 g tuna, canned in water, drained", "240 g chickpeas, cooked, drained", "150 g cucumber, raw", "200 g cherry tomatoes, raw", "80 g red onion, raw", "120 g baby spinach, raw", "60 g green olives, drained", "30 g plain yogurt, low fat", "15 ml lemon juice", "10 ml olive oil", "2 g garlic, raw", "2 g dried oregano", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g salt"]

Cut the cucumber into bite-sized pieces, halve the cherry tomatoes, thinly slice the red onion, and add them with the spinach and olives. In a small bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, oregano, black pepper, and salt until smooth. Pour the dressing over the salad and fold everything together gently so the tuna stays in flakes and the spinach is lightly coated. Let the salad sit for 5 minutes before serving so the flavors blend. Serve chilled or at cool room temperature.

title: Turkey and Vegetable Skillet with Brown Rice and Lemon Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["400 g turkey breast, raw, skinless", "200 g brown rice, dry", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece courgette, raw", "150 g carrots, raw", "200 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "100 g spinach, raw", "1 tsp ground cumin", "1 tsp sweet paprika", "2 g black pepper, ground", "5 g salt", "150 g yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice and cook it in lightly salted water according to the package instructions until tender, then drain if needed and keep warm. While the rice cooks, cut the turkey breast into bite-sized pieces. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the onion. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes until it starts to soften, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Add the turkey pieces and cook for about 5 to 6 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they are lightly browned on the outside. Stir in the carrots, red pepper, courgette, cumin, paprika, black pepper, and salt, then cook over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes until the vegetables are tender but still slightly firm. Add the chopped tomatoes and simmer for 3 minutes so the flavours come together. Fold in the spinach and cook just until wilted. Mix the yogurt with the lemon juice in a small bowl. Serve the turkey and vegetables over the brown rice with the lemon yogurt spooned on top.

title: Turkey and Vegetable Brown Rice Skillet with Lemon Herbs
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean, raw", "200 g brown rice, dry", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "1 piece courgette, raw", "200 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "300 ml water", "1 tbsp tomato paste", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp ground paprika", "1 piece lemon, raw", "20 g parsley, fresh", "5 g salt", "2 g black pepper, ground"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice under cold water until the water runs clearer. Heat the olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened. Stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds, then add the turkey mince and break it up with a spoon. Cook for 5 to 6 minutes over medium-high heat until it is no longer pink. Add the diced red bell pepper and courgette, then cook for another 3 minutes so the vegetables begin to soften. Stir in the tomato paste, oregano, paprika, salt, and black pepper, then add the brown rice, chopped tomatoes, and water. Bring everything to a gentle boil, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 25 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the rice is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Remove from the heat and let it rest covered for 5 minutes. Finish with lemon zest, a squeeze of lemon juice, and chopped parsley before serving hot.

title: Lemon Garlic Turkey Meatballs with Quinoa and Roasted Broccoli
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean", "80 g quinoa, dry", "300 g broccoli florets, raw", "150 g carrot, raw", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 g breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece lemon, raw", "5 g parsley, fresh", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "2 g paprika, sweet"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Rinse the quinoa and cook it in 160 ml water over medium heat for about 15 minutes until the grains are tender and the water has been absorbed, then leave it covered to steam. Meanwhile, cut the broccoli into small florets and slice the carrot into thin pieces. Toss the vegetables with half of the olive oil, half the salt, and the paprika, then spread them on a baking tray and roast for 20 to 25 minutes until lightly browned and tender at the edges. Finely chop the onion, garlic, and parsley, then mix them with the turkey mince, egg, breadcrumbs, remaining salt, black pepper, and the grated zest of the lemon. Shape the mixture into 12 small meatballs. Heat the remaining olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat and cook the meatballs for 8 to 10 minutes, turning them regularly, until they are browned on the outside and cooked through with no pink in the centre. Squeeze the lemon juice over the meatballs, then serve them on top of the quinoa with the roasted broccoli and carrot alongside.

title: Turkey, Spinach and Brown Rice Skillet with Tomato and Lemon
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey mince, lean", "150 g brown rice, dry", "1 tbsp olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper, raw", "200 g cherry tomatoes", "150 g spinach, raw", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "500 ml water", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp paprika, sweet", "1 tsp salt", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 piece lemon, raw"]

While the rice cooks, heat the olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 3 to 4 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more. Add the turkey mince and break it up with a spoon, cooking for 5 to 6 minutes until no longer pink. Stir in the diced red pepper, chopped cherry tomatoes, chopped tomatoes, oregano, paprika, salt and black pepper. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly and the vegetables are tender. Add the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until just wilted. Fold in the cooked brown rice and squeeze over the lemon juice. Stir well and cook for another minute so everything is hot and evenly combined before serving.

title: Herbed Turkey and Vegetable Quinoa Skillet
ingredients_json: ["500 g turkey breast mince", "150 g quinoa, dry", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "2 cloves garlic, raw", "1 piece red bell pepper", "1 piece courgette", "200 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "300 ml vegetable stock, low salt", "100 g spinach, raw", "5 g dried oregano", "2 g ground cumin", "1 g black pepper", "3 g iodised salt", "20 g lemon juice, raw", "15 g parsley, fresh"]

Stir in the garlic, oregano, cumin, and black pepper, and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook over medium-high heat for about 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink. Stir in the diced red pepper and courgette, then add the quinoa, chopped tomatoes, vegetable stock, and salt. Bring the mixture to a gentle boil, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 18 minutes until the quinoa is tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed. Fold in the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted. Finish with lemon juice and chopped parsley, then serve warm while the skillet is still juicy and the quinoa is fluffy.

title: Baked Turkey and Spinach Ziti with Tomato and Ricotta
ingredients_json: ["300 g ziti pasta, dry", "350 g turkey mince, lean, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "400 g tomatoes, canned, chopped", "70 g tomato paste", "150 g spinach, raw", "200 g ricotta cheese, low fat", "30 g parmesan cheese, grated", "1 tsp dried oregano", "1 tsp dried basil", "0.5 tsp black pepper, ground", "1 tsp salt", "100 ml water", "1 piece egg, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the ziti for 2 minutes less than the package directions so it stays firm. Drain well. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the turkey mince and cook over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink. Stir in the tomatoes, tomato paste, water, oregano, basil, pepper, and salt, then simmer gently for 10 minutes until slightly thickened. Add the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted. In a bowl, mix the ricotta with the egg and half of the parmesan. Combine the pasta with the sauce, then fold in the ricotta mixture. Spoon into a baking dish and scatter over the remaining parmesan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling and lightly browned on top. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving so it sets neatly.

title: Whole Wheat Turkey and Spinach Baked Ziti with Tomato and Ricotta
ingredients_json: ["300 g whole wheat ziti pasta", "400 g turkey mince, lean, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw, medium", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "150 g tomato passata", "100 g spinach, raw", "200 g ricotta cheese, part skim", "80 g mozzarella cheese, reduced fat", "20 g parmesan cheese, grated", "5 g dried oregano", "2 g dried basil", "2 g salt", "1 g black pepper, ground", "200 ml water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the ziti for 2 minutes less than the package time so it stays firm. Drain well. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and turkey mince and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking the meat up with a spoon until it is no longer pink. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, passata, water, oregano, basil, salt, and black pepper, then simmer gently for 10 minutes until slightly thickened. Add the spinach and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until wilted. Remove from the heat and fold in the cooked ziti and ricotta until evenly combined. Transfer everything to a baking dish, scatter over the mozzarella and parmesan, and bake for 18 to 20 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden on top. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving so it sets neatly.

title: Wholewheat Turkey and Spinach Baked Ziti with Tomato and Ricotta
ingredients_json: ["300 g wholewheat ziti pasta", "500 g turkey mince, lean", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, yellow, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "400 g tomato passata", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "150 g spinach, raw", "250 g ricotta cheese, part skim", "125 g mozzarella cheese, reduced fat", "30 g parmesan cheese, grated", "5 g dried oregano", "2 g black pepper, ground", "3 g salt, table", "500 ml water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and lightly grease a medium baking dish. Cook the ziti in boiling water for 2 minutes less than the package directions, then drain well. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil over medium heat in a large pan and cook the onion for 4 to 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and turkey mince and cook for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking up the meat, until it is no longer pink. Stir in the passata, chopped tomatoes, oregano, salt, black pepper, and water, then simmer gently for 10 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly. Fold in the spinach and cook just until wilted. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in half of the ricotta. Combine the pasta with the sauce, then spoon half into the baking dish. Add dollops of the remaining ricotta, top with the rest of the pasta, and finish with mozzarella and parmesan. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbling and lightly browned on top. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving so the sauce sets.

title: Whole Wheat Turkey Ziti Bake with Spinach and Tomato
ingredients_json: ["300 g whole wheat ziti pasta", "400 g lean turkey mince", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece yellow onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "400 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "200 g tomato passata", "150 g spinach, raw", "10 g basil, fresh", "1 tsp dried oregano", "5 g salt", "2 g black pepper, ground", "150 g ricotta cheese, low fat", "60 g parmesan cheese, grated", "80 g mozzarella cheese, reduced fat", "500 ml water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees C. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook the ziti for about 2 minutes less than the package directions so it stays slightly firm. Drain well. While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the diced onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. Add the turkey mince and cook over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up with a spoon until no pink remains. Stir in the chopped tomatoes, passata, water, oregano, salt, and black pepper, then simmer gently for 10 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly. Fold in the spinach and basil and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until the spinach wilts. Combine the pasta with the sauce and ricotta, then transfer everything to a baking dish. Sprinkle the parmesan and mozzarella over the top and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until bubbling and lightly golden. Let the ziti rest for 5 minutes before serving so it slices neatly.

title: Baked Turkey and Spinach Ziti with Tomato and Mozzarella
ingredients_json: ["320 g ziti pasta, dry", "400 g turkey mince, lean, raw", "15 ml olive oil", "1 piece onion, raw", "3 cloves garlic, raw", "400 g tomato passata", "200 g chopped tomatoes, canned", "120 g spinach, raw", "150 g courgette, raw", "2 g dried oregano", "1 g dried basil", "3 g salt", "1 g black pepper", "80 g Parmesan cheese, grated", "125 g mozzarella cheese, part skim", "30 g breadcrumbs, wholemeal", "20 g basil, fresh"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 200 C. Cook the ziti in a large pot of salted water for 2 minutes less than the package time, then drain. While the pasta cooks, warm the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook for 4 to 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. Add the turkey mince and cook over medium-high heat for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up until no longer pink. Stir in the courgette, passata, chopped tomatoes, oregano, basil, salt, and black pepper, then simmer for 8 minutes so the sauce thickens slightly. Fold in the spinach until just wilted. Combine the pasta with the sauce in a baking dish, then scatter over the Parmesan, mozzarella, and breadcrumbs. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until bubbling and golden on top. Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving, then finish with the fresh basil.

title: Lemon Angel Food Cake with Fresh Berries
ingredients_json: ["12 piece Egg white, raw", "150 g Sugar, granulated", "90 g Wheat flour, white, cake", "30 g Sugar, powdered", "8 g Lemon zest, fresh", "30 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "4 ml Vanilla extract", "2 g Salt, table", "1 g Cream of tartar", "200 g Strawberries, fresh", "100 g Blueberries, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and place the rack in the lower-middle position. Sift the cake flour and powdered sugar together two times so the cake stays light. In a large clean bowl, beat the egg whites, salt, and cream of tartar on medium speed until foamy, then increase to high speed and add the granulated sugar gradually. Continue beating until glossy medium-stiff peaks form. Fold in the lemon zest, lemon juice, vanilla, and the sifted flour mixture in three additions, taking care not to deflate the batter. Spoon the batter into an ungreased angel food cake pan and smooth the top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the cake is golden and springs back when lightly touched. Invert the pan immediately and let the cake cool completely for at least 1 hour. Run a thin knife around the sides to release the cake. Serve slices with fresh strawberries and blueberries over the top.

title: Light Lemon Angel Food Cake with Fresh Berries
ingredients_json: ["12 pieces Egg white, raw", "150 g Sugar, white", "90 g Wheat flour, cake", "20 g Cornstarch", "2 tsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp Lemon zest, raw", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "0.5 tsp Salt", "150 g Strawberry, raw", "100 g Blueberry, raw", "10 g Icing sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and place an ungreased angel food cake pan on the counter. Sift the cake flour and cornstarch together twice so the mixture stays light. In a large clean bowl, beat the egg whites with the salt on medium speed until foamy, then add the lemon juice and continue beating until soft peaks form. Gradually add the sugar a spoonful at a time, beating on medium-high speed until the meringue is glossy and holds firm peaks. Beat in the vanilla and lemon zest briefly. Fold the sifted flour mixture into the egg whites in three additions, using a gentle motion so the batter stays airy. Spoon the batter into the pan and smooth the top without pressing it down. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the cake is golden and springs back when lightly touched. Invert the pan immediately and let the cake cool completely upside down for about 1 hour. Run a thin knife around the edges to release the cake, then serve slices topped with strawberries, blueberries, and a light dusting of icing sugar.

title: Lemon Vanilla Angel Food Cake with Fresh Berries
ingredients_json: ["12 piece Egg white, raw", "180 g Sugar, white", "100 g Wheat flour, white, cake", "1 tsp Cornstarch", "1 tsp Cream of tartar", "1 tsp Lemon zest, fresh", "2 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 g Salt", "200 g Strawberries, fresh", "100 g Blueberries, fresh", "10 g Icing sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and place a rack in the lower third of the oven. Sift the cake flour and cornstarch together twice so the cake stays light. In a very clean bowl, beat the egg whites with the cream of tartar and salt on medium speed until foamy, then increase to high speed and slowly add the sugar a spoonful at a time. Continue beating until the meringue is glossy and holds soft-to-medium peaks. Beat in the vanilla, lemon zest, and lemon juice briefly. Gently fold in the sifted flour mixture in two or three additions, keeping as much air in the batter as possible. Spoon the batter into an ungreased angel food cake pan and smooth the top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the top is golden and springs back lightly when touched. Invert the pan immediately and let the cake cool completely upside down for at least 1 hour. Run a thin knife around the sides to release the cake, then serve slices with strawberries, blueberries, and a light dusting of icing sugar.

title: Lemon Angel Food Cake with Fresh Berry Compote
ingredients_json: ["12 piece Egg white, raw", "150 g Sugar, granulated", "90 g Wheat flour, white, plain", "1 tbsp Cornstarch", "1 tsp Cream of tartar", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "2 g Salt", "2 tsp Lemon zest, fresh", "60 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "200 g Strawberries, fresh", "100 g Blueberries, fresh", "15 g Honey", "10 ml Water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and make sure the rack is in the lower-middle position. In a very clean, dry bowl, whip the egg whites with the cream of tartar and salt on medium speed until foamy, then increase to high speed and gradually add the sugar until glossy medium-stiff peaks form. Mix the flour and cornstarch together, then sift them over the meringue in three additions, folding gently after each one so the batter stays airy. Fold in the vanilla, lemon zest, and lemon juice just until combined. Spoon the batter into an ungreased angel food cake pan and smooth the top lightly. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the cake is deeply golden and springs back when touched. Invert the pan immediately and let the cake cool completely before releasing it. For the compote, combine the strawberries, blueberries, honey, and water in a small saucepan over medium heat and cook for 5 to 7 minutes until the berries soften and the juices thicken slightly. Serve slices of the cooled cake with the warm berry compote spooned over the top.

title: Lemon-Vanilla Angel Food Cake with Fresh Berries
ingredients_json: ["12 piece Egg white, raw", "150 g Sugar, white", "90 g Wheat flour, white, cake", "10 g Cornstarch", "1 tsp Lemon zest, fresh", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "1 tsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 g Salt, table", "300 g Strawberry, fresh", "150 g Blueberry, fresh", "15 g Powdered sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and place the rack in the lower middle position. Sift the cake flour and cornstarch together three times so the cake stays light. In a large, clean bowl, beat the egg whites with the salt and lemon juice on medium speed until foamy, then increase to medium-high and add the sugar gradually, one spoonful at a time, until the meringue is glossy and forms soft to medium peaks. Fold in the vanilla and lemon zest, then sift in the flour mixture in three additions, folding gently after each addition so the batter does not deflate. Spoon the batter into an ungreased angel food cake pan and smooth the top lightly. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the cake is golden, springy to the touch, and a skewer comes out clean. Invert the pan immediately and let the cake cool completely upside down for at least 1 hour before releasing it. Serve slices topped with the strawberries, blueberries, and a light dusting of powdered sugar.

title: Rustic Wholemeal Apple Pie with Cinnamon and Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "70 g plain white flour", "120 g cold unsalted butter", "50 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "45 ml cold water", "5 g baking powder", "900 g apples, raw, peeled and sliced", "30 g rolled oats", "20 g ground almonds", "25 g honey", "15 g cornflour", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g ground nutmeg", "15 ml lemon juice", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C. In a bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, white flour, baking powder, salt, and 30 g of the brown sugar. Rub in 100 g of the cold butter with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then add the egg and cold water and bring it together into a soft dough. Wrap the dough and chill it for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, toss the sliced apples with the remaining brown sugar, honey, cornflour, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, oats, and ground almonds. Melt the remaining 20 g butter and stir it through the apple mixture. Roll out two-thirds of the pastry and line a 20 cm pie dish, leaving a little overhang. Spoon in the apple filling and press it down lightly. Roll out the remaining pastry and cover the pie, or cut it into strips for a lattice top. Seal the edges well and cut a few small slits if using a full top. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling at the edges. If the top browns too quickly, cover it loosely with foil for the last 10 minutes. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing so the filling can set.

title: Rustic Wholemeal Apple Pie with Cinnamon and Oats
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "75 g rolled oats", "125 g unsalted butter", "60 g low-fat plain yoghurt", "1 piece egg, raw", "25 g caster sugar", "2 g salt", "900 g apples, raw, with skin", "25 g raisins", "15 g lemon juice", "25 g light brown sugar", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g ground nutmeg", "15 g cornflour", "10 ml water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C and place a baking tray inside to heat. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, sugar and salt, then rub in the butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Stir in the yoghurt and egg, then bring the dough together without overworking it. Divide the dough into two pieces, wrap, and chill for 20 minutes. Peel and core the apples, then slice them thinly. Toss the apples with raisins, lemon juice, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, cornflour and water until evenly coated. Roll out one piece of dough and line a 22 cm pie dish, leaving a little overhang. Add the apple filling and pack it down lightly. Roll out the remaining dough and cover the pie, or cut it into strips for a lattice top. Seal the edges and cut a few small steam vents if using a full lid. Bake on the hot tray for 45 to 55 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling thickly. Let the pie cool for at least 30 minutes before slicing so the juices set properly.

title: Rustic Wholemeal Apple Pie with Cinnamon and Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g plain wheat flour", "120 g unsalted butter", "50 g low-fat natural yogurt", "1 piece egg, raw", "20 g caster sugar", "2 ml salt", "900 g apples, raw, peeled, cored", "40 g raisins", "25 g demerara sugar", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground nutmeg", "20 g rolled oats", "15 g chopped walnuts", "10 g honey"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C. To make the pastry, mix the wholemeal flour, plain flour, sugar, and salt in a bowl, then rub in 100 g of the butter until the mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in the yogurt and egg, then bring everything together into a smooth dough. Wrap it and chill for 20 minutes so it firms up. Meanwhile, slice the apples and toss them with the raisins, demerara sugar, lemon juice, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Melt the remaining 20 g butter in a pan over medium heat, add the apple mixture, and cook for 5 to 7 minutes until the fruit begins to soften and releases some juice, but still holds its shape. Roll out two-thirds of the pastry and line a 22 cm pie dish, then fill with the apple mixture. Roll out the remaining pastry for the lid, or cut it into a lattice if you prefer a lighter finish. Scatter the oats and walnuts over the filling before covering, then seal the edges well and cut a few small slits in the top if using a full lid. Brush lightly with a little water and bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling. Warm the honey and brush it over the top after baking for a light shine. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing so the filling sets.

title: Rustic Wholegrain Apple Pie with Cinnamon and Oats
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "50 g rolled oats", "150 g cold unsalted butter", "40 g icing sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml cold water", "900 g apples, raw, with peel", "60 g light brown sugar", "20 g cornflour", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 g fine salt", "15 g rolled oats", "10 g demerara sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C and place a baking tray inside to heat. For the pastry, rub the cold butter into the wholemeal flour, oats, icing sugar and salt until the mixture looks like coarse breadcrumbs. Stir in the egg and cold water, then bring everything together into a soft dough without overworking it. Wrap and chill for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, peel and core the apples, then slice them evenly and toss them with the brown sugar, cornflour, cinnamon and lemon juice. Roll out two thirds of the pastry and line a 23 cm pie dish, leaving a little overhang. Tip in the apple filling and press it down gently. Roll out the remaining pastry and place it over the top, or cut it into strips for a lattice if you prefer. Seal the edges well, cut a few steam holes if using a full lid, and brush the top lightly with a little beaten egg if available from the original egg. Sprinkle with the extra oats and demerara sugar. Bake on the hot tray for 40 to 45 minutes, until the crust is deep golden and the filling is bubbling thickly at the edges. Let the pie cool for at least 30 minutes before slicing so the filling sets properly.

title: Rustic Wholemeal Apple Pie with Cinnamon and Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "70 g plain wheat flour", "120 g cold unsalted butter", "50 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml cold water", "800 g apples, raw, peeled and sliced", "30 g rolled oats", "20 g ground almonds", "25 g honey", "8 g ground cinnamon", "15 ml lemon juice", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C. In a bowl, rub 100 g of the butter into the wholemeal flour, plain flour, 20 g of the brown sugar, and the salt until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Add the egg and cold water, then bring it together quickly into a soft dough. Wrap it and rest it in the fridge for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, toss the apple slices with the lemon juice, remaining brown sugar, cinnamon, honey, oats, ground almonds, and the remaining 20 g butter, cut into small pieces. Roll out two thirds of the dough and line a 23 cm pie dish, trimming the edges. Fill with the apple mixture, then roll out the remaining dough and place it over the top as a lid, or cut into strips for a lattice. Press the edges to seal and cut a few small vents in the top if using a full lid. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling at the edges. Let the pie cool for at least 20 minutes before slicing so the filling sets properly.

title: Oat and Apple Cinnamon Bar Cookies
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g almond flour", "90 g light brown sugar", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "120 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "220 g apple, peeled and diced", "20 g raisins", "15 g chopped walnuts"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a 20 x 20 cm baking tin with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix the oats, wholemeal flour, almond flour, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt until evenly combined. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, rapeseed oil, Greek yogurt, and vanilla extract until smooth. Stir the wet mixture into the dry ingredients until no dry flour remains, then fold in the diced apple, raisins, and walnuts. Spread the batter evenly into the prepared tin and press it down lightly with a spatula. Bake for 28 to 32 minutes, until the top is golden brown and a skewer inserted into the center comes out mostly clean. Let the slab cool completely in the tin before lifting it out and cutting it into 12 bars.

title: Oatmeal Apricot Walnut Bar Cookies with Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g dried apricots", "60 g walnuts", "90 g light brown sugar", "100 g unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 tbsp honey", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g salt", "50 ml semi-skimmed milk", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a 20 cm square baking tin with baking paper. Chop the dried apricots and walnuts into small pieces. In a large bowl, mix the oats, wholemeal flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. In a separate bowl, beat the butter, brown sugar and honey together until well combined, then mix in the egg, milk and vanilla extract. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until a thick dough forms, then fold in the apricots and walnuts. Press the mixture evenly into the prepared tin, smoothing the surface with the back of a spoon. Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until the top is lightly golden and the centre feels set. Leave to cool completely in the tin before slicing into 12 bar cookies.

title: Oatmeal Almond Raspberry Bar Cookies
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g ground almonds", "90 g brown sugar", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "80 ml low-fat milk", "5 ml vanilla extract", "150 g raspberries, fresh", "20 g chia seeds", "15 g sliced almonds"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius and line a 20 x 20 cm baking tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, wholemeal flour, ground almonds, brown sugar, baking powder, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg with the rapeseed oil, milk, and vanilla extract, then stir the wet mixture into the dry ingredients until evenly combined. Press about two thirds of the mixture firmly into the prepared tin to make the base. Toss the raspberries gently with the chia seeds, then spread them over the base. Crumble the remaining oat mixture over the fruit and scatter the sliced almonds on top. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until the top is golden brown and the fruit is bubbling at the edges. Let the tray cool completely in the tin before cutting into 12 bars so they set neatly.

title: Oatmeal Apricot Walnut Bar Cookies with Orange and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "140 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g dried apricots, chopped", "50 g walnuts, chopped", "70 g rapeseed oil", "100 g brown sugar", "2 piece egg, raw", "120 g plain yogurt, low fat", "1 tbsp orange zest", "60 ml orange juice", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a 20 x 20 cm baking tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, wholemeal flour, baking powder, cinnamon, salt, chopped apricots, and walnuts. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs with the brown sugar until well combined, then whisk in the rapeseed oil, yogurt, orange zest, and orange juice. Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and stir just until no dry flour remains. Spread the batter evenly into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Bake for 22 to 26 minutes, until the bars are lightly golden, the centre feels set, and a skewer inserted in the middle comes out with only a few moist crumbs. Let cool completely in the tin before cutting into 16 bars so they hold their shape well.

title: Oatmeal Apple Cranberry Bar Cookies with Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g light brown sugar", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1/4 tsp salt", "80 g unsalted butter", "2 pieces egg, raw", "120 ml low-fat milk", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "180 g apple, peeled and diced", "80 g dried cranberries", "30 g chopped walnuts"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180 C and line a 20 x 20 cm baking tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the oats, wholemeal flour, brown sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Melt the butter gently over low heat, then whisk it with the eggs, milk, and vanilla until smooth. Stir the wet ingredients into the dry mixture until just combined, then fold in the diced apple, dried cranberries, and walnuts. Spread the mixture evenly in the prepared tin and press it down lightly with the back of a spoon. Bake for 28 to 32 minutes, until the top is golden and the center feels set when lightly pressed. Let the bars cool completely in the tin before lifting out and cutting into 12 squares.

title: Whole Wheat Almond Biscotti with Orange and Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "60 g ground almonds", "80 g rolled oats", "90 g caster sugar", "10 g baking powder", "2 g salt", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 orange zest", "2 piece egg, raw", "30 ml sunflower oil", "20 ml low-fat milk", "80 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "40 g whole almonds"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, ground almonds, rolled oats, caster sugar, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, and orange zest. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with the sunflower oil and milk until smooth, then stir the wet ingredients into the dry mixture until a firm dough forms. Fold in the whole almonds and half of the dark chocolate, roughly chopped. Shape the dough into one flat log about 25 cm long and 8 cm wide on the prepared tray. Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until the log is lightly golden and set. Remove from the oven and cool for 10 minutes so it firms up. Reduce the oven temperature to 150°C. Use a sharp serrated knife to cut the log diagonally into 12 slices, then lay the slices cut-side down on the tray. Bake for 10 minutes, turn each slice over, and bake for another 8 to 10 minutes until dry and crisp around the edges. Cool completely on a wire rack, then drizzle or dip with the remaining melted dark chocolate and let it set before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Almond Biscotti with Orange and Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "60 g almond flour", "80 g almonds, whole, unsalted", "90 g brown sugar", "2 pieces egg, raw", "30 ml rapeseed oil", "1 piece orange zest, fresh", "2 ml vanilla extract", "4 g baking powder", "1 g salt", "40 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, almond flour, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the brown sugar, whole almonds, and orange zest. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs with the rapeseed oil and vanilla extract until smooth. Add the wet mixture to the dry ingredients and mix just until a firm dough forms. Shape the dough into a lightly flattened log about 25 cm long and place it on the tray. Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until the log is set and lightly golden. Remove it from the oven and cool for 10 minutes so it is easier to slice. Reduce the oven temperature to 150 C. Slice the log diagonally into 1.5 cm pieces using a sharp knife. Arrange the slices cut-side down on the tray and bake for 10 minutes, then turn them over and bake for another 8 to 10 minutes until dry and crisp at the edges. Let the biscotti cool completely on a wire rack. Melt the dark chocolate gently and drizzle it over the cooled biscotti before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Almond Biscotti with Orange and Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "80 g almond flour", "90 g caster sugar", "60 g whole almonds", "2 pieces egg, raw", "30 ml olive oil", "1 orange zest, fresh", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "40 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, almond flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Stir in the whole almonds and orange zest so they are evenly distributed. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with the olive oil and vanilla extract until smooth, then add them to the dry ingredients and mix until a firm dough forms. If the dough feels too dry, knead it briefly with clean hands until it comes together. Shape the dough into one long log about 25 cm long and 6 cm wide, then place it on the tray and bake for 22 to 25 minutes until lightly golden and set. Remove the log from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes so it firms up enough to slice cleanly. Reduce the oven temperature to 150 C. Slice the log diagonally into 1.5 cm pieces using a sharp serrated knife, then arrange the slices cut-side down on the tray. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, flip the biscotti, and bake for another 8 to 10 minutes until dry and crisp at the edges. Let them cool completely on a wire rack, then drizzle or dip with the melted dark chocolate if desired and allow the chocolate to set before serving.

title: Lemon Almond Wholegrain Biscotti
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "60 g ground almonds", "80 g rolled oats", "90 g caster sugar", "2 pieces egg, raw", "30 ml olive oil", "20 ml skimmed milk", "1 lemon zest", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "40 g almonds, whole, unsalted"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, ground almonds, rolled oats, sugar, baking powder, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with the olive oil, skimmed milk, lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla extract until smooth. Stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients until a firm dough forms, then fold in the whole almonds. Shape the dough into a 25 cm log on the prepared tray and flatten it slightly with damp hands. Bake for 25 minutes, or until the log is pale golden and feels set to the touch. title: Whole Wheat Almond Orange Biscotti

title: Lighter Wholemeal Blueberry Pie with Lemon and Oat Crumble

title: Wholegrain Blueberry Pie with Lemon and Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "80 g cold unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g plain yogurt, low fat", "30 ml cold water", "600 g blueberries, raw", "50 g light brown sugar", "20 g corn starch", "15 ml lemon juice", "1 tsp lemon zest", "1 g ground cinnamon", "1 g salt"]

title: Rustic Wholegrain Blueberry Pie with Lemon and Oat Crumble

title: Rustic Wholegrain Blueberry Pie with Lemon and Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g plain wheat flour", "120 g cold unsalted butter", "40 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "45 ml cold water", "500 g blueberries, raw", "25 g rolled oats", "20 g cornstarch", "35 g honey", "15 ml lemon juice", "2 g lemon zest", "1 g ground cinnamon", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C and place a baking tray on the middle rack to heat up. To make the pastry, mix the wholemeal flour, plain flour, salt, and 20 g of the sugar in a bowl. For the filling, combine the blueberries, cornstarch, honey, lemon juice, lemon zest, cinnamon, and the remaining sugar in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir gently for 4 to 6 minutes until the juices begin to thicken, then remove from the heat and let cool slightly. Roll out two-thirds of the pastry and line a 23 cm pie dish, trimming the edges. Bake the pie on the hot tray for 35 to 40 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling at the centre. Let it cool for at least 1 hour before slicing so the filling sets properly.

title: Wholemeal Blueberry Pie with Lemon and Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "90 g cold unsalted butter", "35 g plain Greek yogurt", "30 ml cold water", "2 g fine salt", "600 g fresh blueberries", "40 g light brown sugar", "20 g cornflour", "15 ml lemon juice", "2 g lemon zest", "1 g ground cinnamon", "30 g rolled oats", "20 g almond flour", "15 g honey", "10 g unsalted butter"]

title: Dark Chocolate Oat Brownies with Walnuts

title: Dark Chocolate Oat Brownies with Walnuts

title: Moist Carrot Cakes with Orange Yogurt Frosting

title: Spiced Wholemeal Carrot Cake with Yogurt Cream Cheese Frosting

ingredients_json: ["180 g plain wholemeal flour", "50 g rolled oats", "120 g soft brown sugar", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "150 g carrot, raw, grated", "100 g apple, raw, grated", "60 g plain yogurt, low fat", "80 g walnut, chopped", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground ginger", "0.5 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "1 g salt", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "150 g cream cheese, reduced fat", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "20 g icing sugar", "1 tsp lemon juice"]

title: Moist Carrot Walnut Cakes with Orange Yogurt Glaze

title: Lemon Blueberry Greek Yogurt Cheesecake
