Meanwhile, put the blueberries, strawberries, cornstarch and water in a small saucepan over medium heat and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring gently, until the fruit softens and the sauce lightly thickens. Cool the cheesecake completely, then chill it for at least 4 hours or overnight. Spoon the berry topping over the chilled cheesecake before serving.

title: Lighter Lemon Vanilla Baked Cheesecake with Berry Compote
ingredients_json: ["180 g oat biscuits", "45 g unsalted butter", "500 g low-fat cream cheese", "200 g skyr, plain", "2 pieces egg, raw", "60 g sugar", "1 tbsp plain flour", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 piece lemon, zest only", "30 ml lemon juice", "150 g mixed berries, fresh or frozen", "15 g honey", "20 ml water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 C and line the base of a 20 cm springform tin with baking paper. Crush the oat biscuits finely, then mix them with the melted butter until the texture resembles wet sand. Press the mixture firmly into the base of the tin and bake for 8 minutes, then set aside to cool slightly. In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese, skyr, sugar, flour, vanilla extract, lemon zest and lemon juice until smooth. Add the eggs one at a time and mix gently just until combined, keeping the batter light and creamy. Pour the filling over the crust and smooth the top. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes at 160 C, until the edges are set and the centre still has a slight wobble. Turn off the oven, leave the door ajar, and let the cheesecake cool inside for 20 minutes to reduce cracking. Chill the cheesecake in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight. For the topping, simmer the berries, honey and water over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes until glossy and slightly thickened, then cool completely before spooning over the chilled cheesecake.

title: Lemon Blueberry Greek Yogurt Cheesecake
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal oat biscuits", "45 g unsalted butter", "400 g low-fat cream cheese", "250 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "2 pieces egg, raw", "80 g caster sugar", "1 piece lemon zest, fresh", "30 ml lemon juice, fresh", "10 g cornflour", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and line the base of a 20 cm springform tin with baking paper. Crush the oat biscuits finely, then mix them with the melted butter until the crumbs are evenly coated. Press the mixture firmly into the base of the tin and bake for 8 minutes, then set aside to cool slightly. Reduce the oven to 160 C. In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese, Greek yogurt, sugar, lemon zest, lemon juice, vanilla extract, cornflour, and salt until smooth. Add the eggs one at a time and mix just until combined, keeping the batter light and avoiding too much air. Fold in two thirds of the blueberries gently. Pour the filling over the crust and smooth the top. Scatter the remaining blueberries over the surface. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until the edges are set but the centre still has a slight wobble. Turn off the oven, crack the door open, and leave the cheesecake inside for 30 minutes to cool gradually and reduce cracking. Chill for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight, before slicing.

title: Lemon Blueberry Greek Yogurt Cheesecake with Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "30 g ground almonds", "25 g unsalted butter", "20 g honey", "400 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "250 g cream cheese, light", "2 piece egg, whole, raw", "60 g sugar", "1 piece lemon, zest only", "30 ml lemon juice", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "10 g cornflour"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and line a 20 cm springform tin with baking paper. Mix the rolled oats, ground almonds, melted butter, and honey until the mixture looks evenly coated, then press it firmly into the base of the tin. Bake the crust for 8 minutes until lightly toasted, then set it aside. In a large bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, light cream cheese, eggs, sugar, lemon zest, lemon juice, vanilla extract, and cornflour until smooth and well combined, but do not overbeat. Fold in most of the blueberries gently, then pour the filling over the crust and smooth the top. Scatter the remaining blueberries over the surface. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 170 C until the edges are set and the centre still has a slight wobble. Turn off the oven, leave the cheesecake inside with the door slightly open for 20 minutes, then cool completely at room temperature. Chill for at least 4 hours, or overnight, before slicing so the texture becomes firm and creamy.

title: Rustic Whole-Wheat Cherry Pie with Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "80 g plain white flour", "120 g cold unsalted butter", "40 g icing sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "45 ml cold water", "1 g fine salt", "600 g cherries, pitted, fresh", "70 g cane sugar", "20 g corn starch", "15 ml lemon juice", "1 g ground cinnamon", "10 g rolled oats", "15 g almond flakes", "5 ml milk, semi-skimmed"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 degrees Celsius and place a baking tray inside to heat. Mix the whole wheat flour, plain flour, icing sugar, and salt in a bowl, then rub in the cold butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Add the egg and cold water, then bring the dough together quickly without overworking it. Wrap the dough and chill it for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the cherries, cane sugar, corn starch, lemon juice, and cinnamon in a saucepan and cook over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring gently, until the juices thicken slightly. Roll out two-thirds of the dough and line a 23 cm pie dish, then spoon in the cherry filling. Roll out the remaining dough and cover the pie with a lattice or full top, sealing the edges well. Brush the top lightly with milk and sprinkle over the oats and almond flakes. Bake on the preheated tray for 35 to 40 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling through the top. Let the pie cool for at least 2 hours before slicing so the filling sets properly.

title: Rustic Wholewheat Cherry Pie with Almond Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholewheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "50 g ground almonds", "120 g cold unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 g icing sugar", "2 g salt", "700 g cherries, sweet, pitted", "60 g cane sugar", "20 g cornflour", "15 ml lemon juice", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "2 g ground cinnamon", "15 g flaked almonds"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C. In a large bowl, mix the wholewheat flour, rolled oats, ground almonds, icing sugar, and salt. Rub in the cold butter with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then mix in the egg until a soft dough forms. Divide the dough into two pieces, wrap one piece, and chill both for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the pitted cherries, cane sugar, cornflour, lemon juice, vanilla extract, and cinnamon in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring gently, until the juices thicken and the cherries look glossy. Roll out the larger piece of dough and line a 23 cm pie dish, trimming the edges. Spoon in the warm cherry filling, then roll out the remaining dough and lay it over the top as a lid or lattice. Press the edges to seal, cut a few small steam vents if using a full lid, and sprinkle the flaked almonds on top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling at the edges. Let the pie cool for at least 30 minutes before slicing so the filling sets properly.

title: Rustic Wholewheat Cherry Pie with Vanilla and Almond
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholewheat flour", "70 g plain white flour", "120 g cold unsalted butter", "30 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "45 ml cold water", "600 g cherries, sweet, pitted", "60 g granulated sugar", "20 g cornflour", "15 ml lemon juice", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "15 g almonds, ground", "1 piece egg, raw", "10 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C and place a baking tray inside to heat. In a large bowl, rub the cold butter into the wholewheat flour, white flour, brown sugar and salt until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in the egg yolk and cold water just until the dough comes together, then divide it into two portions, wrap, and chill for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, combine the cherries, granulated sugar, cornflour, lemon juice, vanilla extract and ground almonds in a saucepan. Spoon in the cherry filling, then roll out the remaining dough and cover the pie with a lattice or full top, sealing the edges well. Brush the top with the beaten egg mixed with milk. Bake on the hot tray for 40 to 45 minutes, until the crust is deep golden and the filling is bubbling through the vents. Let the pie cool for at least 2 hours before slicing so the filling sets properly.

title: Wholegrain Cherry Pie with Almond Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "30 g ground almonds", "120 g unsalted butter", "30 g brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 ml cold water", "600 g cherries, pitted", "40 g maple syrup", "15 g cornflour", "10 ml lemon juice", "1 g ground cinnamon", "2 g vanilla extract", "2 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C and lightly grease a 22 cm pie dish. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, ground almonds, sugar, and salt. Rub in the cold butter with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then stir in the egg and cold water just until the dough comes together. Divide the dough into two pieces, with one piece slightly larger than the other, and chill for 15 minutes. Roll out the larger piece of dough and line the pie dish, then spoon in the cherry filling. Roll out the remaining dough and place it over the top as a lid, or cut it into strips for a lattice. Seal the edges well and cut a few small steam vents if using a full lid. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling at the center. Let the pie cool for at least 30 minutes before slicing so the filling sets properly.

title: Wholegrain Cherry Pie with Almond Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "70 g rolled oats", "60 g ground almonds", "40 g rapeseed oil", "50 g butter, unsalted", "90 ml water", "450 g cherries, sweet, pitted", "150 g cherries, sour, pitted", "40 g sugar, brown", "15 g cornflour", "10 ml lemon juice", "1 g cinnamon, ground", "2 g vanilla extract", "1 piece egg, raw"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C. Mix the wholemeal flour, oats, ground almonds and a small pinch of salt in a bowl. Rub in the butter, then stir in the rapeseed oil and enough water to form a soft dough. Chill it for 15 minutes while you prepare the filling. Combine the cherries, brown sugar, cornflour, lemon juice, cinnamon and vanilla in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring gently, until the fruit starts to release its juices and the mixture thickens slightly. Roll out two thirds of the dough and line a 22 cm pie dish. Spoon in the cherry filling, then roll out the remaining dough and place it over the top as a lid. Seal the edges, cut a few small steam slits, and brush the surface with the beaten egg. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling. Let the pie cool for at least 30 minutes before slicing so the filling sets properly.

title: Maple Pecan Sweet Potato Chess Pie
ingredients_json: ["1 piece wholegrain pie crust, unbaked", "300 g sweet potato, cooked and mashed", "2 piece egg, raw", "120 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "80 g maple syrup", "60 g light brown sugar", "30 g plain wholemeal flour", "40 g pecan nuts, chopped", "30 g unsalted butter, melted", "5 ml vanilla extract", "1 g ground cinnamon", "0.5 g fine salt", "1 g ground nutmeg"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and place a rack in the lower-middle position. Fit the unbaked pie crust into a 23 cm pie dish and chill it while you make the filling. In a large bowl, whisk together the mashed sweet potato, eggs, milk, maple syrup, brown sugar, wholemeal flour, melted butter, vanilla, cinnamon, salt, and nutmeg until smooth and well combined. Stir in most of the chopped pecans, then pour the filling into the crust and scatter the remaining pecans over the top. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes, until the edges are set and the center still has a slight wobble when gently shaken. If the crust browns too quickly, cover the edge loosely with foil. Let the pie cool completely on a wire rack so the filling finishes setting before slicing. Serve at room temperature or lightly chilled.

title: Light Buttermilk Chess Pie with Lemon and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["1 piece whole wheat pie crust, unbaked, 23 cm", "60 g unsalted butter", "150 g caster sugar", "30 g cornmeal", "15 g plain flour", "3 piece egg, raw", "120 ml low fat buttermilk", "15 ml lemon juice", "5 ml vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt", "1 g ground nutmeg"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C. Place the unbaked pie crust into a 23 cm pie dish and chill it while you make the filling. Melt the butter gently over low heat and let it cool for a few minutes. In a mixing bowl, whisk together the sugar, cornmeal, flour, and salt until evenly combined. Add the eggs one at a time and whisk until the mixture looks smooth and slightly thickened. Stir in the buttermilk, lemon juice, vanilla extract, melted butter, and nutmeg until fully incorporated. Pour the filling into the prepared crust and smooth the top. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes, until the center is just set with a slight wobble and the top is lightly golden. If the crust browns too quickly, loosely cover the edges with foil during the last part of baking. Let the pie cool completely before slicing so the filling can finish setting.

title: Lighter Brown Sugar Chess Pie with Lemon and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["1 piece wholemeal shortcrust pie crust, baked, 23 cm", "200 g granulated sugar", "50 g light brown sugar", "30 g cornmeal, fine", "25 g plain flour", "120 g egg, raw", "60 g egg white, raw", "45 g unsalted butter", "120 ml low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "15 ml lemon juice, fresh", "2 g lemon zest", "5 ml vanilla extract", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and place a rack in the middle. If using a homemade crust, blind bake it in a 23 cm pie dish until pale gold and set, then let it cool slightly. In a large bowl, whisk together the granulated sugar, brown sugar, cornmeal, flour, and salt until evenly combined. Add the eggs and egg white, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Pour in the melted butter, milk, lemon juice, lemon zest, and vanilla, and whisk just until the mixture is uniform. Set the pie shell on a baking tray, pour in the filling, and bake for 40 to 50 minutes. The pie is done when the edges are set, the center still has a slight wobble, and the top looks lightly cracked and golden. Cool completely at room temperature, then chill for at least 2 hours before slicing so the custard finishes setting cleanly.

title: Light Southern Chess Pie with Lemon and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["1 piece wholegrain pastry crust, unbaked 23 cm", "50 g butter, unsalted", "150 g sugar, white", "25 g cornmeal, fine", "15 g plain flour", "3 piece egg, raw", "120 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "80 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "30 ml lemon juice, freshly squeezed", "1 tsp lemon zest, grated", "5 ml vanilla extract", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and place a rack in the lower middle position. Set the pastry crust in a 23 cm pie dish and chill it while you make the filling. Melt the butter gently over low heat, then let it cool for a few minutes so it does not scramble the eggs. In a large bowl whisk together the sugar, cornmeal, flour, and salt until evenly combined. Whisk in the eggs one at a time until smooth, then add the yogurt, milk, lemon juice, lemon zest, and vanilla. Slowly whisk in the melted butter until the mixture looks glossy and well blended. Pour the filling into the chilled crust and bake for 40 to 50 minutes, until the edges are set and the centre still has a slight wobble. If the crust browns too quickly, loosely cover the rim with foil during the last part of baking. Cool the pie completely on a wire rack so the custard finishes setting, then chill for at least 2 hours before slicing.

title: Lighter Brown Sugar Chess Pie with Lemon and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["1 piece ready-made wholemeal pie crust", "120 g unsalted butter", "180 g light brown sugar", "2 pieces egg, raw", "2 pieces egg yolk, raw", "120 ml buttermilk, low fat", "15 g cornmeal, yellow", "15 g wholemeal flour", "10 ml lemon juice, fresh", "2 g lemon zest", "5 ml vanilla extract", "1 g salt, table"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and place a rack in the lower middle position. Fit the pie crust into a 23 cm pie dish and chill it while you make the filling. Melt the butter gently over low heat, then let it cool for a few minutes so it is warm but not hot. In a mixing bowl, whisk the brown sugar, cornmeal, wholemeal flour, and salt until evenly combined. Whisk in the eggs and egg yolks until the mixture looks smooth and slightly thickened. Stir in the buttermilk, lemon juice, lemon zest, and vanilla, then slowly whisk in the cooled butter. Pour the filling into the prepared crust and bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until the center is just set with a slight wobble and the top is lightly browned. If the crust browns too quickly, cover the edges loosely with foil. Cool the pie completely on a wire rack so the filling can finish setting, then chill for cleaner slices before serving.

title: Moist Dark Chocolate Olive Oil Cake with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "40 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "120 g granulated sugar", "8 g baking powder", "2 g baking soda", "1 g salt", "2 piece egg, raw", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "80 ml olive oil", "120 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "5 ml vanilla extract", "100 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "80 ml hot water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and lightly grease a 20 cm round cake tin, then line the base with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, cocoa powder, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until evenly combined. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs, Greek yogurt, olive oil, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined. Add the hot water and mix until the batter looks glossy and fairly fluid; do not overmix. Fold in the chopped dark chocolate. Transfer the batter to the prepared tin and smooth the top. Bake for 28 to 32 minutes, until the cake has risen and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out with a few moist crumbs. Let the cake cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn it out onto a wire rack and cool completely before slicing.

title: Dark Chocolate Banana Oat Cake with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "30 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "10 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "2 piece egg, raw", "120 g banana, ripe, raw", "80 g honey", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "120 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "5 ml vanilla extract", "60 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "15 g chopped walnuts"]

Pour the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined, then fold in the chopped dark chocolate. Transfer the batter to the prepared tin and smooth the top. Sprinkle the walnuts over the surface. Bake on the middle rack for 28 to 32 minutes, until the cake is risen and a skewer inserted into the center comes out with a few moist crumbs. Let it cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack and allow it to cool completely before slicing.

title: Moist Dark Chocolate Oat Cake with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "35 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "120 g unrefined cane sugar", "8 g baking powder", "2 g baking soda", "1 g fine salt", "2 piece egg, raw", "200 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "120 ml semi-skimmed milk", "5 ml vanilla extract", "80 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "20 g chopped walnuts"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a 20 cm round cake tin with baking paper. title: Moist Dark Chocolate Banana Oat Cakes
ingredients_json: ["180 g ripe banana, raw", "120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "30 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "2 pieces egg, raw", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "70 g brown sugar", "60 ml skimmed milk", "8 g baking powder", "2 g baking soda", "1 g salt", "5 ml vanilla extract", "40 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa"]

Mash the banana until smooth in a large bowl, then whisk in the eggs, yogurt, milk, rapeseed oil, and vanilla until evenly combined. In a separate bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, cocoa powder, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir gently just until no dry flour remains. Fold in the chopped dark chocolate. Spoon the batter into the prepared tin or moulds and smooth the top. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes for muffin-sized cakes, or 28 to 32 minutes for a small cake, until the centre springs back and a skewer inserted in the middle comes out with only a few moist crumbs. Leave to cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack before serving.

title: Moist Dark Chocolate Banana Oat Cakes
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal flour", "60 g rolled oats", "35 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "8 g baking powder", "2 g bicarbonate of soda", "2 g fine salt", "120 g ripe banana, mashed", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 g low-fat plain yogurt", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "120 ml semi-skimmed milk", "90 g light brown sugar", "5 ml vanilla extract", "70 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a 20 cm round cake tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, oats, cocoa powder, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, and salt. In a separate bowl, mix the mashed banana, eggs, yogurt, rapeseed oil, milk, brown sugar, and vanilla extract until smooth. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined; do not overmix. Fold in the chopped dark chocolate. Pour the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Bake for 28 to 32 minutes, until the cake is risen and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out with only a few moist crumbs. Leave to cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

title: Whole Wheat Oat Chocolate Chip Cookies with Dark Chocolate and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "80 g unsalted butter", "60 g light brown sugar", "40 g white sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "100 g dark chocolate chips", "40 g walnuts"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, and salt. In a separate bowl, beat the butter, brown sugar, and white sugar until smooth and slightly creamy, then mix in the egg and vanilla extract. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, then fold in the dark chocolate chips and walnuts. Scoop the dough into 18 small mounds and place them evenly spaced on the trays. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden but the centres still look soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before moving them to a wire rack so they firm up without drying out.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies with Dark Chocolate and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "100 g rolled oats", "80 g unsalted butter", "70 g light brown sugar", "40 g white sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "1 g fine salt", "120 g dark chocolate chips", "50 g walnuts", "30 ml semi-skimmed milk"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a large bowl, beat the softened butter with the brown sugar and white sugar until the mixture looks creamy and slightly lighter in colour. Mix in the egg, vanilla extract, and milk until smooth. In a separate bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, oats, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir just until a dough forms, then fold in the chocolate chips and walnuts. Chill the dough for 20 minutes if it feels too soft, because this helps the cookies hold their shape. Scoop heaped spoonfuls onto the trays, leaving space between each cookie, and flatten them slightly. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the edges are set and lightly golden but the centres still look a little soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before moving them to a wire rack so they finish setting without breaking.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Chip Cookies with Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g unsalted butter", "50 g light brown sugar", "40 g granulated sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "120 g dark chocolate chips", "50 g walnuts"]

In a bowl, whisk together the melted butter, brown sugar, granulated sugar, egg, and vanilla until smooth and slightly glossy. Stir in the wholemeal flour, oats, baking powder, and salt until just combined, then fold in the chocolate chips and walnuts. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden but the centres still look a little soft. title: Whole Wheat Dark Chocolate Chip Cookies with Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "80 g plain flour", "1 g baking soda", "2 g fine salt", "85 g unsalted butter", "60 g light brown sugar", "40 g white sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "5 ml vanilla extract", "80 g dark chocolate chips", "40 g walnuts, chopped"]

Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden but the centres still look slightly soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to finish cooling.

title: Whole Wheat Chocolate Chip Cookies with Oats and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "90 g unsalted butter", "70 g light brown sugar", "40 g white sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp baking powder", "2 g salt", "120 g dark chocolate chips", "40 g walnuts"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, baking powder, and salt. In a separate bowl, beat the butter, brown sugar, and white sugar until the mixture looks creamy and slightly lighter in color. Mix in the egg and vanilla extract until smooth. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until combined, then fold in the dark chocolate chips and walnuts. Scoop tablespoon-sized portions onto the prepared tray, leaving enough space for spreading, and gently flatten them slightly. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are golden but the centers still look a little soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before moving them to a wire rack so they set without becoming dry.

title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Fudge with Toasted Almonds
ingredients_json: ["200 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa solids", "150 g avocado, raw, flesh only", "120 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "60 g honey", "20 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "30 g almond butter", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g salt, table", "25 g almonds, toasted, chopped"]
instructions: Line a small square tin with baking paper, leaving some overhang for easy lifting. Melt the dark chocolate gently in a heatproof bowl over a pan of barely simmering water, stirring until smooth and glossy. In a blender or food processor, blend the avocado, milk, honey, cocoa powder, almond butter, vanilla extract, and salt until completely smooth with no lumps. Pour in the melted chocolate and blend again briefly until the mixture is thick, even, and shiny. Spread the fudge mixture into the prepared tin and smooth the top with a spatula. Scatter the chopped toasted almonds over the surface and press them in lightly. Chill for at least 3 hours, or until firm enough to slice cleanly. title: Dark Chocolate Avocado Fudge with Almond and Orange

title: Silky Vanilla Almond Flan with Light Caramel
ingredients_json: ["80 g cane sugar", "30 ml water", "400 ml semi-skimmed milk", "200 ml unsweetened almond drink", "3 piece egg", "2 piece egg yolk", "60 g caster sugar", "20 g cornflour", "2 g vanilla extract", "1 g fine sea salt", "5 ml lemon zest"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 160 C and place a deep roasting tray on the middle shelf. Make the caramel by heating the cane sugar and water in a small saucepan over medium heat without stirring until it turns a deep amber colour. Immediately pour the caramel into a 20 cm round flan dish and tilt the dish so the base is evenly coated. In a separate saucepan, warm the milk and almond drink over medium heat until steaming, but do not let it boil. In a bowl, whisk the eggs, egg yolks, caster sugar, cornflour, vanilla extract, salt, and lemon zest until smooth. Slowly pour the hot milk mixture into the egg mixture while whisking constantly so the eggs do not scramble. Strain the custard through a fine sieve into the caramel-lined dish. Place the dish in the roasting tray and pour in enough hot water to come halfway up the sides of the flan dish. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until the edges are set and the centre still has a slight wobble. Remove the flan from the water bath and cool to room temperature, then chill for at least 4 hours. To serve, run a thin knife around the edge and invert onto a serving plate so the caramel runs over the top.

In a separate bowl, beat the butter and brown sugar until smooth, then mix in the molasses and egg until well combined. Add the dry ingredients and the milk, stirring just until a soft dough forms. Chill the dough for 20 minutes so it is easier to roll. Roll the dough out to about 5 mm thickness on a lightly floured surface and cut into cookie shapes. Place the cookies on the prepared trays with a little space between them. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until the edges are set and the centres still look slightly soft. Let them cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack. Melt the dark chocolate and drizzle it lightly over the cooled cookies for a balanced, richer finish.

title: Soft Wholemeal Gingerbread Cookies with Molasses and Spices
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "70 g plain wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g unsalted butter", "60 g rapeseed oil", "90 g brown sugar", "80 g molasses", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 ml low-fat milk", "1 tsp baking soda", "2 tsp ground ginger", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground cloves", "0.5 tsp ground nutmeg", "1 g salt", "5 ml vanilla extract"]

Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely. They will firm up as they cool and stay pleasantly soft in the middle.

title: Soft Spiced Wholemeal Gingerbread Cookies
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g plain white flour", "1 tsp ground ginger", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground nutmeg", "0.25 tsp ground cloves", "0.5 tsp baking soda", "1 g fine salt", "60 g unsalted butter", "50 g soft brown sugar", "70 g molasses", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml skimmed milk", "5 ml vanilla extract"]

title: Greek Yogurt Vanilla Berry Ice Cream
ingredients_json: ["300 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed, pasteurised", "120 g banana, raw", "150 g strawberries, raw", "80 g blueberries, raw", "35 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "15 ml lemon juice, freshly squeezed", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Place the banana, strawberries, blueberries, honey, vanilla extract, lemon juice, milk, Greek yogurt, and salt into a blender. Blend on high speed until completely smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides once if needed. Pour the mixture into a shallow freezer-safe container and freeze for 45 minutes. Stir vigorously with a fork or whisk to break up the ice crystals, then return it to the freezer. Repeat the stirring every 30 to 45 minutes for about 2 to 3 hours, until the texture is thick and scoopable. For a firmer ice cream, freeze for another 30 minutes before serving. Let it sit at room temperature for 5 minutes before scooping.

title: Banana-Blueberry Greek Yogurt Ice Cream
ingredients_json: ["300 g banana, ripe", "250 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "150 g blueberries, frozen", "40 g honey", "60 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "15 ml lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g salt", "20 g rolled oats", "10 g chia seeds"]
instructions: Peel the bananas, slice them, and freeze the pieces for at least 4 hours until solid. Add the frozen banana, Greek yogurt, blueberries, honey, milk, lemon juice, vanilla extract, and salt to a food processor or high-speed blender. Blend in short bursts at first, then continue until the mixture becomes smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed. If the mixture is too thick, add a little more milk and blend again briefly. Fold in the rolled oats and chia seeds, then transfer everything to a shallow freezer-safe container. Freeze for 1 to 2 hours, stirring once halfway through, until scoopable but still creamy. Let the ice cream sit at room temperature for 5 minutes before serving to soften slightly.

title: Greek Yogurt Berry Swirl Ice Cream with Honey and Oats
ingredients_json: ["500 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "250 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "120 g mixed berries, frozen", "60 g honey", "40 g rolled oats", "15 ml lemon juice", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Toast the rolled oats in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often, until they smell nutty and turn lightly golden. Set them aside to cool. In a blender, combine the Greek yogurt, milk, frozen berries, honey, lemon juice, vanilla extract, and salt, then blend until smooth and creamy. Stir in most of the cooled oats by hand, saving a little for topping if desired. Pour the mixture into a shallow freezer-safe container and freeze for about 2 hours, stirring well every 30 minutes to break up ice crystals. Once the texture is thick and scoopable, freeze for another 1 to 2 hours until firm. Let the ice cream sit at room temperature for 5 to 10 minutes before serving, then scoop into bowls and finish with the remaining oats.

title: Greek Yogurt Berry Swirl Ice Cream
ingredients_json: ["300 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "250 g strawberries, raw", "100 g blueberries, raw", "60 g honey", "15 ml lemon juice, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Place the strawberries, blueberries, honey, and lemon juice in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring often, until the berries soften and release their juices. Remove from the heat and blend until smooth, then let the fruit puree cool completely. In a bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, milk, vanilla extract, and salt until fully combined. Stir in about two thirds of the cooled berry puree, leaving visible swirls for a marbled effect. Pour the mixture into an ice cream maker and churn according to the machine instructions until thick and softly frozen. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, ripple the remaining puree through the top, and freeze for 2 to 3 hours until scoopable. Let it stand at room temperature for 5 minutes before serving for a creamier texture.

title: Greek Yogurt Strawberry-Vanilla Nice Cream
ingredients_json: ["300 g Banana, raw", "250 g Strawberries, raw", "300 g Yogurt, Greek style, plain, low fat", "30 g Honey", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "20 g Oats, rolled, dry", "10 g Chia seeds", "1 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Slice the bananas and freeze them for at least 4 hours, or overnight, until solid. Rinse and hull the strawberries, then freeze them for 2 hours so they are cold and slightly firm. Add the frozen banana, frozen strawberries, Greek yogurt, honey, vanilla extract, lemon juice, oats, chia seeds, and salt to a food processor. Blend in short bursts at first, then continue on medium speed, scraping down the sides as needed, until the mixture becomes smooth and thick like soft-serve ice cream. If the mixture looks too dense, let it sit for 2 to 3 minutes and blend again until creamy. Spoon into a freezer-safe container and freeze for 30 to 45 minutes for a firmer scoopable texture. Serve slightly softened for the best texture.

title: Light Greek Yogurt Key Lime Pie with Oat-Almond Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "80 g almond flour", "40 g unsalted butter, melted", "20 g honey", "1 g fine salt", "300 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "200 g cream cheese, reduced fat", "120 ml key lime juice, fresh", "2 piece egg, raw", "60 g honey", "2 g lime zest", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C. Lightly grease a 20 cm pie dish. Pulse the oats until coarsely ground, then mix them with the almond flour, melted butter, honey, and salt until the mixture holds together when pressed. Firmly press it into the base and up the sides of the dish and bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until lightly golden. Let the crust cool for 10 minutes. Lower the oven temperature to 160 C. In a bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, reduced-fat cream cheese, key lime juice, eggs, honey, lime zest, and vanilla until smooth and glossy. Pour the filling into the cooled crust and bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until the edges are set but the centre still has a slight wobble. Turn off the oven and let the pie sit inside with the door ajar for 15 minutes. Cool completely, then refrigerate for at least 3 hours until fully chilled and sliceable.

title: Light Key Lime Pie with Greek Yogurt and Almond Crust
ingredients_json: ["180 g almond meal", "30 g rolled oats", "40 g butter, unsalted", "20 g honey", "300 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "200 g cream cheese, reduced fat", "120 ml lime juice, fresh", "2 pieces lime zest, fresh", "2 pieces egg, raw", "2 pieces egg yolk, raw", "60 g sugar, granulated", "10 g cornstarch", "80 g whipped cream, light", "10 g lime zest, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and lightly grease a 23 cm pie dish. Mix the almond meal, rolled oats, melted butter and honey until the mixture resembles damp sand, then press it firmly into the base and up the sides of the dish. Bake the crust for 10 to 12 minutes until lightly golden, then set it aside to cool slightly. In a large bowl, whisk the cream cheese until smooth, then add the Greek yogurt, lime juice, lime zest, eggs, egg yolks, sugar and cornstarch. Whisk until the filling is glossy and well combined without overbeating. Pour the filling into the warm crust and bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 165 C, or until the edges are set and the center still has a slight wobble. Turn off the oven, leave the pie inside with the door cracked for 15 minutes, then cool completely at room temperature. Chill for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight, before topping with the light whipped cream and extra lime zest. Slice with a warm knife for clean portions.

title: Lighter Key Lime Pie with Yogurt and Graham Cracker Crust
ingredients_json: ["180 g graham crackers", "60 g unsalted butter, melted", "25 g light brown sugar", "350 g low-fat plain Greek yogurt", "200 g reduced-fat cream cheese", "120 ml key lime juice", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 g caster sugar", "1 tsp lime zest, fresh", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 degrees C. Crush the graham crackers finely, then mix them with the melted butter and brown sugar until the crumbs hold together when pressed. Press the mixture firmly into the base and slightly up the sides of a 23 cm pie dish. Bake for 8 minutes, then set aside to cool while you make the filling. Reduce the oven temperature to 160 degrees C. In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese, yogurt, caster sugar, lime zest, vanilla, and salt until smooth. Whisk in the eggs one at a time, then mix in the key lime juice until fully combined and glossy. Pour the filling into the cooled crust and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until the edges are set but the center still has a slight wobble. Turn the oven off and let the pie sit with the door cracked open for 10 minutes, then cool completely at room temperature. Chill for at least 4 hours before slicing so the filling firms up and the lime flavour develops.

title: Light Key Lime Pie with Yogurt and Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "60 g almond flour", "40 g unsalted butter, melted", "20 g honey", "1 piece egg white, raw", "300 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "200 g quark, low fat, plain", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 ml key lime juice, fresh", "2 tbsp lime zest, fresh", "60 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g salt"]

Whisk the yogurt, quark, eggs, key lime juice, lime zest, honey, vanilla extract, and salt until smooth and well combined. Pour the filling into the warm crust and bake at 160 C for 25 to 30 minutes, until the center is just set with a slight wobble. Remove the pie and let it cool to room temperature, then chill it for at least 3 hours so it slices cleanly. Serve cold, with extra lime zest over the top if desired.

title: Lighter Key Lime Pie with Oat-Almond Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g oat flakes", "80 g almond flour", "30 g light brown sugar", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 piece egg white, raw", "1 g fine salt", "400 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "200 g sweetened condensed milk, reduced fat", "120 ml key lime juice, unsweetened", "2 piece egg yolk, raw", "2 g lime zest, fresh", "150 g skyr, plain", "15 g honey", "1 ml vanilla extract"]

In a bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, reduced-fat condensed milk, key lime juice, egg yolks and lime zest until smooth. Pour the filling into the warm crust and bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until the center is just set but still has a slight wobble. Cool to room temperature, then chill for at least 4 hours so the pie firms up cleanly. title: Whole Wheat Lemon Bars with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "80 g plain wheat flour", "60 g oats, rolled", "90 g butter, unsalted", "60 g sugar", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "2 g salt", "2 pieces lemon zest, raw", "3 pieces lemon juice, raw", "2 pieces egg, raw", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "50 g sugar", "20 g whole wheat flour", "10 g icing sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and line an 20 cm square baking tin with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, plain flour, oats, sugar, and salt. Rub in the butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then mix in the egg yolk until it just comes together. Press the dough firmly into the tin in an even layer and bake for 14 to 16 minutes, until lightly golden at the edges. While the base bakes, whisk the eggs with the sugar, whole wheat flour, lemon zest, lemon juice, and Greek yogurt until smooth. Pour the filling over the hot base and return it to the oven. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes on the middle rack, until the center is just set and still slightly wobbly. Cool completely in the tin, then chill for at least 2 hours so the bars slice cleanly. Dust with icing sugar before cutting into squares.

title: Wholemeal Lemon Bars with Greek Yogurt and Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal flour", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g unsalted butter", "40 g honey", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "1 g fine salt", "250 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "2 pieces eggs, raw", "90 g caster sugar", "45 ml lemon juice, fresh", "2 g lemon zest, fresh", "15 g cornflour", "5 ml vanilla extract", "10 g icing sugar"]

While the crust bakes, whisk together the Greek yogurt, eggs, caster sugar, lemon juice, lemon zest, cornflour, and vanilla extract until smooth. Pour the filling over the hot crust and return the tin to the oven. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes on the middle rack, until the centre is just set and still has a slight wobble. Remove from the oven and let it cool completely in the tin, then chill for at least 2 hours so the bars slice cleanly. Dust lightly with icing sugar before cutting into squares.

title: Wholemeal Lemon Bars with Greek Yogurt Glaze
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "70 g plain wheat flour", "120 g unsalted butter", "60 g icing sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 pieces lemon, raw", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "90 g caster sugar", "20 g cornflour", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a 20 cm square baking tin with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, plain flour, icing sugar, and salt, then rub in the butter until the mixture looks like fine crumbs. Add the egg and mix just until a soft dough forms. Press the dough evenly into the base of the tin and bake for 15 minutes, or until lightly golden around the edges. While the base bakes, finely zest and juice the lemons. Whisk the yogurt, caster sugar, cornflour, lemon zest, lemon juice, and a little beaten egg from the reserved filling until smooth. Pour the filling over the hot base and return the tin to the oven. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes at 180 C, until the centre is just set with a slight wobble. Cool completely in the tin, then chill for at least 2 hours before cutting into squares for clean slices.

title: Wholemeal Lemon Bars with Greek Yogurt and Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "70 g cold unsalted butter", "60 g granulated sugar", "1 piece egg", "1 g fine salt", "3 piece lemon, unwaxed", "90 g plain Greek yogurt, low-fat", "2 piece egg", "40 g cornflour", "120 g granulated sugar", "15 g powdered sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and line a 20 cm square baking tin with baking paper, leaving some overhang for lifting the bars out later. In a bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, 60 g sugar and salt. Rub in the cold butter with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then add the egg and mix just until the dough comes together. Press it firmly and evenly into the lined tin. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until lightly golden at the edges. While the crust bakes, zest the lemons and squeeze out the juice. Whisk the yogurt, eggs, cornflour, 120 g sugar, lemon zest and lemon juice until smooth. Pour the filling over the hot crust and return the tin to the oven. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes at 175 C, until the center is just set and no longer sloshes when gently shaken. Let the bars cool completely at room temperature, then chill for at least 2 hours for clean slicing. Dust with powdered sugar before cutting into squares.

title: Wholemeal Lemon Bars with Greek Yogurt and Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal flour", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g almond flour", "60 g butter, unsalted", "40 g rapeseed oil", "70 g brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "250 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "2 piece egg, raw", "120 g caster sugar", "90 ml lemon juice, freshly squeezed", "2 tsp lemon zest, grated", "20 g cornflour", "1 g salt", "15 g icing sugar"]

Mix the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, almond flour, brown sugar, salt, melted butter, rapeseed oil and 1 egg in a bowl until a crumbly dough forms. Press it firmly into the tin in an even layer and bake for about 12 to 15 minutes, until lightly golden at the edges. While the base bakes, whisk together the Greek yogurt, 2 eggs, caster sugar, lemon juice, lemon zest and cornflour until smooth. Pour the filling over the hot crust and reduce the oven temperature to 170 C. Bake for 18 to 22 minutes, until the center is just set with a slight wobble. Cool completely in the tin, then chill for at least 2 hours so the bars slice neatly. Dust lightly with icing sugar before cutting into 9 squares.

title: Coconut Almond Macaroons with Dark Chocolate Drizzle
ingredients_json: ["200 g unsweetened desiccated coconut", "100 g ground almonds", "90 g egg whites", "80 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt", "40 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "10 ml water"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a mixing bowl, combine the desiccated coconut, ground almonds and fine salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg whites until foamy, then whisk in the honey and vanilla extract until the mixture looks slightly glossy and lightly aerated. Fold the dry ingredients into the egg white mixture until evenly combined and sticky. Scoop small mounds of the mixture onto the tray, leaving a little space between them, and gently shape them into rounded macaroons with damp fingers. Bake for 14 to 16 minutes on the middle rack until the edges are golden and the tops are lightly toasted. Remove from the oven and let the macaroons cool on the tray for 10 minutes before moving them to a wire rack. Melt the dark chocolate with the water over low heat or in short microwave bursts, stirring until smooth, then drizzle lightly over the cooled macaroons. Allow the chocolate to set before serving.

title: Coconut Almond Macaroons with Dark Chocolate Drizzle
ingredients_json: ["180 g unsweetened shredded coconut", "80 g ground almonds", "120 g egg white", "90 g honey", "30 g plain Greek yogurt", "5 ml vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt", "40 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "5 ml coconut oil"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a large bowl, mix the shredded coconut, ground almonds, and salt. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg whites until foamy, then whisk in the honey, Greek yogurt, and vanilla extract until well combined. Stir the wet mixture into the dry ingredients and let the batter stand for 5 minutes so the coconut absorbs some moisture. Scoop small mounds onto the tray, spacing them slightly apart, and shape them gently with damp fingers. Bake for 14 to 16 minutes on the middle rack, until the edges are golden and the tops are lightly toasted. Cool on the tray for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. Melt the dark chocolate with the coconut oil over low heat or in short microwave bursts, drizzle over the cooled macaroons, and let it set before serving.

title: Almond Coconut Raspberry Macaroons

Fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients until everything is evenly coated. Gently crush the raspberries and fold them in very lightly so the batter stays textured. Scoop small mounds onto the tray and shape them with slightly damp fingers. Bake for 14 to 16 minutes over medium heat until the tops are lightly golden and the edges look set. Let the macaroons cool on the tray for 10 minutes before moving them. Melt the dark chocolate, drizzle it over the cooled macaroons, and allow it to set before serving.

title: Coconut Almond Macaroons with Dark Chocolate Drizzle
ingredients_json: ["180 g unsweetened shredded coconut", "80 g ground almonds", "90 g egg white, raw", "70 g honey", "40 g maple syrup", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g fine sea salt", "20 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "10 ml water"]

title: Coconut Almond Macaroons with Dark Chocolate Drizzle

title: Light Chocolate Avocado Mousse with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g Avocado, raw, flesh only", "150 g Yogurt, Greek style, plain, low fat", "25 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "40 g Honey", "30 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "15 ml Lemon juice, fresh", "1 g Salt, table"]
instructions: Place the avocado flesh, Greek yogurt, cocoa powder, honey, milk, vanilla extract, lemon juice, and salt into a food processor or blender. Blend on medium speed until completely smooth, scraping down the sides once or twice so no green flecks remain. Taste and blend again briefly if you want it a little sweeter or more chocolatey, keeping in mind that the flavors will mellow after chilling. Spoon the mousse into four serving glasses and smooth the tops. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour so the texture firms up and the chocolate flavor deepens. Serve chilled, optionally with a few berries or a light dusting of cocoa powder if desired.

title: Greek Yogurt Chocolate Avocado Mousse with Raspberries
ingredients_json: ["250 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 piece avocado, raw, peeled and pitted", "25 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "40 g honey", "30 ml orange juice, fresh", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g salt, table", "80 g raspberries, raw", "10 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "5 g chia seeds"]
instructions: Scoop the avocado flesh into a blender or food processor and add the Greek yogurt, cocoa powder, honey, orange juice, vanilla extract, and salt. Blend on high until the mixture is completely smooth and airy, stopping once or twice to scrape down the sides. Taste and, if needed, blend for a few more seconds so the mousse is silky and evenly sweet. Divide the mousse between 4 glasses or small bowls and chill for at least 30 minutes so it firms slightly and the flavors meld. Just before serving, top with the raspberries, finely chopped dark chocolate, and chia seeds. Serve cold.

title: Light Greek Yogurt Chocolate Mousse with Raspberries
ingredients_json: ["250 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "100 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "30 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 piece egg white, raw", "5 ml vanilla extract", "2 g gelatin powder", "15 ml water", "80 g raspberries, fresh", "5 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "1 g lemon zest"]
instructions: Place the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl and melt it gently over a pan of barely simmering water, stirring until smooth. Stir in the honey, vanilla extract, and lemon zest, then let the mixture cool until it is only slightly warm. Sprinkle the gelatin over the water and leave it to bloom for 5 minutes, then warm it briefly until fully dissolved. Whisk the egg and egg white in a heatproof bowl over very low heat until the mixture becomes pale, foamy, and slightly thickened, about 3 to 4 minutes; do not let it scramble. Fold the yogurt into the cooled chocolate mixture, then whisk in the dissolved gelatin. Gently fold in the egg mixture until the mousse is airy and evenly combined. Divide into 4 glasses, smooth the tops, and chill for at least 2 hours until set. Just before serving, top with the raspberries and a light dusting of cocoa powder.

title: Greek Yogurt Chocolate Avocado Mousse with Raspberries
ingredients_json: ["200 g avocado flesh", "250 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "20 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "35 g honey", "30 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g salt", "120 g raspberries, fresh", "10 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa"]

title: Greek Yogurt Chocolate Avocado Mousse with Raspberries
ingredients_json: ["200 g Avocado, raw flesh", "250 g Yogurt, Greek style, plain, low fat", "25 g Cocoa powder, unsweetened", "35 g Honey", "60 ml Milk, semi-skimmed", "5 ml Vanilla extract", "1 g Salt, table", "120 g Raspberries, raw", "10 g Dark chocolate, 70-85% cocoa"]
instructions: Scoop the avocado flesh into a blender or food processor and add the Greek yogurt, cocoa powder, honey, milk, vanilla extract, and salt. Blend on high until the mixture is completely smooth and airy, stopping once to scrape down the sides if needed. Taste and blend again briefly if you want a richer chocolate flavour. Divide the mousse between 4 small glasses or bowls and chill for at least 1 hour so it firms slightly and the flavour develops. Just before serving, top with the raspberries and finely grate the dark chocolate over the top.

title: Soft Oatmeal Cookies with Banana, Raisins and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["150 g rolled oats", "80 g wholemeal wheat flour", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "60 g unsalted butter", "80 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 piece ripe banana, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "50 g raisins", "30 g chopped walnuts"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, wholemeal flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, beat the butter and brown sugar until smooth, then mix in the egg, mashed banana, and vanilla extract. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, then fold in the raisins and walnuts. Scoop spoonfuls of dough onto the tray, leaving space between each cookie, and flatten them slightly with the back of a spoon. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centres look set but still soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Soft Oatmeal Cookies with Raisins and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "100 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g unsalted butter", "70 g light brown sugar", "50 g granulated sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g plain yoghurt, low fat", "80 g raisins", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a bowl, beat the butter, light brown sugar, and granulated sugar together until smooth and slightly fluffy. Mix in the egg, yoghurt, and vanilla extract until fully combined. In a separate bowl, stir together the rolled oats, wholemeal flour, cinnamon, baking powder, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and fold until a thick dough forms, then mix in the raisins. Let the dough rest for 10 minutes so the oats hydrate slightly. Scoop tablespoon-sized portions onto the prepared trays, leaving enough space for spreading, and flatten them gently with your fingers. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the edges are lightly golden but the centres still look soft. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to finish cooling.

title: Chewy Oatmeal Cookies with Raisins and Walnuts
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "90 g wholemeal wheat flour", "60 g unsalted butter", "60 g light brown sugar", "40 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 g raisins", "30 g walnuts", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "2 g fine salt", "1 tsp vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Melt the butter gently, then whisk it with the brown sugar, honey, egg, and vanilla extract until smooth. In a separate bowl, combine the oats, wholemeal flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until just combined, then fold in the raisins and chopped walnuts. Scoop spoonfuls of the dough onto the tray and flatten them slightly with your fingers, leaving space between each cookie. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden but the centres still look a little soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack so they firm up as they cool.

title: Soft Oatmeal Cookies with Apple, Raisins and Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "90 g wholemeal wheat flour", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp fine salt", "60 g unsalted butter", "60 g rapeseed oil", "90 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "100 g unsweetened apple purée", "80 g raisins", "30 g chopped walnuts"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a medium bowl, mix the rolled oats, wholemeal flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt until evenly combined. In a second bowl, whisk together the butter, rapeseed oil, and brown sugar until smooth, then beat in the egg, vanilla extract, and apple purée. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir just until no dry flour remains, then fold in the raisins and walnuts. Let the dough rest for 10 minutes so the oats absorb some moisture. Spoon portions of dough onto the trays, spacing them well apart, and flatten each mound slightly with the back of a spoon. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centres still look slightly soft. Leave the cookies on the tray for 5 minutes before moving them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Soft Oatmeal Cookies with Banana, Cinnamon and Raisins
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "90 g wholemeal wheat flour", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1.5 g salt", "60 g unsalted butter", "70 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "120 g ripe banana, mashed", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "50 g raisins", "30 g plain low-fat yogurt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, wholemeal flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. In a separate bowl, beat the butter and brown sugar until well combined, then stir in the egg, mashed banana, vanilla and yogurt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and mix just until combined, then fold in the raisins. Scoop tablespoons of dough onto the trays, leaving space between each cookie, and flatten them slightly with damp fingers. Bake for 11 to 13 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centres still look a little soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring them to a rack so they firm up without drying out.

title: Mini Berry Pavlovas with Greek Yogurt and Mint
ingredients_json: ["3 pieces Egg white, raw", "150 g Sugar, granulated", "1 tsp Cornflour", "1 tsp Vinegar, white wine", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "200 g Yogurt, Greek, plain, low fat", "200 g Strawberries, raw", "100 g Blueberries, raw", "80 g Raspberries, raw", "10 g Mint, fresh", "10 g Honey"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 120 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Whisk the egg whites in a clean bowl until soft peaks form, then add the sugar a little at a time while whisking until the mixture is thick, glossy, and holds stiff peaks. Fold in the cornflour, vinegar, and vanilla gently so the meringue stays airy. Spoon the mixture into 6 small rounds on the tray, making a slight hollow in the center of each one. Bake for about 75 minutes, then turn the oven off and leave the pavlovas inside with the door closed for 1 hour so they dry out slowly and stay crisp outside and marshmallow-like inside. When ready to serve, mix the Greek yogurt with half of the honey. Top each cooled pavlova with the yogurt, scatter over the strawberries, blueberries, and raspberries, then finish with the remaining honey and torn mint leaves.

title: Mini Lemon Greek Yogurt Pavlovas with Mixed Berries
ingredients_json: ["3 pieces Egg white, raw", "150 g Sugar, white", "1 tsp Cornflour", "1 tsp White wine vinegar", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "1 tsp Lemon zest", "15 ml Lemon juice", "150 g Strawberries, raw", "100 g Blueberries, raw", "100 g Raspberries, raw", "10 g Honey", "10 g Pistachios, unsalted"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 120 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Whisk the egg whites in a clean bowl until soft peaks form, then add the sugar little by little while whisking until the meringue is thick, glossy, and holds firm peaks. Gently fold in the cornflour, vinegar, and vanilla, keeping as much air in the mixture as possible. Spoon the meringue into 6 small rounds on the tray and make a slight dip in the centre of each. Bake for 70 minutes, then turn the oven off and leave the pavlovas inside for another hour so they dry out slowly without cracking too much. Mix the Greek yogurt with the lemon zest and lemon juice, then chill it until serving. Hull and slice the strawberries and combine them with the blueberries and raspberries. When the pavlovas are cool, top each one with the lemon yogurt, spoon over the berries, drizzle lightly with honey, and finish with the chopped pistachios.

title: Mini Lemon Berry Pavlovas with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["4 piece Egg white, raw", "200 g Sugar, granulated", "1 tsp Cornstarch", "1 tsp White wine vinegar", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "250 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "200 g Strawberries, fresh", "100 g Blueberries, fresh", "1 tbsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp Lemon zest, fresh", "10 g Mint, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 120°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Whisk the egg whites in a clean bowl until they form soft peaks, then add the sugar gradually while whisking until the mixture is thick, glossy, and the sugar has dissolved. Fold in the cornstarch, white wine vinegar, and vanilla extract. Spoon 4 even mounds onto the tray and shape each one with a slight dip in the centre. Bake for about 75 minutes until the outside is crisp and dry but still pale. Turn the oven off and leave the pavlovas inside with the door slightly open for at least 1 hour so they cool slowly and stay crisp. Meanwhile, mix the Greek yogurt with the lemon juice and lemon zest, and slice the strawberries if needed. Just before serving, top each pavlova with the lemon yogurt, divide over the berries, and finish with the mint.

title: Mini Lemon Berry Pavlovas with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["3 pieces Egg white, raw", "150 g Sugar, white", "1 tsp Cornstarch", "1 tsp Lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "200 g Strawberries, raw", "100 g Blueberries, raw", "50 g Raspberries, raw", "10 g Honey", "5 g Mint leaves, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 120°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Beat the egg whites in a clean, dry bowl until soft peaks form, then add the sugar gradually while whisking until the mixture is glossy and thick. Fold in the cornstarch, lemon juice, and vanilla extract gently so the meringue stays airy. Spoon the mixture into 6 small rounds on the tray, shaping a slight well in the centre of each. Bake for about 70 minutes until the pavlovas are dry on the outside and lift easily from the paper, then turn the oven off and leave them inside with the door slightly open until completely cool. Just before serving, mix the Greek yogurt with half of the honey. Top each pavlova with the yogurt, sliced strawberries, blueberries, raspberries, the remaining honey, and fresh mint leaves.

title: Crisp Mini Pavlovas with Greek Yogurt, Berries and Kiwi
ingredients_json: ["4 piece Egg white, raw", "180 g Sugar, granulated", "1 tsp Cornflour", "1 tsp White wine vinegar", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "200 g Greek yogurt, low fat, plain", "150 g Strawberries, raw", "100 g Blueberries, raw", "2 piece Kiwi fruit, raw", "10 g Mint, fresh"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 120°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Whisk the egg whites in a clean bowl until soft peaks form, then add the sugar gradually, one spoonful at a time, whisking well after each addition until the mixture is thick, glossy and holds firm peaks. Gently fold in the cornflour, vinegar and vanilla extract. Spoon the meringue into four small rounds on the tray, shaping a slight dip in the centre of each one. Bake for 75 minutes until the outside is dry and crisp but the centres still look pale. Turn the oven off and leave the pavlovas inside with the door slightly open for at least 30 minutes to cool slowly and prevent cracking. Just before serving, stir the Greek yogurt briefly to loosen it, then spoon it into the centres. Top with sliced strawberries, blueberries, diced kiwi and torn mint leaves.

title: Oatmeal Peanut Butter Cookies with Dark Chocolate Chips
ingredients_json: ["120 g peanut butter, smooth", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g wholemeal wheat flour", "50 g light brown sugar", "30 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "20 g dark chocolate chips", "5 g baking powder", "2 g vanilla extract", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. Stir in the oats, wholemeal flour, baking powder, and salt until a soft dough forms, then fold in the dark chocolate chips. Scoop the dough into 12 equal portions and place them on the tray, leaving space between each cookie. Flatten each portion gently with a fork or the back of a spoon. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centres are just set. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack, as they will firm up while cooling.

title: Soft Oat Peanut Butter Cookies with Dark Chocolate Chips

title: Soft Peanut Butter Oat Cookies with Dark Chocolate Chips
ingredients_json: ["120 g peanut butter, smooth, unsalted", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g wholemeal wheat flour", "50 g brown sugar", "40 g egg, whole, raw", "30 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "20 g dark chocolate chips, 70% cocoa solids", "4 g baking powder", "2 g vanilla extract", "1 g salt"]

title: Oat Flour Peanut Butter Cookies with Dark Chocolate Chips
ingredients_json: ["120 g peanut butter, unsweetened", "80 g oat flour", "40 g brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1/2 tsp baking powder", "1 g salt", "25 g dark chocolate chips"]

Stir in the oat flour, baking powder, and salt until a soft dough forms, then fold in the dark chocolate chips.
