title: Maple-Orange Pecan Pie with Wholemeal Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "80 g cold unsalted butter", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "20 ml water", "2 g salt", "180 g pecan nuts", "2 piece eggs, raw", "120 ml maple syrup", "80 g light brown sugar", "40 g plain yogurt, low fat", "30 g unsalted butter", "2 ml vanilla extract", "2 g orange zest, fresh", "1 g ground cinnamon", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and place a baking tray inside to heat. Make the crust by mixing the wholemeal flour, oats, salt, and cold butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Stir in the egg yolk and water just until the dough comes together, then press it into a 23 cm pie tin. Chill for 15 minutes, then bake for 12 minutes until lightly set. Scatter the pecan nuts over the crust. In a bowl, whisk the eggs, maple syrup, brown sugar, yogurt, melted butter, vanilla, orange zest, cinnamon, and salt until smooth. Pour the filling over the pecans and gently shake the tin so the nuts settle evenly. Bake on the hot tray for 28 to 35 minutes at 180 C, until the filling is puffed and the centre still has a slight wobble. Cool completely before slicing so the pie sets properly.

title: Maple-Sweetened Pecan Pie with Oat Whole Wheat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g cold unsalted butter", "30 g plain yogurt, low fat", "20 ml cold water", "1 g salt", "180 g pecan nuts", "3 piece egg, raw", "120 ml maple syrup", "80 g light brown sugar", "30 g unsalted butter", "5 ml vanilla extract", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. To make the crust, pulse the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, salt, and cold butter in a food processor until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Add the yogurt and cold water, then mix just until the dough comes together. Press the dough into a 23 cm pie dish, shaping it evenly up the sides, and chill for 15 minutes. Blind bake the crust for 12 minutes until it looks lightly set and pale golden. For the filling, melt the butter gently over low heat, then whisk it with the maple syrup, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt until smooth. Stir in the pecans so they are evenly coated. Pour the filling into the warm crust and spread the nuts evenly. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes at 180°C, until the centre is just set and still has a slight wobble. Let the pie cool completely before slicing so the filling firms up cleanly.

title: Maple Bourbon Pecan Pie with Whole Wheat Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g cold unsalted butter", "30 g plain yogurt, low fat", "25 ml cold water", "2 g fine salt", "180 g pecan nuts", "3 pieces egg, raw", "120 ml maple syrup", "80 g brown sugar", "30 g honey", "30 g melted unsalted butter", "60 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "5 ml vanilla extract", "2 ml bourbon whiskey", "1 g ground cinnamon", "1 g ground nutmeg"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and place a rack in the middle. To make the crust, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats and salt in a bowl, then rub in the cold butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Stir in the yogurt and cold water, just enough to bring the dough together. Press the dough into a 23 cm pie dish, making an even layer over the base and sides, then chill it for 15 minutes. Bake the crust for 10 minutes until lightly set and beginning to color. While it bakes, lightly toast 120 g of the pecans in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often, until fragrant. Whisk the eggs, maple syrup, brown sugar, honey, melted butter, milk, vanilla, bourbon, cinnamon and nutmeg until smooth. Stir in the toasted pecans, then pour the filling into the warm crust. Arrange the remaining pecans evenly on top if needed for a neat finish. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 180 C until the filling is puffed around the edges and the center still has a slight wobble. Cool the pie completely before slicing so the filling can set properly. Serve at room temperature for the best texture.

title: Maple-Walnut Pecan Pie with Whole Wheat Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g whole wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "40 g cold unsalted butter", "30 ml cold water", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "1 g salt", "200 g pecan nuts", "3 piece egg, raw", "120 ml maple syrup", "60 g light brown sugar", "30 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "30 g unsalted butter", "5 ml vanilla extract", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C. To make the crust, mix the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, and salt in a bowl. Rub in the cold butter with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then stir in the egg yolk and cold water until a dough forms. Press the dough into a 23 cm pie dish, shaping it evenly over the base and sides, then chill for 15 minutes. Prick the base lightly with a fork and bake for 10 minutes until just starting to set. Reduce the oven temperature to 170 C. Scatter the pecans over the crust. In a saucepan over low heat, melt the butter with the maple syrup and brown sugar, stirring until the sugar dissolves. Remove from the heat and whisk in the eggs, Greek yogurt, vanilla, cinnamon, and salt until smooth. Pour the filling over the pecans and bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the center is set but still has a slight wobble. Let the pie cool completely before slicing so the filling finishes setting and the pieces cut neatly.

title: Maple-Oat Pecan Pie with Orange and Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "40 g oat flour", "1 g salt", "80 g cold unsalted butter", "45 ml cold water", "250 g pecan nuts", "180 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "2 piece egg, raw", "60 ml maple syrup", "70 g brown sugar", "30 g honey", "15 g unsalted butter", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g ground nutmeg", "5 g orange zest", "10 ml orange juice", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. To make the crust, mix the wholemeal flour, oat flour, and salt in a bowl, then rub in the cold butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Add the cold water and stir just until the dough comes together. Press the dough into a 23 cm pie dish, smoothing it over the base and up the sides, then chill it for 15 minutes. Line the crust with baking paper and fill with baking beans if you have them, then bake for 12 minutes. Remove the paper and beans and bake for another 6 minutes until lightly golden. Reduce the oven temperature to 170°C. Spread the pecan nuts over the warm crust. In a saucepan over low heat, melt the butter with the brown sugar, honey, maple syrup, orange juice, orange zest, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt, stirring until the sugar is dissolved. Remove from the heat and let it cool for 5 minutes, then whisk in the Greek yogurt and eggs until smooth. Pour the filling over the pecans and gently tap the dish to level it. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the centre is just set with a slight wobble. Cool completely before slicing so the filling can firm up.

title: Lemon Blueberry Wholemeal Yogurt Pound Cake
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "60 g plain white flour", "150 g plain yogurt, low-fat", "120 g caster sugar", "80 g unsalted butter", "3 piece egg, raw", "120 g blueberries, fresh", "2 piece lemon zest, fresh", "30 ml lemon juice, freshly squeezed", "8 g baking powder", "2 g salt", "5 ml vanilla extract", "10 g ground almonds"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and line a small loaf tin with baking paper. In a mixing bowl, beat the butter and sugar together for 2 to 3 minutes until pale and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition, then stir in the yogurt, lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla extract. In a separate bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, white flour, ground almonds, baking powder, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and fold gently just until combined; do not overmix. Fold in most of the blueberries, reserving a few for the top. Spoon the batter into the prepared tin, smooth the surface, and scatter the remaining blueberries over the top. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, until the cake is golden and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let the cake cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then lift it out and cool completely on a wire rack before slicing.

title: Whole Wheat Lemon Yogurt Pound Cake
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "70 g plain white flour", "10 g baking powder", "2 g fine salt", "120 g unsalted butter", "140 g light brown sugar", "2 piece egg, raw", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "60 ml milk, low fat", "2 piece lemon zest", "30 ml lemon juice", "5 ml vanilla extract", "15 g sliced almonds"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and line a 23 cm loaf tin with baking paper. Whisk the whole wheat flour, white flour, baking powder, and salt together in a bowl. In a separate large bowl, beat the butter and brown sugar with a hand mixer on medium speed for 2 to 3 minutes until pale and fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition, then mix in the yogurt, milk, lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla extract. Fold in the dry ingredients just until no streaks of flour remain; do not overmix or the cake will become heavy. Spoon the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Scatter the sliced almonds over the surface. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, until the cake is golden and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Leave the cake in the tin for 10 minutes, then lift it out and cool completely on a wire rack before slicing.

title: Wholemeal Lemon Yogurt Pound Cake
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g plain wheat flour", "10 g baking powder", "2 g salt", "120 g unsalted butter", "90 g rapeseed oil", "180 g light brown sugar", "3 pieces egg, raw", "200 g plain yogurt, low fat", "2 pieces lemon zest", "30 ml lemon juice", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and line a 23 cm loaf tin with baking paper. In a bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, plain flour, baking powder, and salt. In a larger bowl, beat the butter, rapeseed oil, and brown sugar for about 2 minutes until lighter and well combined. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition, then mix in the yogurt, lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla extract. Fold in the dry ingredients just until no streaks of flour remain, keeping the batter smooth but not overmixed. Spoon the batter into the prepared tin and level the top. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until the cake is golden and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean or with just a few moist crumbs. Let the cake cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then lift it out and cool completely on a wire rack before slicing.

title: Lemon Yogurt Wholemeal Pound Cake
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "70 g plain white flour", "150 g low-fat plain yogurt", "120 g unsalted butter", "120 g caster sugar", "2 piece egg, raw", "1 piece egg white, raw", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 piece lemon zest, raw", "30 ml lemon juice, fresh", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "2 g salt", "20 g ground almonds"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a small loaf tin with baking paper. In a bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, white flour, baking powder, ground almonds, and salt. In a separate large bowl, beat the butter and sugar until pale and fluffy, then mix in the eggs and egg white one at a time. Stir in the yogurt, lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla extract. Fold in the dry ingredients just until combined; do not overmix or the cake will become dense. Scrape the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean and the top is golden. Let the cake cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then lift it out and cool completely on a rack before slicing.

title: Wholegrain Lemon Yogurt Pound Cake with Blueberries
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "70 g plain wheat flour", "120 g unsalted butter", "120 g low-fat plain Greek yogurt", "120 g caster sugar", "3 pieces egg, raw", "2 pieces lemon, zest", "60 ml lemon juice", "8 g baking powder", "2 g salt", "150 g blueberries, fresh", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and line a loaf tin with baking paper. Beat the butter and sugar together for about 3 minutes until pale and slightly fluffy. Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition, then mix in the yogurt, lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla. In a separate bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, plain flour, baking powder, and salt. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until combined, then gently fold in most of the blueberries so they do not burst. Spoon the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Scatter the remaining blueberries over the surface. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes, until the cake is golden and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean or with only a few moist crumbs. Leave the cake in the tin for 10 minutes, then lift it out and cool completely on a wire rack before slicing.

title: Spiced Pumpkin Pie with Wholemeal Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal flour", "60 g rolled oats", "60 g unsalted butter", "30 g ground almonds", "25 g brown sugar", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "30 ml cold water", "400 g pumpkin puree, canned", "150 ml skimmed milk", "2 pieces egg, raw", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "70 g brown sugar", "10 g cornflour", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g ground ginger", "0.5 g ground nutmeg", "0.5 g salt", "5 ml vanilla extract"]

Press the dough into a 23 cm pie dish, making an even layer on the bottom and sides. Prick the base with a fork and bake for 12 minutes until lightly set. While the crust bakes, whisk together the pumpkin puree, skimmed milk, eggs, yogurt, brown sugar, cornflour, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, salt and vanilla extract until smooth. title: Spiced Pumpkin Pie with Wholemeal Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal flour", "60 g rolled oats", "40 g unsalted butter", "2 tbsp rapeseed oil", "30 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 tbsp cold water", "425 g pumpkin puree, canned", "200 ml skimmed milk", "2 piece egg, raw", "60 g maple syrup", "20 g light brown sugar", "10 g cornflour", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp ground ginger", "0.5 tsp ground nutmeg", "0.25 tsp ground cloves", "1 g fine salt", "5 ml vanilla extract"]

title: Spiced Pumpkin Pie with Wholemeal Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml cold water", "450 g pumpkin puree, canned, unsweetened", "2 piece egg, raw", "150 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "60 g brown sugar", "20 g maple syrup", "2 tsp cinnamon, ground", "1 tsp ginger, ground", "0.5 tsp nutmeg, ground", "0.25 tsp cloves, ground", "2 g salt"]

Prick the base with a fork and chill the crust for 15 minutes. Bake the crust for 10 minutes until just set and lightly golden. While it bakes, whisk together the pumpkin puree, eggs, milk, brown sugar, maple syrup, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and cloves until smooth. title: Spiced Pumpkin Pie with Wholemeal Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g unsalted butter", "2 tbsp cold water", "500 g pumpkin puree, canned, unsweetened", "2 piece egg, raw", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "80 g light brown sugar", "15 g maple syrup", "5 g ground cinnamon", "2 g ground ginger", "1 g ground nutmeg", "1 g fine salt", "5 ml vanilla extract"]

In a separate bowl, whisk together the pumpkin puree, eggs, milk, brown sugar, maple syrup, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, salt, and vanilla until smooth. Pour the filling into the warm crust and place the pie on the hot tray. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until the edges are set and the center still has a slight wobble. title: Spiced Pumpkin Pie with Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "60 g wholemeal flour", "40 g ground almonds", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "20 g honey", "1 g salt", "425 g pumpkin puree, canned", "2 piece egg, raw", "150 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "70 g brown sugar", "5 ml vanilla extract", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g ground ginger", "0.5 g ground nutmeg", "0.5 g ground cloves"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a 23 cm pie dish. Make the crust by blending the rolled oats into a coarse meal, then mix with the wholemeal flour, ground almonds, salt, honey, and softened butter until the mixture resembles damp crumbs. Add the egg and press the mixture firmly into the pie dish, working it up the sides in an even layer. Bake the crust for 12 minutes until it is just starting to set. While it bakes, whisk the pumpkin puree with the eggs, milk, yogurt, brown sugar, vanilla extract, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and cloves until smooth. title: Rustic Wholemeal Rhubarb Pie with Orange and Oats
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "50 g plain white flour", "120 g unsalted butter", "50 g plain yogurt, low fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "20 g caster sugar", "2 g salt", "600 g rhubarb, raw", "80 g brown sugar", "15 g cornflour", "1 piece orange zest", "30 ml orange juice, unsweetened", "25 g rolled oats", "10 g demerara sugar", "10 ml milk, semi-skimmed"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Mix the wholemeal flour, white flour, salt, and caster sugar in a bowl, then rub in the butter until the mixture looks like fine crumbs. Stir in the yogurt and egg, then bring the dough together without overworking it. Wrap it and chill for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, cut the rhubarb into 2 cm pieces and combine it with the brown sugar, cornflour, orange zest, and orange juice. Let it stand for 10 minutes so the fruit begins to release its juice. Roll out two thirds of the pastry and line a 23 cm pie dish, trimming the edges neatly. Spoon in the rhubarb filling, including any juices. Roll out the remaining pastry and place it over the top, or cut it into a lattice if preferred. Seal the edges well, cut a few steam holes, brush lightly with milk, and sprinkle with oats and demerara sugar. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbling through the vents. Let the pie cool for at least 30 minutes before serving so the filling sets.

title: Rustic Wholegrain Rhubarb Pie with Orange and Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "150 g plain wheat flour", "180 g unsalted butter", "50 g caster sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 ml cold water", "700 g rhubarb, raw", "120 g apples, raw", "90 g brown sugar", "20 g cornflour", "1 piece orange, raw, zest only", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "40 g rolled oats", "1 tbsp milk, semi-skimmed", "2 g ground cinnamon"]

Peel and dice the apples, then toss both fruits with the brown sugar, cornflour, orange zest, lemon juice, and cinnamon. Roll out two thirds of the pastry and line a 23 cm pie dish, leaving a slight overhang. Spoon in the fruit filling and dot with small pieces of the remaining butter. Roll out the remaining pastry and cover the pie, or cut it into strips for a lattice top. Seal the edges well and cut a few steam holes if using a full lid. Brush the top lightly with milk and scatter over the oats. Bake on the hot tray for 40 to 45 minutes, until the pastry is golden and the filling is bubbling thickly at the centre. Let the pie cool for at least 30 minutes before slicing so the juices settle.

title: Rustic Wholemeal Rhubarb Pie with Orange and Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "120 g cold unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml cold water", "2 g salt", "600 g rhubarb, raw", "90 g cane sugar", "1 piece orange zest, fresh", "15 ml orange juice, fresh", "20 g wholemeal wheat flour", "30 g rolled oats", "25 g unsalted butter", "15 g brown sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C and place a baking tray on the middle rack to heat. Stir in the egg and cold water, then bring the dough together without overworking it. Wrap it and chill for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, trim the rhubarb and cut it into 2 cm pieces. Toss it with the cane sugar, orange zest, orange juice, and wholemeal flour, then let it stand for 10 minutes so a little juice is released. Roll out two thirds of the pastry and line a 23 cm pie dish, leaving a slight overhang. Add the rhubarb filling. title: Rustic Wholemeal Rhubarb Pie with Orange and Oat Crumble
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "70 g plain white flour", "120 g unsalted butter", "35 g brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml cold water", "500 g rhubarb, raw", "80 g apples, raw, with skin", "90 g granulated sugar", "10 g cornflour", "1 tsp orange zest, fresh", "15 ml orange juice, fresh", "40 g rolled oats", "20 g chopped almonds", "1 g ground cinnamon", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C and lightly grease a 22 cm pie dish. Add the egg and cold water, then bring the dough together without overworking it. Wrap and chill for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, cut the rhubarb into 2 cm pieces and dice the apple. Toss them with the granulated sugar, cornflour, orange zest and orange juice, then let the fruit stand for 10 minutes so it starts to release juices. Roll out two thirds of the pastry and line the pie dish, trimming the edges. Spoon in the fruit filling and dot with the remaining 20 g butter. title: Rustic Rhubarb Pie with Oat-Walnut Whole Wheat Crust
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat flour", "80 g rolled oats", "80 g walnuts", "120 g cold unsalted butter", "2 tbsp honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "60 ml cold water", "700 g rhubarb", "80 g cane sugar", "20 g cornstarch", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 190 C and place a rack in the lower middle position. To make the crust, pulse the whole wheat flour, rolled oats, walnuts, and salt together until the nuts are finely chopped. Add the cold butter and rub or pulse it in until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Mix in the honey, egg, and cold water just until a dough forms, then divide it into two discs and chill for 20 minutes. While the dough rests, trim and cut the rhubarb into 2 cm pieces and toss it with the sugar, cornstarch, vanilla, cinnamon, and lemon juice. Roll out one disc and line a 23 cm pie dish, then add the filling and spread it evenly. Roll out the second disc, cover the pie, and cut a few steam vents in the top. title: Creamy Cinnamon Apple Rice Pudding
ingredients_json: ["120 g short-grain brown rice", "750 ml semi-skimmed milk", "250 ml water", "1 piece apple, raw, with skin", "30 g raisins", "20 g honey", "5 g ground cinnamon", "1 g vanilla extract", "1 g salt", "15 g almond flakes"]
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs clear. Put the rice, milk, water, salt, and cinnamon into a medium saucepan and bring it slowly to a gentle simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook uncovered for about 35 to 40 minutes, stirring often so the rice does not stick, until the grains are tender and the mixture is thick and creamy. Stir in the diced apple, raisins, honey, and vanilla extract, then cook for 5 more minutes over low heat until the apple softens slightly but still keeps some texture. Remove from the heat and let the pudding stand for 5 minutes to thicken further. Toast the almond flakes in a dry pan over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes until lightly golden, then scatter them over the pudding before serving warm.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Rice Pudding with Apples and Raisins
ingredients_json: ["120 g short-grain white rice", "750 ml semi-skimmed milk", "250 ml water", "30 g raisins", "2 piece apple", "25 g honey", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 pinch fine salt", "10 g unsalted butter", "15 g chopped almonds"]
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear. Put the rice, milk, water, raisins, cinnamon, vanilla extract, and salt into a medium saucepan and bring it gently to a simmer over medium heat, stirring often so the rice does not catch on the bottom. Reduce the heat to low and cook for about 25 to 30 minutes, stirring regularly, until the rice is tender and the mixture has turned thick and creamy. Meanwhile, peel, core, and dice the apples. Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat, add the apples, and cook for 6 to 8 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Stir the honey into the rice pudding, then fold in about half of the cooked apples and reserve the rest for topping. Spoon the pudding into bowls, finish with the remaining apples and chopped almonds, and serve warm.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Apple Rice Pudding with Skim Milk
ingredients_json: ["120 g short-grain white rice", "900 ml skim milk", "250 ml water", "250 g apple, peeled and diced", "30 g raisins", "20 g honey", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g salt", "10 g butter", "15 g sliced almonds"]
instructions: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear. Add the rice, skim milk, water, and salt to a heavy saucepan and bring it slowly to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring often so the rice does not stick. Reduce the heat to low and cook for about 30 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the rice is tender and the mixture has become creamy. Stir in the diced apple, raisins, cinnamon, vanilla extract, and honey, then cook for another 8 to 10 minutes over low heat until the apple is soft but still holds its shape. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the butter for a smoother finish. Let the pudding stand for 5 minutes to thicken, then spoon into bowls and sprinkle with the sliced almonds before serving warm.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Apple Rice Pudding
ingredients_json: ["150 g short-grain rice, dry", "800 ml semi-skimmed milk", "300 ml water", "2 medium apples, fresh", "30 g raisins, dried", "25 g honey", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 piece lemon zest", "1 pinch salt", "15 g almond flakes"]

Stir the apples, raisins, cinnamon, vanilla extract and lemon zest into the pudding during the last 10 minutes of cooking so the fruit softens but still holds some shape. When the pudding looks creamy and the rice is cooked through, remove it from the heat and stir in the honey. Let it stand for 5 minutes to thicken slightly, then spoon into bowls and finish with the almond flakes.

title: Creamy Cinnamon Brown Rice Pudding with Berries
ingredients_json: ["120 g brown rice, dry", "900 ml semi-skimmed milk, pasteurised", "200 ml water", "40 g sugar", "1 g salt", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "15 g raisins", "100 g mixed berries, fresh", "20 g almonds, flaked"]
instructions: Rinse the brown rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear. Put the rice, milk, water, sugar and salt into a medium saucepan and bring it slowly to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring often so the milk does not catch on the bottom. Reduce the heat to low and cook uncovered for about 45 to 55 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the rice is tender and the pudding has thickened to a creamy consistency. Stir in the cinnamon, vanilla extract and raisins during the last 5 minutes of cooking so the raisins plump up. Remove from the heat and let the pudding stand for 5 minutes, since it will thicken slightly as it cools. Spoon into bowls and top with the mixed berries and flaked almonds before serving warm.

title: Oatmeal Peanut Butter Banana Sandwich Cookies
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "120 g whole wheat flour", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "80 g ripe banana, mashed", "90 g peanut butter, unsweetened", "60 g soft light brown sugar", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "5 ml vanilla extract", "80 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "20 g peanut butter, unsweetened", "15 g honey", "1 g ground cinnamon"]
instructions: Heat the oven to 180 C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the rolled oats, whole wheat flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until combined and let the dough rest for 5 minutes so the oats hydrate. Scoop small mounds onto the trays, flatten them slightly with damp fingers, and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the edges are lightly golden and the centers are set but still soft. Cool the cookies on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack and let them cool completely. For the filling, mix the Greek yogurt, peanut butter, and honey until creamy. Spread about 1 teaspoon of filling on the flat side of half the cookies, then sandwich with the remaining cookies. Chill for 20 minutes before serving so the filling firms up.

title: Oatmeal Sandwich Cookies with Greek Yogurt Vanilla Cream
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "90 g wholemeal wheat flour", "1 tsp baking powder", "1/2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1/4 tsp fine salt", "60 g unsalted butter", "60 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "60 g plain Greek yogurt", "40 g honey", "120 g plain low-fat Greek yogurt", "1 tsp lemon juice"]

In a bowl, whisk together the oats, wholemeal flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a separate bowl, beat the butter and brown sugar until light and creamy, then mix in the egg and vanilla extract. Stir in the dry ingredients until a soft dough forms. Scoop the dough into 24 small portions, roll them into balls, and flatten them slightly on the trays, leaving space between each one. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centres feel set but still soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely. For the filling, mix the plain Greek yogurt, honey, low-fat Greek yogurt, and lemon juice until smooth and thick. Once the cookies are fully cool, spread a spoonful of filling on the flat side of half the cookies and sandwich with the remaining cookies. Chill for 20 minutes before serving so the filling firms up.

title: Oatmeal Almond Sandwich Cookies with Greek Yogurt and Raspberry Chia Filling
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "90 g whole wheat flour", "50 g ground almonds", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g salt", "60 g unsalted butter", "70 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "5 ml vanilla extract", "30 ml skimmed milk", "150 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "80 g raspberries, fresh", "10 g chia seeds", "15 g honey", "5 ml lemon juice"]

In a separate bowl, beat the butter and brown sugar until smooth and slightly fluffy, then mix in the egg, vanilla extract, and milk. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until a soft dough forms. Scoop small portions onto the trays and flatten them gently into rounds. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centers feel set, then leave them on the tray for 5 minutes before cooling completely on a wire rack. title: Oatmeal Banana Sandwich Cookies with Greek Yogurt Vanilla Filling
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "120 g rolled oats", "80 g ripe banana, mashed", "60 g unsalted butter, softened", "60 g brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "80 g plain Greek yogurt", "20 g honey", "1 tsp lemon juice"]

Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until a soft dough forms. Scoop walnut-sized portions onto the trays and flatten them slightly with the back of a spoon. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centres feel set but still soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer them to a rack to cool completely. To make the filling, stir together the Greek yogurt, honey, and lemon juice until smooth. Spread a small amount on the flat side of half the cookies, then sandwich with the remaining cookies. Chill for 15 minutes before serving so the filling firms up a little.

title: Oatmeal Banana Sandwich Cookies with Yogurt and Raspberry Filling
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "1 tsp baking powder", "1/2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1/4 tsp fine salt", "80 g unsalted butter", "70 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 piece ripe banana, mashed", "30 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "150 g low-fat plain Greek yogurt", "80 g raspberries, fresh", "20 g honey"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, wholemeal flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. In a second bowl, beat the butter and brown sugar together until smooth and slightly fluffy, then mix in the egg, mashed banana, milk, and vanilla extract. Add the dry ingredients and stir just until combined. Scoop small portions of dough onto the trays and flatten them slightly with the back of a spoon. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centres feel set. Cool the cookies on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool completely. For the filling, stir the yogurt with the raspberries and honey until thick and lightly swirled. Spread or pipe about 1 tablespoon of filling onto the flat side of half the cookies, then sandwich with the remaining cookies. Chill for 20 minutes before serving so the filling firms up.

title: Wholemeal Almond and Lemon Shortbread
ingredients_json: ["150 g wholemeal wheat flour", "100 g plain white flour", "80 g ground almonds", "90 g unsalted butter", "50 g olive oil spread, 70% fat", "70 g caster sugar", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "1 whole lemon zest", "5 ml vanilla extract", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, rub the butter and olive oil spread into the wholemeal flour, white flour, ground almonds, and salt until the mixture looks like fine breadcrumbs. Stir in the sugar and lemon zest, then add the egg yolk and vanilla extract and mix gently until a soft dough forms. If the dough seems dry, press it together with warm hands rather than adding more liquid. Shape the dough into a disc, wrap it, and chill for 20 minutes so it firms up. Roll out the dough to about 1 cm thickness and cut into fingers or rounds. Place them on the tray with a little space between each piece and prick the tops lightly with a fork. Bake for 14 to 16 minutes, until the edges are just turning golden but the centres are still pale. Let the shortbread cool on the tray for 10 minutes before moving it to a rack, then cool completely so it becomes crisp.

title: Wholemeal Lemon Almond Shortbread Biscuits
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g plain wheat flour", "60 g ground almonds", "100 g unsalted butter", "50 g caster sugar", "25 g icing sugar", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "1 tsp lemon zest, fresh", "2 tbsp lemon juice, fresh", "1 g fine salt"]

Stir in the egg yolk, lemon zest and lemon juice, then add the dry ingredients and mix just until a soft dough forms. If the dough feels too sticky, chill it for 15 minutes rather than adding more flour. Roll the dough out to about 1 cm thickness and cut into rounds or fingers. Place them on the tray with a little space between each piece. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden but the centres are still pale. Leave the shortbread on the tray for 10 minutes to firm up, then transfer to a rack to cool completely.

title: Lemon Almond Wholemeal Shortbread
ingredients_json: ["150 g wholemeal wheat flour", "75 g plain wheat flour", "50 g ground almonds", "100 g unsalted butter", "50 g rapeseed oil", "60 g golden caster sugar", "20 g icing sugar", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "2 g lemon zest, fresh", "5 ml lemon juice", "2 g baking powder", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 170°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, plain flour, ground almonds, baking powder and salt. In a separate bowl, beat the butter, rapeseed oil, caster sugar and icing sugar together until pale and smooth, then mix in the egg yolk, lemon zest and lemon juice. Add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture and stir until a soft dough forms, adding a little extra flour only if needed to bring it together. Shape the dough into a rectangle about 1 cm thick, cut into 12 fingers or rounds, and place them on the tray with a little space between each piece. Bake for 14 to 16 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden but the centres are still pale. Leave to cool on the tray for 10 minutes before transferring to a rack, because the shortbread firms up as it cools.

title: Oat and Almond Shortbread with Lemon Zest
ingredients_json: ["150 g plain wheat flour", "80 g oat flour", "50 g ground almonds", "120 g unsalted butter", "40 g light brown sugar", "20 g icing sugar", "1 piece egg yolk, raw", "2 g fine salt", "2 g lemon zest, fresh", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
