title: Lighter Fresh Strawberry Pie with Oat-Almond Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "60 g almond flour", "25 g unsalted butter", "15 g honey", "1 piece egg white, raw", "2 g salt", "500 g strawberries, fresh", "150 g strawberries, fresh, for puree", "30 g sugar", "10 g cornflour", "15 ml lemon juice", "5 ml vanilla extract", "5 g chia seeds"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. In a bowl, mix the rolled oats, almond flour, melted butter, honey, egg white, and salt until the mixture holds together when pressed. Press it firmly into a 23 cm pie dish, bringing it up the sides in an even layer. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes, until lightly golden and fragrant, then cool completely. While the crust cools, place 150 g of the strawberries in a small saucepan with the sugar and a splash of water and warm over medium heat for about 3 minutes until the berries release their juices. Stir the cornflour with 2 tablespoons of cold water, add it to the pan, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes over medium heat until the mixture thickens and turns glossy. Remove from the heat and stir in the lemon juice, vanilla extract, and chia seeds, then let the filling cool until just warm. Slice the remaining strawberries and fold them into the cooled glaze so they are well coated. Spoon the strawberry mixture into the crust, arranging the fruit neatly and smoothing the top. Chill the pie for at least 2 hours, or until set and sliceable, before serving.

title: Fresh Strawberry Pie with Light Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "40 g rolled oats", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml water", "25 g cane sugar", "1 g salt", "500 g strawberries, fresh", "150 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "15 g cornstarch", "30 ml lemon juice", "10 g honey", "5 ml vanilla extract", "10 g chia seeds"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. In a bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, sugar, and salt, then rub in the butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Add the egg and water, and bring the dough together without overworking it. Roll it out and line a 23 cm pie dish, then prick the base all over with a fork. Bake the crust for 15 to 18 minutes, until lightly golden and dry to the touch, then let it cool completely. Meanwhile, slice about two thirds of the strawberries and place them in a saucepan with the honey, lemon juice, and half of the vanilla. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes until the berries soften and release juice. Stir the cornstarch with 2 tablespoons of water, add it to the pan, and cook for 1 to 2 minutes until the filling thickens and turns glossy. Remove from the heat and fold in the chia seeds, then cool for 10 minutes. Spread the Greek yogurt mixed with the remaining vanilla over the cooled crust, spoon the strawberry filling on top, and arrange the remaining strawberries over the surface. Chill the pie for at least 2 hours before slicing so the filling sets cleanly.

title: Light Strawberry Pie with Yogurt and Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "80 g whole wheat flour", "40 g unsalted butter", "20 g honey", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 g salt", "400 g strawberries, fresh", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "30 g cream cheese, reduced fat", "15 g honey", "6 g gelatin powder", "30 ml water", "5 ml lemon juice", "2 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C. Pulse the oats in a food processor until they are partly ground, then mix them with the whole wheat flour and salt. Rub in the butter until the mixture looks crumbly, add the egg and honey, and press everything into a 23 cm pie dish. Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until lightly golden and set, then cool completely. Sprinkle the gelatin over the water and let it stand for 5 minutes. Warm it gently until dissolved, then let it cool until just lukewarm. In a bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, cream cheese, honey, lemon juice, and vanilla until smooth, then stir in the dissolved gelatin. Fold in half of the sliced strawberries and spread the filling into the cooled crust. Arrange the remaining strawberries on top and chill the pie for at least 3 hours, or until fully set. Slice with a sharp knife and serve cold.

title: Wholemeal Strawberry Shortcakes with Vanilla Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholemeal wheat flour", "50 g plain white flour", "25 g light brown sugar", "8 g baking powder", "1 g salt", "45 g cold unsalted butter", "120 ml semi-skimmed milk", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "400 g strawberries", "10 g lemon juice", "15 g honey", "200 g low-fat Greek yogurt", "20 g icing sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, white flour, brown sugar, baking powder, and salt. Rub in the cold butter with your fingertips until the mixture looks like fine breadcrumbs with a few small butter pieces remaining. Beat the milk, egg, and vanilla extract together, then stir it into the dry ingredients just until a soft dough forms. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat it to about 2 cm thick. Cut into 6 rounds and place them on the tray. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the shortcakes are risen and lightly golden on top. While they bake, slice the strawberries and toss them with the lemon juice and honey. In a separate bowl, mix the Greek yogurt with the icing sugar until smooth. Split the warm shortcakes, spoon on the strawberries and their juices, then finish with a generous dollop of vanilla yogurt cream.

title: Light Strawberry Shortcakes with Vanilla Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "40 g rolled oats", "30 g sugar", "10 g baking powder", "2 g salt", "60 g cold unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "120 ml skimmed milk", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "400 g strawberries", "15 g sugar", "10 ml lemon juice", "200 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "100 ml whipping cream, reduced fat"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Cut in the cold butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Beat the egg with the skimmed milk and vanilla extract, then stir it into the dry ingredients just until a soft dough forms. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat it into a 2 cm thick round. Cut into 6 shortcakes and place them on the tray. Bake for 14 to 16 minutes, until risen and lightly golden on top. While they bake, slice the strawberries and toss them with the sugar and lemon juice. Let them sit for 10 minutes so they release their juices. Whisk the Greek yogurt and reduced-fat cream together until smooth and lightly fluffy. Split the warm shortcakes, spoon over the strawberries and their juices, and finish with a generous dollop of the yogurt cream.

title: Light Strawberry Shortcakes with Vanilla Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["250 g whole wheat flour", "50 g oat flour", "30 g granulated sugar", "10 g baking powder", "2 g salt", "60 g cold unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "120 ml low-fat milk", "5 ml vanilla extract", "400 g strawberries, fresh", "20 g honey", "200 g Greek yogurt, low fat", "100 ml whipping cream, light"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, oat flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Cut the cold butter into the dry ingredients until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Beat the egg with the milk and vanilla extract, then stir it into the flour mixture just until a soft dough forms; do not overmix. Pat the dough into a 2 cm thick round and cut out 6 shortcakes. Place them on the tray and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until risen and lightly golden on top. While they bake, hull and slice the strawberries, then toss them with the honey and let them sit for 10 minutes so they become juicy. Whip the light cream until soft peaks form, then fold it gently into the Greek yogurt to make a smooth cream. Split the warm shortcakes, spoon the strawberries and juices over the bottom halves, add a generous dollop of yogurt cream, and finish with the top halves before serving.

title: Whole Wheat Strawberry Shortcakes with Vanilla Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g whole wheat flour", "50 g all-purpose flour", "20 g sugar", "8 g baking powder", "2 g salt", "60 g cold unsalted butter", "120 ml low-fat milk", "1 piece egg, raw", "5 ml vanilla extract", "400 g strawberries, fresh", "15 g sugar", "10 ml lemon juice", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "10 g honey"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a large bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Add the cold butter and rub it in with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. In a small bowl, whisk the milk, egg, and vanilla extract together, then stir it into the flour mixture until just combined. Do not overmix. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and pat it to about 2 cm thick. Cut out 6 shortcakes and place them on the tray. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until risen and lightly golden on top. While they bake, slice the strawberries and toss them with the sugar and lemon juice. Let them sit for 10 minutes so the juices start to release. Mix the Greek yogurt with the honey until smooth. Split the warm shortcakes, spoon the strawberries and their syrup over the bottom halves, add a generous spoonful of yogurt, and cap with the tops. Serve immediately while the shortcakes are still tender.

title: Whole Wheat Strawberry Shortcakes with Vanilla Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["300 g strawberries, fresh", "15 g honey", "5 ml lemon juice", "180 g whole wheat flour", "60 g plain flour", "12 g baking powder", "2 g salt", "25 g light brown sugar", "60 g unsalted butter", "150 ml low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "1 piece egg, raw", "5 ml vanilla extract", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "10 g icing sugar", "2 g lemon zest"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with baking paper. Slice the strawberries and toss them with the honey and lemon juice, then let them sit while you prepare the shortcakes so they become juicy. In a large bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, plain flour, baking powder, salt, and brown sugar. Rub in the butter with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. In a separate bowl, whisk the milk, egg, and vanilla extract together, then stir it into the dry ingredients just until a soft dough forms. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface, pat it to about 2 cm thick, and cut out 6 rounds. Place them on the tray and bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until risen and lightly golden on top. While they bake, mix the Greek yogurt, icing sugar, and lemon zest into a smooth cream. Let the shortcakes cool for a few minutes, then split them in half and fill with the strawberries and yogurt cream. Serve immediately while the shortcakes are still slightly warm.

title: Vanilla Oat Sugar Cookies with Lemon Zest
ingredients_json: ["180 g plain wholemeal flour", "80 g rolled oats", "90 g unsalted butter", "70 g light brown sugar", "40 g caster sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml low-fat milk", "5 ml vanilla extract", "2 g baking powder", "1 g salt", "2 g lemon zest"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a bowl, beat the butter, brown sugar, and caster sugar together for 2 to 3 minutes until light and creamy. Mix in the egg, milk, vanilla extract, and lemon zest until smooth. In a separate bowl, combine the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, baking powder, and salt, then stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture until a soft dough forms. If the dough feels too sticky, chill it for 15 minutes. Scoop tablespoon-sized portions onto the trays, spacing them well apart, and flatten each one slightly with the palm of your hand. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are just turning golden but the centres still look soft. Leave the cookies on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Soft Vanilla Sugar Cookies with Lemon Zest
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "70 g plain white flour", "120 g unsalted butter", "90 g caster sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 tbsp low-fat plain yogurt", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp lemon zest, grated", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line two baking trays with parchment paper. In a large bowl, beat the softened butter and caster sugar together for 2 to 3 minutes until pale and fluffy. Add the egg, yogurt, vanilla extract, and lemon zest, then mix until smooth. In a separate bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, white flour, baking powder, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir just until a soft dough forms. If the dough feels sticky, chill it for 15 minutes so it is easier to handle. Roll the dough into small balls, place them on the trays with enough space between each one, and flatten them gently with your hand or the bottom of a glass. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are lightly golden and the centers still look soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to finish cooling.

title: Soft Vanilla Sugar Cookies with Lemon Zest
ingredients_json: ["180 g plain white flour", "60 g wholemeal flour", "90 g unsalted butter", "70 g light brown sugar", "25 g caster sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 ml vanilla extract", "2 g lemon zest, fresh", "3 g baking powder", "1 g salt", "15 ml semi-skimmed milk", "10 g granulated sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a bowl, whisk the flour, wholemeal flour, baking powder, and salt together. In a separate bowl, beat the butter, brown sugar, caster sugar, and lemon zest until pale and fluffy, then mix in the egg and vanilla extract. Add the dry ingredients in two additions, alternating with the milk, and stir just until a soft dough forms. Cover the dough and chill it for 20 minutes so the cookies hold their shape. Scoop the dough into 18 even portions, roll lightly into balls, and place them on the trays with enough space to spread. Flatten each ball gently with your hand and sprinkle the tops with the granulated sugar. Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until the edges are set and lightly golden but the centres still look soft. Leave the cookies on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Soft Vanilla Sugar Cookies with Lemon Zest
ingredients_json: ["180 g plain wheat flour", "40 g oat flour", "90 g unsalted butter", "70 g light brown sugar", "35 g granulated sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp lemon zest", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g salt", "30 ml semi-skimmed milk"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a baking tray with baking paper. In a bowl, beat the butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar together for about 2 minutes until pale and creamy. Add the egg, vanilla extract, and lemon zest, then mix until smooth. In a separate bowl, whisk together the plain flour, oat flour, baking powder, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture in two additions, alternating with the milk, and stir just until a soft dough forms. Do not overmix. Cover the dough and chill it for 20 minutes so the cookies hold their shape better. Roll the dough into 18 small balls, place them on the prepared tray with space between each one, and gently flatten them with your fingers or the bottom of a glass. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are just turning golden but the centres still look soft. Let the cookies cool on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to finish cooling.

title: Soft Whole Wheat Vanilla Sugar Cookies
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "70 g plain white flour", "120 g unsalted butter", "90 g cane sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 ml vanilla extract", "2 g baking powder", "1 g fine salt", "30 ml skim milk", "10 g demerara sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a baking tray with parchment paper. In a bowl, beat the softened butter and cane sugar together for 2 to 3 minutes until pale and creamy. Mix in the egg and vanilla extract until smooth. In a separate bowl, combine the whole wheat flour, white flour, baking powder, and salt. Add the dry ingredients to the butter mixture in two additions, alternating with the milk, and stir just until a soft dough forms. Chill the dough for 20 minutes if it feels sticky. Roll the dough to about 5 mm thickness on a lightly floured surface and cut into rounds or shapes. Place the cookies on the prepared tray, leaving a little space between them, and sprinkle lightly with demerara sugar. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the edges are just turning golden but the centers are still soft. Let the cookies rest on the tray for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Creamy Sweet Potato Pie with Warm Cinnamon and Orange
ingredients_json: ["450 g sweet potato, baked, flesh only", "180 g wholemeal wheat flour", "70 g cold butter, unsalted", "25 g rolled oats", "30 ml cold water", "2 whole eggs, raw", "180 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "80 g plain yoghurt, low fat", "70 g brown sugar", "25 g maple syrup", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground ginger", "0.25 tsp ground nutmeg", "1 tsp orange zest", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a 23 cm pie dish. To make the crust, pulse the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, cold butter and salt together until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then add the cold water and mix just until it comes together. Press the dough into the pie dish, patching any cracks, and bake for 10 minutes until lightly set. For the filling, mash the baked sweet potato until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, milk, yoghurt, brown sugar, maple syrup, vanilla, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and orange zest until creamy and well combined. Pour the filling into the warm crust and smooth the top. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes, until the centre is just set with a slight wobble and the edges are lightly browned. Cool completely before slicing so the pie firms up cleanly.

title: Creamy Spiced Sweet Potato Pie with Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["200 g oat flour", "60 g whole wheat flour", "50 g cold unsalted butter", "30 ml cold water", "600 g sweet potato flesh, baked", "2 pieces egg, raw", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "80 ml maple syrup", "40 g brown sugar", "30 g unsalted butter, melted", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground ginger", "0.25 tsp ground nutmeg", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. To make the crust, combine the oat flour, whole wheat flour, and salt in a bowl, then rub in the cold butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs. Add the cold water and mix just until the dough comes together. Press it evenly into a 23 cm pie dish and chill for 10 minutes if time allows. Blind bake the crust for about 12 minutes, until lightly set and just starting to color. For the filling, mash the baked sweet potato flesh until smooth, then whisk in the eggs, yogurt, maple syrup, brown sugar, melted butter, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and vanilla until fully combined. Pour the filling into the warm crust and smooth the top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes at 180°C, until the edges are set and the center still has a slight wobble. Let the pie cool completely before slicing so the filling can firm up. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Creamy Sweet Potato Pie with Warm Cinnamon and Vanilla
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal wheat flour", "120 g cold unsalted butter", "60 ml cold water", "1 piece egg, raw", "500 g sweet potato, cooked flesh", "150 ml semi-skimmed milk", "100 g Greek yogurt, plain, low-fat", "80 g light brown sugar", "2 pieces egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground nutmeg", "0.25 tsp ground ginger", "1 g fine salt", "5 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Start by making the pastry. Rub the cold butter into the wholemeal flour with your fingertips until the mixture looks like coarse breadcrumbs, then mix in the egg and cold water just until the dough comes together. Shape it into a disc, wrap it, and chill it for 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 180°C. Roll the pastry out and line a 23 cm pie dish, then trim the edges and prick the base with a fork. Line the pastry with baking paper, fill with baking beans, and blind bake for 12 minutes. Remove the paper and beans and bake for 5 minutes more until the base looks dry and lightly golden. For the filling, mash the cooked sweet potato until smooth. Whisk in the milk, Greek yogurt, sugar, eggs, vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, salt, and lemon juice until the mixture is creamy and evenly combined. Pour the filling into the warm pastry shell and smooth the top. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes on the middle rack until the centre is just set with a slight wobble. Let the pie cool completely before slicing so the filling firms up cleanly. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Spiced Sweet Potato Pie with Walnut Oat Crust
ingredients_json: ["250 g wholemeal oat flour", "80 g walnuts", "40 g light brown sugar", "60 g unsalted butter", "1 piece egg, raw", "2 tbsp cold water", "500 g sweet potato, raw", "2 piece egg, raw", "150 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "80 ml maple syrup", "100 ml semi-skimmed milk", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "2 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 tsp ground ginger", "0.5 tsp ground nutmeg", "0.25 tsp ground cloves", "1 g fine salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C. To make the crust, pulse the walnuts until finely chopped, then mix them with the oat flour, brown sugar, and salt. Rub in the butter until the mixture looks like coarse crumbs, then add the egg and cold water and mix just until a dough forms. Press the dough into a 23 cm pie dish and chill it for 15 minutes. Prick the base lightly with a fork and bake for 10 minutes until just set and pale golden. Meanwhile, peel and cube the sweet potato, then steam or boil it until very tender, about 15 to 20 minutes. Drain well and mash until smooth. In a large bowl, whisk the sweet potato with the eggs, Greek yogurt, maple syrup, milk, vanilla, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, cloves, and salt until creamy and evenly combined. Pour the filling into the warm crust and smooth the top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the centre is mostly set with just a slight wobble. Cool the pie completely before slicing so the filling firms up properly. Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Spiced Sweet Potato Pie with Oat and Walnut Crust
ingredients_json: ["180 g rolled oats", "80 g walnuts", "60 g wholemeal flour", "40 g coconut oil", "15 g honey", "2 g salt", "600 g sweet potato flesh, cooked and mashed", "200 ml milk, semi-skimmed", "2 pieces egg, raw", "60 g maple syrup", "30 g brown sugar", "10 g cornflour", "5 ml vanilla extract", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g ground ginger", "0.5 g ground nutmeg", "1 g ground allspice", "1 g lemon zest"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a 23 cm pie dish. To make the crust, blend the oats and walnuts until finely chopped, then mix with the wholemeal flour, salt, melted coconut oil and honey until the mixture looks like damp crumbs. Press it firmly into the pie dish and bake for 10 minutes, until lightly set and fragrant. While the crust bakes, whisk together the mashed sweet potato, milk, eggs, maple syrup, brown sugar, cornflour, vanilla, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, allspice and lemon zest until smooth. Pour the filling into the warm crust and smooth the top. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until the centre is just set and only slightly wobbly. Let the pie cool completely, then chill it for at least 2 hours before slicing so the filling firms up cleanly.

title: Light Espresso and Skyr Tiramisu with Cocoa and Oats
ingredients_json: ["250 g skyr, plain, low fat", "250 g quark, low fat", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "40 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "2 pieces egg, raw, large", "2 tbsp espresso, brewed, strong", "120 g sponge finger biscuits", "120 ml espresso, brewed, strong, cooled", "10 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "15 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "20 g rolled oats", "1 tbsp orange zest, fresh"]
instructions: Separate the eggs and place the yolks in a large bowl. Whisk the yolks with the honey and vanilla extract until the mixture looks paler and slightly fluffy. Fold in the skyr, quark, and Greek yogurt until smooth. In a clean bowl, whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, then gently fold them into the cream mixture so the filling stays light. Mix the cooled espresso with the 2 tablespoons of brewed espresso for dipping. Briefly dip each sponge finger biscuit, one at a time, so they absorb coffee without becoming soggy, and arrange a layer in the base of a serving dish. Spread over half of the cream mixture, then repeat with another layer of dipped biscuits and the remaining cream. Cover and chill for at least 4 hours, or overnight for the best texture. Before serving, dust the top evenly with cocoa powder, scatter over the rolled oats, add the orange zest, and finish with finely grated dark chocolate.

title: Light Coffee-Orange Tiramisu with Greek Yogurt and Cocoa
ingredients_json: ["250 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "200 g quark, low fat", "120 g mascarpone cheese", "60 g honey", "1 piece orange, zest only", "10 ml vanilla extract", "200 ml espresso coffee, brewed", "15 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "12 pieces ladyfinger biscuits", "15 ml orange liqueur"]
instructions: Prepare the espresso and let it cool until just lukewarm. Stir in the orange liqueur and set it aside. In a bowl, whisk the Greek yogurt, quark, mascarpone, honey, orange zest, and vanilla extract until smooth and creamy. Dip each ladyfinger very briefly into the coffee, just long enough to moisten them without letting them fall apart. Arrange a layer of soaked ladyfingers in the bottom of a dish, then spread half of the cream over the top. Repeat with the remaining ladyfingers and finish with the rest of the cream. Cover and chill for at least 4 hours, or overnight for the best texture. Just before serving, dust the surface evenly with cocoa powder and cut into neat portions.

title: Light Mascarpone and Greek Yogurt Tiramisu with Cocoa and Espresso
ingredients_json: ["250 g mascarpone cheese", "200 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "2 piece egg, raw", "35 g sugar", "2 g vanilla extract", "180 ml espresso, brewed", "18 pieces ladyfinger biscuits", "8 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "10 ml coffee liqueur", "2 g dark chocolate, grated"]
instructions: Separate the eggs and place the yolks in a mixing bowl. Whisk the yolks with the sugar for 2 to 3 minutes until the mixture turns pale and slightly thick. Stir in the mascarpone, Greek yogurt, vanilla extract, and coffee liqueur until smooth and creamy. In a clean bowl, whisk the egg whites until soft peaks form, then fold them gently into the mascarpone mixture so the cream stays airy. Pour the espresso into a shallow dish and let it cool to warm or room temperature. Briefly dip each ladyfinger into the espresso for 1 to 2 seconds per side, just until moistened but not soggy. Arrange a layer of soaked biscuits in the base of a serving dish, spread over half of the cream, then repeat with a second layer of biscuits and the remaining cream. Smooth the top, cover, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight, until firm and well chilled. Before serving, dust the top evenly with cocoa powder and finish with a light sprinkle of grated dark chocolate.

title: Light Espresso Greek Yogurt Tiramisu with Cocoa and Berries
ingredients_json: ["250 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "250 g quark, low fat", "150 g mascarpone cheese, reduced fat", "40 g honey", "5 g vanilla extract", "120 ml espresso, brewed, unsweetened", "20 ml orange juice, freshly squeezed", "180 g ladyfinger biscuits, whole wheat", "15 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "120 g strawberries, fresh", "80 g raspberries, fresh", "20 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa"]
instructions: Start by mixing the Greek yogurt, quark, reduced-fat mascarpone, honey, and vanilla extract in a bowl until smooth and creamy. In a shallow dish, combine the cooled espresso with the orange juice. Briefly dip each ladyfinger into the coffee mixture for about 1 second per side so they soften without falling apart, then arrange a layer in the bottom of a serving dish. Spread half of the cream mixture over the biscuits and smooth the top. Add another layer of dipped ladyfingers, then spread over the remaining cream. Dust the surface evenly with cocoa powder, cover, and chill for at least 4 hours, or overnight for the best texture. Before serving, top with the strawberries, raspberries, and finely grated dark chocolate.

title: Light Coffee-Orange Tiramisu with Greek Yogurt and Cocoa
ingredients_json: ["250 g Greek yogurt, plain, 2% fat", "250 g quark, low fat", "200 ml whipping cream, 30% fat", "40 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp orange zest", "180 ml espresso, brewed", "20 ml orange juice, unsweetened", "16 pieces ladyfinger biscuits, sponge", "12 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "10 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa"]
instructions: Combine the Greek yogurt, quark, honey, vanilla extract, and orange zest in a bowl and whisk until smooth. In a separate chilled bowl, whip the cream to soft peaks, then fold it gently into the yogurt mixture so the filling stays light and airy. Mix the espresso with the orange juice in a shallow dish and let it cool to room temperature. Quickly dip the ladyfinger biscuits one by one into the coffee mixture for about 1 second per side, because they should be moistened but not soggy. Arrange a layer of soaked biscuits in the bottom of a medium dish, spread half of the cream mixture over them, then repeat with the remaining biscuits and cream. Smooth the top with a spatula, cover the dish, and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, or overnight for the best texture. Before serving, dust the surface evenly with cocoa powder and finish with finely grated dark chocolate.

title: Salted Almond Butter Toffee with Dark Chocolate
ingredients_json: ["120 g almond butter, unsweetened", "80 g coconut sugar", "60 g honey", "30 ml water", "20 g unsalted butter", "1 g fine sea salt", "1 g vanilla extract", "40 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "20 g chopped almonds"]
instructions: Line a small square tin with baking paper and set it aside. Place the almond butter, coconut sugar, honey, water, butter and sea salt in a small heavy saucepan over medium heat. Stir constantly until the butter melts and the sugar starts to dissolve, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often, until the mixture thickens and turns a deeper caramel colour. If you have a thermometer, cook it to about 118 to 120 C for a firmer toffee. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract. Pour the hot toffee into the prepared tin and spread it quickly into an even layer. Leave it for 2 minutes, then sprinkle the chocolate over the surface and let it soften before spreading it thinly. Scatter the chopped almonds on top and press them in lightly. Allow the toffee to cool completely at room temperature, then chill for 1 hour until firm. Cut into small squares with a sharp knife.

title: Salted Almond Maple Toffee Squares
ingredients_json: ["120 g Almonds, raw", "80 g Oats, rolled", "50 g Butter, unsalted", "90 g Sugar, brown", "70 g Maple syrup", "40 g Honey", "2 ml Vanilla extract", "1 g Salt, table", "30 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "15 g Pumpkin seeds"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a small square baking tin with baking paper. Spread the almonds and rolled oats on the tray and toast them for 6 to 8 minutes until fragrant and lightly golden, then set aside. In a heavy saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter with the brown sugar, maple syrup, honey and salt. Stir steadily and bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then cook for about 4 to 6 minutes until it thickens slightly and turns a deeper caramel colour. Remove from the heat and stir in the vanilla, toasted almonds and oats. Press the mixture firmly and evenly into the prepared tin, smoothing the top with the back of a spoon. Bake for 10 minutes at 180 C until the edges are bubbling. Remove from the oven and immediately scatter over the dark chocolate. Let it sit for 2 minutes, then spread the chocolate into a thin layer and finish with the pumpkin seeds. Cool completely at room temperature, then chill until firm before cutting into small squares.

title: Salted Date and Almond Toffee Bark
ingredients_json: ["120 g Medjool dates, pitted", "80 g almonds, raw", "40 g rolled oats", "20 g unsalted butter", "30 g light brown sugar", "20 g honey", "30 ml water", "1 g fine sea salt", "1 g vanilla extract", "10 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "5 g pumpkin seeds"]
instructions: Line a small baking tray with baking paper. Chop the dates finely and set them aside. Place the butter, brown sugar, honey and water in a small saucepan over medium heat and stir until the sugar dissolves. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring often, until it becomes glossy and slightly thickened. Add the chopped dates, vanilla extract and salt, then cook for 2 minutes more, stirring constantly so the dates soften and the mixture turns sticky. Stir in the almonds and rolled oats until everything is evenly coated. Spoon the mixture onto the lined tray and press it out into a thin, even layer with the back of a spoon. Melt the dark chocolate and drizzle it over the top, then scatter the pumpkin seeds over the surface. Chill for at least 1 hour until firm, then break into pieces and serve.

title: Salted Almond Date Toffee Bark
ingredients_json: ["120 g Medjool dates, pitted", "60 g Almonds, roasted, unsalted", "80 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa solids", "25 g Tahini", "15 ml Maple syrup", "2 g Sea salt", "1 g Vanilla extract"]
instructions: Line a small tray or baking dish with baking paper. Finely chop the dates and warm them gently in a small saucepan over low heat with the tahini, maple syrup, vanilla extract, and 1 g of the salt for 2 to 3 minutes, stirring until the mixture becomes glossy and spreadable. Stir in most of the almonds, then press the mixture firmly into the lined tray in an even layer. Melt the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl set over barely simmering water, or in short bursts in the microwave, stirring until smooth. Spread the chocolate over the date layer and sprinkle with the remaining almonds and the rest of the salt. Chill for at least 1 hour, until firm, then cut or break into small pieces to serve.

title: Sea Salt Almond Butter Toffee Squares
ingredients_json: ["150 g Almonds, whole, dry roasted", "80 g Butter, unsalted", "120 g Sugar, brown", "60 g Honey", "30 ml Water", "2 g Salt, sea", "1 tsp Vanilla extract", "20 g Dark chocolate, 70% cocoa solids", "10 g Sesame seeds, whole"]
instructions: Line a small square baking tin with baking paper and spread the roasted almonds evenly over the base. Put the butter, brown sugar, honey, water and salt into a heavy saucepan and warm over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves. Bring the mixture to a steady boil and cook for about 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it turns a deep amber colour and reaches a brittle toffee stage. Remove the pan from the heat, stir in the vanilla extract, then quickly pour the hot toffee over the almonds and spread it into an even layer. Sprinkle the dark chocolate and sesame seeds over the surface while the toffee is still hot, then let them soften for a minute before gently smoothing the chocolate. Leave the toffee to cool completely at room temperature until firm, then break or cut into squares.

title: Rustic Apple and Walnut Yogurt Torte with Cinnamon
ingredients_json: ["200 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g oat flour", "120 g plain low-fat yogurt", "2 piece egg, raw", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "120 g honey", "2 medium apple, raw", "80 g walnut kernel", "10 g baking powder", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g salt", "5 ml lemon juice", "5 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and line a 22 cm springform tin with baking paper. Whisk the eggs, yogurt, rapeseed oil, honey, lemon juice and vanilla extract together until smooth. In a separate bowl mix the wholemeal flour, oat flour, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until combined, then spread the batter evenly into the tin. Core the apples, slice them thinly and arrange them over the batter in overlapping circles. Roughly chop the walnuts and sprinkle them over the top. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the torte is golden brown and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. Let it cool in the tin for 15 minutes, then release the springform and cool fully before slicing.

title: Hazelnut Chocolate and Raspberry Wholegrain Torte
ingredients_json: ["120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "80 g ground hazelnuts", "30 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "120 g sugar", "8 g baking powder", "2 g salt", "3 pieces egg, raw", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "150 ml low-fat milk", "5 ml vanilla extract", "200 g raspberry, fresh", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "15 g honey", "20 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa", "10 g powdered sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a 20 cm springform tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, ground hazelnuts, cocoa powder, sugar, baking powder, and salt. In a second bowl, beat the eggs with the rapeseed oil, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir just until combined. Spread the batter evenly into the prepared tin and scatter half of the raspberries over the top. Bake for 28 to 32 minutes, until the centre is just set and a skewer comes out with a few moist crumbs. Let the cake cool completely in the tin, then transfer to a serving plate. Mix the yogurt with honey and spread it over the top in a thin layer. Arrange the remaining raspberries on the yogurt and finish with finely grated dark chocolate and a light dusting of powdered sugar. Chill for 30 minutes before slicing so the torte holds its shape.

title: Lemon Almond Yogurt Torte with Blueberry Compote
ingredients_json: ["150 g wholemeal flour", "100 g ground almonds", "120 g rolled oats", "80 g raw cane sugar", "2 tsp baking powder", "1 g salt", "3 piece egg, raw", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "80 ml rapeseed oil", "2 piece lemon zest", "60 ml lemon juice", "300 g blueberries, fresh", "20 g chia seeds", "40 ml water", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "30 g sliced almonds"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line a 22 cm round springform tin with baking paper. Mix the wholemeal flour, ground almonds, rolled oats, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs, yogurt, rapeseed oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, and vanilla extract until smooth. Stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients just until combined, then scrape the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top. Scatter the sliced almonds over the surface. Bake for 28 to 32 minutes, until the torte is golden and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. While it bakes, simmer the blueberries with the water over medium heat for 6 to 8 minutes, then stir in the chia seeds and cook for 2 minutes more until lightly thickened. Cool the torte in the tin for 10 minutes, then transfer to a rack and let it cool completely. Serve slices topped with the blueberry compote.

title: Wholemeal Almond Pear Torte with Greek Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["200 g pear, fresh, raw", "3 piece egg, raw", "120 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "90 g wholemeal wheat flour", "60 g almond flour", "70 g cane sugar", "30 ml rapeseed oil", "8 g baking powder", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "2 g cinnamon, ground", "1 g salt", "15 g almond flakes", "10 ml lemon juice", "5 g icing sugar"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and line a 20 cm springform tin with baking paper. Whisk the eggs and cane sugar together for 2 to 3 minutes until pale and slightly thickened, then mix in the yogurt, rapeseed oil, vanilla, lemon juice, and salt. In a separate bowl combine the wholemeal flour, almond flour, baking powder, and cinnamon. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until combined, then scrape the batter into the prepared tin. Peel, core, and slice the pears, arrange them neatly over the top, and scatter with almond flakes. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes on the middle rack until the torte is golden and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean or with a few moist crumbs. Let it cool in the tin for 15 minutes, then transfer to a rack to cool fully. Dust lightly with icing sugar before serving, and serve small slices with extra Greek yogurt if desired.

title: Lemon Almond Berry Torte with Greek Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["200 g ground almonds", "60 g wholemeal flour", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "3 piece egg, raw", "90 g honey", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "2 piece lemon zest", "30 ml lemon juice", "8 g baking powder", "2 g salt", "200 g mixed berries, fresh", "150 g quark, low fat", "20 g icing sugar", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 175 C and line a 20 cm springform cake tin with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs, honey, Greek yogurt, rapeseed oil, lemon zest, lemon juice and vanilla until smooth. Stir in the ground almonds, wholemeal flour, baking powder and salt until just combined, then fold in 120 g of the berries. Spoon the batter into the tin and level the surface. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the torte is golden on top and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. Let it cool in the tin for 15 minutes, then remove and cool completely on a wire rack. Mix the quark with the icing sugar until creamy. Spread the yogurt cream over the cooled torte and top with the remaining berries. Chill for at least 30 minutes before slicing so the texture sets neatly.

title: Dark Chocolate Almond Date Truffles with Orange and Oats
ingredients_json: ["180 g Medjool dates, pitted", "80 g almonds, blanched", "30 g rolled oats", "20 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "15 g chia seeds", "20 g almond butter", "1 tsp orange zest", "15 ml orange juice", "1 g fine salt", "10 g unsweetened cocoa powder, for coating", "10 g desiccated coconut, unsweetened, for coating"]
instructions: Place the almonds in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped, but not oily. Add the dates, rolled oats, cocoa powder, chia seeds, almond butter, orange zest, orange juice, and salt, then process until the mixture becomes sticky and holds together when pressed between your fingers. If the mixture feels too dry, let it rest for 5 minutes so the oats and chia can absorb moisture, then pulse again briefly. Scoop out small portions and roll into 16 even balls with lightly damp hands. Roll half the truffles in cocoa powder and the other half in desiccated coconut. Chill them on a lined tray for at least 30 minutes until firm before serving.

title: Dark Chocolate Almond Date Truffles with Orange and Sea Salt
ingredients_json: ["180 g dates, dried, pitted", "80 g almonds, raw", "25 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "20 g oat flakes, dry", "30 g almond butter, unsweetened", "20 ml orange juice, freshly squeezed", "1 tsp orange zest, fresh", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "10 g chia seeds", "5 g cocoa powder, unsweetened, for coating", "8 g coconut, desiccated, unsweetened, for coating", "1 g salt, sea"]
instructions: Place the almonds and oat flakes in a food processor and pulse until finely ground. Add the dates, cocoa powder, almond butter, orange juice, orange zest, vanilla extract, chia seeds, and sea salt. Blend until the mixture is sticky and holds together when pressed between your fingers. If it looks too dry, add 1 teaspoon of water at a time until it forms a smooth dough. Chill the mixture for 15 minutes so it is easier to shape. Roll into 16 small balls, about 20 g each, then coat half of them in cocoa powder and the rest in desiccated coconut. Set the truffles on a tray and chill for at least 30 minutes before serving so they firm up. Serve slightly cool for the best texture.

title: Dark Chocolate Almond Truffles with Dates and Orange Zest
ingredients_json: ["150 g Medjool dates, pitted", "80 g almonds, roasted", "25 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "20 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa solids", "30 g rolled oats", "15 g almond butter", "1 tsp orange zest, fresh", "1 tbsp water", "15 g coconut flakes, unsweetened"]
instructions: Place the dates in a bowl and cover them with hot water for 10 minutes if they feel dry, then drain well. Add the almonds and rolled oats to a food processor and pulse until finely chopped but not oily. Add the dates, cocoa powder, dark chocolate, almond butter, orange zest, and water, then process until the mixture becomes sticky and holds together when pressed between your fingers. If it looks too crumbly, add another small splash of water and pulse again. Chill the mixture for 15 minutes so it is easier to roll. Shape the mixture into 16 small balls, then roll them in the coconut flakes until lightly coated. Refrigerate the truffles for at least 30 minutes before serving so they firm up and the flavours settle.

title: Dark Chocolate Almond Date Truffles
ingredients_json: ["180 g dates, dried, pitted", "80 g almonds, whole, blanched", "25 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "30 g oats, rolled, dry", "20 g almond butter, unsalted", "30 ml water", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 g salt", "20 g coconut, desiccated, unsweetened"]
instructions: Place the almonds and oats in a food processor and pulse until finely ground but not completely pasty. Add the dates, cocoa powder, almond butter, water, vanilla extract, and salt, then blend until the mixture comes together into a sticky dough. If it seems too dry, add a little more water, 5 ml at a time, until it holds when pressed. Chill the mixture for 15 minutes to make rolling easier. Scoop out small portions and roll into 16 even truffles with lightly damp hands. Roll each truffle in the desiccated coconut until coated. Chill the truffles for at least 30 minutes before serving so they firm up and the flavor deepens.

title: Dark Chocolate Almond Truffles with Orange and Oats
ingredients_json: ["120 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa solids", "80 g rolled oats", "60 g almond butter, unsweetened", "80 ml skim milk", "20 g honey", "1 tsp orange zest, fresh", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "10 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "15 g ground almonds"]
instructions: Place the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl. Warm the skim milk in a small saucepan over low heat until steaming but not boiling, then pour it over the chocolate and let it sit for 2 minutes. Stir gently until smooth. Mix in the almond butter, honey, orange zest, and vanilla extract until evenly combined. Add the rolled oats and stir well. Cover and chill the mixture for about 45 minutes, or until firm enough to shape. Scoop and roll into 16 small balls with cool hands. Roll half of the truffles in cocoa powder and the other half in ground almonds. Chill for another 15 minutes before serving so they hold their shape and the flavours settle.

title: Caramelized Pear and Oat Upside-Down Cake
ingredients_json: ["2 medium pear, fresh", "20 g unsalted butter", "25 g brown sugar", "1 tbsp lemon juice", "120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "40 g rolled oats", "50 g plain yogurt, low fat", "2 piece egg, raw", "70 g honey", "45 ml rapeseed oil", "60 ml semi-skimmed milk", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "1 g salt"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a 20 cm round cake tin. Peel the pears, remove the cores, and cut them into thin wedges. Melt the butter in a small pan over low heat, stir in the brown sugar and lemon juice, then cook for 1 minute until glossy. Spread this mixture over the base of the tin and arrange the pear slices neatly on top. In a bowl, whisk the eggs, honey, yogurt, rapeseed oil, milk, and vanilla until smooth. In a second bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until combined, then spoon the batter evenly over the pears. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the top is golden and a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean. Let the cake cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then run a knife around the edge and invert it onto a plate while still warm so the pear topping releases cleanly.

title: Wholemeal Apple and Cinnamon Upside-Down Cake
ingredients_json: ["2 medium apple, with skin, raw", "20 g unsalted butter", "25 g light brown sugar", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "150 g wholemeal wheat flour", "50 g plain wheat flour", "8 g baking powder", "2 g salt", "2 piece egg, raw", "120 ml low-fat milk, 1.5% fat", "60 g plain yogurt, low fat", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "80 g caster sugar", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "10 ml lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a 20 cm round cake tin. Peel, core, and slice the apples into thin wedges, then toss them with the lemon juice and cinnamon. Melt the butter with the brown sugar in a small pan over low heat until the sugar starts to dissolve, then spread this mixture over the base of the tin. Arrange the apple slices neatly on top in overlapping circles. In a large bowl, whisk together the wholemeal flour, plain flour, baking powder, and salt. In another bowl, whisk the eggs with the caster sugar until slightly pale, then mix in the milk, yogurt, rapeseed oil, and vanilla extract. Stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients just until combined; do not overmix. Spoon the batter gently over the apples and level the surface. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the cake is golden, springy to the touch, and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. Let the cake cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then run a knife around the edge and invert it onto a plate while still warm so the apples release cleanly. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Pear and Oat Upside-Down Cake with Cinnamon and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g pear, raw, with skin", "20 g light brown sugar", "15 g unsalted butter", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "60 g rolled oats", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat, unsweetened", "2 pieces egg, raw", "50 g honey", "40 ml rapeseed oil", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 g salt", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "30 ml semi-skimmed milk"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a 20 cm round cake tin. Peel, core, and slice the pears into even wedges. Melt the butter in a small pan over low heat, stir in the brown sugar and cinnamon, then spread this mixture over the base of the tin. Arrange the pear slices neatly on top in a single overlapping layer. In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, yogurt, honey, rapeseed oil, milk, and vanilla until smooth. In a second bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, baking powder, and salt. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until combined, then spoon the batter gently over the pears and smooth the surface. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the cake is golden, springy to the touch, and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. Let it cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then run a knife around the edge and invert onto a plate while still warm so the pears release cleanly. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Apricot and Oat Upside-Down Cake with Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["300 g apricots, fresh, pitted", "20 g unsalted butter", "20 g light brown sugar", "150 g plain wholemeal flour", "50 g rolled oats", "60 g light brown sugar", "8 g baking powder", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g salt", "2 pieces egg, raw", "150 g plain yogurt, low fat", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "40 ml semi-skimmed milk", "5 ml vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line the base of a 20 cm round cake tin with baking paper. Melt the butter and spread it over the paper, then sprinkle the 20 g of light brown sugar evenly over the base. Arrange the apricot halves cut-side down in a single layer, packing them closely together. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs with the remaining sugar, yogurt, rapeseed oil, milk and vanilla until smooth. In another bowl, mix the wholemeal flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon and salt. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until combined; do not overmix. Spoon the batter over the apricots and level the surface. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the top is golden and a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. Leave the cake in the tin for 10 minutes, then run a knife around the edge and invert onto a serving plate while still warm so the fruit layer sits neatly on top. Cool slightly before slicing.

title: Pear and Oat Upside-Down Cake with Cinnamon and Yogurt
ingredients_json: ["2 pieces pear, raw", "20 g unsalted butter", "15 g brown sugar", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "120 g plain wholemeal flour", "60 g rolled oats", "80 g plain yogurt, low fat", "2 pieces egg, raw", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "70 g honey", "1 tsp baking powder", "0.5 tsp bicarbonate of soda", "1 g salt", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "30 ml milk, semi-skimmed"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and lightly grease a 20 cm round cake tin. Melt the butter and spread it over the base of the tin, then sprinkle the brown sugar and cinnamon evenly on top. Peel, core, and slice the pears, then arrange them closely over the sugar mixture in a neat layer. In a large bowl, whisk the eggs with the honey, yogurt, rapeseed oil, milk, and vanilla until smooth. In a separate bowl, combine the wholemeal flour, rolled oats, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, and salt. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until no dry flour remains, being careful not to overmix. Spoon the batter over the pears and smooth the surface. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the cake is golden, well risen, and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. Let it cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then run a knife around the edge and invert onto a serving plate so the pears sit on top. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Whole Wheat Pumpkin Whoopie Pies with Greek Yogurt Vanilla Filling
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "80 g oat flour", "1 tsp baking soda", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp ground cinnamon", "0.5 tsp ground ginger", "0.25 tsp ground nutmeg", "0.25 tsp salt", "120 g pumpkin purée", "80 g plain Greek yogurt", "80 g light brown sugar", "50 g maple syrup", "1 piece egg, raw", "30 ml rapeseed oil", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "120 g plain Greek yogurt", "80 g low-fat cream cheese", "25 g powdered sugar", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "1 tsp lemon juice"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, oat flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, and salt. In a second bowl, mix the pumpkin purée, Greek yogurt, brown sugar, maple syrup, egg, rapeseed oil, and vanilla extract until smooth. Fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until combined, then let the batter rest for 5 minutes so it thickens slightly. Drop heaped tablespoons of batter onto the trays, leaving space between each one, and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the cakes are springy to the touch and the tops look set. Cool completely on a wire rack. For the filling, beat together the Greek yogurt, low-fat cream cheese, powdered sugar, vanilla extract, and lemon juice until creamy and smooth. Spread or pipe the filling onto the flat side of half the cakes, then top with the remaining cakes to make sandwiches. Chill the whoopie pies for 20 minutes before serving so the filling firms up.

title: Whole Wheat Pumpkin Whoopie Pies with Greek Yogurt Cream Filling
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "60 g oat flour", "5 g baking powder", "3 g baking soda", "2 g ground cinnamon", "1 g ground ginger", "1 g fine salt", "120 g pumpkin puree", "80 g brown sugar", "60 ml rapeseed oil", "1 piece egg, raw", "5 ml vanilla extract", "60 ml low fat milk", "150 g Greek yogurt, plain, low fat", "60 g light cream cheese", "25 g honey", "2 g vanilla extract", "10 g powdered sugar", "15 g chopped walnuts"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line two baking trays with parchment paper. In a medium bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, oat flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, and salt. In a second bowl, beat the pumpkin puree, brown sugar, rapeseed oil, egg, vanilla extract, and milk until smooth. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir just until combined; the batter should be thick and spoonable. Drop 20 equal mounds of batter onto the trays, leaving space between each one, and gently flatten the tops with the back of a spoon. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the cakes spring back lightly when touched and the edges look set. Cool them on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. For the filling, whisk the Greek yogurt, light cream cheese, honey, vanilla extract, and powdered sugar until smooth and creamy, then fold in the chopped walnuts. Spread filling on the flat side of half the cakes and sandwich with the remaining cakes. Chill for 20 minutes before serving so the filling firms up slightly.

title: Oatmeal Chocolate Whoopie Pies with Greek Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["120 g rolled oats", "120 g wholemeal wheat flour", "30 g cocoa powder, unsweetened", "1 tsp baking powder", "1 tsp bicarbonate of soda", "2 g salt", "80 g unsalted butter, softened", "80 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "120 ml low-fat buttermilk", "120 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "60 g cream cheese, reduced fat", "40 g honey", "1 tsp vanilla extract", "40 g dark chocolate chips"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 degrees C and line two baking trays with baking paper. Blitz the oats briefly so they are partly ground but still slightly textured. In a bowl, whisk together the oats, wholemeal flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda, and salt. In a separate bowl, beat the butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy, then mix in the egg and vanilla extract. Stir in the dry ingredients alternately with the buttermilk until you have a thick batter. Fold in the dark chocolate chips. Drop heaped tablespoonfuls of batter onto the trays, leaving space between each one, and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the tops spring back gently when touched. Cool on the trays for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack until completely cold. For the filling, beat the Greek yogurt, cream cheese, honey, and vanilla extract until smooth and spreadable. Pair the cooled cakes by size, spread the filling on the flat side of one cake, and sandwich with another. Chill for 20 minutes before serving so the filling firms up slightly.

title: Whole Wheat Chocolate Banana Whoopie Pies with Greek Yogurt Cream
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "25 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "5 g baking powder", "2 g baking soda", "2 g salt", "60 g unsalted butter, softened", "80 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "1 piece ripe banana, mashed", "120 ml plain low-fat yogurt", "60 ml skim milk", "5 ml vanilla extract", "150 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "25 g honey", "10 g cocoa powder", "2 g vanilla extract"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180 C and line two baking trays with parchment paper. In a bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. In a separate large bowl, beat the softened butter and brown sugar until smooth and slightly fluffy. Mix in the egg, mashed banana, yogurt, skim milk, and vanilla extract until well combined. Add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and stir just until the batter comes together; do not overmix. Spoon or pipe small rounds of batter onto the prepared trays, leaving space between each one, and bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the tops spring back lightly when touched. Cool the cookies on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer them to a rack to cool completely. For the filling, stir the Greek yogurt, honey, cocoa powder, and vanilla extract together until smooth and thick. Spread or pipe the filling onto the flat side of half the cakes, then sandwich with the remaining cakes. Chill the whoopie pies for 20 minutes before serving so the filling firms up slightly.

title: Whole Wheat Chocolate Banana Whoopie Pies with Greek Yogurt Filling
ingredients_json: ["180 g whole wheat flour", "40 g unsweetened cocoa powder", "8 g baking powder", "2 g baking soda", "2 g fine salt", "80 g ripe banana, mashed", "70 g light brown sugar", "1 piece egg, raw", "40 ml rapeseed oil", "120 ml low-fat milk", "5 ml vanilla extract", "150 g plain Greek yogurt, low fat", "60 g reduced-fat cream cheese", "25 g honey", "10 ml lemon juice", "1 g vanilla extract", "15 g dark chocolate, 70% cocoa, grated"]
instructions: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line two baking trays with baking paper. In a large bowl, whisk together the whole wheat flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until evenly combined. In a second bowl, mix the mashed banana, brown sugar, egg, rapeseed oil, milk, and vanilla extract until smooth. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture just until a thick batter forms. Let the batter rest for 5 minutes so it thickens slightly. Spoon 18 small mounds of batter onto the trays, leaving space between them, and flatten them very lightly with the back of a spoon. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the tops spring back when gently touched. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely. For the filling, beat the Greek yogurt, cream cheese, honey, lemon juice, and vanilla until smooth and creamy, then chill for 10 minutes if it feels too soft. Sandwich the filling between two cooled cakes to make 9 whoopie pies, and finish with a light sprinkle of grated dark chocolate.
